###### Integrating Custom Analysis Commands with NetViewer
For custom analysis commands to integrate with the rest of NetViewer, Input.aspx and Execute.aspx must follow a set of rules: 
  * If the command requires input, Input.aspx must provide a user interface that lets the user execute the analysis function when they have finished entering the minimum amount of input. 
  * When the user activates this user interface, Input.aspx must load the Execute.aspx page. 
  * If the command requires state changes within NetViewer, Input.aspx must, while it is still active, call client-side functions that cause an immediate state change. 
  * When Execute.aspx has finished processing, it calls server-side functions to trigger specific state changes (zoom to specific area and select a specific feature) and then calls the NetAnalysisComplete function to transfer control and the analysis results back to NetViewer. 
  * Before the Input.aspx page loads Execute.aspx, it must tell NetViewer to switch to the wait cursor while the analysis function is executing. This is done by the SetWait function available as part of the set of client-side APIs. 
  * Input.aspx and Execute.aspx can get needed information about the current state of NetViewer through a set of public server-side session variables. 

  
|  Session Variables  |  Description   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Public.AreaOfInterestFID  |  The FID of the currently active Area Of Interest (AOI). If there is no current AOI, this value is 0.   |  
|  Public.AreaOfInterestFNO  |  The FNO of the currently active Area Of Interest (AOI). If there is no current AOI, this value is 0.   |  
|  Public.AreaOfInterestLI  |  The value of the currently active Area Of Interest Location Identifier (AOILI). If there is no current AOI or if the active AOI has no location identifier, this value is the empty string.   |  
|  Public.Configuration  |  The configuration that the user is currently viewing. If your configurations are properly set up in [G3E_DATACONNECTION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XVSORnBdhQjIxL9aNJ0TPw), you can use this variable to determine whether you are running a desktop NetViewer configuration or a field Field Review configuration.   |  
|  Public.DisplayScaleDenominator  |  The map scale denominator that the map is currently zoomed to.   |  
|  Public.DistUnit  |  The unit of measure used for displaying distances within NetViewer. This value comes from the [G3E_UNITFORMAT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA) metadata table. You set this value for all users.   |  
|  Public.Job  |  The job that the user is currently viewing. If the user is not in a job context, this value is set to Null.   |  
|  Public.LicenseToken  |  LicenseToken needed when calling NetViewer COM object APIs.   |  
|  Public.MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel  |  Defines whether measurements performed within NetViewer take the curvature of the earth into account (true) or are done directly with respect to the projection (false).   |  
|  Public.RedlineSymbolFonts  |  Defines the list of symbol fonts available for use in the redlines. The content of this variable is configured using the RedlineFontsOption and the RedlineSymbolOption Customize.inc variables.   |  
|  Public.RedlineTextFonts  |  Defines the list of text fonts available for use in the redlines. The content of this variable is configured using the RedlineFontsOption and the RedlineTextOption Customize.inc variables.   |  
|  Public.SelectedCID  |  The CID of the currently selected feature. If there is not a currently selected feature, this value is 0.   |  
|  Public.SelectedCNO  |  The CNO of the currently selected feature. If there is not a currently selected feature, this value is 0.   |  
|  Public.SelectedFID  |  The FID of the currently selected feature. If there is not a currently selected feature, this value is 0.   |  
|  Public.SelectedFNO  |  The FNO of the currently selected feature. If there is not a currently selected feature, this value is 0.   |  
|  Public.Username  |  The username that the user has logged in using.   |  
|  Public.ViewHeight  |  Height of the current map in pixels.   |  
|  Public.ViewWidth  |  Width of the current map in pixels.   |  
|  Public.WorldLLX  |  Lower left X coordinate of the current map view in world (DDC) units.   |  
|  Public.WorldLLY  |  Lower left Y coordinate of the current map view in world (DDC) units.   |  
|  Public.WorldURX  |  Upper right X coordinate of the current map view in world (DDC) units.   |  
|  Public.WorldURY  |  Upper right Y coordinate of the current map view in world (DDC) units.   |  
Application Scope Variables
To determine if a client is running a connected NetViewer configuration or a disconnected Field Review configuration, you can use the Public.Configuration variable (listed avobe), or you can use the RunDisconnected application scope variable in ASP.NET. 
For .NET .aspx in C#, use 
HttpContext _context = HttpContext.Current; bool bRunDisconnected = (bool)_context.Application.Get("RunDisconnected");
For ASP in JavaScript, use
var bRunDisconnected = Application.Contents["RunDisconnected"];

###### Quick Reference Find in NetViewer
Quick Reference Finds are exposed on the Analysis panel of NetViewer. 
When the user selects an entry on the Analysis panel, that panel is replaced with another page that gathers the input attribute values of the user for the query. Bold labeled attributes are required, non-bold labeled attributes are optional. 
The results of the find can be displayed on the map and/or in a report window below the map as defined in metadata. The details of how the find results are symbolized on the map and whether the map is adjusted based on these results is defined also in metadata and can be changed by the user on the Analysis Options panel. 
You can suppress display of the results on the map until the user selects a feature from the find results report, including the suppression of the Analysis Options panel. 
On the Analysis panel, ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262743) denotes that an AOILI is required. For AOILI-required entries, if no AOILI is currently defined, the entry is disabled. Within NetViewer, an AOILI is defined using the Area Manager panel. 
If, while performing an AOI-constrained quick-reference find, the AOI threshold value is exceeded, users without sufficient privilege cannot perform the query. This lets you keep users from overwhelming the database and/or the map server. Users with sufficient privilege receive a warning, but can continue processing. 
Metadata
The following metadata is required to expose Quick Reference Find in NetViewer: 
  * [G3E_NETCLASSES](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/MWQ8JnP~eAz5sVyDgqfuAA)
Add a row to this table to define a class of analysis commands that includes these finds. 
  * [G3E_NETPAGES](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/U_jTtX9ywikMmvnfKR~U_w)
    * Add a row to this table for each quick- reference find.
    * The G3E_OPTIMIZED_TABLE column needs to contain G3E_FINDQUICK_OPTABLE.
    * The G3E_KEYFIELD column must contain G3E_QNO.
    * The G3E_ROWID column must contain the value of the G3E_QNO corresponding row of the quick-reference find you want to expose. 
  * [G3E_NETANALYSISOPTIONS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/o0P9Sdj7anCtwmlE9N4WOg)
Add a row to this table defining how the results are going to be displayed.


In addition, Quick Reference Find uses the find-feature metadata defined in the following tables: 
  * [G3E_FINDQUICK](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AoGKL7_Ay5AepP5qmfgKLA)
  * [G3E_FINDQUICKATTRIBUTE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/A6ETowTBPX9zvWT8Z7r15w)
  * [G3E_FINDMETHOD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/~yh_nP3UzVZyGCMF8WCpQg)
  * [G3E_ATTRIBUTE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)

###### Report Formats
NetViewer provides many types of [analysis functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg). These analysis functions can optionally produce HTML reports the user can view. The HTML is generated from XML that was generated by the given analysis function. A configurable XSLT stylesheet (.xsl file) dictates the format and style of these HTML reports. The [View Pairs report](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SgyZsy4P3TYRfkh_DTfrrA) is is an example of a report that uses the default stylesheet. 
The G3E_OUTPUTXSL field of the [G3E_NETANALYSISOPTIONS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/o0P9Sdj7anCtwmlE9N4WOg) metadata table defines the XSLT stylesheet that is used. 
When you customize the XSLT stylesheet, the HTML include must include DHTML event handlers so your report allows feature selection. These event handlers have the following JScript function signatures: 
onclick=OnClickRow(this,FNO,FID,CNO,CID) 
ondblclick=OnDblClickRow(this,FNO,FID,CNO,CID)
CNO and CID are optional. Feature selection from a report is only available when the report displays in the BOTTOM frame as defined by the G3E_OUTPUTFRAME field of the [G3E_NETANALYSISOPTIONS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/o0P9Sdj7anCtwmlE9N4WOg) metadata table. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262698) You need to port the embedded script code in a custom XSL to the .NET variation of the language used (JScript to JScript.NET or VBScript to VB.NET).

###### Simple Attribute Query Metadata
NetViewer uses all of the existing simple attribute query metadata as defined in [G3E_ATTRIBUTEQUERY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/zk79M~vl5q_AJkS_5B~YXw) and [G3E_SIMPLEQUERYATTRIBUTE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/uJ3P5mNw~7NA~Kusg1kA8Q). The following is metadata is required to expose simple attribute query within NetViewer: 
  * Add a row to [G3E_NETCLASSES](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/MWQ8JnP~eAz5sVyDgqfuAA) to define a class of analysis commands that includes these queries. 
  * Add a row to [G3E_NETPAGES](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/U_jTtX9ywikMmvnfKR~U_w) for each simple attribute query. The G3E_OPTIMIZED_TABLE column needs to contain [G3E_ATTRIBUTEQUERY_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/x2qQTnSoqATWfciY5O_sgw). The G3E_KEYFIELD column must contain G3E_QNO and the G3E_ROWID column must contain the value of the G3E_QNO corresponding row of the Simple Attribute Query to expose. 
  * Add a row to [G3E_NETANALYSISOPTIONS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/o0P9Sdj7anCtwmlE9N4WOg) defining how the results are going to be displayed.

###### Simple Attribute Query
Within NetViewer, you expose simple attribute queries through the Analysis panel. 
Attributes are supplied when the user selects an entry on the Analysis panel. Bold labeled attributes are required, non-bold labeled attributes are optional. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262736)
The results of the query can be displayed on the map and/or in a report window below the map as defined in metadata. The details of how the query results are symbolized on the map and whether the map is adjusted based on these results is defined in metadata and can be optionally changed by the user using the Analysis Options panel. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/eQS_ORXp3qW6dAb9kOP~vw-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=537c8935db72db1f&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
On the Analysis panel, the ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262736) denotes an AOILI is required and the ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262736) denotes an AOI is required (see Area Management for further explanation of AOI and AOILI). For AOI required entries, if no AOI is currently defined, the entry is disabled. For AOILI required entries, if no AOILI is currently defined, the entry is disabled. Within NetViewer, an AOI or AOILI is defined using the Area Manager panel. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262736)
If, while performing an AOI-constrained simple attribute query, the AOI Threshold value is exceeded, users without sufficient privilege cannot perform the query. This provides a mechanism for you to keep users from overwhelming the database and/or the Map Server. Users with sufficient privilege receive a warning, but can continue processing.

###### Trace Metadata
Trace functionality in NetViewer uses all of the existing trace metadata as defined in [G3E_TRACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/trnr4poliwRg4MV7egOufg) and the other supporting trace metadata tables. 
The following metadata is required to expose Trace within NetViewer: 
  * [G3E_NETCLASSES](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/MWQ8JnP~eAz5sVyDgqfuAA)


Add a row to this table to define a class of analysis commands that includes trace.
  * [G3E_NETPAGES](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/U_jTtX9ywikMmvnfKR~U_w)
    * Add a row to this table for each trace.
    * The G3E_OPTIMIZED_TABLE column needs to contain [G3E_TRACEMAPPING_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WgCoNlKft~FyxvOufQfBwA). 
    * The G3E_KEYFIELD column must contain G3E_TRACEID.
    * The G3E_ROWID column must contain the value of the G3E_TRACEID corresponding row of the trace to expose. 
  * [G3E_NETANALYSISOPTIONS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/o0P9Sdj7anCtwmlE9N4WOg)
Add a row to this table defining how the results are going to be displayed.

###### Trace
You expose trace functionality in NetViewer through the Analysis panel. 
NetViewer can trace from the selected feature outward until the stop criterion is reached. You can specify an ending feature or a hint to define the trace direction from the selected feature. Additionally, filter criteria, stop criteria, and path cost can contain user-supplied attributes. 
If the trace is defined to require a hint feature, the user is prompted to select a feature. This feature can be selected directly from the map or through Feature Explorer's relationship navigation. 
If the trace is defined to require an ending feature the user is prompted to select a feature. This feature can be selected directly from the map or through Feature Explorer's relationship navigation. 
If the trace is defined to allow user-substitutable attributes for filter criteria, stop criteria and/or path cost, a page is presented that allows the user to enter the attributes. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262755)

###### Viewer OTDR or Distance-Based Trace Interfaces
OTDR or distance-based trace functionality for NetViewernd Field Reviewis generally the same as is [delivered for ](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0I_atMRKHMJ1LFN~0djfAQ)Designer/Analyst. For example, the [metadata for the delivered](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/_ANwKmiCemPQ03M57NiRBg) Compute Marker Location and Compute Geo Point is the same for the viewer applications and Designer/Analyst product.   
|  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262761) Delivered OTDR solutions require the .NET Framework. If necessary, you can [rerun setup](javascript:;) to install the .NET Framework. After the .NET Framework is installed, select Repair on the installation screen to install the required [.NET assemblies ](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/262761)for the OTDR functionality.  A collection of functionality built, versioned, and deployed as a single implementation unit. It is the primary building block of a .NET application.  AssemblyName:TypeName where AssemblyName is the name of the file name of the assembly containing the .NET custom extension and TypeName is the type name (namespace.classname) of the .NET custom extension.   |  
| --- |  
The following are differences with regard to Designer/Analyst: 
  * The Marker Location Report interface is implemented as ASP instead of COM.
  * The markers are placed as redlines instead of temporary geometries.
  * The marker creation is done by the Marker Location Report interface instead of a separate Create Marker Location interface implementation.

###### Filtering the List of Legends Example
|  Example function GetAdditionalLegendFilter( oLegendRS ) { // Filter the G3EALLPROD configuration legend choices down to just the // Electric Design and Network legends. Note that the Gas legend (G3E_LNO<>6)is filtered out. if (Session.Contents("Public.Configuration") == "G3EALLPROD") return "G3E_LNO<>6"; else return ""; } function GetDefaultLegendNumber( oLegendRS ) { // Override the default legend for G3EALLPROD; make it be the Network legend if (Session.Contents("Public.Configuration") == "G3EALLPROD") return 2; // Network legend G3E_LNO is 2. else return -1; }  |

###### High-Resolution Printing
Both NetViewer and Field Review let you turn high-resolution printing on and off and to control the quality of the printed map with two variables in the [Customize.inc](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0oS4fFcocoNaavR2SoHH9g) file: 
HiResPrint
HiResPrintMagnification
These variables define the quality of the printed map. If HiResPrint is set to False, the printed map is printed at screen resolution. If set to True, the resolution of the printed map is magnified by the HiResPrintMagnification value. A higher magnification value results in a higher quality print. However, a higher magnification also increases processing time and memory usage. And for NetViewer, a higher magnification means increased time for transmitting a larger file from server to client. To manage this increased time, do not set the magnification level too high (not more than 10) or the image may have a resolution that is higher than your printer supports. The following shows an example setting: 
var HiResPrint : boolean = true; 
var HiResPrintMagnification : int = 3;
For NetViewer, high quality printing is off by default. For Field Review, high quality printing on with a default magnification of 3x. 
To get Internet Explorer to print higher resolution images, turn off the Internet Explorer option Enable Automatic Image Resizing.

###### Jobs and Job Filtering
NetViewer lets each user [filter jobs](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/zsW0HKRlPQsuf0_UW8ffJw) to view only their jobs and/or select from a list of filters with attributes that you define. 
You can configure the following NetViewer items related to jobs and job filtering: 
  * The job table fields displayed on the Jobs panel
You can define which fields appear, their order of presentation, and the name used in the column header. 
To customize the fields that display in the Job List, type G3E_NETJOBS in the [G3E_DIALOG.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/JliNbi7cNRgf~rtlez7_mw) field. This type is like the G3E_JOBENVIRONMENT value used by Designer. This row references an entry in [G3E_DIALOGTAB](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wXkC~0Yh2gPmOfwMdoVKOA) that defines which job table fields display. 
If there is no G3E_NETJOBS dialog type, the software looks for one of the following Designer dialog types in the order listed: G3E_JOBENVIRONMENT, G3E_NEWJOB, and G3E_EDITJOB. 
  * The format and style of the list of jobs
To customize the job list presentation (for example, fonts or colors) on the Jobs panel, edit the JobsList.xsl XMLT file delivered in the \GTechnology\Program\GNetViewerApp\Customize folder. 
  * The number of jobs presented on each page in a multipage presentation
To configure the number of jobs presented on each page of the multipage presentation, modify the JobPageSize variable within [Customize.inc](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/tpBazqCVN~asUttpBiSBoQ). The default is 20 jobs per page. 


Jobs Metadata
The following metadata lets you control jobs and job filtering in NetViewer: 
  * [G3E_NETJOBFILTER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GgE6CQIJTshfBLcjkGh19A)
This table controls the list of job filters defined. It contains the name of the filter, the presentation order of the filters and the actual filter. 
  * [G3E_NETJOBFILTERATTR](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wXkC~0Yh2gPmOfwMdoVKOA)
This table contains user-definable attributes for the job filter. You use this table to define the association to an existing attribute defined in [G3E_ATTRIBUTE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw), whether the attribute is required or optional, the order of the attributes, and the label or prompt for that attribute.

###### Legends and Display Control
In addition to configuring the legend through metadata, in NetViewer you can also [filter the list of legends](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TRKwaWWAiKltaAo2zuFI1w). 
To set the Display Control so the user cannot turn off display scale processing for a legend entry, use the G3E_DisplayControlDisplayScaleEnabled behavioral role in [G3E_ROLEASSOCIATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/zh3qB4osHGP2VkpCluxGBg).

###### Managing Legends
Map servers cache legends and their (per user) overrides. The following strategies result in fewer user overrides to track and ensure that features are drawn to the appropriate scale: 
  * Design legends that most users want to use without alteration.
  * Create only a small number of legends.
  * Use appropriate zoom scale for all entries.
  * Customize NetViewer to prevent the user from turning off zoom scale display.

###### Measurements, Readouts, and Key-ins for Viewer Applications
NetViewer and Field Review provide functionality for ad hoc measurement, measurement along a feature, precision map coordinate readout, alternate coordinate system readouts, and precision coordinate key- in. Several aspects of this functionality can be customized.   
|  Example
  * The MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel option in [Customize.inc](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0oS4fFcocoNaavR2SoHH9g), is used to determine the default measurement 
    * on the projection plane or take the curvature of the earth into consideration.
  * The ReadoutKeyinCoordSystemDefault option in [Customize.inc](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0oS4fFcocoNaavR2SoHH9g) is used to specify the default coordinate system to be used for readouts and key-ins. 

 |  
| --- |  
The [G3E_UNITFORMAT table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA) contains the information you need to format distance and coordinate values for presentation to the user. Each row in the table defines the unit and format information for all types of coordinates and distances.   
|  To define  |  Fields  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Units and precision for measurement  |  G3E_DISTUNIT G3E_DISTPREC  |  
|  Precision, units, and coordinate order for geographic coordinates  |  G3E_GEOGUNITS G3E_GEOGPREC G3E_GEOGCOORDORD G3E_GEOGHEMIOPT  |  
|  Precision, units, and coordinate order for projection coordinates  |  G3E_PROJUNITS G3E_PROJPREC G3E_PROJQUADRANTOPT  |  
All of the *UNIT fields are localizable fields. To find the appropriate text strings to use for these defaults, select Tools > Options on the Designer menu.

#### CustomFrame.htm
CustomFrame.htm lets you embed your own non-GUI ActiveX controls in the Web application and write event handlers and custom commands to communicate with it.   
|  Example A GPS control could monitor a USB port that is receiving GPS updates and fire events that are processed by custom event handlers in CustomFrame.htm. The custom event handler could use the updated GPS position to move a redline symbol on the map view.   |  
| --- |  
The CustomFrame.htm page is loaded into a hidden frame at startup and remains active for the duration of the viewing session. 
NetViewer delivers no custom client-side controls, but you can package your controls in a Verisigned CAB file and arrange for the object tags in CustomFrame.htm to automatically install your control on first access or when the version changes. For Field Review you would have your own install step run after the Field Review setup.

The top two windows are known as the overview windows, and the bottom two are known as the precision windows. When the user places the first control point in the overview window, the RegistrationZoomInFactor value is used as the zoom- in factor to compute the [display scale denominator](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258537) of the corresponding precision window. If user zooms in further in the precision window, the new zoom-in scale is remembered for consecutive control point placement.  The second number in the display scale ratio, for example, 1600 is the display scale denominator in a ratio of 1:1600.   
 |  Example If the overview registration window has a map scale of 1:1600, the overview geographic window has a map scale of 1:2000 and RegistrationZoomInFactor variable is defined as 4 in the Customize.inc file, then when the user places the first control point pair the computed display scale is 1:400 and 1:500 in the respective precision window. If the user zooms in further to a scale of 1:200 and 1:300, all consecutive control point placement maintains this scale in the precision windows.   |  
| --- |  
The default is 4.

###### IGTSecurityPrincipal Object
The IGTSecurityPrincipal object represents the security context of the user on whose behalf the code is running, including the identity of the user. This interface is added to the Intergraph.GTechnology.dll assembly in the \GTechnology\Program folder. 
The \GTechnology\Program\Samples folder contains an example implementation of this object.   
|  Property  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  [DefaultUserCredential](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/N9IvjYFCrncn0si8k_yBgA)  |  Represents the default user credential.  |  
|  [Identity](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/R8a7cdapZafJLGllVTBplQ)  |  Represents the identity of the underlying user.  |  
|  Method  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  [IsInRole](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/msJPWAmkbazNqffgdjvfUw)  |  Determines whether the current user belongs to the specified role.  |  
|  [GetAttributeValue](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Nt_YHvFd_cmSolUOvh2CRA)  |  Returns the value of the given security attribute for the current user.  |

###### Implementing NetViewer Authentication
To enable the NetViewer authentication scheme, add a key-value pair to the appSettings section of the web.config file. The key "GViewerNET.Authentication.Security.Principal" represents the custom implementation of the security principal object. The syntax for the value is "<Namespace>.<Class>, <AssemblyName>".   
|  Example <ADD KEY="GViewerNET.Authentication.Security.Principal" VALUE="Intergraph.Authentication.Sample.SecurityPrincipal,NetViewerSecurityPrincipal"/> where  Namespace = Intergraph.Authentication.Sample Class = SecurityPrincipal AssemblyName = NetViewerSecurityPrincipal   |  
| --- |  
The custom security principal object defined by the appSettings key should be derived from the [IGTSecurityPrincipal](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/MPQKbAjJz1jZIg5RFVeFjw) interface. This interface is derived from the System.Security.Principal.IPrincipal interface, which inherits the Identity property and the [IsInRole method](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/msJPWAmkbazNqffgdjvfUw). This interface includes the [GetAttributeValue method](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Nt_YHvFd_cmSolUOvh2CRA), which returns the value of the given security-related attribute. In the case of the NetViewer Web application, it should return the "NetViewer.DBConnection" attribute value containing the username, password, and configuration delimited by semicolons to perform an automatic log in into NetViewer.   
|  Example Username=CONFIG123;Password=CONFIG123;Configuration=CONFIG   |  
| --- |  
A sample implementation of the custom security principal that inherits from the IGTSecurityPrincipal interface is provided in \GTechnology\Program\Samples to help you build your own custom security principal object. The sample references the Intergraph.GTechnology.Interfaces.dll assembly that contains the definition for the IGTSecurityPrincipal interface. 
Once the implementation of the custom security principal object is complete, copy it to the Web application \BIN folder for testing and for final deployment. 
Processing
After IIS is restarted and the first user starts the NetViewer Web application, a caching object is created to store the custom security principal object for each user. This ensures that subsequent HTTP requests are assigned the same security principal object so it can be shared. A custom analysis or tools command can access this security principal object through the [HttpContext.Current.User property](http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/aa302415.aspx). 
Before the login page displays, the custom security principal object is created using the information provided by the appSettings key. If the current HTTP request user is successfully authenticated, the security principal object is added to the cache. The cache is indexed by the IP address of the client machine and the client username for "Integrated Windows Authentication" IIS settings and by the anonymous username for the "Anonymous Authentication" IIS setting. 
For the "Anonymous Authentication" IIS setting, there is only one entry in the cache. So, the custom security principal object is created only once for the first user who logs in to the NetViewer Web application. This object is maintained throughout the life of the Web application. Subsequent users are assigned the same security principal object. 
Once the user is authenticated, the login page retrieves the value of the "NetViewer.DBConnection" security attribute using the GetAttributeValue method of the custom security principal object. The value is parsed to extract the username, password, and configuration needed to perform an automatic login. If any part of the information is missing, the user must enter or select the missing information on the login page before performing an explicit login. 
When the session ends for the current user due to session timeout or the restarting of IIS, the custom security principal object that corresponds to the current HTTP request user is removed from the cache. This happens only when IIS is not using the "Anonymous Authentication" scheme.

##### PlotRequestHelper
The PlotRequestHelper static server side object is used to construct the AttachedFile, QuerySpecification and LegendSpecification xml node elements of the Plotting request. 
The object is added to Intergraph.GTechnology.Viewer.dll assembly in the \GTechnology\Program folder.   
|  Methods  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  [GetAttachedFilesPlotRequest](Ms-its:Intergraph.GTechnology.Viewer.API.Reference.chm::/html/M_Intergraph_GTechnology_Viewer_PlotRequestHelper_GetAttachedFilesPlotRequest.htm)  |  Method to construct the AttachedFile xml node element of the Plotting request.   |  
|  [GetLegendSpecificationPlotRequest](Ms-its:Intergraph.GTechnology.Viewer.API.Reference.chm::/html/M_Intergraph_GTechnology_Viewer_PlotRequestHelper_GetLegendSpecificationPlotRequest.htm)  |  Method to construct the LegendSpecification xml node element of the Plotting request.   |  
|  [GetQuerySpecificationsPlotRequest](Ms-its:Intergraph.GTechnology.Viewer.API.Reference.chm::/html/M_Intergraph_GTechnology_Viewer_PlotRequestHelper_GetQuerySpecificationsPlotRequest.htm)  |  Method to construct the QuerySpecification xml node element of the Plotting request.   |  
Example (C#):
string strXML = "";
WebClientContext oWebClientContext = new WebClientContext(oMapRequest);
LegendSpecification oLegendSpecification = oWebClientContext.GetLegendSpecification(sLicenseToken);
strXML = PlotRequestHelper.GetLegendSpecificationPlotRequest(oLegendSpecification);
ReadOnlyCollection<QuerySpecification> oQuerySpecificationCollection = oWebClientContext.GetQuerySpecifications(sLicenseToken);
strXML += PlotRequestHelper.GetQuerySpecificationsPlotRequest(oQuerySpecificationCollection);
ReadOnlyCollection<AttachedFile> oAttachedFileCollection = null;
if (strServerPortsSecure == "1")
oAttachedFileCollection = oWebClientContext.GetFileAttachments(sConfiguration, nLNO, 
sLicenseToken, true);
else
oAttachedFileCollection = oWebClientContext.GetFileAttachments(sConfiguration, nLNO, 
sLicenseToken, false);
if (oAttachedFileCollection.Count > 0)
{
strXML += PlotRequestHelper.GetAttachedFilesPlotRequest(oAttachedFileCollection);
}

[DataRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/FyfdVWsZAjqHveNanBXOXA)
Description
The Execute method executes the specified query, SQL statement or stored procedure against the facility database. This method is a wrapper on the ADO connection object's Execute method, which also sets the NetWorks Core job and configuration context for the caller. 
Syntax
Set Recordset = Object.Execute(LicenseToken, CommandText, Options, JobName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  LicenseToken  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  License token identifying an authenticated user. The NetWorks Core configuration used by this user is set in the database before performing the Execute.   |  
|  CommandText  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  SQL or stored procedure call.  |  
|  [Options](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/igQ7gM5Z5ypjjOoHkEXqZg)  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Required  |  See the [Microsoft ADO documentation](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ms808742.aspx) for more details.   |  
|  JobName  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Required  |  Sets the job context before performing the Execute.  |  
Return Type
[ADODB.Recordset](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ms808775.aspx)
Remarks
Although this method does not test "If IsMissing(JobName) ", it uses the variable as if it were there. So, if the variable is not supplied by the caller, a Type Mismatch error is returned.

###### ExecuteBound Method
Applies To
[DataRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/FyfdVWsZAjqHveNanBXOXA)
Description
The ExecuteBound method executes the specified query, SQL statement, or stored procedure against the facility database and passes the specified parameters into Oracle as bind variables. Returns the [ADODB.Recordset](http://msdn.microsoft.com/library/default.asp?url=/library/en-us/ado270/htm/mdobjodbrec.asp) containing results if any exist. 
Syntax
Set Recordset = Object.ExecuteBound(LicenseToken, CommandText, [JobName], Parameters) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  LicenseToken  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  License token identifying an authenticated user. The NetWorks Core Configuration used by this user is set in the database before performing the ExecuteBound.   |  
|  CommandText  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The SQL statement to be executed with ? as a placeholder for bind variable substitution.  |  
|  JobName  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Sets the Job context before performing the ExecuteBound.  |  
|  Parameters()  |  ParamArray  |  Input  |  Required  |  The values of the parameters for the query that are substituted into the ? placeholders in the SQL.  The ParamArray lets you provide an arbitrary number of arguments.  |  
Return Type
Recordset

###### ExecuteBoundArray Method
Applies To
[DataRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/FyfdVWsZAjqHveNanBXOXA)
Description
The ExecuteBoundArray method executes the specified SQL and passes the specified parameters into Oracle as bind variables. Returns the [ADODB.Recordset](http://msdn.microsoft.com/library/default.asp?url=/library/en-us/ado270/htm/mdobjodbrec.asp) containing results if any exist. 
This is like the ExecuteBound method except that ExecuteBoundArray accepts its parameters in the form of a variant array. 
Syntax
Set Recordset = Object.ExecuteBoundArray(LicenseToken, CommandText, JobName, Parameters) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  LicenseToken  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  License token identifying an authenticated user. The NetWorks Core Configuration used by this user is set in the database before performing the ExecuteBoundArray.   |  
|  CommandText  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The SQL statement to be executed with ? as a placeholder for bind variable substitution.  |  
|  JobName  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Required  |  Sets the Job context.  |  
|  Parameters()  |  VariantArray  |  Input  |  Required  |  The values of the parameters for the query that are substituted into the ? placeholders in the SQL.   |  
Return Type
Recordset

###### GetLicense Method
Applies To
[LicenseRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/dVh1JJgZmKEdHU~6d_tI9Q)
Description
The GetLicense method authenticates a user and gets a license token to be used by other APIs. Obtaining a license identifies a user and allows the server to maintain state about the licensed user. 
Syntax
String = Object.GetLicense(UserID, Configuration, Username, Password, ProductID) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  UserID  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Unique string that distinguishes this user from other users.  |  
|  Configuration  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Name of the NetWorks Core configuration being connected by to by this user   |  
|  Username  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Database username to use to authenticate this user.  |  
|  Password  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Database password to use to authenticate this user.  |  
|  ProductID  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Unique identifier to distinguish a unique identity for the user when using different NetViewer products.   |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
All license strings are guaranteed to be unique and of uniform length.

###### GetUserOptions Method
Applies To
[LicenseRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/dVh1JJgZmKEdHU~6d_tI9Q)
Description
The GetUserOptions method lets the caller add, delete, and maintain generic state information on the server for the user. The returned recordset contains name- value pairs that let you add, delete, or modify variables that can be used for options or for any type of user-state information that can be expressed as a string. 
The field names in this recordset are NAME, VALUE, and LICENSE_TOKEN. When creating a new row in the recordset, you must specify values for all fields before updating. 
Syntax
Set = Object.GetUserOptions(LicenseToken) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  LicenseToken  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  License token used to identify the user.  |  
Return Type
[ADODB.Recordset](http://msdn.microsoft.com/library/default.asp?url=/library/en-us/ado270/htm/mdobjodbrec.asp)

###### MapPoint Object

###### Keyin Property
Applies To
[MapPoint Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pInYUEeNSfybFWo_KyJemQ)
Description
The Keyin property sets the precision key-in defining coordinate.
Data Type
String
Remarks
Prepend "EN=" to the precision key-in to designate projection coordinates. Prepend "LL=" to the precision key-in to designate geographic coordinates. 
  * When using precision key-ins, projection coordinates you must format and express the units defined by the following columns in the [G3E_UNITFORMAT table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA): 
  * G3E_PROJUNIT
  * G3E_PROJPREC
  * G3E_PROJQUANDRANTOPT
  * When using precision key-ins, geographic coordinates must be formatted and expressed in the units defined by the following columns in the G3E_UNITFORMAT table: 
  * G3E_GEOGUNIT
  * G3E_GEOGPREC
  * G3E_GEOGCOORDORD
  * G3E_GEOGHEMIOPT

###### MapRequest Object

###### ActiveView Property
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The ActiveView property sets the active-view name.
Each view maintained by the application is uniquely identified by the value of this property. For instance, an application could maintain two map windows showing two legends that it presents to the user. 
Data Type
String
Remarks
If a request is made for a user and the ActiveView does not exist for this user, a new view is added. Information about each view is saved on the Web server and is available from session to session.

###### AppendQuery Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The AppendQuery method displays the results of a query in the active map window and adds a legend entry for the query to the current legend. Returns the file name of an image containing the new map. 
Syntax
ImageFile = Object.AppendQuery(QueryName, Features, [Symbology], [ExcludeSecondaryGraphics], [ExcludeNonLegendGraphics], [ViewAdjustmentOption], [MinimumFitWidth], [DisplayOn], [Locatable], [UseDisplayScale], [LegendLocationOption]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  QueryName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Name of the legend entry to add to the legend. If a legend entry by this same name already exists, it is replaced.   |  
|  Features  |  Recordset  |  Input  |  Required  |  The Recordset containing the results of a query to be displayed. The Recordset must include G3E_FNO, G3E_CNO, G3E_FID and G3E_CID fields.   |  
|  Symbology  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, expects a [Symbology](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1dwvqDD9dh0e6mHwvcidHw) object   |  
|  ExcludeSecondaryGraphics  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, expects a value of type Boolean. If true, only primary graphics are displayed. If false (the default) all graphic components in the legend are displayed.   |  
|  ExcludeNonLegendGraphics  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, expects a value of type Boolean. If true, only graphic components associated with the legend are be displayed. If false (the default), all components are included.   |  
|  ViewAdjustments  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, this parameter expects a value of type [ViewAdjustmentOptionsConstants](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/UA2LazghsM95HvMCXW5siw). It determines whether the display is adjusted for the appended query. The default value is gnetViewAdjustNone.   |  
|  MinimumFitWidth  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If the ViewAdjustmentOption is set to gnetViewAdjustFit, this parameter, defines the minimum width (or height depending on which is shorter) of the area zoomed into. This value is expressed in the units defined in the G3E_DISTUNIT column of the G3E_UNITFORMAT metadata table. If specified, this parameter expects a value of type String.   |  
|  DisplayOn  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, expects a value of type Boolean; used to set whether the query is initially displayed (the default is True).   |  
|  Locatable  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, expects a value of type Boolean; used to set whether the query is initially locatable (the default is False).   |  
|  UseDisplayScale  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, expects a value of type Boolean; used to set whether the query reacts to the display scale (the default is False).   |  
|  LegendLocationOption  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Indicates the display priority of the query. If specified, a value of type [LegendLocationOptionsConstants](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/EJJIMJ~wqWoIKCIZvjNoxQ) is expected.   |  
Return Type
String

###### AttachCADFile Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The AttachCADFile method attaches a CAD file to a legend as a vector backdrop.
Syntax
strMap = AttachCADFile(LegendEntryName, FileName, FileType, [CSFile], [SourceControlPoints], [DestControlPoints], [SendToBack], [DisplayLevels]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  LegendEntryName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Name of the legend entry.  |  
|  FileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The image file name with path.  |  
|  FileType  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Required  |  Indicates if the file is an AutoCAD file or MicroStation file.  
1 = AutoCAD  
2 = MicroStation   |  
|  CSFile  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The coordinate system file name with path.  |  
|  SourceControlPoints  |  [MapPoints](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/4mSV11QlAGIukX5pK0DFjw)  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The source control point coordinates.  |  
|  DestControlPoints  |  MapPoints  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The destination control point coordinates that correspond to the SourceControlPoints.  |  
|  SendToBack  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Indicates if the image should be displayed in front or back. The default is True.  |  
|  DisplayLevels  |  [LegendOverrides](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/sc92b8S0xY7irA5RoLwbFw)  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Indicates the name, display status and locate status for each levels in the CAD file.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
You must pass in the CSFile or the source and destination control points.

###### AttachRaster Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The AttachRaster method attaches a raster file to a legend. Returns the map image name with path. 
Syntax
strMap = AttachRaster(LegendEntryName, FileName, ImageType, [CSFile], [SourceControlPoints], [DestControlPoints], [SendToBack]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  LegendEntryName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Name of the legend entry.  |  
|  FileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The image file name with path.  |  
|  ImageType  |  [ImageType constant](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/oI_X3Y4V3t6lmwF0bmh68A)  |  Input  |  Required  |  Indicates if the image has a geo-header or header.  |  
|  CSFile  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The coordinate system file name with path.  |  
|  SourceControlPoints  |  [MapPoints](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/4mSV11QlAGIukX5pK0DFjw)  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The source control point coordinates.  |  
|  DestControlPoints  |  MapPoints  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The destination control point coordinates that correspond to the SourceControlPoints.  |  
|  SendToBack  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Indicates if the image should be displayed in front or back. The default is True.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
If the image type is Header, then the coordinate system file must be supplied. Otherwise, this API raises an exception. 
If the image type is NoHeader, then you must supply the source and destination control points. Otherwise, this API raises an exception.

###### ComputePartialValue Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The ComputePartialValue method calls the specified implementation of the [IGTComputePartialStartValue](Ms-its:Intergraph.GTechnology.Desktop.API.Reference.chm::/html/T_Intergraph_GTechnology_Interfaces_IGTComputePartialStartValue.htm) interface, which calculates a value representing part of the specified feature based on the specified point. 
Syntax
dblValue = Object.ComputePartialValue(RINO, RIARGNO, FNO, FID, PointX, PointY) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RINO  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  Relationship interface number for the partial value interface.  |  
|  RIARGNO  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  Relationship interface argument group number.  |  
|  FNO  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  Feature number.  |  
|  FID  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Feature identifier.  |  
|  PointX  |  Double  |  Input  |  Optional  |  X value of the selected point.  |  
|  PointY  |  Double  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Y value of the selected point.  |  
Return Type
Double
Remarks
Returns result from call to specified IGTComputePartialValue implementation. This method is called from the NetViewer Trace command if a [G3E_TRACE.G3E_PARTIALVALUERINO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/trnr4poliwRg4MV7egOufg) value is defined for the trace. This method can also be called from any custom .ASP.

###### GenerateMap Property

Description
The GenerateMap property controls whether or not the map image is generated.
Data Type
Boolean
Remarks
This property allows the caller to perform multiple commands more efficiently. Before the multiple map operations are performed, the caller sets this property to False. The caller then sets this property to True before calling the last operation. Only the last image is generated.

###### GetFeaturesInAreaByComponentView Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
Returns records that satisfy the given operator on the geometries of the given component view with the given area polygon. 
Syntax
OutputRawRawFile = Object.GetFeaturesInAreaByComponentView(AreaPolygon, ComponentViewName SpatialOperator, ResultType) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  AreaPolygon  |  GNet.MapPoints  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies the GNet.MapPoint collection for the area polygon. The points are used to generate a single polygon geometry, therefore the area polygon cannot represent a collection of areas or holes in boundaries.   |  
|  ComponentViewName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  A string containing the component view name.  |  
|  SpatialOperator  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  A spatial operator that can take the following values: 1 = Entirely Contains. The area polygon entirely contains the component geometries from the given features.  2 = Entirely Contained By. The area polygon is entirely contained within the component geometries from the given features.  3 = Touches. The area polygon is touching the component geometries from the given features.  4 = Not Touches. The area polygon is not touching the component geometries from the given features.  5 = Index Intersect. The area polygon MBR intersects the MBR of the component geometries from the given features.   |  
|  ResultType  |  Long String RawFile  |  Input Output Output  |  Optional  |  Indicates the type of the output recordset: 1 = FNO- CNO- Count. Returns records of distinct FNO- CNO pair along with its count. 2 = Complete Feature List. Returns records of complete list of features that satisfy the given operator. The result set includes the G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO, and G3E_CID field values.  3 = FNO- FID. Returns records of distinct FNO- FID pair. The default value is 1.  |  
Remarks
This method returns the name of the raw file that exists in the \MAP virtual folder. You can then use the Open method on the ADODB.Recordset object to open this raw file. The following C# sample describes a way to open the returned raw file as an ADO recordset:   
|  Code Example - C# HttpContext oContext = HttpContext.Current; ADODB.Recordset oResultRS = new ADODB.RecordsetClass(); string sRawFile = oContext.Server.MapPath("/Maps/" + OutputRawFile); oResultRS.Open(sRawFile, "Provider=MSPersist;", CursorTypeEnum.adOpenUnspecified, LockTypeEnum.adLockUnspecified, -1);  |  
| --- |

###### GetFeaturesInAreaByFNO Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
Returns records that satisfy the given operator on the component geometries of the given FNOs with the given area polygon. 
Syntax
OutputRawRawFile = Object.GetFeaturesInAreaByFNO(AreaPolygon, FNOList, SpatialOperator, AlternateGeoOrdinal, ComponentRetrievalMode, IncludeReferencingFeatureRecords, ResultType) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  AreaPolygon  |  GNet.MapPoints  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies the GNet.MapPoint collection for the area polygon. The points are used to generate a single polygon geometry, therefore the area polygon cannot represent a collection of areas or holes in boundaries.   |  
|  FNOList  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  A comma- delimited string containing FNOs.  |  
|  SpatialOperator  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  A spatial operator that can take the following values: 1 = Entirely Contains. The area polygon entirely contains the component geometries from the given features.  2 = Entirely Contained By. The area polygon is entirely contained within the component geometries from the given features.  3 = Touches. The area polygon is touching the component geometries from the given features.  4 = Not Touches. The area polygon is not touching the component geometries from the given features.  5 = Index Intersect. The area polygon MBR intersects the MBR of the component geometries from the given features.   |  
|  AlternateGeoOrdinal  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Used to specify the Alternate Geo Ordinal used to include the alternate geo components. The default value is 0.  |  
|  ComponentRetrievalMode  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Specifies the components of the given features to be considered when performing the spatial operation:  1 = Primary Geographic. Primary Geographic or Alternate Geographic components only. 2 = All Geographic. All Geographic and Alternate Geographic components. 3 = All Detail. All Detail components. 4 = Primary Detail. Primary Detail components only. 5 = All Primary. Primary Detail, Primary Geographic and Alternate Geographic components only.  The default value is 1.  |  
|  IncludeReferencingFeatureRecords  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether to include the records from the detail referencing features that are within the given area polygon and may contain the features specified by the FNO list.  The default value is False.  |  
|  ResultType  |  Long  
String  
RawFile   |  Input  
Output  
Output   |  Optional  |  Indicates the type of the output recordset: 1 = FNO- CNO- Count. Returns records of distinct FNO- CNO pair along with its count. 2 = Complete Feature List. Returns records of complete list of features that satisfy the given operator. The result set includes the G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO, and G3E_CID field values.  3 = FNO- FID. Returns records of distinct FNO- FID pair. The default value is 1.  |  
Remarks
This method returns the name of the raw file that exists in the \MAP virtual folder. You can then use the Open method on the ADODB.Recordset object to open this raw file. The following C# sample describes a way to open the returned raw file as an ADO recordset:   
|  Code Example - C# HttpContext oContext = HttpContext.Current; ADODB.Recordset oResultRS = new ADODB.RecordsetClass(); string sRawFile = oContext.Server.MapPath("/Maps/" + OutputRawFile); oResultRS.Open(sRawFile, "Provider=MSPersist;", CursorTypeEnum.adOpenUnspecified, LockTypeEnum.adLockUnspecified, -1);  |  
| --- |

###### GetSeedFiles Property
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The GetSeedFiles property returns the names of seed files that are stored on the map server and reside in the location configured in FileUNCPaths.xml file. 
Data Type
VARIANT Array
Remarks
The array includes MicroStation version 7 and version 8 seed files, which are filtered based on the geometry dimension. The names include .2D.V7 or .2D.V8 or .3D.V7 or .3D.V8 suffixes which allow you to differentiate the seed files based on the MicroStation version and the geometry dimension.

###### Highlight Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The Highlight method highlights the given list of features on the map. Returns the file name of an image containing the new map.

Parameters

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

It determines whether the display is adjusted for the highlighted features. The default value is gnetViewAdjustNone.   |

This value is expressed in the units defined in [G3E_UNITFORMAT.G3E_DISTUNIT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). If specified, this parameter expects a value of type String.   |  
Return Type
String

[LegendOverrides object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/sc92b8S0xY7irA5RoLwbFw)
Remarks
This property must be set using the [SetViewParameters method](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/c2Cwpg2dEaoUSkcPGomxZw).

###### Locate Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The Locate method produces a list containing the feature keys of all features located near a given point. 
Syntax
Set Recordset = Object.Locate(Point) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Point  |  [MapPoint object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pInYUEeNSfybFWo_KyJemQ)  |  Input  |  Required  |  Point to locate features near.  |  
Return Type
Recordset
Remarks
The returned recordset includes the G3E_FNO, G3E_CNO, G3E_FID, and G3E_CID values.

###### MeasureAreaByFeature Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The MeasureAreaByFeature method measures the area of an entire area feature or a selected instance of an area feature. This value is expressed in the units defined in [G3E_UNITFORMAT.G3E_DISTUNIT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). 
Syntax
Area = Object.MeasureAreaByFeature(Feature, [MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Feature  |  Recordset  |  Input  |  Required  |  Recordset containing a row with G3E_FNO, G3E_CNO, G3E_FID and G3E_CID fields defining the feature to measure.   |  
|  MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If True, the curvature of earth is taken into account to measure the area.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
If the values in the input recordset of G3E_CNO and G3E_CID are 0, then the entire feature is measured. The entire feature means all instance of the primary geographic component of a feature. If the input recordset has a valid G3E_CNO and G3E_CID, then the area of that instance of the feature is measured.

###### MeasureAreaByPoints Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The MeasureAreaByPoints method measures the area of a polygon formed by the specified points. This value is expressed in the units defined in [G3E_UNITFORMAT.G3E_DISTUNIT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). 
Syntax
Area = Object.MeasureDistanceByPoints(MapPoints, [MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  MapPoints  |  [MapPoints](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/4mSV11QlAGIukX5pK0DFjw)  |  Input  |  Required  |  Collection of points that forms a polygon to be measured.  |  
|  MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If True, the curvature of earth is taken into account to measure the area.  |  
Return Type
String

###### MeasureDistanceByFeature Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The MeasureDistanceByFeature method measures the length of an entire feature or a section along a feature specified by two points near the feature. This value is expressed in the units defined in [G3E_UNITFORMAT.G3E_DISTUNIT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). 
Syntax
Distance = Object.MeasureDistanceByFeature(Feature, [BeginPointAlong], [MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel], [EndPointAlong]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Feature  |  Recordset  |  Input  |  Required  |  Recordset containing a row with G3E_FNO, G3E_CNO, G3E_FID and G3E_CID fields defining the feature to measure.   |  
|  MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If True, the curvature of earth is taken into account to measure the area.  |  
|  BeginPointAlong  |  [MapPoint](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pInYUEeNSfybFWo_KyJemQ)  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, defines the first point along the feature to measure.  |  
|  EndPointAlong  |  MapPoint  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If specified, defines the second point along the feature to measure.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
If BeginPointAlong and EndPointAlong are not specified, the entire feature is measured. The points specified with BeginPointAlong and EndPointAlong do not have to be directly on the feature, a snap points along the feature are computed. 
To obtain the points along the feature between the two points specified, use the [AlongPoints](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8U1~xvMwmL2FDqcn4dXvfw) property.

###### MeasureDistanceByPoints Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The MeasureDistanceByPoints method is used to measure the cumulative length between the specified points. This value is expressed in the units defined in [G3E_UNITFORMAT.G3E_DISTUNIT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). 
Syntax
Instance = Object.MeasureDistanceByPoints(MapPoints, [MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  MapPoints  |  [MapPoints object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/4mSV11QlAGIukX5pK0DFjw)  |  Input  |  Required  |  Collection of points to measure between.  |  
|  MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If True, the curvature of earth is taken into account to measure the area.  |  
Return Type
String

###### Pan Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The Pan method pans the map view a given distance from its current location. Returns the file name of an image containing the new map. 
Syntax
ImageFile = Object.Pan(Deltas) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Deltas  |  [MapPoint object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pInYUEeNSfybFWo_KyJemQ)  |  Input  |  Required  |  MapPoint object used to define X and Y deltas from the current map location.  |

###### Readout Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The Readout method gets a precision coordinate readout for a point on the map. Returns a formatted string containing the precision readout coordinate. 
Syntax
ReadoutCoordinate = Object.Readout(Point, PointType) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Point  |  [MapPoint](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pInYUEeNSfybFWo_KyJemQ)  |  Input  |  Required  |  Point on the map.  |  
|  PointType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Type of readout: "LL" for Geographic  
"EN" for Projection   |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
When PointType is "LL", the coordinate is expressed in the units and format defined by the following columns in the [G3E_UNITFORMAT table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA): 
  * G3E_GEOGUNIT
  * G3E_GEOGPREC
  * G3E_GEOGCOORDORD
  * G3E_GEOGHEMIOPT


When PointType is "EN", the coordinate is expressed in the units and format defined by the following columns in the G3E_UNITFORMAT table: 
  * G3E_PROJUNIT
  * G3E_PROJPREC
  * G3E_PROJQUANDRANTOPT

###### SaveAsDGN Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
Saves the current map view contents to the given MicroStation file.
Syntax
Object.SaveAsDGN(FileName, Version, SeedFile, CoordSystemFile) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Full path to the output DGN file name.  |  
|  Version  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Output Microstation file version along with the dimension. These are the valid values:
  * 2DV7 = 2D MicroStation V7
  * 2DV8 = 2D MicroStation V8
  * 3DV7 = 3D MicroStation V7
  * 3DV8 = 3D MicroStation V8

The default is 2DV7.  |  
|  SeedFile  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Name of the MicroStation seed file. The default value is "".  |  
|  CoordSystemFile  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Name of the coordinate system file. The default value is "".  |  
Remarks
In NetViewer, the output DGN file, once saved, is moved back to the client and copied to the target file specified by the user. The specified CSF file and the seed file should exist in the location configured in FileUNCPaths.xml file. If the seed file is not specified, it defaults to first DGN file in the configured location or the default file delivered with the product.

###### SaveAsPDF Function
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
[Printing](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ELwYvv7YyUUrFy8h5Cc15g)
Description
The SaveAsPDF function lets you customize the[Save as PDF command](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bDZgNPQLxMHGNvFyXEtQew) in NetViewer and Field Review. 
Syntax
Object.SaveAsPDF(FileName, [Orientation], [PageSize], [PageHeight], [PageWidth], [HMargin], [VMargin], [Resolution], [EmbedFont], [RedlineXML]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FileName  |  String  |  Required  |  The output file name.  |  
|  Orientation  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The paper orientation. The value for the corresponding orientation needs to be passed: 1 = Portrait 2= Landscape The default is Landscape.  |  
|  PageSize  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The paper size. The value for corresponding paper size needs to be passed. The following sizes are supported:  0 = Custom Size 1 = Letter (8 1/2 x 11 in) 5 = Legal (8 1/2 x 14 in) 8 = A3 (297 x 420 mm) 9 = A4 (210 x 297 mm) 10 = Auto Size If Custom Size is selected, the PageHeight and PageWidth need to be specified. If Auto Size is selected, the PageSize is computed by the software. The PageHeight and PageWidth are always computed by the API for the Auto Size option. The default is A4.  |  
|  PageHeight  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The page height in millimeters for the custom page size. If the PageSize option is anything other than Custom Size, this value is ignored. If it is 0, the PageHeight is computed by the software.   |  
|  PageWidth  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The page width in millimeters for the custom page size. If the PageSize option is anything other than Custom Size, this value is ignored. If it is 0, the PageWidth is computed by the software.   |  
|  HMargin  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The horizontal margin in millimeters. The default is 0.  |  
|  VMargin  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The vertical margin in millimeters. The default is 0.  |  
|  Resolution  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The printer resolution. The resolution affects the image quality and the text quality. The following resolutions (in dots per inch) are supported: 
  * 72
  * 150
  * 300
  * 600
  * 1200

The default is 600 dpi.  |  
|  EmbedFont  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether the TrueType fonts should be embedded in the document. The default is True.  |  
|  RedlineXML  |  String  |  Optional  |  XML string of redlines to be attached to the map.  |  
|  JPEGCompression  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether to activate or deactivate the JPEG compression option for 24-bit images. JPEG compression heavily reduces the size of documents containing real life images but has a slight effect on image quality.  The default is False.  |  
|  JPEGLevel  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  Sets the JPEG level when JPEG compression is True. The following JPEG levels are supported:
  * 3 – Low quality, High compression
  * 7 – Good quality, Good compression
  * 9 – High quality, Low compression.

The default is 9.  |  
|  MultiLingualSupport  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether to add support for international character sets. The default value is True  |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This API can be accessed from both the client-side script and the server-side code. The client-side API is exposed as a Net Page Extension API on the [NetViewerDOM object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/URuYQivKns2ufSBq5VmzDw). The server side API is exposed on the [MapRequest object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ). 
This API does not wait for the completion of the creation of PDF file to return the call. 
A sample page to demonstrate this function is delivered with Field Review.

###### SetViewParameters Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The SetViewParameters method defines what legend is to be displayed, the size of the map view image, and the background color of the active map view. 
Syntax
Object.SetViewParameters([Legend], [LegendOverrides], [DetailID], [ViewWidth], [ViewHeight], [BackgroundColor], FrameName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Legend  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The number (G3E_LNO from G3E_LEGENDS) of the legend to display within the current map view. If specified, expects a value of type Integer.   |  
|  LegendOverrides  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Collection of [LegendOverride objects](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/2NF4pZSq0pw0QPumj~BJOg) to override legend metadata determining whether the entry is displayed, is locatable and if the display scale is applied.   |  
|  DetailID  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Detail ID used as filter on the legend when viewing detail legends. If specified, expects a value of type Integer.   |  
|  ViewWidth  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Width in pixels of the map image to produce for subsequent map generating methods. If specified, expects a value of type Integer.   |  
|  ViewHeight  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Height in pixels of the map image to produce for subsequent map generating methods. If specified, expects a value of type Integer.   |  
|  BackgroundColor  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Optional  |  A whole number containing an RGB color value defining the background color of the map. If specified, expects a value of type Integer.   |  
|  FrameName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The numbered positions of the frames that must be passed to the SetViewParameters method. For example, the name of the first frame is "1".   |  
Remarks
The following diagrams show how the map frames are numbered:
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/257412)

###### UpdateDeltas Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
The UpdateDeltas method updates the active map window with the most recent edits to the facility data. Returns the file name of an image containing the new map.

If an active job is set, non-posted job edits for that job ware included with all recently posted job edits.

###### NetViewerDOM Object

###### DOM Property
Applies To
[NetViewerDOM Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/URuYQivKns2ufSBq5VmzDw)
Description
If an instance of NetViewer is running on the client computer, the DOM property returns a pointer to the top of the Document Object Model of the Web application; otherwise, it returns Null. 
The Net Page Extension APIs can be called directly as methods off of this pointer. Or, if the caller is using the GNetPageExtAPI helper object, this pointer can be used to set the DOM property on the GNetPageExtAPI object. 
Data Type
IDispatch pointer

###### Launch Method
Applies To
[<Prodcut4_Short>DOM Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/URuYQivKns2ufSBq5VmzDw)
Description
If the NetViewer client is not running on the current machine, the Launch method creates a new instance of Internet Explorer (iexplore.exe) process and navigates to the specified URL. If NetViewer is already running, the query- string portion of the URL is sent as the argument to the ExecQueryCommands function of the running instance. In either case, the Internet Explorer window containing NetViewer moves to the top of the window's Z order. 
Syntax
Object.Launch(URL) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  URL  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The path to the NetViewer Web server. The path can include a query string with calls to Net Page Extension APIs.   |

Description
The Width property determines the line width for linear features.

Long

If this property is Null, the default width is used. The units for width is points. Width applies to lines and area boundaries.

###### WebTransferService Object

###### Coding Samples for Web Transfer Service
Creating a Web folder
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
oWTS.CreateWebFolder "http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder"
Deleting a Web folder
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
oWTS.DeleteWebResource "http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder"
Sending a file to a Web folder
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
oWTS.PushToWebFolder "c:/a.xml", _
"http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder/a.xml"
Pulling a file from a Web folder
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
oWTS.PullFromWebFolder "http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder/a.xml", _
"c:/a.xml"
Deleting a file from a Web folder
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
oWTS.DeleteWebResource "http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder/a.xml"
Get a list of Web folder files and folders
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
Dim sXML as String
sXML = oWTS.ListFolder("http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder")
Dim oDOM As New MSXML2.DOMDocument
oDOM.loadXML sXML
Dim oNodes As MSXML2.IXMLDOMNodeList
Set oNodes = mDOM.selectNodes("properties/prop/displayname")
Dim oNode As MSXML2.IXMLDOMNode
For Each oNode In oNodes
MsgBox oNode.Text
Next
Add a user-defined property to a Web folder or file in a Web folder
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
oWTS.SetProperty "http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder/a.xml", _
"owner", "John Nash"
Get a user-defined property of a Web folder or file in a Web folder
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
Dim sPropertyValue As String
oWTS.GetProperty "http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder/a.xml", _
"owner"
Delete a user-defined property of a Web folder or file in a Web folder
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
Dim sPropertyValue As String
oWTS.DeleteProperty "http://MyWebServer/WebFolders/MyWebFolder/a.xml", _
"owner"
Compress the contents of a folder into a ZIP file
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
oWTS.CompressLocalFolder "c:/Folder", "c:/FolderContents.zip"
Compress the contents of several files into a ZIP file
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
Dim sFiles(1) As String
sFiles(0) = "c:/file1.txt"
sFiles(1) = "c:/file2.txt"
oWTS.CompressLocalFiles sFiles, "c:/FolderContents.zip"
Uncompress the contents of ZIP file
Dim oWTS As New WebTransferService
oWTS.Uncompress "c:/test.zip", "c:/unziptest"
