###### GetProperties Method
Applies To
[WebTransferService Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mJbSckFCX_3JVChAJelm2Q)
Description
The GetProperties method returns all of the properties for a given folder or file as XML containing a prop element representing the properties for the given Web file or folder. The format of the prop element and standard subelements are defined in the WEBDAV specification. See <http://asg.web.cmu.edu/rfc/rfc2518.html#sec-23.1> for details. 
Syntax
String = Object.GetProperties(ServerResource) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ServerResource  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  URL of the file or folder whose resources are being looked up.  |  
Return Type
String

###### GetProperty Method
Applies To
[WebTransferService Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mJbSckFCX_3JVChAJelm2Q)
Description
The GetProperty method gets the given value of the given folder or file's property.
Syntax
String = Object.GetProperty(ServerResource, PropertyName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ServerResource  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  URL of the file or folder whose property is being looked up.  |  
|  PropertyName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Name of the property whose value is to be returned.  |  
Return Type
String

###### ListWebFolder Method
Applies To
[WebTransferService Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mJbSckFCX_3JVChAJelm2Q)
Description
The ListWebFolder method enumerates all of the files and folders within the given folder, including all of the properties for each of those files and folders. 
Syntax
List = Object.ListWebFolder(ServerFolder) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ServerFolder  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  URL of the folder on the server.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This method returns XML containing prop elements representing files and folders within the given Web folder. The format of the prop elements and standard subelements are defined in the WEBDAV specification. See <http://asg.web.cmu.edu/rfc/rfc2518.html#sec-23.1> for details. 
There is a prop element for each file and folder in the Web folder. All of these prop elements are contained in a properties element.

Applies To

Applies To
[Net Page Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg)
Description
The RedlineMouseMove event is called when the user moves the mouse over the map.
Syntax
RedlineMouseMove(XPixelPos,YPixelPos, XWorldPos, YWorldPos) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  XPixelPos  |  Double  |  Required  |  The position in pixels of the cursor on the horizontal plane.  |  
|  YPixelPos  |  Double  |  Required  |  The position in pixels of the cursor on the vertical plane.  |  
|  XWorldPos  |  Double  |  Required  |  The position in world coordinates of the cursor on the horizontal plane.  |  
|  YWorldPos  |  Double  |  Required  |  The position in world coordinates of the cursor on the vertical plane.  |  
Remarks
This function is called at a very high frequency. You must be extremely careful not to do any computationally intensive operations within the event handler function for this event. By default, MouseMove events are disabled. To enable them, call [EnableRedlineMouseMoveEvents](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AZF1bewIaonM6qbLuMiMHg). 
The custom event handlers added by the [AddEventHandler function](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/lHJjLZHW1uXwuCVHuFHGRw) are notified whenever this event occurs.

###### ActivateRedlineCategory Function
Applies To
[Redline Categories](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ECQfcuXLI_DJi7a6CEf54A)
Description
The ActivateRedlineCategory function switches the state of the Redline control to the styles, behavior, and display-layer settings of the specified category. 
Syntax
ActivateRedlineCategory(CategoryName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  CategoryName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The new active category.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

If the CategoryName passed in as an argument to this function is not a valid category name, an exception is thrown. The caller should catch the exception and handle it appropriately.

###### AddEventHandler Function
Applies To
[Net Page Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg)
Description
The AddEventHandler function associates a client-side callback function with a client event. 
The custom event handlers that are added by this function are notified whenever a [Redline DisplayControl event](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/4LyU4_Zt~iqvC1EPCW4CXg) occurs and whenever the [value of a session variable](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Ck0CNkScxUSjdeeWVJdEA) changes. 
There can be more than one callback function for each event; but a specific callback function is written to handle one event type. The callback functions are called in the same order that they were added. The callback functions are expected to have the same number of arguments in the same order as the event for which the callback is called. 
Syntax
AddEventHandler(EventType, this, CallbackFuncName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  EventType  |  String  |  Required  |  Specifies the [name of an event](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/fSIa2AwLDPCnaJ1l3nREzA).   |  
|  this  |  String  |  Required  |  The second argument must be the "this" keyword. Passing the "this" pointer establishes the context of the callback function.   |  
|  CallbackFuncName  |  String  |  Required  |  Specifies a client-side script function name.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The Customframe.htm page is loaded into a hidden frame of the Web application and has the same lifetime as the main NetViewer page. This is the best place to add custom event handler functions that need to handle events for the entire session. 
Event handling that makes sense only during the lifetime of the execution of a custom command page should be enabled and disabled by OnWindowLoad and OnWindowUnload logic, respectively, for the custom page. 
If the callback location in the [NetViewerDOM object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/URuYQivKns2ufSBq5VmzDw) is incorrect or the callback does not exist, that callback function is removed from the list of functions to be called. 
If the callback function throws an exception, indicating that an unhandled exception occur inside the callback, that callback function is removed from the list of functions to be called, and an alert message pops up.

###### CancelAction Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The CancelAction function can be called within the Before event handlers to cancel the current operation. 
Operations that can be canceled include:
  * Map frame layout changes
  * Map frame view changes
  * Map frame activation


Syntax
CancelAction(EventName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  EventName  |  String  |  Required  |  The name of the event handler canceling the action. This is always the Before event for the action.  These are the valid values:
  * To cancel map frame layout changes: BeforeMapFrameLayoutChanged
  * To cancel map frame view changes: BeforeMapFrameViewChanged
  * To cancel map frame activation: BeforeMapFrameActivated

 |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Multiple event handlers can be active. If any of the active event handlers cancels the action, it is canceled. Certain product operations, such as the interactive ad hoc file registration, change the frame layout. A project event handler should consider this when canceling the action to be sure it was the action it expected to cancel.

Geographic  
UOR   |

###### ClickOnMapForPoint Function
Applies To
[Net Page Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg)
Description
The ClickOnMapForPoint function is called by the custom command when it needs to get a point from the user. This function changes the wait cursor to a crosshair and turns off the current point mode. 
Syntax
ClickOnMapForPoint(PointType) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  PointType  |  String  |  Required  |  Type of point to be returned in the QueryString of the page. Possible values include
  * Projection
  * Geographic
  * UOR

 |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
When the user enters a point, by clicking the map or by precision key-in, the calling page is reloaded with a QueryString member called UserPoint containing the point in the specified point mode. The point is a string that is comma delimited. 
When the PointType is Projection or Geographic, the value of the UserPoint query string is in a localized format for the X and Y projection coordinates or the longitutude and latitude geographic coordinates. However, the UOR point mode is always a string formatted in the USA locale—that is,comma delimited with a period as the radix point. 
UOR points are not intended for end user display, but for programmatic exchange from this function to other client-side functions such as PlaceLocationPinAtPoint. Regardless of the PointType setting, this function also returns a UORPoint query string value after the UserPoint value.

###### ConvertUnitToUnit Function
Applies To
[Redline Coordinate System](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Zqu1jh3MAVzzSoc6hfZ2g)
Description
The ConvertUnitToUnit function converts a value expressed in one unit to a value expressed in another unit. 
Returns a double precision value containing the converted value expressed in the OutputUnit.
Syntax
Value = ConvertUnitToUnit(UnitType, InputUnit, InputValue, OutputUnit) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  UnitType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Defines the category or type of unit being converted. Possible values include:
  * "ANGLE"
  * "AREA" 
  * "DISTANCE"

 |  
|  InputUnit  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Defines the units of the input value being converted. Possible values depend on the UnitType parameter. For "ANGLE" the possible values include:  
"d:m:s"  
"dd.mmss"  
"deg"  
"gr"  
"min"  
"rad"  
"rev"  
"sec"  For "AREA" the possible values include:  
"ac"  
"area"  
"chain^2"  
"cm^2"  
"deciare"  
"ft^2"  
"hectare"  
"in^2"  
"km^2"  
"link^2"  
"m^2"  
"mi^2"  
"mm^2"  
"perch"  
"rod^2"  
"yd^2"  For "DISTANCE" the possible values include:  
"chain"  
"cm"  
"ft"  
"furlong"  
"hundredth"  
"in"  
"kft"  
"km"  
"link"  
"m"  
"mi"  
"mm"  
"nm"  
"nmi"  
"pole"  
"pt"  
"rod"  
"sf"  
"si"  
"sk"  
"svy_ft"  
"svy_in"  
"svy_kft"  
"tenth"  
"thousandth"  
"yd"   |  
|  InputValue  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  Input value to be converted.  |  
|  OutputUnit  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Unit of the output value after the conversion. See InputUnit for possible values.  |  
Return Type
Double precision
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

|  IDs  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The comma- separated list of redline IDs to delete.  |  
Return Type
Long. The number of redlines deleted.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
To prevent accidental deletion of all redlines, empty string IDLists are ignored. If the program really wants to delete all redlines, then it can call SelectRedlines, followed by a call to DeleteRedlines.

Description
The EnableRedlineMouseMoveEvents function enables redline mouse move events.
Syntax
EnableRedlineMouseMoveEvents()

This is a client-side function.
Because mouse-move events use client-side resources, there is no need to fire them unless they are currently being used by custom code. So, by default, they are not fired. ###### FormatPoint Function
Applies To
[Redline Coordinate System](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Zqu1jh3MAVzzSoc6hfZ2g)
Description
The FormatPoint function is used to format a computational point (radians for geographic points, meters for projected points) to the unit, precision, coordinate order, and so forth, as defined in the [G3E_UNITFORMAT metadata table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). 
The G3E_UNITFORMAT table defines how coordinates are formatted for the end user.
Syntax
FormattedPoint = FormatPoint(Type, Point) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Type  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Type of coordinates to format. Possible values include:  
"GEOGRAPHIC"  
"PROJECTION"   |  
|  Point  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Computational point to convert and format. This is a string in the format "x.x,y.y". Computational geographic points must be in radians. Computational projected points must be in meters.   |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Returns the formatted point.

###### FormatValue Function
Applies To
[Redline Coordinate System](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Zqu1jh3MAVzzSoc6hfZ2g)
Description
The FormatValue function is used to format a computational value (radians for angular values, meters for linear values, square meters for areas) to the unit and precision as defined in the [G3E_UNITFORMAT metadata table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). 
The G3E_UNITFORMAT table defines how coordinates are formatted for the end user.
Syntax
Value = FormatValue(Type, Value) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Type  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Type of value to format. Possible values include:  
"DISTANCE"  "AREA" "ANGLE" "AZIMUTH" "BEARING" "HEIGHT"  |  
|  Value  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  Computational value to convert and format. Computational distances and heights must be in meters. Computational areas must be in square meters. Computational angles, azimuths and bearings must be in radians.   |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Returns the formatted value.

###### GetFeaturePoints Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The GetFeaturePoints function takes a feature component key as input and returns a string of X and Y coordinate values. The return string can be passed as the StringOfXandYs argument in subsequent calls to the [PlaceRedline function](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j9cNqI9mWDc8HbDg4yaxyA). 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/260352?tocId=4idN9~Ql27k8Tq~YheMHNA) This function could be used in an edit-existing-feature-geometry workflow where the first step is to get the existing feature's geometry and then create a redline on top of the existing feature that the user can edit. 
Syntax
StringOfXandYs = GetFeaturePoints(FNO, FID, [CNO], [CID])
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FNO  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Required  |  The feature number.  |  
|  FID  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  The feature ID.  |  
|  CNO  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The component number. If not specified, then the primary geographic component is assumed.  |  
|  CID  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The component ID. If not specified, then a component ID of 1 is assumed.  |  
Return Type
String. Specifies Type, a comma-separated string of X and Y world coordinates that define the points of the geometry. 
Remarks
This function can be called from either the client or server side. If called from client-side, then the function triggers a hidden page request to the server to get the return value. The function waits for the hidden page load to finish, picks up the return value and then returns control back to the caller. Arc, CompositePolyline, CompositePolygon, and Rectangle geometries are stroked to simple geometries. 
Collection and Boundary geometries are not supported.

###### GetNextPlotDocName Hook
Applies To
[NetViewer-to-Plotting](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/I3wcVKxxUVSQkoVXGC4h7g)
Description
The GetNextPlotDocName hook lets you override the default name for the plot document. The default implementation simply appends a sequence number such as _1 or _2 to the input argument and returns it. 
To override the default naming, provide an alternative name as the return value from the GetNextPlotDocName function defined in the CustomPlotOutput.inc file. 
The plot document name displays in the print queue for the specified device. If the target device is a virtual PDF printer that uses the document name as the file name (or basename) for generated .PDF files, the function can control the naming of the final file. 
Syntax
var m_nSequenceNumber = 0;
function GetNextPlotDocName(DocName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  DocName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  This is the name of the document output from the CustomPlotOutput.inc file.   |

The GetRedlineDocumentProperty function uses the property's Name attribute to look up the corresponding Type and Value from the collection of properties at the redline document level.

###### GetRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The GetRedlines function returns the XML string representation of all of the redlines matched by the CategoryList and filter mask. 
Syntax
XML = GetRedlines(CategoryList, FilterMask) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Category  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The Category names to be included in the XML. If CategoryList is a null string, all categories are included.   |  
|  FilterMask  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies a set of filters to control which redlines are included in the XML. The mask must be the logical OR of one or more of the following flags:
  * 0x0 — No filtering
  * 0x1 — Only selected redlines
  * 0x2 — Only generally persistible
  * 0x4 — Only plotable redlines

 |  
Return Type
String. An XML string for the matched redlines.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Each XML string that is returned is a complete XML tree that validates against Redlines.xsd. That is, it has all of the required elements and attributes and can be saved as is to a file.

###### GetRedlineStyle Function
Applies To
[Redline Interactive State Functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7oU_Heii1uomLGHLvdwdfw)
Description
The GetRedlineStyle function returns the current value of the specified style.
Syntax
StyleValue = GetRedlineStyle(StyleName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  StyleName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The [name of a style property](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/logP1znu0AuQaB5ptyj79w).   |  
Return Type
Variant
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The Redline control maintains a set of current style properties that the next placed redline inherits. The set of styles is updated whenever a new category is activated, whenever an existing redline is selected, and whenever a particular style is set with a SetRedlineStyle call. 
If the StyleName passed in as an argument to this function is not a valid style name, an exception is thrown.

###### LocateRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Edit](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/~Ma3yf2INGVfsy~dBNKi0w)
Description
The LocateRedlines function uses the X,Y coordinate passed in to try to spatially locate redlines within the specified tolerance and add the located redlines to the select set. 
Syntax
IDs = LocateRedlines(StringOfXandY, [Tolerance]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  StringOfXandY  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The X,Y coordinate to locate around.  |  
|  Tolerance  |  Double  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The locate tolerance about the point as a distance in ground units. If not specified, then the control's pixel tolerance value is converted to ground units and used for the locate operation.   |  
Return Type
String. IDs of redlines that are located. The order of IDs follows the z order of the redlines. The ID of the topmost redline element is the last ID in the string. 
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The GetLocateTolerance and SetLocateTolerance functions control a locate tolerance in pixels that is used for interactive locates at the screen. Pixels provide the user a consistent requirement for how close to be when clicking the mouse, regardless of what the current zoom scale is. However, the LocateRedlines function is called by custom code that wants to have a specific tolerance in ground units that is independent of the current view scale.

###### Login Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The Login function initiates an automatic login to the Web application.
During an automatic login, the login page, such as a welcome screen, is shown briefly before the main viewing page replaces it. An automatic login occurs when the following conditions are met: 
All of the login information—configuration, username, and password—is supplied noninteractively.
The PauseAtLogin value in Customize.inc is greater than 0. This value controls how many seconds the login page displays before the main viewing page appears. 
Syntax
Login(Configuration, Username) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Configuration  |  String  |  Required  |  Must match one of the values in the CCM file, one of the installed subsets for Field Review, or the empty string.  Subset names have the following syntax: <FieldConfiguration> " – " <SubsetName>  |  
|  Username  |  String  |  Required  |  Oracle username or empty string.  |  
Remarks
This function can be used only in a [query string](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bwI0XLJDRQ_0U8cjAjBYlg). 
Login information is supplied automatically according to the following rules:
  * You can hardcode the configuration, username, and/or password through Customize.inc. 
  * The Login function can override the configuration and/or username.
  * If the configuration and username fields are still empty, client-side cookies can supply the last configuration and username values. 
  * If the password field is still empty and this user has previously logged into the specified configuration with the specified username on this machine, the saved encrypted password that matches is retrieved. 


The Login function is not required if you supply all of the login information from Customize.inc and have set the PauseAtLogin to non-zero. This is the case for those Web servers that are using operating system authentication.

###### MeasureArea Function
Applies To
[Redline Coordinate System](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Zqu1jh3MAVzzSoc6hfZ2g)
Description
The MeasureArea function measures the area within the polygon defined by the input points given. 
The returned area is always in square meters. This function reads the MeasureOnCurvedEarthModel variable from the Customize.inc file to determine whether to measure areas on the projection or along the curved earth surface.

Area = MeasureArea(Points)

Return Type
Double
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Returns a value in square meters containing the area of the polygon.

###### NetAnalysisComplete Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The NetAnalysisComplete function is called by the Custom Analysis command when Execute.aspx has completed its analysis and is ready for NetViewer to take back control. It also provides the mechanism for transferring the results of the analysis to NetViewer for further processing, such as map viewing and report generating. 
Syntax
NetAnalysisComplete(Result, [ResultsType], ApplyThreshold, [Threshold], ThresholdOverride) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Results  |  ADO RecordSet or XML object  |  Required  |  Contains the results of the analysis function.  |  
|  ResultType  |  String  |  Optional  |  Indicates the file type of the persisted results. Defaults to RAW, but also recognizes XML.   |  
|  ApplyThreshold  |  Boolean  |  Required  |  Indicates whether the result recordset should be checked to see if the record count exceeds the threshold.   |  
|  Threshold  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  If Null or zero and ApplyThreshold is True, the FindCountThreshold value from the [G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OQ5eJGmN8hHE5WKzX6N1fQ) is used. Otherwise, this value is used as the maximum allowed record count.   |  
|  ThresholdOverride  |  String  |  Required  |  Name of the behavioral role required to override the threshold check.  |  
Remarks
This is a server-side function.
This function terminates execution of the caller page and transfer control to an internal NetViewer page through a Response.Redirect. The Response.Redirect causes ASP to call Response.End to terminate execution of the caller page. In ASP.NET, a Response.End also throws the System.Threading.ThreadAbortException. If this function is called within the scope of an exception handler, the calling code should handle the System.Threading.ThreadAbortException and do nothing.

###### NetAnalysisReportError Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The NetAnalysisReportError function is used for reporting errors that occur during Execute.aspx. This assures a consistent approach to error reporting. This can also be used for fatal errors that occur in Input.aspx. 
Syntax
NetAnalysisReportError(Error, [sURL]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Error  |  String  |  Required  |  The error string to report to the user.  |  
|  sURL  |  String  |  Optional  |  Specifies the page to load after reporting the error to the user. If not specified, the page containing the list of analysis functions displays.   |  
Remarks
This is a server-side function.
This function terminates execution of the caller page and transfer control to an internal NetViewer page through a Response.Redirect. The Response.Redirect causes ASP to call Response.End to terminate execution of the caller page. In ASP.NET, a Response.End also throws the System.Threading.ThreadAbortException. If this function is called within the scope of an exception handler, the calling code should handle the System.Threading.ThreadAbortException and do nothing.

###### NewRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The NewRedlineFile function is used to open a new redline file.
Syntax
Success = NewRedlineFile([RedlineFileName]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineFileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The name of the redline file to be created. The name should include the full path. If this argument is not specified, the function displays an Open New Redline File dialog box, which lets the user browse and enter the name of the new file before it is created.   |  
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully created.
The user can browse to a Web folder to create a new redline file.
If there is an already opened redline file to which changes have been made since the last save, the function asks whether the current redline file edits need to be saved or discarded or if the new file operation should be canceled. 
If the input RedlineFileName is not a valid file name, the method throws an exception.

###### NotifyWhenFeatureIsSelected Function
Applies To
[Net Page Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg)
Description
The NotifyWhenFeatureIsSelected function is used to get notification when the user selects a feature. 
Syntax
NotifyWhenFeatureIsSelected(Submit) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Submit  |  Boolean  |  Required  |  Tells the system whether you want your page reloaded using a form submit (True) or as a standard page load.   |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Having your page reloaded using a form submit makes the existing form controls available through the Request.Form server object. 
A hidden form control with the name tbNotifySelect is added to your form to detect when your form is being submitted for select notification. 
If you are not using the form submit, a query string argument named NotifySelect with a value of True is added to your page's existing query string when your page is loaded during notification.

###### OpenRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The OpenRedlineFile function is used to open an existing redline file.
If the selected file is a GRL file, then the user is asked to save it as an XML file.
Syntax
Success = OpenRedlineFile([RedlineFileName]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineFileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The name of the file to be opened. The name should include the full path and extension. If this argument is not specified, the function displays an Open Existing Redline File dialog box, which lets the user browse to select an existing redline file.   |  
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully opened. If the user does not accept the conversion, the operation is canceled and the file is not opened. 
The user can browse to a Web folder to open an existing redline file. If there is an already opened redline file to which changes have been made since the last save, the function asks whether the current redline file edits need to be saved or discarded or if the open file operation should be canceled. 
If the input RedlineFileName is not a valid existing file name, the function throws an exception.

###### ParsePoint Function
Applies To
[Redline Coordinate System](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Zqu1jh3MAVzzSoc6hfZ2g)
Description
The ParsePoint function is used to parse a formatted point and return a computational point (radians for geographic points, meters for projected points). This parsing takes into consideration the unit, precision, coordinate order, and so forth, as defined in the [G3E_UNITFORMAT metadata table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). 
The G3E_UNITFORMAT table defines how coordinates are formatted for the end user.
Syntax
Point = ParsePoint(Type, FormattedPoint) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Type  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Type of coordinates to parse. Possible values include:  
"GEOGRAPHIC"  "PROJECTION"  |  
|  Point  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Computational point to convert and parse.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Returns the computational point (radians for geographic points, meters for projected points).

###### ParseValue Function
Applies To
[Redline Coordinate System](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Zqu1jh3MAVzzSoc6hfZ2g)
Description
The ParseValue function is used to parse a formatted value and return a computational value (radians for angular values, meters for linear values, square meters for areas). This parsing takes into consideration the unit, precision as defined in the [G3E_UNITFORMAT metadata table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5S6bh9MtABqD5119EIdVyA). 
The G3E_UNITFORMAT table defines how coordinates are formatted for the end user.
Syntax
Set = ParseValue(Type, ValueString) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Type  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Type of value to format. Possible values include:  
"DISTANCE"  
"AREA"  
"ANGLE"  
"AZIMUTH"  
"BEARING"  
"HEIGHT"   |  
|  ValueString  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Formatted value to parse and convert to computational value. Computational distances and heights must be in meters. Computational areas must be in square meters. Computational angles, azimuths and bearings must be in radians.   |  
Return Type
Double
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Returns a computational value (radians for angular values, meters for linear values, square meters for areas).

###### PlaceLocationPinAtPoint Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlaceLocationPinAtPoint function places a [location pin](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pXbOuulrd~UTRJjzOsvfPQ) symbol at a specified map location, using a specified style, and associates attribute information with the placed symbol. 
Note: Location pins are unlike other redlines in that they cannot be saved to or loaded from a file. Also, they are not selectable; so they cannot be moved or edited. All location pins are view-scale independent. 
Syntax
PlaceLocationPinAtPoint(Point, PointType, [FontName], [FontSize], [FontColor], [CharValue], [Attribution]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Point  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The map coordinates of the LocationPin (specified as a string whose syntax corresponds with the PointType argument).   |  
|  PointType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The value must be UOR. A point in UOR syntax is an X,Y coordinate that is comma separated and the X and Y values are specified with period as the radix point.   |  
|  FontName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The symbol font family name from which the location pin character comes. If a null string is specified, the default font is the G_MapPins font.   |  
|  FontSize  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The point size for the location pin. If 0 is passed, the point size defaults to 24.  |  
|  FontColor  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The color of the location pin. It is specified as a 6-hex character string with consecutive two hex characters specifying a red, green and blue value (for example, RRGGBB format). If a null string is specified, the default is FF0000 (red).   |  
|  CharValue  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The character code value of the location pin character. If 0 is specified, the default character code from a delivered location pins font is used.   |  
|  Attribution  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The attribution string can be any arbitrary HTML string. If a null string is specified, nothing happens when the user hovers over the location pin.   |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### PlacePlotBoxesByLine Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlacePlotBoxesByLine function places plot boxes in a line.
If the two points are also passed in, the function simulates a mouse down at the first point, a mouse drag to the second point, and a mouse up at the second point. When they are not specified, the Redline control enters a placement mode where it waits for the user to either left click once to center a plot box at that point, or to do a left-mouse button down, mouse drag, and mouse up to place a series of Plot Box category redlines in a line. 
All the redlines have the specified world width and height and the same rotation angle as the placed line. The number of placed plot boxes is determined by "floor (length of the line / WorldWidth) + 1". The plot boxes are placed right edge to left edge with baselines aligned and with any extra length evenly divided and added to the beginning and end of the placed line. 
Syntax
PlacePlotBoxesByLine(WorldWidth, WorldHeight, X1, Y1, X2, [Y2]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  WorldWidth  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  The width of the plot box in world (UOR) coordinates.  |  
|  WorldHeight  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  The height of the plot box in world (UOR) coordinates.  |  
|  X1, Y1, X2, Y2  |  Double  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The two points of an imaginary line that the plot boxes are to be centered around.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### PlaceRedline Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlaceRedline function places redlines programmatically in a similar manner to interactive placement. Specifically, it uses the current state of the Redline control to complete the description of the newly placed redline. 
This function returns a redline ID value that can be used to uniquely identify the first new redline from the XML. This value does not persist beyond the lifetime of the Redline control. 
Syntax
ID = PlaceRedline(RedlineType, StringOfXandYs, Val1, Val2) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The type of the [Redlines element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/FDRMBeGpAr8rdsb6CyuO4A).  The value specified must be the name of one of the elements that can be a child of the Redlines element, such as "Line" or "Rect".   |  
|  StringOfXandYs  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies a comma-separated string of X and Y world coordinates that define the points of the geometry. Double precision values must use the period decimal separator regardless of the locale of the user.   |  
|  Val1  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If the placement mode is for text, then this is the string value to be placed. If the placement mode is for symbol, then this is the character value for the symbol in the symbol font.   |  
|  Val2  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Reserved for future use.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The PlotBoxes redline type is not supported by this method. Use the [PlacePlotBoxesByLine API](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WeLLYDzsDqxhuA8kjxXMJg) to place PlotBoxes.

###### SaveAsDGN Method
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
Description
Saves the current map view contents to the given MicroStation file.
Syntax
Object.SaveAsDGN(FileName, Version, SeedFile, CoordSystemFile) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Full path to the output DGN file name.  |  
|  Version  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Output Microstation file version along with the dimension. These are the valid values:
  * 2DV7 = 2D MicroStation V7
  * 2DV8 = 2D MicroStation V8
  * 3DV7 = 3D MicroStation V7
  * 3DV8 = 3D MicroStation V8

The default is 2DV7.  |  
|  SeedFile  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Name of the MicroStation seed file. The default value is "".  |  
|  CoordSystemFile  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Name of the coordinate system file. The default value is "".  |  
Remarks
In NetViewer, the output DGN file, once saved, is moved back to the client and copied to the target file specified by the user. The specified CSF file and the seed file should exist in the location configured in FileUNCPaths.xml file. If the seed file is not specified, it defaults to first DGN file in the configured location or the default file delivered with the product.

###### SaveAsPDF Function
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
[Printing](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ELwYvv7YyUUrFy8h5Cc15g)
Description
The SaveAsPDF function lets you customize the[Save as PDF command](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bDZgNPQLxMHGNvFyXEtQew) in NetViewer and Field Review. 
Syntax
Object.SaveAsPDF(FileName, [Orientation], [PageSize], [PageHeight], [PageWidth], [HMargin], [VMargin], [Resolution], [EmbedFont], [RedlineXML]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FileName  |  String  |  Required  |  The output file name.  |  
|  Orientation  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The paper orientation. The value for the corresponding orientation needs to be passed: 1 = Portrait 2= Landscape The default is Landscape.  |  
|  PageSize  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The paper size. The value for corresponding paper size needs to be passed. The following sizes are supported:  0 = Custom Size 1 = Letter (8 1/2 x 11 in) 5 = Legal (8 1/2 x 14 in) 8 = A3 (297 x 420 mm) 9 = A4 (210 x 297 mm) 10 = Auto Size If Custom Size is selected, the PageHeight and PageWidth need to be specified. If Auto Size is selected, the PageSize is computed by the software. The PageHeight and PageWidth are always computed by the API for the Auto Size option. The default is A4.  |  
|  PageHeight  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The page height in millimeters for the custom page size. If the PageSize option is anything other than Custom Size, this value is ignored. If it is 0, the PageHeight is computed by the software.   |  
|  PageWidth  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The page width in millimeters for the custom page size. If the PageSize option is anything other than Custom Size, this value is ignored. If it is 0, the PageWidth is computed by the software.   |  
|  HMargin  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The horizontal margin in millimeters. The default is 0.  |  
|  VMargin  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The vertical margin in millimeters. The default is 0.  |  
|  Resolution  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The printer resolution. The resolution affects the image quality and the text quality. The following resolutions (in dots per inch) are supported: 
  * 72
  * 150
  * 300
  * 600
  * 1200

The default is 600 dpi.  |  
|  EmbedFont  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether the TrueType fonts should be embedded in the document. The default is True.  |  
|  RedlineXML  |  String  |  Optional  |  XML string of redlines to be attached to the map.  |  
|  JPEGCompression  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether to activate or deactivate the JPEG compression option for 24-bit images. JPEG compression heavily reduces the size of documents containing real life images but has a slight effect on image quality.  The default is False.  |  
|  JPEGLevel  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  Sets the JPEG level when JPEG compression is True. The following JPEG levels are supported:
  * 3 – Low quality, High compression
  * 7 – Good quality, Good compression
  * 9 – High quality, Low compression.

The default is 9.  |  
|  MultiLingualSupport  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether to add support for international character sets. The default value is True  |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This API can be accessed from both the client-side script and the server-side code. The client-side API is exposed as a Net Page Extension API on the [NetViewerDOM object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/URuYQivKns2ufSBq5VmzDw). The server side API is exposed on the [MapRequest object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ). 
This API does not wait for the completion of the creation of PDF file to return the call. 
A sample page to demonstrate this function is delivered with Field Review.

###### SaveAsRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The SaveAsRedlineFile function is used to save edits to a different redline file.
Syntax
Success = SaveAsRedlineFile([RedlineFileName]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineFileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The name of the file to which redlines should be saved. The name should include the full path.  If this argument is not specified, the function displays a Save As Redline File dialog box, which lets the user browse to select the file in which the edits should be saved.   |  
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully saved.
Once the new file is selected, it replaces the current redline file as the active file. 
The user can browse to a Web folder to create a new save-as redline file.
If the input RedlineFileName is not a valid file name, the function throws an exception.

###### SetMapFrameView Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The SetMapFrameView function sets the given map view in the given map frame.
Syntax
MapView = SetMapFrameView(ViewName, FrameNumber) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ViewName  |  String  |  Required  |  Name of the view.  |  
|  FrameNumber  |  Integer  |  Required  |  Map frame number.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.
If the input ViewName is the name of a legend, then the map frame reflects the data model associated with that legend. The extents of the displayed data are determined by whether or not this frame has ever been exposed before. If this is the first exposure, the extents of the last active geographic map are used. If the frame has been exposed before, the extents of the map within that frame are used. 
If the input ViewName is the unique name of a detail area, then the map frame reflects the data model associated with that detail area. If the detail has been displayed in this frame previously, those extents are applied to position the window. If the detail has not previously been seen in this frame, then the extents are from the last active frame containing this detail area. 
If the input ViewName is an ad hoc file, then that file displays as an unregistered file according to the rules followed by the Display File command. 
The following diagrams show how the map frames are numbered:
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/257338?tocId=PCtZzjDEqolaT3LUcdO~ww)

###### SetOption Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The SetOption function sets a named option to the specified value. The option could be one of the special options that control the web application behavior, or it could be an option that is only used by the customizer. 
Syntax
SetOption(OptionName, OptionValue) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  OptionName  |  String  |  Required  |  The name of the option. Can be one of the reserved NetViewer option names or a custom name.   |  
|  OptionValue  |  String  |  Required  |  The option value.  |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.
NetViewer option names are as follows:   
|  Option name  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  MinFitWidth  |  Minimum integer distance across the map to zoom in to during fit selected feature or zoom area operations.   |  
|  SelectedFeatureColor  |  An RGB value specified as six hexadecimal characters.  |  
|  SelectMapAdjust  |  "NONE", "FIT", or "CENTER."  |  
|  ReadoutKeyinType  |  "EN" = Projection  
"LL" = Geographic   |  
|  LocateSelectOption  |  One of the following: 0 = No automatic selection.  
1 = Select single row results.  
2 = Select single row results and make Feature Explorer active.  
3 = Select first row of results.  
4 = Select first row and make Feature Explorer active.   |  
|  AutoPanSpeed  |  Controls how fast the map slides during a step pan operation. The value is the time in milliseconds to pause between movements of the map.  The following values are allowed: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50.  |  
|  ImageSizeFactor  |  Sets the size of the map image to get for every map request. When the map image is set to be larger than the map viewing area, the user sees new data slide into view during dynamic pan and dynamic zoom operations.  The following values are allowed: 1 = Do not expand the map image  
2 = Expand the map image to support a half map pan in any direction. That is, increase map area by 4x.  
3 = Expand map image to support a full map pan in any direction. That is, increase map area by 9x.   |  
|  PanStepPercentage  |  Controls how far the map slides during a step pan operation. The following values are allowed: 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100.  |  
|  ZoomWheelPercent  |  Controls how much the map zooms in or out per click of the mouse wheel. The value is a percentage of the current display scale.  The following values are allowed: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50.  |  
|  ToolTipsOnHover  |  The enabled/disabled state of the Tooltips on hover option.   |

###### SetRedlineAttrValue Function
Applies To
[Redline Edit](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/~Ma3yf2INGVfsy~dBNKi0w)
Description
The SetRedlineAttrValue function uses the redline ID and the attribute name to set the value of a specific attribute of the nodes. 
Syntax
SetRedlineAttrValue(ID, AttrName, Value) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ID  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The ID of a redline.  |  
|  AttrName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The name of the attribute that is set.  |  
|  Value  |  Variant  |  Input  |  Required  |  The new value.  |

###### TransformFromConfigurationToDB Function
Applies To
[Redline Coordinate System](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Zqu1jh3MAVzzSoc6hfZ2g)
Description
The TransformFromConfigurationToDB function transforms a point from the current configuration's coordinate system to the database coordinate system. 
Syntax
Point = TransformFromConfigurationToDB(InputPointType, OutputPointType, Point) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  InputPointType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Type of input coordinates to convert from. Possible values include:  
"GEOGRAPHIC"  
"PROJECTION"  
"UOR"  These coordinate types are defined in the [GCOORDSYSTEMTABLE metadata table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XwuKVI_U5ObpDp0hIkR1tA) for the current configuration's coordinate system.   |  
|  OutputPointType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Type of output coordinates to convert to. See InputPointType for possible values.  |  
|  Point  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Input point to be transformed. This is a string in the format "x.x,y.y". The comma delimits the X and Y portions of the coordinate. Double precision values must use the period decimal separate regardless of the locale of the user.   |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Returns the output point converted to the type defined in the OutputPointType parameter. See the Point parameter for format definition. 
"UOR" is also referred to as Units of Resolution, Storage, DDC or World depending on the context. 
Geographic coordinates must be expressed in radians. Projection coordinates must be expressed in meters. 
You can use the ParsePoint or ConvertUnitToUnit functions to perform unit conversions for coordinates.

|  Point  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Input point to be transformed.  This is a string in the format "x.x,y.y". The comma delimits the x and y portions of the coordinate. Double precision values must use the period decimal separate regardless of the locale of the user.   |

String
Remarks

"UOR" is also referred to as Units of Resolution, Storage, DDC or World depending on the context. 
Geographic coordinates must be expressed in radians. Projection coordinates must be expressed in meters.

###### Zoom Function
Applies To
[Map Viewing](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8pEVqjJux9JipDLnAYC2hg)
Description
The Zoom function zooms in or out smoothly on the map by the specified percentage.
The percentage is applied to the current map scale. Negative percentages cause the map to zoom out while positive percentages cause the map to zoom in.   
|  Example If the active map is currently at a 1:1000 display scale, then a call to Zoom(-25.0) would do a smooth zoom out from the center of map to a new scale of 1:1250.  Similarly, Zoom(25.0) starting at 1:1000 would zoom in to a new scale of 1:800. So, a Zoom(-25) following by a Zoom(25) would zoom out 25 percent then zoom in 25 percent and leave the map at the display scale it started with.   |  
| --- |  
Syntax
Zoom(Percentage) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Percentage  |  Double  |  Required  |  The direction and percentage amount to zoom the map.  |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.

###### GetNextPlotDocName Hook
Applies To
[NetViewer-to-Plotting](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/I3wcVKxxUVSQkoVXGC4h7g)
Description
The GetNextPlotDocName hook lets you override the default name for the plot document. The default implementation simply appends a sequence number such as _1 or _2 to the input argument and returns it. 
To override the default naming, provide an alternative name as the return value from the GetNextPlotDocName function defined in the CustomPlotOutput.inc file. 
The plot document name displays in the print queue for the specified device. If the target device is a virtual PDF printer that uses the document name as the file name (or basename) for generated .PDF files, the function can control the naming of the final file. 
Syntax
var m_nSequenceNumber = 0;
function GetNextPlotDocName(DocName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  DocName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  This is the name of the document output from the CustomPlotOutput.inc file.   |

###### PostProcessPlotRequest Hook
Applies To
NetViewer[-to-Plotting](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/I3wcVKxxUVSQkoVXGC4h7g)
Description
The PostProcessPlotRequest hook is used to perform special processing on the plot request just after it returns from the Plotting Web service's [SendPlotRequest method](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Gc~~h5I~P3piN5K_idO8aQ). This optional processing is enabled by setting the m_bPostProcessPlotRequest variable to True. 
Syntax
PostProcessPlotRequest(strPlotRequestXML, strPlotStatus, strCustomInfoXML) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  strPlotRequestXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML description of the plot request. For more information, see [RemotePlottingRequest XML Documents](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P5ezW0aS6L5H3nHPbPjz~w).   |  
|  strPlotStatus  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The plot status XML that was returned from the SendPlotRequest method. For more information, see [PlotStatus Element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/R4VX1NhDqqTpkqz7oEpOnA).   |  
|  strCustomInfoXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML description of custom information that was gathered from the CustomInput.aspx page, if that page was used.   |  
Remarks
The XML schema definition for the XML string that is passed to the PostProcessPlotRequest hook function is in the RemotePlotting.xsd file delivered with NetViewer in the \GTechnology\Program\GViewerApp\Customize folder. 
When the m_bPostProcessPlotRequest variable is set to true, both the Send to Plotting (SubmitPlotExecStd.aspx) and the Define Plot (DefinePlotExecStd.aspx) commands call the PostProcessPlotRequest function so you can process the plot request XML and its plot status just after it returns from the SendPlotRequest method. 
The custom user information XML, collected from CustomPlotInput.aspx, if it exists, is also passed in to the PostProcessPlotRequest function. 
The routine is called once for each plot request. So, if you define three plot boxes in the Define Plot command, PostProcessPlotRequest is called three times.

###### PreProcessPlotRequest Hook
Applies To
[NetViewer-to-Plotting](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/I3wcVKxxUVSQkoVXGC4h7g)
Description
The PreProcessPlotRequest hook is used to perform special processing on the plot request just before it is sent to the Plotting Web Service. This optional processing is enabled by setting the m_bPreProcessPlotRequest variable to True. 
Syntax
PreProcessPlotRequest(strPlotRequestXML, strCustomInfoXML) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  strPlotRequestXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML description of the plot request. For more information, see [RemotePlottingRequest XML Documents](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P5ezW0aS6L5H3nHPbPjz~w).   |  
|  strCustomInfoXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML description of custom information that was gathered from the CustomInput.aspx page, if that page was used.   |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
The XML schema definition for the XML string that is passed to the PreProcessPlotRequest hook function is in the RemotePlotting.xsd file delivered with NetViewer in the \GTechnology\Program\GViewerApp\Customize folder. 
This method returns the altered plot request XML string.
When the m_bPreProcessPlotRequest variable is set to true, both the Send to Plotting (SubmitPlotExecStd.aspx) and the Define Plot (DefinePlotExecStd.aspx) commands call the PreProcessPlotRequest function so you can alter the plot request XML just before it is sent to the Plotting Web Service. 
The custom user, collected from CustomPlotInput.aspx, if it exists, is also passed in to the PreProcessPlotReqinfo XMLuest function. 
The routine is called once for each plot request. So, if you define three plot boxes in the Define Plot command, PreProcessPlotRequest is called three times.

###### PostProcessPlotRequest Hook
Applies To
NetViewer[-to-Plotting](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/I3wcVKxxUVSQkoVXGC4h7g)
Description
The PostProcessPlotRequest hook is used to perform special processing on the plot request just after it returns from the Plotting Web service's [SendPlotRequest method](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Gc~~h5I~P3piN5K_idO8aQ). This optional processing is enabled by setting the m_bPostProcessPlotRequest variable to True. 
Syntax
PostProcessPlotRequest(strPlotRequestXML, strPlotStatus, strCustomInfoXML) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  strPlotRequestXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML description of the plot request. For more information, see [RemotePlottingRequest XML Documents](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P5ezW0aS6L5H3nHPbPjz~w).   |  
|  strPlotStatus  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The plot status XML that was returned from the SendPlotRequest method. For more information, see [PlotStatus Element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/R4VX1NhDqqTpkqz7oEpOnA).   |  
|  strCustomInfoXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML description of custom information that was gathered from the CustomInput.aspx page, if that page was used.   |  
Remarks
The XML schema definition for the XML string that is passed to the PostProcessPlotRequest hook function is in the RemotePlotting.xsd file delivered with NetViewer in the \GTechnology\Program\GViewerApp\Customize folder. 
When the m_bPostProcessPlotRequest variable is set to true, both the Send to Plotting (SubmitPlotExecStd.aspx) and the Define Plot (DefinePlotExecStd.aspx) commands call the PostProcessPlotRequest function so you can process the plot request XML and its plot status just after it returns from the SendPlotRequest method. 
The custom user information XML, collected from CustomPlotInput.aspx, if it exists, is also passed in to the PostProcessPlotRequest function. 
The routine is called once for each plot request. So, if you define three plot boxes in the Define Plot command, PostProcessPlotRequest is called three times.

###### PreProcessPlotRequest Hook
Applies To
[NetViewer-to-Plotting](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/I3wcVKxxUVSQkoVXGC4h7g)
Description
The PreProcessPlotRequest hook is used to perform special processing on the plot request just before it is sent to the Plotting Web Service. This optional processing is enabled by setting the m_bPreProcessPlotRequest variable to True. 
Syntax
PreProcessPlotRequest(strPlotRequestXML, strCustomInfoXML) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  strPlotRequestXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML description of the plot request. For more information, see [RemotePlottingRequest XML Documents](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P5ezW0aS6L5H3nHPbPjz~w).   |  
|  strCustomInfoXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML description of custom information that was gathered from the CustomInput.aspx page, if that page was used.   |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
The XML schema definition for the XML string that is passed to the PreProcessPlotRequest hook function is in the RemotePlotting.xsd file delivered with NetViewer in the \GTechnology\Program\GViewerApp\Customize folder. 
This method returns the altered plot request XML string.
When the m_bPreProcessPlotRequest variable is set to true, both the Send to Plotting (SubmitPlotExecStd.aspx) and the Define Plot (DefinePlotExecStd.aspx) commands call the PreProcessPlotRequest function so you can alter the plot request XML just before it is sent to the Plotting Web Service. 
The custom user, collected from CustomPlotInput.aspx, if it exists, is also passed in to the PreProcessPlotReqinfo XMLuest function. 
The routine is called once for each plot request. So, if you define three plot boxes in the Define Plot command, PreProcessPlotRequest is called three times.

###### Remote Plotting XML Schemas
After each plot request is sent to Plotting, the PostProcessPlotRequest function is called and passed an [XML representation of the plot request](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P5ezW0aS6L5H3nHPbPjz~w) and an [XML representation of the plot status](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GgjHi~fPuAc24t1SsPsfAg). You can implement special processing of the last plot request. 
In general, the RemotePlotting root node contains either zero or more PlotRequest elements, or zero or more PlotStatus elements. Hence, this schema could represent either the contents of the plot request queue or the contents of the plot status queue. 
To process the XML string that was passed in, you must know how to interpret it. Likewise, to replace the PlotStatus.xsl you must know the XML of the plot status report. A Remote Plotting XML schema called RemotePlotting.xsd is provided in the NetViewer /Customize folder.

###### Events and Callback Notification Functions

###### AddEventHandler Function
Applies To
[Net Page Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg)
Description
The AddEventHandler function associates a client-side callback function with a client event. 
The custom event handlers that are added by this function are notified whenever a [Redline DisplayControl event](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/4LyU4_Zt~iqvC1EPCW4CXg) occurs and whenever the [value of a session variable](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Ck0CNkScxUSjdeeWVJdEA) changes. 
There can be more than one callback function for each event; but a specific callback function is written to handle one event type. The callback functions are called in the same order that they were added. The callback functions are expected to have the same number of arguments in the same order as the event for which the callback is called. 
Syntax
AddEventHandler(EventType, this, CallbackFuncName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  EventType  |  String  |  Required  |  Specifies the [name of an event](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/fSIa2AwLDPCnaJ1l3nREzA).   |  
|  this  |  String  |  Required  |  The second argument must be the "this" keyword. Passing the "this" pointer establishes the context of the callback function.   |  
|  CallbackFuncName  |  String  |  Required  |  Specifies a client-side script function name.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The Customframe.htm page is loaded into a hidden frame of the Web application and has the same lifetime as the main NetViewer page. This is the best place to add custom event handler functions that need to handle events for the entire session. 
Event handling that makes sense only during the lifetime of the execution of a custom command page should be enabled and disabled by OnWindowLoad and OnWindowUnload logic, respectively, for the custom page. 
If the callback location in the [NetViewerDOM object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/URuYQivKns2ufSBq5VmzDw) is incorrect or the callback does not exist, that callback function is removed from the list of functions to be called. 
If the callback function throws an exception, indicating that an unhandled exception occur inside the callback, that callback function is removed from the list of functions to be called, and an alert message pops up.

###### ClickOnMapForPoint Function
Applies To
[Net Page Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg)
Description
The ClickOnMapForPoint function is called by the custom command when it needs to get a point from the user. This function changes the wait cursor to a crosshair and turns off the current point mode. 
Syntax
ClickOnMapForPoint(PointType) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  PointType  |  String  |  Required  |  Type of point to be returned in the QueryString of the page. Possible values include
  * Projection
  * Geographic
  * UOR

 |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
When the user enters a point, by clicking the map or by precision key-in, the calling page is reloaded with a QueryString member called UserPoint containing the point in the specified point mode. The point is a string that is comma delimited. 
When the PointType is Projection or Geographic, the value of the UserPoint query string is in a localized format for the X and Y projection coordinates or the longitutude and latitude geographic coordinates. However, the UOR point mode is always a string formatted in the USA locale—that is,comma delimited with a period as the radix point. 
UOR points are not intended for end user display, but for programmatic exchange from this function to other client-side functions such as PlaceLocationPinAtPoint. Regardless of the PointType setting, this function also returns a UORPoint query string value after the UserPoint value.

###### NotifyWhenFeatureIsSelected Function
Applies To
[Net Page Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg)
Description
The NotifyWhenFeatureIsSelected function is used to get notification when the user selects a feature. 
Syntax
NotifyWhenFeatureIsSelected(Submit) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Submit  |  Boolean  |  Required  |  Tells the system whether you want your page reloaded using a form submit (True) or as a standard page load.   |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Having your page reloaded using a form submit makes the existing form controls available through the Request.Form server object. 
A hidden form control with the name tbNotifySelect is added to your form to detect when your form is being submitted for select notification. 
If you are not using the form submit, a query string argument named NotifySelect with a value of True is added to your page's existing query string when your page is loaded during notification.

###### RedlineMouseMove Event
Applies To
[Net Page Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUTAPdmES3p7L4w6bZXSxg)
Description
The RedlineMouseMove event is called when the user moves the mouse over the map.
Syntax
RedlineMouseMove(XPixelPos,YPixelPos, XWorldPos, YWorldPos) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  XPixelPos  |  Double  |  Required  |  The position in pixels of the cursor on the horizontal plane.  |  
|  YPixelPos  |  Double  |  Required  |  The position in pixels of the cursor on the vertical plane.  |  
|  XWorldPos  |  Double  |  Required  |  The position in world coordinates of the cursor on the horizontal plane.  |  
|  YWorldPos  |  Double  |  Required  |  The position in world coordinates of the cursor on the vertical plane.  |  
Remarks
This function is called at a very high frequency. You must be extremely careful not to do any computationally intensive operations within the event handler function for this event. By default, MouseMove events are disabled. To enable them, call [EnableRedlineMouseMoveEvents](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AZF1bewIaonM6qbLuMiMHg). 
The custom event handlers added by the [AddEventHandler function](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/lHJjLZHW1uXwuCVHuFHGRw) are notified whenever this event occurs.

Description

Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  EventType  |  String  |  Required  |  Specifies the [name of an event](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/fSIa2AwLDPCnaJ1l3nREzA).   |

|  CallbackFuncName  |  String  |  Required  |  Specifies a client-side script function name.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### Zoom Function
Applies To
[Map Viewing](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8pEVqjJux9JipDLnAYC2hg)
Description
The Zoom function zooms in or out smoothly on the map by the specified percentage.
The percentage is applied to the current map scale. Negative percentages cause the map to zoom out while positive percentages cause the map to zoom in.   
|  Example If the active map is currently at a 1:1000 display scale, then a call to Zoom(-25.0) would do a smooth zoom out from the center of map to a new scale of 1:1250.  Similarly, Zoom(25.0) starting at 1:1000 would zoom in to a new scale of 1:800. So, a Zoom(-25) following by a Zoom(25) would zoom out 25 percent then zoom in 25 percent and leave the map at the display scale it started with.   |  
| --- |  
Syntax
Zoom(Percentage) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Percentage  |  Double  |  Required  |  The direction and percentage amount to zoom the map.  |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.

###### Net Page Extension API Programming Considerations
Most of the Net Page Extension APIs are client-side functions that obey the usual call and return semantics of programming languages. However, several of the APIs have asynchronous side effects, usually requiring a trip to the Web server. You must account for these side effects when calling these APIs one after the other within a custom workflow without waiting for a user action to take place in between. 
Synchronization among the functions in this group can be achieved by using the ExecQueryCommands function.   
|  Example If custom code calls FitMap() and then immediately calls GetSessionValue('DisplayScaleDenominator'), the wrong display might be returned because the map update had not yet completed. However, if the custom code calls ExecQueryCommands("eval=FitMap()&eval=GetSessionValue('DisplayScaleDenominator')"), the sequencing is correct.   |  
| --- |  
The table below lists the functions that need to be called within the ExecQueryCommands function:   
|  Function  |  Comments  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  CenterMapAtPoint  |  Fetches new map unless it smooth pans without hitting edge of map.  |  
|  ClearJob  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  CopyMapToClipboard  |  The map image being copied may be changing.  |  
|  FinishPrint  |  Resizes frame which fetches new map.  |  
|  FitJob  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  FitMap  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  FitRedlines  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  FitAllLocationPins  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  GetSessionValue  |  Value being fetched may be changed by pending map load.  |  
|  KeyinPoint  |  May fetch new map - depends on current map mode.  |  
|  Print  |  Map fetch new map - depends on extra map setting.  |  
|  ResetAfterPrint  |  Map fetch new map - depends on extra map setting.  |  
|  SaveAsPDF  |  The map image being printed may be changing.  |  
|  SetActiveMapFrameNumber  |  May change contents of Legend pane.  |  
|  SetDetail  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  SetDisplayScale  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  SetInputPane  |  May change map frame size which fetches new map.  |  
|  SetJob  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  SetLegend  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  SetLegendEntries  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  SetMapFrameLayout  |  Resizes frame which fetches new map.  |  
|  SetMapFrameView  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  SetOption  |  SelectedFeatureColor and ImageSizeFactor reload map.  |  
|  SetResultsPane  |  May change map frame size which fetches new map.  |  
|  SetSelectedFeature  |  Fetches new map unless map adjust option is NONE.  |  
|  Zoom  |  Fetches new map.  |  
|  ZoomArea  |  Fetches new map.  |
