###### SaveAsPDF Function
Applies To
[MapRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ)
[Printing](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ELwYvv7YyUUrFy8h5Cc15g)
Description
The SaveAsPDF function lets you customize the[Save as PDF command](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bDZgNPQLxMHGNvFyXEtQew) in NetViewer and Field Review. 
Syntax
Object.SaveAsPDF(FileName, [Orientation], [PageSize], [PageHeight], [PageWidth], [HMargin], [VMargin], [Resolution], [EmbedFont], [RedlineXML]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FileName  |  String  |  Required  |  The output file name.  |  
|  Orientation  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The paper orientation. The value for the corresponding orientation needs to be passed: 1 = Portrait 2= Landscape The default is Landscape.  |  
|  PageSize  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The paper size. The value for corresponding paper size needs to be passed. The following sizes are supported:  0 = Custom Size 1 = Letter (8 1/2 x 11 in) 5 = Legal (8 1/2 x 14 in) 8 = A3 (297 x 420 mm) 9 = A4 (210 x 297 mm) 10 = Auto Size If Custom Size is selected, the PageHeight and PageWidth need to be specified. If Auto Size is selected, the PageSize is computed by the software. The PageHeight and PageWidth are always computed by the API for the Auto Size option. The default is A4.  |  
|  PageHeight  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The page height in millimeters for the custom page size. If the PageSize option is anything other than Custom Size, this value is ignored. If it is 0, the PageHeight is computed by the software.   |  
|  PageWidth  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The page width in millimeters for the custom page size. If the PageSize option is anything other than Custom Size, this value is ignored. If it is 0, the PageWidth is computed by the software.   |  
|  HMargin  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The horizontal margin in millimeters. The default is 0.  |  
|  VMargin  |  Double  |  Optional  |  The vertical margin in millimeters. The default is 0.  |  
|  Resolution  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  The printer resolution. The resolution affects the image quality and the text quality. The following resolutions (in dots per inch) are supported: 
  * 72
  * 150
  * 300
  * 600
  * 1200

The default is 600 dpi.  |  
|  EmbedFont  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether the TrueType fonts should be embedded in the document. The default is True.  |  
|  RedlineXML  |  String  |  Optional  |  XML string of redlines to be attached to the map.  |  
|  JPEGCompression  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether to activate or deactivate the JPEG compression option for 24-bit images. JPEG compression heavily reduces the size of documents containing real life images but has a slight effect on image quality.  The default is False.  |  
|  JPEGLevel  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  Sets the JPEG level when JPEG compression is True. The following JPEG levels are supported:
  * 3 – Low quality, High compression
  * 7 – Good quality, Good compression
  * 9 – High quality, Low compression.

The default is 9.  |  
|  MultiLingualSupport  |  Boolean  |  Optional  |  Indicates whether to add support for international character sets. The default value is True  |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This API can be accessed from both the client-side script and the server-side code. The client-side API is exposed as a Net Page Extension API on the [NetViewerDOM object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/URuYQivKns2ufSBq5VmzDw). The server side API is exposed on the [MapRequest object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aVe78f49yvL_bm79~ABvQQ). 
This API does not wait for the completion of the creation of PDF file to return the call. 
A sample page to demonstrate this function is delivered with Field Review.

###### CancelAction Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The CancelAction function can be called within the Before event handlers to cancel the current operation. 
Operations that can be canceled include:
  * Map frame layout changes
  * Map frame view changes
  * Map frame activation


Syntax
CancelAction(EventName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  EventName  |  String  |  Required  |  The name of the event handler canceling the action. This is always the Before event for the action.  These are the valid values:
  * To cancel map frame layout changes: BeforeMapFrameLayoutChanged
  * To cancel map frame view changes: BeforeMapFrameViewChanged
  * To cancel map frame activation: BeforeMapFrameActivated

 |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Multiple event handlers can be active. If any of the active event handlers cancels the action, it is canceled. Certain product operations, such as the interactive ad hoc file registration, change the frame layout. A project event handler should consider this when canceling the action to be sure it was the action it expected to cancel.

###### SetMapFrameView Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The SetMapFrameView function sets the given map view in the given map frame.
Syntax
MapView = SetMapFrameView(ViewName, FrameNumber) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ViewName  |  String  |  Required  |  Name of the view.  |  
|  FrameNumber  |  Integer  |  Required  |  Map frame number.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.
If the input ViewName is the name of a legend, then the map frame reflects the data model associated with that legend. The extents of the displayed data are determined by whether or not this frame has ever been exposed before. If this is the first exposure, the extents of the last active geographic map are used. If the frame has been exposed before, the extents of the map within that frame are used. 
If the input ViewName is the unique name of a detail area, then the map frame reflects the data model associated with that detail area. If the detail has been displayed in this frame previously, those extents are applied to position the window. If the detail has not previously been seen in this frame, then the extents are from the last active frame containing this detail area. 
If the input ViewName is an ad hoc file, then that file displays as an unregistered file according to the rules followed by the Display File command. 
The following diagrams show how the map frames are numbered:
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/257338?tocId=e35mk4bmGBVauIH5zBPMpQ)

###### SetOption Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The SetOption function sets a named option to the specified value. The option could be one of the special options that control the web application behavior, or it could be an option that is only used by the customizer. 
Syntax
SetOption(OptionName, OptionValue) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  OptionName  |  String  |  Required  |  The name of the option. Can be one of the reserved NetViewer option names or a custom name.   |  
|  OptionValue  |  String  |  Required  |  The option value.  |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.
NetViewer option names are as follows:   
|  Option name  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  MinFitWidth  |  Minimum integer distance across the map to zoom in to during fit selected feature or zoom area operations.   |  
|  SelectedFeatureColor  |  An RGB value specified as six hexadecimal characters.  |  
|  SelectMapAdjust  |  "NONE", "FIT", or "CENTER."  |  
|  ReadoutKeyinType  |  "EN" = Projection  
"LL" = Geographic   |  
|  LocateSelectOption  |  One of the following: 0 = No automatic selection.  
1 = Select single row results.  
2 = Select single row results and make Feature Explorer active.  
3 = Select first row of results.  
4 = Select first row and make Feature Explorer active.   |  
|  AutoPanSpeed  |  Controls how fast the map slides during a step pan operation. The value is the time in milliseconds to pause between movements of the map.  The following values are allowed: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50.  |  
|  ImageSizeFactor  |  Sets the size of the map image to get for every map request. When the map image is set to be larger than the map viewing area, the user sees new data slide into view during dynamic pan and dynamic zoom operations.  The following values are allowed: 1 = Do not expand the map image  
2 = Expand the map image to support a half map pan in any direction. That is, increase map area by 4x.  
3 = Expand map image to support a full map pan in any direction. That is, increase map area by 9x.   |  
|  PanStepPercentage  |  Controls how far the map slides during a step pan operation. The following values are allowed: 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100.  |  
|  ZoomWheelPercent  |  Controls how much the map zooms in or out per click of the mouse wheel. The value is a percentage of the current display scale.  The following values are allowed: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50.  |  
|  ToolTipsOnHover  |  The enabled/disabled state of the Tooltips on hover option.   |

Applies To

Description
The NetAnalysisComplete function is called by the Custom Analysis command when Execute.aspx has completed its analysis and is ready for NetViewer to take back control. It also provides the mechanism for transferring the results of the analysis to NetViewer for further processing, such as map viewing and report generating. 
Syntax
NetAnalysisComplete(Result, [ResultsType], ApplyThreshold, [Threshold], ThresholdOverride) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Results  |  ADO RecordSet or XML object  |  Required  |  Contains the results of the analysis function.  |  
|  ResultType  |  String  |  Optional  |  Indicates the file type of the persisted results. Defaults to RAW, but also recognizes XML.   |  
|  ApplyThreshold  |  Boolean  |  Required  |  Indicates whether the result recordset should be checked to see if the record count exceeds the threshold.   |  
|  Threshold  |  Integer  |  Optional  |  If Null or zero and ApplyThreshold is True, the FindCountThreshold value from the [G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OQ5eJGmN8hHE5WKzX6N1fQ) is used. Otherwise, this value is used as the maximum allowed record count.   |  
|  ThresholdOverride  |  String  |  Required  |  Name of the behavioral role required to override the threshold check.  |  
Remarks
This is a server-side function.
This function terminates execution of the caller page and transfer control to an internal NetViewer page through a Response.Redirect. The Response.Redirect causes ASP to call Response.End to terminate execution of the caller page. In ASP.NET, a Response.End also throws the System.Threading.ThreadAbortException. If this function is called within the scope of an exception handler, the calling code should handle the System.Threading.ThreadAbortException and do nothing.

###### Login Function
Applies To
[Field Review Framework](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/whW1_5dcrkfOgWNRRIHpMg)
Description
The Login function initiates an automatic login to the Web application.
During an automatic login, the login page, such as a welcome screen, is shown briefly before the main viewing page replaces it. An automatic login occurs when the following conditions are met: 
All of the login information—configuration, username, and password—is supplied noninteractively.
The PauseAtLogin value in Customize.inc is greater than 0. This value controls how many seconds the login page displays before the main viewing page appears. 
Syntax
Login(Configuration, Username) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Configuration  |  String  |  Required  |  Must match one of the values in the CCM file, one of the installed subsets for Field Review, or the empty string.  Subset names have the following syntax: <FieldConfiguration> " – " <SubsetName>  |  
|  Username  |  String  |  Required  |  Oracle username or empty string.  |  
Remarks
This function can be used only in a [query string](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bwI0XLJDRQ_0U8cjAjBYlg). 
Login information is supplied automatically according to the following rules:
  * You can hardcode the configuration, username, and/or password through Customize.inc. 
  * The Login function can override the configuration and/or username.
  * If the configuration and username fields are still empty, client-side cookies can supply the last configuration and username values. 
  * If the password field is still empty and this user has previously logged into the specified configuration with the specified username on this machine, the saved encrypted password that matches is retrieved. 


The Login function is not required if you supply all of the login information from Customize.inc and have set the PauseAtLogin to non-zero. This is the case for those Web servers that are using operating system authentication.

###### Location Pins
A location pin is a map symbol implemented using redline symbols; however, the user cannot manipulate location pins using normal redline operations. It uses the _LocationPin category in the GTechnology/GViewApp/Customize/Categories.xml file. 
Location Pin on Map View
The location pin that appears on the map is implemented as a special redline symbol (from a TrueType symbol font). The custom command specifies the exact font family name, font size, font color, and character value. If a special font is required, you must verify that this font is installed on all NetViewer client machines. However, no special font installation is required if you use a character from one of the Microsoft-installed symbol fonts. 
If no font information is passed to the [PlaceLocationPinAtPoint function](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/solLzXr0iCkAxLSMFGQhZA), a 24-point red push pin symbol from a location pins font is used. NetViewer client delivers a small TrueType font containing a few symbols whose hot spot coincides with the leftmost baseline position of the glyph, which is the placement point for redline symbols. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/260365) Text weight and text width-to-height ratio are honored only for TrueType fonts. 
Attribute Window Next to Cursor
When the user hovers for one second over a location pin that has string attribution, the associated string displays in a window near the cursor. The cursor position divides the map view into four quadrants and the information window appears in the largest quadrant. The window style matches the style of all other pop-up tooltip windows in NetViewer. The string is processed as HTML text; hence, you can format the information associated with the location pin as required. 
The window remains visible until the user moves the mouse off the location pin or performs a right-mouse click. If a location pin overlaps another location pin, the right-mouse click displays the attribution of the bottom location pin in the window, and the bottom location pin is moved to the top of the display order to help clarify which location pin corresponds with the window.

######## Redline Category Attributes

###### Redline Category DisplayLevel Attribute
The DisplayLevel attribute defines the overall order for drawing categories. Every category should have a unique DisplayLevel value. If it does not, then the order in which the categories are added to the Redline control determines their order; the last added is drawn first. 
Redlines within the same category are drawn in the order they are created unless they have been reordered by commands such as MoveToFront or MoveToBack. Higher numbered levels are drawn before lower numbered levels. 
The built-in category _Dynamics has a value of zero and is always drawn on top. The built-in categories _Default and _PlotBox have a DisplayLevel value of one. The IsDisplayed attribute controls whether redlines in this category are displayed. 
As individual redlines within a category are being drawn, the redline element's IsSelected attribute and the category's EditGeometryOperations attribute control whether the redline is drawn with edit handles at each of its vertices. In addition, the individual redline's LegendNumber and DetailID must match the current control settings.

###### Redline Category EventsFired Attribute
For custom code to be notified of redline events, two conditions must be met:
  * The custom code must have established a callback function for the redline event.
  * The corresponding event attribute for the category must be set to fire.


The parameters that are passed in the events are specified in the AddEventHandler function. There are no events for client start and client shutdown. Instead of events, you simply add your own startup and shutdown logic to the OnWindowLoad and OnWindowUnload handlers in [CustomFrame.htm](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/G00EkobGonzWDtj8wem~_A). 
The following events, set to True, are enabled for categories. One event, CategoryChange, fires whenever the active category changes. This event is always enabled and does not need to be listed in the EventsFired attribute.   
|  Event  |  Fires when  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Select  |  Redline is added or removed from select set.  |  
|  ModeChange  |  Redline mode changes.  |  
|  Delete  |  Redline is deleted.  |  
|  Hover  |  Mouse position is over redline.  |  
|  CancelHover  |  Mouse position moves off redline.  |  
|  PlacementStart  |  A placement starts.  |  
|  PlacementEnd  |  A placement completes.  |  
|  Cancel  |  A placement of redline is canceled.  |  
|  LButtonDown  |  Left mouse is down. This event occurs whether or not the mouse is currently over a redline.  |  
|  LButtonUp  |  Left mouse is up. This event occurs whether or not the mouse is currently over a redline  |  
|  LButtonDblClick  |  Left mouse is double-clicked. This event occurs whether or not the mouse is currently over a redline  |  
|  RButtonDown  |  Right mouse is clicked. This event occurs whether or not the mouse is currently over a redline  |

###### Redline Category Modes Attribute
The Modes attribute is a comma-separated string value that provides a list of permitted modes. The DefaultMode attribute specifies the starting mode when the category is activated. 
The list values are as follows:  
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  DisplayOnly  |  Display-only mode is allowed. This is a passive display mode where redlines are drawn, but no mouse events at the map are consumed.   |  
|  SelectEdit  |  Allows redlines in the active category to be located with a mouse click and then added to the redline select set. Requires that the Select operation also be allowed.   |  
|  PlaceLine  |  Allows placement of line geometries.  |  
|  PlaceRect  |  Allows placement of rectangle geometries.  |  
|  PlaceEllipse  |  Allows placement of ellipse geometries.  |  
|  PlaceLineString  |  Allows placement of polyline geometries.  |  
|  PlacePolygon  |  Allows placement of polygon geometries.  |  
|  PlaceText  |  Allows placement of text geometries.  |  
|  PlaceSymbol  |  Allows placement of symbol geometries.  |  
|  PlacePlotBoxes  |  Allows placement of plot boxes.  |  
|  FenceDynamic  |  Allows placement of a dynamic fence.  |  
|  LinestringDynamic  |  Allows placement of a dynamic linestring.  |  
|  PolygonDynamic  |  Allows placement of a dynamic polygon.  |  
|  AllowAllModes  |  Allows all of the above modes.  |

###### Redline Category Name Attribute
Functions that operate on categories pass a category name or a list of category names to identify the categories. Category names that begin with an underscore character are reserved by Hexagon. Do not change any of the characteristics of the Hexagon reserved categories. The following are ther reserved category names:   
|  Name  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  _Default  |  Used for all general mark-up redlines.  |  
|  _Dynamics  |  Used at runtime to define the style of temporary graphics used by several Web application functions such as Fence Select, Zoom Area, and Measure Along Feature.   |  
|  _PlotBox  |  Used by the Define Plot command.  |  
|  _LocationPin  |  Used by the PlaceLocationPinAtPoint function.  |

###### Redline Category Operations Attribute
The Operations attribute is a comma-separated string value that provides a list of permitted operations. The list values are as follows:   
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Select  |  Redlines that belong to the active category can be located and added to the select set.   |  
|  EditStyle  |  Redline style can be changed. When the category allows style to be edited, the Redline control tracks any changes to the style settings so that switching among categories always restores the last style settings for the category.   |  
|  EditProperty  |  Redline user properties can be added or changed.  |  
|  EditGeometry  |  Redline can be edited, that is, it can be moved, deleted, scaled, rotated, and so forth.   |  
|  Persist  |  Redline can be exported to file through the general Save Redlines command.  |  
|  Plot  |  Redline is included in plots.  |  
|  ControlDisplay  |  Redline visibility is controlled by the Redlines On/Off button.  |  
|  ActivateCategory  |  Controls which categories are available for selection on the Active Category list.  |  
|  AllOperations  |  All of the above operations are allowed.  |

###### Redline Category Style Attribute
The following attribute values are optionally used to control the drawing style of redlines during display. These attributes are set in Categories.xml delivered in the \GTechnology\Program\GViewerApp\Customize folder.   
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  FillColor  |  [The RGB](javascript:;) value of the interior of area geometry (only used when BrushStyle is BS_SOLID).   |  
|  FillStyle  |  The GDI BS_* value for specifying brush styles—solid, hatched, or transparent.  |  
|  FillHatch  |  The GDI HS_* value that indicates the type of hatching. Only used when BrushStyle is BS_HATCHED.   |  
|  FontAlignment  |  The alignment for the text can be any of the following:
  * Bottom Center
  * Bottom Left
  * Bottom Right
  * Center Center
  * Center Left
  * Center Right
  * Left Baseline
  * Top Center
  * Top Left
  * Top Right

 |  
|  [FontColor](javascript:;)  |  The pen color for the text that is drawn.  |  
|  FontName  |  A font family name such as Arial or Times New Roman.  |  
|  FontSize  |  The height of font in points. Accepts double precision values to match Designer/Analyst feature styles during redline placement.   |  
|  FontStyle  |  Specifies one of the following values: Regular, Bold, Italic, or Bold Italic.  |  
|  LineColor  |  The [RGB value of linear geometry](javascript:;), or the boundary or hatching of area geometry, or the text or symbol font color.   |  
|  LineStyle  |  The GDI PS_* value for specifying pen style stroking—for example, solid, dashed, or dotted.   |  
|  LineWidth  |  The width of the pen in pixels. Accepts double precision values to match Designer/Analyst feature styles during redline placement.   |  
|  MapScale  |  Indicates what the map-scale-denominator value was when the redline was created. This value is used to scale text height and line widths for redlines that have a view-scale- dependent style.   |  
|  StartSymbol  |  A comma delimited string containing the font name, symbol character, symbol size, [alignment](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/~6VeMGRDMTO4Znaq3Xabvw), and invert flag (for example, StartSymbol="G_GENSYM,Z,12,1,1") used to display a start symbol. The symbol character can also be defined in the format 0xhh (for example, 0xFF) where h represents a hexadecimal number to support unambiguous glyphs in a symbol font. The hex value represents an index into the codepage. The invert flag is an optional value indicating whether to flip the symbol 180 degrees. This is done so that you can use the same font glyph without having to redraw a different inverted glyph within the symbol font.  The start symbol and its line (or polyline) are treated as one entity; however, they are not a redline group, so the user cannot ungroup them. You can update the Categories.xml to include a StartSymbol property at the category level, which ensures that any line (or polyline) created within that category always has a start symbol associated with it.   |  
|  EndSymbol  |  A comma delimited string containing the font name, symbol character, symbol size, [alignment](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/~6VeMGRDMTO4Znaq3Xabvw), and invert flag (for example, EndSymbol="G_GENSYM,Z,12,1,1") used to display an end symbol. The symbol character can also be defined in the format 0xhh (for example, 0xFF) where h represents a hexadecimal number to support unambiguous glyphs in a symbol font. The hex value represents an index into the codepage. The invert flag is an optional value indicating whether to flip the symbol 180 degrees. This is done so that you can use the same font glyph without having to redraw a different inverted glyph within the symbol font.  The end symbol and its line (or polyline) are treated as one entity; however, they are not a redline group, so the user cannot ungroup them. You can update the Categories.xml to include an EndSymbol property at the category level, which ensures that any line (or polyline) created within that category always has an end symbol associated with it.   |  
|  SymbolFontCharset  |  Specifies whether the font is a symbol font or a code page font.  |  
|  SymbolAlignment  |  The alignment for a symbol can be any of the following:
  * Bottom Center
  * Bottom Left
  * Bottom Right
  * Center Center
  * Center Left
  * Center Right
  * Left Baseline
  * Top Center
  * Top Left
  * Top Right

 |  
|  [SymbolColor](javascript:;)  |  The pen color for the symbol that is drawn.  |  
|  SymbolFontName  |  Specifies a symbol font family name, such as Wingdings.  |  
|  SymbolSize  |  The height of font in points. Accepts double precision values to match Designer/Analyst feature styles during redline placement.   |  
|  SymbolValue  |  The default symbol to display during redline symbol placement.   |  
|  TextString  |  The default string to display during text placement before the user enters new text at the keyboard. default symbol to display during redline symbol placement.   |  
|  TextBox  |  A Boolean indicating whether the text box is on or off. The attribute applies only to redline text objects. You can update the Categories.xml to include a TextBox on or off property at the category level which ensures that any text created within that category always has a text box associated with it.   |  
|  ViewScaleDependent  |  These are the valid values: 0 = View-scale independent. During placement, the scale does not change as the view is zoomed in and out.  1 = View-scale dependent. During placement the scale changes as the view is zoomed in and out. The redline is placed at the current scale. Only the FontSize, SymbolSize, and LineWidth styles are affected by changes in display scale.  2 = To place redlines that are sized using a predefined map scale, set the ViewScaleDependent attribute value to 2. This value configures redlining to mimic the behavior of feature placement in Designer/Analyst. If you set the ViewScaleDependent attribute value to 2, you must add a MapScale attribute to define what map scale to use when determining size during redline placement. FontSize, SymbolSize, and LineWidth styles are affected by this value.   
 |  Example <Category Name="_Default" IsDisplayed="1" DisplayLevel="1" Operations="AllOperations" DefaultMode="DisplayOnly" Modes="AllowAllModes" EventsFired="Select,ModeChange,Delete,Cancel,LButtonDown,LButtonUp, LButtonDblClick,PlacementStart,PlacementEnd,RButtonDown" LineColor="255" LineWidth=".25"  LineStyle="0" FillColor="16777215" FillHatch="4" FillStyle="1" FontStyle="Regular" FontName="Arial" FontSize=".75" FontColor="255" TextValue="" SymbolFontCharset="1"  SymbolFontName="Wingdings" SymbolSize="2.12" SymbolColor="255"  SymbolValue="N" ViewScaleDependent="2" MapScale="5000"/>  |  
| --- |  
The Designer/Analyst supports both scale-dependent and scale-independent styles. However, the Attach Redlines command in Designer converts NetViewer and Field Review redlines that have view-scale-independent redline styles to view-scale-dependent styles using the redline's MapScaleAtCreation attribute and the Designer/Analyst map view's paper scale. The conversion is performed by multiplying the style value by MapScaleAtCreation / PaperScale. 
 |

###### Redline Category Username Attribute
For categories, the Username attribute is [used in the localization](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/63e5EYTVvpb8_dPZOL0Khg) of category names that are displayed on the [Activate Redline Category](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/9dPAMBuyFjsTgb8NAC_4eA), [Activate Redline Category](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Zc71QxJtFzJrb7hfybSqpg) drop-down list and the [Redline Category Display Control](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j0X7Gt5ee5G4hC~hBtktgQ), [Redline Category Display Control](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XTrBKzWAoXIfEsiDlDFWoA). The Username attribute is used for customized categories to avoid conflict with the [Name attribute](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bB9jLuSYB3Bvu2L83~g~uA), some of which are used by NetViewer commands.

###### RedlineCategoriesDisplayOff Function
Applies To
[Redline Categories](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ECQfcuXLI_DJi7a6CEf54A)
Description
The RedlineCategoriesDisplayOff function controls the display-off status of the redline categories. 
Syntax
RedlineCategoriesDisplayOff([CategoriesList]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  CategoriesList  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The string containing the category list. If this argument is not specified, the function assumes that all categories should be turned off.   |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Internally this function uses SetRedlineCategoryAttrValue to set the IsDisplayed property of the redline category to 1. You can use the GetRedlineCategoryAttrValue to find the display status of the given category.

###### RedlineCategoriesDisplayOn Function
Applies To
[Redline Categories](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ECQfcuXLI_DJi7a6CEf54A)
Description
The RedlineCategoriesDisplayOn function controls the display-on status of the redline categories. 
Syntax
RedlineCategoriesDisplayOn([CategoriesList]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  CategoriesList  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The string containing the category list. If this argument is not specified, the function assumes that all categories should be turned on.   |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Internally this function uses SetRedlineCategoryAttrValue to set the IsDisplayed property of the redline category to 0. You can use the GetRedlineCategoryAttrValue to find the display status of the given category.

####### Redline Coordinate System Functions

###### ConvertUnitToUnit Function
Applies To
[Redline Coordinate System](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Zqu1jh3MAVzzSoc6hfZ2g)
Description
The ConvertUnitToUnit function converts a value expressed in one unit to a value expressed in another unit. 
Returns a double precision value containing the converted value expressed in the OutputUnit.
Syntax
Value = ConvertUnitToUnit(UnitType, InputUnit, InputValue, OutputUnit) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  UnitType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Defines the category or type of unit being converted. Possible values include:
  * "ANGLE"
  * "AREA" 
  * "DISTANCE"

 |  
|  InputUnit  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Defines the units of the input value being converted. Possible values depend on the UnitType parameter. For "ANGLE" the possible values include:  
"d:m:s"  
"dd.mmss"  
"deg"  
"gr"  
"min"  
"rad"  
"rev"  
"sec"  For "AREA" the possible values include:  
"ac"  
"area"  
"chain^2"  
"cm^2"  
"deciare"  
"ft^2"  
"hectare"  
"in^2"  
"km^2"  
"link^2"  
"m^2"  
"mi^2"  
"mm^2"  
"perch"  
"rod^2"  
"yd^2"  For "DISTANCE" the possible values include:  
"chain"  
"cm"  
"ft"  
"furlong"  
"hundredth"  
"in"  
"kft"  
"km"  
"link"  
"m"  
"mi"  
"mm"  
"nm"  
"nmi"  
"pole"  
"pt"  
"rod"  
"sf"  
"si"  
"sk"  
"svy_ft"  
"svy_in"  
"svy_kft"  
"tenth"  
"thousandth"  
"yd"   |  
|  InputValue  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  Input value to be converted.  |  
|  OutputUnit  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Unit of the output value after the conversion. See InputUnit for possible values.  |  
Return Type
Double precision
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

####### Redline Document Management Functions

###### AppendRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The AppendRedlineFile function is used to append the current redlines with redlines from an existing redline file. 
Syntax
Success = AppendRedlineFile([RedlineFileName]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineFileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The name of the file whose redlines are appended into the currently created or opened redline file. The name should include the full path.  If this argument is not specified, the function displays an Append Redline File dialog box, which lets the user browse to select the file whose redlines are appended to the current redlines.   |  
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully appended.
The user can browse to a Web folder to select a redline file that should be appended to the current redline file. 
If the input RedlineFileName is not a valid file name, the function throws an exception.

###### CloseRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The CloseRedlineFile function is used to close an already created or opened redline file. 
Syntax
Success = CloseRedlineFile()
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully saved.
Once the redline file is closed, all persisted redlines are erased from the screen.

###### GetRedlineFileName Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)

The GetRedlineFileName function returns the name of the currently opened redline file along with its full path. If there are no currently opened redline files, this function returns a null string.

Return Type
String

This is a client-side function.
If ManageRedlineFilesByCategory option is enabled, this function returns only the base name, excluding the category name.

###### ManageRedlineFilesByCategory Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The ManageRedlineFilesByCategory function is used to indicate to the Redline control that the files need to be saved or opened by category. Only persisted categories are saved or opened. 
The syntax used for naming the files is <given file name without extension>_<category name>.xml. During the Open workflow, if the user selects one of these saved files, all files that are grouped by category are opened. 
Syntax
ManageRedlineFilesByCategory(Enable) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### NewRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The NewRedlineFile function is used to open a new redline file.
Syntax
Success = NewRedlineFile([RedlineFileName]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineFileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The name of the redline file to be created. The name should include the full path. If this argument is not specified, the function displays an Open New Redline File dialog box, which lets the user browse and enter the name of the new file before it is created.   |  
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully created.
The user can browse to a Web folder to create a new redline file.
If there is an already opened redline file to which changes have been made since the last save, the function asks whether the current redline file edits need to be saved or discarded or if the new file operation should be canceled. 
If the input RedlineFileName is not a valid file name, the method throws an exception.

###### OpenRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The OpenRedlineFile function is used to open an existing redline file.
If the selected file is a GRL file, then the user is asked to save it as an XML file.
Syntax
Success = OpenRedlineFile([RedlineFileName]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineFileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The name of the file to be opened. The name should include the full path and extension. If this argument is not specified, the function displays an Open Existing Redline File dialog box, which lets the user browse to select an existing redline file.   |  
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully opened. If the user does not accept the conversion, the operation is canceled and the file is not opened. 
The user can browse to a Web folder to open an existing redline file. If there is an already opened redline file to which changes have been made since the last save, the function asks whether the current redline file edits need to be saved or discarded or if the open file operation should be canceled. 
If the input RedlineFileName is not a valid existing file name, the function throws an exception.

######## Redline Import and Export Functions

###### ExportRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The ExportRedlines function saves all of the redlines matched by the Category list and Selected flag in the file designated by the file path. 
Syntax
Count = ExportRedlines(FilePath, CategoryList, Selected) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FilePath  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The destination redline file.  |  
|  CategoryList  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Comma- separated list of category names to be exported. If CategoryList is a null string, all categories are included.   |  
|  Selected  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies whether all redlines in the CategoryList or only the redlines with IsSelected True in the CategoryList are included.   |  
Return Type
Integer. The number of redlines loaded.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### GetRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The GetRedlines function returns the XML string representation of all of the redlines matched by the CategoryList and filter mask. 
Syntax
XML = GetRedlines(CategoryList, FilterMask) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Category  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The Category names to be included in the XML. If CategoryList is a null string, all categories are included.   |  
|  FilterMask  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies a set of filters to control which redlines are included in the XML. The mask must be the logical OR of one or more of the following flags:
  * 0x0 — No filtering
  * 0x1 — Only selected redlines
  * 0x2 — Only generally persistible
  * 0x4 — Only plotable redlines

 |  
Return Type
String. An XML string for the matched redlines.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Each XML string that is returned is a complete XML tree that validates against Redlines.xsd. That is, it has all of the required elements and attributes and can be saved as is to a file.

###### ImportRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The ImportRedlines function loads redlines from the specified file. The redlines are added to the set of redlines already loaded. A unique ID value is generated for each redline as it is added to the list of redlines. 
Syntax
Count = ImportRedlines(FilePath) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FilePath  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The redline file to load  |  
Return Type
Integer. The number of redlines loaded.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Each redline in the XML fragment is appended to the end of the list of redlines under the category to which the redline belongs.

###### MergeRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The MergeRedlines function loads redlines from an XML string. The new redlines are added to or update the set of redlines already loaded. A unique ID value is generated for each new redline as it is added to the list of redlines.

MergeRedlines(sXML) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  sXML  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  An XML string that describes the redlines to be merged with the existing redlines.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
See the [rules for merging](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag).

###### ResetRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The ResetRedlines function clears all redlines from the Redline control and resets the control to its default state.

ResetRedlines()

This is a client-side function.

###### SetRedlineDefaultDirectory Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)

The SetRedlineDefaultDirectory function sets the default folder for importing and exporting files. The redline Open and Save dialog boxes are initialized to this folder.

SetRedlineDefaultDirectory(DirPath) 
Parameters

######## Redline Interactive State Functions

###### DisableRedlineMouseMoveEvents Function
Applies To
[Redline Interactive State Functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7oU_Heii1uomLGHLvdwdfw)
Description
The DisableRedlineMouseMoveEvents function disables redline mouse move events.
Syntax
DisableRedlineMouseMoveEvents()
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Because mouse-move events use client-side resources, there is no need to fire them unless they are currently being used by custom code. If you want to stop mouse-move events from firing, call this function.

###### DisplayAnalysisResults Function
Applies To
[Redline Interactive State Functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7oU_Heii1uomLGHLvdwdfw)
Description
The DisplayAnalysisResults function provides a way for client-side code to display the results of a custom query in the map. 
Syntax
DisplayAnalysisResults(FileName, [ResultsName], [ForeColor], [BackColor], [LineWeight], [MapAdjust], [PrimaryGraphicsOnly]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The .RAW file name that has the query results.  |  
|  ResultsName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The name under which query results are appended to the legend.  |  
|  ForeColor  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Fore color for the area elements in the results.  |  
|  BackColor  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Back color for the area elements in the results.  |  
|  LineWeight  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Line thickness.  |  
|  MapAdjust  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Option to indicate whether to fit or to center the appended results in the map display.  |  
|  PrimaryGraphicsOnly  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Option to indicate whether to highlight only the primary geographic component or all graphic components of a feature.   |

This is a client-side function.

###### EnableRedlineMouseMoveEvents Function
Applies To
[Redline Interactive State Functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7oU_Heii1uomLGHLvdwdfw)
Description
The EnableRedlineMouseMoveEvents function enables redline mouse move events.
Syntax
EnableRedlineMouseMoveEvents()
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Because mouse-move events use client-side resources, there is no need to fire them unless they are currently being used by custom code. So, by default, they are not fired. If you want to allow mouse-move events to be fired, call this function during command initiation or viewer initiation in CustomFrame.htm.

###### GetRedlineMode Function
Applies To

Description

ModeValue = GetRedlineMode()
Return Type

###### GetRedlineStyle Function
Applies To
[Redline Interactive State Functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7oU_Heii1uomLGHLvdwdfw)
Description
The GetRedlineStyle function returns the current value of the specified style.
Syntax
StyleValue = GetRedlineStyle(StyleName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  StyleName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The [name of a style property](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/logP1znu0AuQaB5ptyj79w).   |  
Return Type
Variant
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The Redline control maintains a set of current style properties that the next placed redline inherits. The set of styles is updated whenever a new category is activated, whenever an existing redline is selected, and whenever a particular style is set with a SetRedlineStyle call. 
If the StyleName passed in as an argument to this function is not a valid style name, an exception is thrown.

Return Value
The analysis pane or locate pane frame.

###### SetRedlineMode Function
Applies To
[Redline Interactive State Functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7oU_Heii1uomLGHLvdwdfw)
Description
The SetRedlineMode function sets the current redline mode of operation.

Parameters

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineModeEnum  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The new [mode of operation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OhHncUNMHsTP6Pb~s~p7ow) to switch to.   |

###### SetRedlineStyle Function
Applies To
[Redline Interactive State Functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7oU_Heii1uomLGHLvdwdfw)
Description
The SetRedlineStyle function sets the value of the specified style.

SetRedlineStyle(StyleName, StyleValue) 
Parameters

###### GetFeaturePoints Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The GetFeaturePoints function takes a feature component key as input and returns a string of X and Y coordinate values. The return string can be passed as the StringOfXandYs argument in subsequent calls to the [PlaceRedline function](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j9cNqI9mWDc8HbDg4yaxyA). 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/260352?tocId=tLSOdxdXN67UIHTl0CScug) This function could be used in an edit-existing-feature-geometry workflow where the first step is to get the existing feature's geometry and then create a redline on top of the existing feature that the user can edit. 
Syntax
StringOfXandYs = GetFeaturePoints(FNO, FID, [CNO], [CID])
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FNO  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Required  |  The feature number.  |  
|  FID  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  The feature ID.  |  
|  CNO  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The component number. If not specified, then the primary geographic component is assumed.  |  
|  CID  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The component ID. If not specified, then a component ID of 1 is assumed.  |  
Return Type
String. Specifies Type, a comma-separated string of X and Y world coordinates that define the points of the geometry. 
Remarks
This function can be called from either the client or server side. If called from client-side, then the function triggers a hidden page request to the server to get the return value. The function waits for the hidden page load to finish, picks up the return value and then returns control back to the caller. Arc, CompositePolyline, CompositePolygon, and Rectangle geometries are stroked to simple geometries. 
Collection and Boundary geometries are not supported.

###### PlaceLocationPinAtPoint Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlaceLocationPinAtPoint function places a [location pin](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pXbOuulrd~UTRJjzOsvfPQ) symbol at a specified map location, using a specified style, and associates attribute information with the placed symbol. 
Note: Location pins are unlike other redlines in that they cannot be saved to or loaded from a file. Also, they are not selectable; so they cannot be moved or edited. All location pins are view-scale independent. 
Syntax
PlaceLocationPinAtPoint(Point, PointType, [FontName], [FontSize], [FontColor], [CharValue], [Attribution]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Point  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The map coordinates of the LocationPin (specified as a string whose syntax corresponds with the PointType argument).   |  
|  PointType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The value must be UOR. A point in UOR syntax is an X,Y coordinate that is comma separated and the X and Y values are specified with period as the radix point.   |  
|  FontName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The symbol font family name from which the location pin character comes. If a null string is specified, the default font is the G_MapPins font.   |  
|  FontSize  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The point size for the location pin. If 0 is passed, the point size defaults to 24.  |  
|  FontColor  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The color of the location pin. It is specified as a 6-hex character string with consecutive two hex characters specifying a red, green and blue value (for example, RRGGBB format). If a null string is specified, the default is FF0000 (red).   |  
|  CharValue  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The character code value of the location pin character. If 0 is specified, the default character code from a delivered location pins font is used.   |  
|  Attribution  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The attribution string can be any arbitrary HTML string. If a null string is specified, nothing happens when the user hovers over the location pin.   |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### PlacePlotBoxesByLine Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlacePlotBoxesByLine function places plot boxes in a line.
If the two points are also passed in, the function simulates a mouse down at the first point, a mouse drag to the second point, and a mouse up at the second point. When they are not specified, the Redline control enters a placement mode where it waits for the user to either left click once to center a plot box at that point, or to do a left-mouse button down, mouse drag, and mouse up to place a series of Plot Box category redlines in a line. 
All the redlines have the specified world width and height and the same rotation angle as the placed line. The number of placed plot boxes is determined by "floor (length of the line / WorldWidth) + 1". The plot boxes are placed right edge to left edge with baselines aligned and with any extra length evenly divided and added to the beginning and end of the placed line. 
Syntax
PlacePlotBoxesByLine(WorldWidth, WorldHeight, X1, Y1, X2, [Y2]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  WorldWidth  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  The width of the plot box in world (UOR) coordinates.  |  
|  WorldHeight  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  The height of the plot box in world (UOR) coordinates.  |  
|  X1, Y1, X2, Y2  |  Double  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The two points of an imaginary line that the plot boxes are to be centered around.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### PlaceRedline Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlaceRedline function places redlines programmatically in a similar manner to interactive placement. Specifically, it uses the current state of the Redline control to complete the description of the newly placed redline. 
This function returns a redline ID value that can be used to uniquely identify the first new redline from the XML. This value does not persist beyond the lifetime of the Redline control. 
Syntax
ID = PlaceRedline(RedlineType, StringOfXandYs, Val1, Val2) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The type of the [Redlines element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/FDRMBeGpAr8rdsb6CyuO4A).  The value specified must be the name of one of the elements that can be a child of the Redlines element, such as "Line" or "Rect".   |  
|  StringOfXandYs  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies a comma-separated string of X and Y world coordinates that define the points of the geometry. Double precision values must use the period decimal separator regardless of the locale of the user.   |  
|  Val1  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If the placement mode is for text, then this is the string value to be placed. If the placement mode is for symbol, then this is the character value for the symbol in the symbol font.   |  
|  Val2  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Reserved for future use.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The PlotBoxes redline type is not supported by this method. Use the [PlacePlotBoxesByLine API](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WeLLYDzsDqxhuA8kjxXMJg) to place PlotBoxes.

###### PlaceRedlineGroup Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlaceRedlineGroup function places a cloned predefined named sketch.
Syntax
PlaceRedlineGroup(NamedSketch) 
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
If the input NamedSketch is not a valid name of a predefined named sketch, the function throws an exception.

|  Name  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The property name.  |  
|  Type  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The type of the property value. The meaning of this field is controlled by the calling software.   |  
|  Value  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The property value.  |

This is a client-side function.

Applies To
[Redline View](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SJ_LHKqNc0FyG8H~_xk6rQ)
Description
The FitAllLocationPins function changes the map view so that all of the [location pin](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pXbOuulrd~UTRJjzOsvfPQ) redline symbols fit in the current view. 
Syntax
FitAllLocationPins()
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw).

###### FitRedlines Function
Applies To

Description
The FitRedlines function uses the ID list to select a set of redlines, compute the minimum bounding rectangle (MBR) that contains them all, and then alter the map center point and scale to fit that box in the view. 
Syntax
FitRedlines(IDs) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  IDs  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The IDs of redlines to be fitted into the view. If IDs is null string, all redlines are selected for the fit operation.   |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.

###### SaveAsRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The SaveAsRedlineFile function is used to save edits to a different redline file.
Syntax
Success = SaveAsRedlineFile([RedlineFileName]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineFileName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The name of the file to which redlines should be saved. The name should include the full path.  If this argument is not specified, the function displays a Save As Redline File dialog box, which lets the user browse to select the file in which the edits should be saved.   |  
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully saved.
Once the new file is selected, it replaces the current redline file as the active file. 
The user can browse to a Web folder to create a new save-as redline file.
If the input RedlineFileName is not a valid file name, the function throws an exception.

###### SaveRedlineFile Function
Applies To
[Redline Document Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kU7DuEpaq9ugObwx9EJ7Tw)
Description
The SaveRedlineFile function is used to save edits to an already created or opened redline file. 
Syntax
Success = SaveRedlineFile()
Return Type
Boolean
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
This function returns True if the given file is successfully saved.

###### LocateRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Edit](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/~Ma3yf2INGVfsy~dBNKi0w)
Description
The LocateRedlines function uses the X,Y coordinate passed in to try to spatially locate redlines within the specified tolerance and add the located redlines to the select set. 
Syntax
IDs = LocateRedlines(StringOfXandY, [Tolerance]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  StringOfXandY  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The X,Y coordinate to locate around.  |  
|  Tolerance  |  Double  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The locate tolerance about the point as a distance in ground units. If not specified, then the control's pixel tolerance value is converted to ground units and used for the locate operation.   |  
Return Type
String. IDs of redlines that are located. The order of IDs follows the z order of the redlines. The ID of the topmost redline element is the last ID in the string. 
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The GetLocateTolerance and SetLocateTolerance functions control a locate tolerance in pixels that is used for interactive locates at the screen. Pixels provide the user a consistent requirement for how close to be when clicking the mouse, regardless of what the current zoom scale is. However, the LocateRedlines function is called by custom code that wants to have a specific tolerance in ground units that is independent of the current view scale.

###### MoveRedline Function
Applies To
[Redline Edit](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/~Ma3yf2INGVfsy~dBNKi0w)
Description
The MoveRedline function uses the redline ID to select redlines on which to perform a translate operation. The X and Y offset values are added to every vertex in the geometry of the selected redlines. The X and Y offset values are in ground units.

MoveRedline(ID, OffsetX, OffsetY)

|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ID  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  The ID of the redline to be moved.  |  
|  OffsetX  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  The offset value to add to all X coordinate values.  |  
|  OffsetY  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  The offset value to add to all Y coordinate values.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
If the ID does not exist or the offset values are invalid, an exception is thrown.

####### Redline Import and Export Functions

###### ExportRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The ExportRedlines function saves all of the redlines matched by the Category list and Selected flag in the file designated by the file path. 
Syntax
Count = ExportRedlines(FilePath, CategoryList, Selected) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FilePath  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The destination redline file.  |  
|  CategoryList  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Comma- separated list of category names to be exported. If CategoryList is a null string, all categories are included.   |  
|  Selected  |  Boolean  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies whether all redlines in the CategoryList or only the redlines with IsSelected True in the CategoryList are included.   |  
Return Type
Integer. The number of redlines loaded.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### GetRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The GetRedlines function returns the XML string representation of all of the redlines matched by the CategoryList and filter mask. 
Syntax
XML = GetRedlines(CategoryList, FilterMask) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Category  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The Category names to be included in the XML. If CategoryList is a null string, all categories are included.   |  
|  FilterMask  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies a set of filters to control which redlines are included in the XML. The mask must be the logical OR of one or more of the following flags:
  * 0x0 — No filtering
  * 0x1 — Only selected redlines
  * 0x2 — Only generally persistible
  * 0x4 — Only plotable redlines

 |  
Return Type
String. An XML string for the matched redlines.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Each XML string that is returned is a complete XML tree that validates against Redlines.xsd. That is, it has all of the required elements and attributes and can be saved as is to a file.

###### ImportRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline Import and Export](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qhhBqKzlTrGStBOMKSz6Ag)
Description
The ImportRedlines function loads redlines from the specified file. The redlines are added to the set of redlines already loaded. A unique ID value is generated for each redline as it is added to the list of redlines.

Count = ImportRedlines(FilePath)

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FilePath  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The redline file to load  |  
Return Type
Integer. The number of redlines loaded.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Each redline in the XML fragment is appended to the end of the list of redlines under the category to which the redline belongs.

Remarks
This is a client-side function.
If the DirPath is invalid and the function is not able to set the default folder, an exception is thrown.

####### Redline Interactive State Functions

###### DisableRedlineMouseMoveEvents Function
Applies To

Description
The DisableRedlineMouseMoveEvents function disables redline mouse move events.
Syntax
DisableRedlineMouseMoveEvents()
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
Because mouse-move events use client-side resources, there is no need to fire them unless they are currently being used by custom code. If you want to stop mouse-move events from firing, call this function.

The EnableRedlineMouseMoveEvents function enables redline mouse move events.

This is a client-side function.

###### GetRedlineStyle Function
Applies To
[Redline Interactive State Functions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7oU_Heii1uomLGHLvdwdfw)
Description
The GetRedlineStyle function returns the current value of the specified style.
Syntax
StyleValue = GetRedlineStyle(StyleName) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  StyleName  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The [name of a style property](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/logP1znu0AuQaB5ptyj79w).   |  
Return Type
Variant
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The Redline control maintains a set of current style properties that the next placed redline inherits. The set of styles is updated whenever a new category is activated, whenever an existing redline is selected, and whenever a particular style is set with a SetRedlineStyle call. 
If the StyleName passed in as an argument to this function is not a valid style name, an exception is thrown.

###### GetFeaturePoints Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The GetFeaturePoints function takes a feature component key as input and returns a string of X and Y coordinate values. The return string can be passed as the StringOfXandYs argument in subsequent calls to the [PlaceRedline function](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j9cNqI9mWDc8HbDg4yaxyA). 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/260352?tocId=I74DKkGOlykA6GQlNNOtmw) This function could be used in an edit-existing-feature-geometry workflow where the first step is to get the existing feature's geometry and then create a redline on top of the existing feature that the user can edit. 
Syntax
StringOfXandYs = GetFeaturePoints(FNO, FID, [CNO], [CID])
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  FNO  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Required  |  The feature number.  |  
|  FID  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  The feature ID.  |  
|  CNO  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The component number. If not specified, then the primary geographic component is assumed.  |  
|  CID  |  Integer  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The component ID. If not specified, then a component ID of 1 is assumed.  |  
Return Type
String. Specifies Type, a comma-separated string of X and Y world coordinates that define the points of the geometry. 
Remarks
This function can be called from either the client or server side. If called from client-side, then the function triggers a hidden page request to the server to get the return value. The function waits for the hidden page load to finish, picks up the return value and then returns control back to the caller. Arc, CompositePolyline, CompositePolygon, and Rectangle geometries are stroked to simple geometries. 
Collection and Boundary geometries are not supported.

###### PlaceLocationPinAtPoint Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlaceLocationPinAtPoint function places a [location pin](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pXbOuulrd~UTRJjzOsvfPQ) symbol at a specified map location, using a specified style, and associates attribute information with the placed symbol. 
Note: Location pins are unlike other redlines in that they cannot be saved to or loaded from a file. Also, they are not selectable; so they cannot be moved or edited. All location pins are view-scale independent. 
Syntax
PlaceLocationPinAtPoint(Point, PointType, [FontName], [FontSize], [FontColor], [CharValue], [Attribution]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Point  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The map coordinates of the LocationPin (specified as a string whose syntax corresponds with the PointType argument).   |  
|  PointType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The value must be UOR. A point in UOR syntax is an X,Y coordinate that is comma separated and the X and Y values are specified with period as the radix point.   |  
|  FontName  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The symbol font family name from which the location pin character comes. If a null string is specified, the default font is the G_MapPins font.   |  
|  FontSize  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The point size for the location pin. If 0 is passed, the point size defaults to 24.  |  
|  FontColor  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The color of the location pin. It is specified as a 6-hex character string with consecutive two hex characters specifying a red, green and blue value (for example, RRGGBB format). If a null string is specified, the default is FF0000 (red).   |  
|  CharValue  |  Long  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The character code value of the location pin character. If 0 is specified, the default character code from a delivered location pins font is used.   |  
|  Attribution  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The attribution string can be any arbitrary HTML string. If a null string is specified, nothing happens when the user hovers over the location pin.   |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### PlacePlotBoxesByLine Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlacePlotBoxesByLine function places plot boxes in a line.
If the two points are also passed in, the function simulates a mouse down at the first point, a mouse drag to the second point, and a mouse up at the second point. When they are not specified, the Redline control enters a placement mode where it waits for the user to either left click once to center a plot box at that point, or to do a left-mouse button down, mouse drag, and mouse up to place a series of Plot Box category redlines in a line. 
All the redlines have the specified world width and height and the same rotation angle as the placed line. The number of placed plot boxes is determined by "floor (length of the line / WorldWidth) + 1". The plot boxes are placed right edge to left edge with baselines aligned and with any extra length evenly divided and added to the beginning and end of the placed line. 
Syntax
PlacePlotBoxesByLine(WorldWidth, WorldHeight, X1, Y1, X2, [Y2]) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  WorldWidth  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  The width of the plot box in world (UOR) coordinates.  |  
|  WorldHeight  |  Double  |  Input  |  Required  |  The height of the plot box in world (UOR) coordinates.  |  
|  X1, Y1, X2, Y2  |  Double  |  Input  |  Optional  |  The two points of an imaginary line that the plot boxes are to be centered around.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### PlaceRedline Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlaceRedline function places redlines programmatically in a similar manner to interactive placement. Specifically, it uses the current state of the Redline control to complete the description of the newly placed redline. 
This function returns a redline ID value that can be used to uniquely identify the first new redline from the XML. This value does not persist beyond the lifetime of the Redline control. 
Syntax
ID = PlaceRedline(RedlineType, StringOfXandYs, Val1, Val2) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RedlineType  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The type of the [Redlines element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/FDRMBeGpAr8rdsb6CyuO4A).  The value specified must be the name of one of the elements that can be a child of the Redlines element, such as "Line" or "Rect".   |  
|  StringOfXandYs  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Specifies a comma-separated string of X and Y world coordinates that define the points of the geometry. Double precision values must use the period decimal separator regardless of the locale of the user.   |  
|  Val1  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  If the placement mode is for text, then this is the string value to be placed. If the placement mode is for symbol, then this is the character value for the symbol in the symbol font.   |  
|  Val2  |  String  |  Input  |  Optional  |  Reserved for future use.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
The PlotBoxes redline type is not supported by this method. Use the [PlacePlotBoxesByLine API](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WeLLYDzsDqxhuA8kjxXMJg) to place PlotBoxes.

###### PlaceRedlineGroup Function
Applies To
[Redline Placement](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wYhHMbbRVFZj8ZVzhLPJXA)
Description
The PlaceRedlineGroup function places a cloned predefined named sketch.
Syntax

This is a client-side function.
If the input NamedSketch is not a valid name of a predefined named sketch, the function throws an exception.
