The GetRedlineDocumentProperty function uses the property's Name attribute to look up the corresponding Type and Value from the collection of properties at the redline document level. 
Syntax
TypeValue = GetRedlineDocumentProperty(Name) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Name  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The property name  |  
Return Type
String. The value of Type, followed by a comma, followed by the value of Value.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
If the specified property does not exist, an exception is thrown.

###### GetRedlineProperty Function
Applies To
[Redline User-Defined Properties](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AInOwNGWTm0MjO1~yW~44g)
Description
The GetRedlineProperty function uses the redline ID and property Name attributes to look up the corresponding Type and Value from the collection of properties for a redline. 
Syntax
TypeValue = GetRedlineProperty(ID, Name) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ID  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The redline ID  |  
|  Name  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The property name  |  
Return Type
String. The value of Type, followed by a comma, followed by the value of Value.
Remarks
This is a client-side function.
If the specified property does not exist, an exception is thrown.

####### Redline View Functions

###### BringRedlineToTop Function
Applies To
[Redline View](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SJ_LHKqNc0FyG8H~_xk6rQ)
Description
The BringRedlineToTop function uses the specified redline ID to pull a redline out of the ordered list of redlines and bring it to the top. 
Syntax
BringRedlineToTop(ID) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  ID  |  Long  |  Input  |  Required  |  The ID of the redline to be brought to top.  |  
Remarks
This is a client-side function.

###### FitAllLocationPins Function
Applies To
[Redline View](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SJ_LHKqNc0FyG8H~_xk6rQ)
Description
The FitAllLocationPins function changes the map view so that all of the [location pin](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pXbOuulrd~UTRJjzOsvfPQ) redline symbols fit in the current view. 
Syntax
FitAllLocationPins()
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.
Nothing happens if there are currently no location pin redline symbols.

###### FitRedlines Function
Applies To
[Redline View](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SJ_LHKqNc0FyG8H~_xk6rQ)
Description
The FitRedlines function uses the ID list to select a set of redlines, compute the minimum bounding rectangle (MBR) that contains them all, and then alter the map center point and scale to fit that box in the view. 
Syntax
FitRedlines(IDs) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  IDs  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  The IDs of redlines to be fitted into the view. If IDs is null string, all redlines are selected for the fit operation.   |  
Remarks
This API can have asynchronous side effects that [require special programming considerations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ghq3WMyYuPxDwRlzrtWuEw). 
This is a client-side function.

|  Code Example Private Sub Form_Load()  Dim RequestID As Long  Dim ReturnFileList As String  Dim sWebFolderLogins As String  'When anonymous access is allowed for the Web folder 'specifying username and password is not required sWebFolderLogins = "WebFolder=ComputerName/WebFoldername;UserName=;Password=" GNetExportControl1.ExtractLocation = "C:/MyNetExportOutputFiles" GNetExportControl1.WebFolderLogins = sWebFolderLogins RequestID = xxx ReturnFileList = GNetExportControl1.GetFiles(RequestID) End Sub  |

To use this example, paste the code into the Form_Load section of a form with a GNetExportControl with the name of GNetExportControl1.   
|  Code Example Private Sub Form_Load()  Dim RequestID As Long  Dim ReturnFileList As String  Dim sWebFolderLogins As String  'When anonymous access is allowed for the Web folder 'specifying username and password is not required sWebFolderLogins = "WebFolder=ComputerName/WebFoldername;UserName=;Password=" GNetExportControl1.ExtractLocation = "C:/MyNetExportOutputFiles" GNetExportControl1.WebFolderLogins = sWebFolderLogins RequestID = xxx ReturnFileList = GNetExportControl1.GetFiles(RequestID) End Sub  |

Applies To
[GNetExportControl Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Pd8V0ET6lpn4vrD4plK_3w)
Description
The GetFiles method gets the output and input files from the Export file server for a request submitted through the [SubmitExportRequest](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/tFrtAS0ScS1lzoYRYOmaqQ) or [SubmitImportRequest](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/_loNc5Re6JTTlW_wVpwVpw) methods. 
Syntax
Object.GetFiles(RequestID) 
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RequestID  |  Long  |   |  Required  |  The ID of the export or import request whose files are requested.  |  
Remarks
Returns the list of files retrieved from the Export file server in string carriage-return line-feed delimited format so that the list is ready to display in a multiline description text box for the specified unique request ID.   
|  Applicable Properties  |  R/O  |  Comments  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  [FTPLogins](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8upAbHuOM1rBYSh13TVs9A)  |  Required/Optional  |  Either WebFolderLogins or FTPLogins is required.  |  
|  [WebFolderLogins](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TGxsbQvYvEB81k4dKEPM0Q)  |  Required/Optional  |  Either WebFolderLogins or FTPLogins is required.  |  
|  [ExtractLocation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qcWuHj9GWrOKkpaDGtvt9A)  |  Required  |   |

#### SubmitExportRequest Method
[Example](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258168?tocId=tFrtAS0ScS1lzoYRYOmaqQ)
The following Visual Basic example illustrates the use of the [SubmitExportRequest method](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/hfrw9LItkgqZElt_n~wekw) of the GNetExportControl. 
To use this example, paste the code into the Form_Load section of a form with a GNetExportControl with the name of GNetExportControl1.   
|  Code Example Private Sub Form_Load ()  Dim ExportRequestID As Long  Dim sWebFolderLogins As String  Dim sConnectionLogins As String  sConnectionLogins = "ConfigurationName=xxx;UserName=abc;Password=lmn"  'When anonymous access is allowed for the NetExport file  'server (Web folder), specifying username and password is  'not required.  sWebFolderLogins = "WebFolder=ComputerName/WebFoldername; UserName=;Password="  With GNetExportControl1  .ConnectionLogins = sConnectionLogins  .WebFolderLogins = sWebFolderLogins  .ApplicationServerName = "ComputerName"  .WebServerName = "ComputerName/NetExportWebFolderName"  .ExtractID = N 'Value from metadata  'G3E_EXPORTLIST_OPTABLE.G3E_ELNO .AreaExtent = "x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3"  ExportRequestID = .SubmitExportRequest()  End With  End Sub  |

Applies To
[GNetExportControl Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Pd8V0ET6lpn4vrD4plK_3w)
Description
The SubmitExportRequest method collects all the information that was set on the GNetExportControl and sends it to the Export web server. This method also creates a folder on the File Server for holding the input and output files. 
Syntax
Object.SubmitExportRequest()
Remarks
All the required properties on the GNetExportControl need to be set before calling this method. Returns the ExportRequestID of the export request which can be used as an input for GetRequestStatus and GetFiles method calls.   
|  Applicable Properties  |  R/O  |  Comments  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  [ApplicationServerName](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/uzVnJxrhcIrWi3f_Zpm8vA)  |  Required  |   |  
|  [AreaExtent](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8wxok4rxlkfVg7rQEeU6ng)  |  Required/Optional  |  Either AreaExtent or [ExtractGeomFeatureNumber and ExtractGeomFeatureID] is required.  |  
|  [AutoCADCreateLayer](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/xcLXyT9HN0cHRNnxneiMog)  |  Optional  |   |  
|  [AutoCADVersionNumber](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/V~Hz_uWS1RxqiQGfpCVwZQ)  |  Optional  |   |  
|  [ClipGeometries](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/q5hi~HiMya~Dzcyxl5KIIg)  |  Optional  |   |  
|  [ConnectionLogins](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5r0fgcu66s9bYcA8~PNDww)  |  Required  |   |  
|  [ExtractGeomFeatureID](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/hxalL~OZ64WfWOD5uykIVA)  |  Required/Optional  |  Either AreaExtent or [ExtractGeomFeatureNumber and ExtractGeomFeatureID] is required.  |  
|  [ExtractGeomFeatureNumber](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OoXSxl4nF1lynNHQy3Pzhg)  |  Required/Optional  |  Either AreaExtent or [ExtractGeomFeatureNumber and ExtractGeomFeatureID] is required.  |  
|  [ExtractID](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/JpUswbcsh~XUqRQts9XVWQ)  |  Required  |   |  
|  [FTPLogins](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8upAbHuOM1rBYSh13TVs9A)  |  Required/Optional  |  Either WebFolderLogins or FTPLogins is required.  |  
|  [GlyphLocation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Vz~vNoHQGwlUsIpRDV~UVg)  |  Optional  |  Overrides metadata G3E_EXPORTLIST.G3E_GLYPHLOCATION value.  |  
|  [OutputFileName](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XAJW3Ty8EN3J7EEe0J7gZg)  |  Required/Optional  |  Overrides metadata G3E_EXPORTLIST.G3E_OUTPUTFILENAME value.  |  
|  [PaperScale](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pIv3EyaOwMS99ikn5om~vA)  |  Optional  |  Overrides metadata G3E_EXPORTLIST.G3E_PAPERSCALE value.  |  
|  [TemplateFileName](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/lVkE7pw0_776teDiM2vDhQ)  |  Required/Optional  |  Overrides metadataG3E_EXPORTLIST.G3E_TEMPLATE value.  |  
|  [UseMBR](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ayvlPxztZMtBkUL_lFVyPw)  |  Optional  |   |  
|  [WebFolderLogins](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TGxsbQvYvEB81k4dKEPM0Q)  |  Required/Optional  |  Either WebFolderLogins or FTPLogins is required.  |  
|  [WebServerName](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Lv_lLC19Uvl4iekoU8vzg)  |  Required  |   |

### Objects

#### GNetExportClient Object
![Warning](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258162?tocId=Pd8V0ET6lpn4vrD4plK_3w) The GNetExportControl object has been deprecated but retained for backward compatibility. Use the new GNetExportClient object instead. 
The GNetExportClient object is an ActiveX control that provides a way to export the NetWorks Core industry data into and from other standard formats such as MapInfo®, MicroStation®, AutoCAD®, ArcView™, and ArcInfo™ using G/Industry Solutions on the Web. It also provides API for developers to use to produce Web pages or applications.   
|  Property  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  [ApplicationServerName](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/uzVnJxrhcIrWi3f_Zpm8vA)  |  The computer name of the application server  |

### Plotting API

#### Custom Plot XML Example
The XML interface to Plotting includes an optional tag, CustomInterface, that specifies a custom interface to call when processing the plot request. The following example XML code is provided for developers of remote plotting applications. 
XSD Files Delivered with Plotting
The following .xsd files are delivered with Plotting in the \GTechnology\Program\WebService folder: 
  * PlotRequest.xsd
  * PlotStatus.xsd


RemotePlotting.xsd is delivered with Plotting in the \GTechnology\Program\GViewerApp\Customize folder.   
|  Code Example <?xml version="1.1" encoding="UTF-8" ?> <RemotePlottingRequest> <PlotRequest> <ConnectionLogins>ConfigurationName=ALLPROD93;UserName=;PassWord=</ConnectionLogins> <Output> <Print> <PrinterName>//B01Print/23b-3300</PrinterName> </Print> <CustomInterface InterfaceNumber="41"> <Argument>8.5</Argument> <Argument>11</Argument> <Argument>100</Argument> <Argument>100</Argument> <Argument>NamedPlot1</Argument> </CustomInterface> </Output> <PlotName>NamedPlot1</PlotName> <PlotServerName>derhp</PlotServerName> <SenderName>XML Test 1</SenderName> <WorkspaceName>e:/workspaces/NETPLOTPVT.gfw</WorkspaceName> <MapFrameAssignment> <MapScale>1500</MapScale> <Name>MapFrame1</Name> <RotateAngle>0</RotateAngle> <CenterPoint> <X>418267</X> <Y>1250384</Y> </CenterPoint> </MapFrameAssignment> </PlotRequest> </RemotePlottingRequest> GTechPDFPrinter <Output> <Print> <PrinterName></PrinterName> <DocumentName>TestDocument1</DocumentName> <GTechPDFPrinter> <OutputFilename>MyPDF.pdf</OutputFilename> <Overwrite>true</Overwrite> <Resolution>300</Resolution> <FontEmbedding>true</FontEmbedding> <JPEGCompression>true</JPEGCompression> <JPEGLevel>7</JPEGLevel> <HorizontalMargin>0</HorizontalMargin> <VerticalMargin>0</VerticalMargin> <Orientation>2</Orientation> <MultiLingualSupport>false</MultiLingualSupport> </GTechPDFPrinter> </Print> </Output>  |  
| --- |  
Related Topic
[IGTCustomPlot Interface](Ms-its:Intergraph.GTechnology.Desktop.API.Reference.chm::/html/T_Intergraph_GTechnology_Interfaces_IGTCustomPlot.htm)

#### GNetRemotePlotRequest Object

##### GetPlotStatus Method
![Warning](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258305) The GNetRemotePlotRequest object has been deprecated. Use the Plotting RESTful Web API service call instead. 
Applies To
[GNetRemotePlotRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/o8lQ4Y~mNlwW1KP~V1xfrA)
Description
The GetPlotStatus method passes back the plotting status.
Syntax
outPlotStatus = Object.GetPlotStatus(inPlotStatus) 
Web API Request URL Template
http://{NetPlotWebServerName}/NetPlot/GetPlotStatus
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  inPlotStatus  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |  Contains the XML.  |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
The PlotStatus XML document is passed in with the list of plotIDs and the corresponding statuses empty and returns a different XML document with the plot IDs and the corresponding status information populated. This allows for multiple plot status requests to be made in one call to the server. 
NetViewer keeps track of multiple plot requests and can take advantage of this capability.

##### SendPlotRequest Method
![Warning](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258301) The GNetRemotePlotRequest object has been deprecated. Use the Plotting RESTful Web API service call instead. 
Applies To
[GNetRemotePlotRequest Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/o8lQ4Y~mNlwW1KP~V1xfrA)
Description
The SendPlotRequest method passes the plot parameters.
Syntax
PlotStatus = Object.SendPlotRequest(RemotePlotting) 
Web API Request URL Template
http://{NetPlotWebServerName}/NetPlot/SendPlotRequest
Parameters  
|  Parameter  |  Data Type  |  I/O  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  RemotePlotting  |  String  |  Input  |  Required  |   |  
Return Type
String
Remarks
The RemotePlotStatus and PlotStatus are strings which contain the XML. The plot ID is returned in the PlotStatus XML. If the SendPlotRequest is successful, then the error attribute is empty. Otherwise, an error attribute contains the appropriate error message. 
See the plot status schema in PlotStatus.xsd.

###### RegistrationPoint Element
This is an optional element on the AttachedFile element.
Applies To

R/O
Optional
Description
The RegistrationPoint element contains the necessary information to build a transformation matrix that positions the attached file.

Complex
Elements

|  SourceY  |  Double  |  Required  |  Specifies the Y value of a point in the source file’s coordinate system.  |  
|  DestinationX  |  Double  |  Required  |  Specifies the X value of a point in the current configuration’s coordinate system.  |

###### BackgroundColor Element
Applies To
[MapFrameAssignment Element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aSJ9oszE_Cf8PqgJ8FFskQ)
R/O
Optional
Description
The BackgroundColor element defines the background color to be used for the specified map frame. This is a RGB color value or one of the following special values:   
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Default  |  The default background color should be used. If the legend on the map frame has a metadata-specified default, that default color is used. Otherwise, the default map background color is used.   |  
|  Template  |  The default background color should remain unchanged from the value saved in the plot template. This value, when used in conjunction with a LegendSpecification whose LegendName is not empty, means that the background color of the template is used in place of the metadata-specified default background color of the legend, if any. This is the default.   |  
DataType
[BackColorType](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Ki0992XV_kvL_hJh4upzoA)

###### CenterPoint Element
Applies To

R/O
Required/optional
Description
The CenterPoint element designates a point in world coordinates that is centered in the map frame. 
Data Type
Complex
Elements  
|  Element  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  X  |  Double  |  Required  |  The coordinate location of a point along the horizontal axis measured from the equator.  |  
|  Y  |  Double  |  Required  |  The coordinate location of a point along the vertical axis measured from a zero meridian.  |  
Remarks
Either the CenterPoint or the [PlotDataQuery](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/9eAM4HTEIjNfMmcOADNZFg) element must be specified.

###### GeographicRedlines Element
Applies To
[MapFrameAssignment Element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aSJ9oszE_Cf8PqgJ8FFskQ)
R/O
Optional
Description
The GeographicRedlines element contains redlines to be attached to the map frame's legend. These redlines are created by NetViewer. 
Data Type
Read-write String
Remarks
The contents of this element must be an XML string of redlines. NetViewer provides an object to convert redlines to and from this format. The value of this property must be supplied by NetViewer. 
The format of the XML string produced by NetViewer for redlines is private and subject to change.

###### LegendSetting Element
Applies To
[LegendSpecification Element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kO9TPqKmRH69zsBtgqgnmQ)
R/O
Optional
Description
The LegendSetting element specifies overrides for the settings for one or more legend entries 
Data Type
Complex
Elements  
|  Element  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  LegendEntry  |  Read-write String  |  Required  |  Name of the metadata legend entry to which the specified settings apply. If a legend entry name is specified that does not match any legend entry in the specified legend, the plot request fails and reports an error back to the client.   |  
|  DisplayMode  |  Read-write Boolean  |  Required  |  The display mode for the legend entry. A value of True means the legend entry should display; a value of False means the legend entry should not display. The default is True.   |  
|  DisplayScaleMode  |  Read-write Boolean  |  Required  |  The display scale mode for the legend entry. A value of True means the legend entry should honor the display scale; a value of False means the legend entry should not honor the display scale. The default is True.   |  
|  Filter  |  Read-write String  |  Optional  |  An SQL WHERE- clause that is applied to the data for the legend entry. Only data for which this expression evaluates to True displays. The default value is the empty string, which indicates no filter is requested.   |  
|  Binary Color  |  RGB color value  |  Optional  |  The RGB color value for a binary raster metadata legend entry. The default value is -1, which indicates that no color override is requested.   |

###### PlotDataQuery Element

###### SymbologyOverridesType
These are the SymbologyOverridesType attributes. All are optional.  
|  Name  |  Data Type  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  LineWeight  |  positiveInteger  |  The value of the line thickness used. Any double precision value 0 or greater is valid. Overrides the line weight for all linear and area styles in the results.  |  
|  Color  |  ColorType  |  Overrides the color of all lines, area borders, text, and points in the results.  |  
|  Translucency  |  TranslucencyType  |  Specifies the translucency value.  |  
|  FillColor  |  [FillColorType](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mqGhk3XQwpwas1~jNteEqw)  |  Overrides the fill color for all area styles in the results.  |  
|  FillTranslucency  |  TranslucencyType  |  Specifies the translucency value of the fill color.  |  
|  DisplayModeOn  |  Boolean  |  Specifies whether the query results are displayed at all or not. The default is True, which means to display the results.  False means do not display results.  |  
|  DisplayScaleMode  |  [DisplayScaleType](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/F0lTGmPfBJwktVMIIdwkLg)  |  Specifies how the display scale affects the display of the results. This setting has no effect if the DisplayModeOn attribute is False.  |  
|  PrimaryGraphicsOnly  |  Boolean  |  Indicates whether to highlight only the primary geographic component or all graphic components of a feature.  True indicates that only the primary graphic component should be included. False indicates that all graphic components should be included for each feature included in the query keys.   |  
|  ExcludeNonLegendGraphics  |  Boolean  |  Specifies whether or not graphic components not associated with the legend are displayed. True means only display graphic components associated with the legend. False means display all graphic components associated with all features in the query results.  By default, when a query is added to the legend, all graphics associated with the features in the query are displayed, whether or not they are on that legend. This default behavior can be overridden by setting the ExcludeNonLegendGraphics attribute to True.   |  
|  AppendLocation  |  [AppendLocationType](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ljWvPI4L6C3G7fTF9zhXVQ)  |  Specifies where the query should be appended to the legend.  |  
|  PointSize  |  positiveInteger  |  The value of the point size used. Any double precision value 0 or greater is valid. Overrides the point size for all point styles in the results.  |  
|  FontName  |  String  |  Specifies the font name from the fonts installed on the machine. It should be expressed as a string.   |  
|  Symbol  |  String  |  Specifies the symbol character (Unicode character from 33 to255). It should be expressed as a Single character string.   |  
|  LinePattern  |  positiveInteger  |  Specifies the stroke pattern ID (SPNO) from the G3E_NORMALIZEDSTROKE table.  |

By default, when a query is added to the legend, all graphics associated with the features in the query are displayed, whether or not they are on that legend. This default behavior can be overridden by setting the ExcludeNonLegendGraphics attribute to True.   |  
|  AppendLocation  |  [AppendLocationType](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ljWvPI4L6C3G7fTF9zhXVQ)  |  Specifies where the query should be appended to the legend.  |  
|  PointSize  |  positiveInteger  |  The value of the point size used. Any double precision value 0 or greater is valid. Overrides the point size for all point styles in the results.  |  
|  FontName  |  String  |  Specifies the font name from the fonts installed on the machine. It should be expressed as a string.   |  
|  Symbol  |  String  |  Specifies the symbol character (Unicode character from 33 to255). It should be expressed as a Single character string.   |  
|  LinePattern  |  positiveInteger  |  Specifies the stroke pattern ID (SPNO) from the G3E_NORMALIZEDSTROKE table.  |

##### PlotStatus Element
Applies To
[RemotePlottingStatus](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GgjHi~fPuAc24t1SsPsfAg)
R/O
Required
Description
The PlotStatus element contains the list of plotIDs and the corresponding statuses, plot information, and a group of time-related attributes. 
Data Type
Complex
Elements  
|  Element  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  [Error](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/B_Hft19lcmM6SWdo~vz0zw)  |  String  |  Required/optional  |  Error message generated by a failed plot request.  |  
Attributes  
|  Attribute  |  Data Type  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  PlotID  |  Long  |  Required  |  The ID, returned from the SubmitPlotRequest method, of the plot request.  |  
|  Status  |  [PlotStatusType](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SkG01hoNwoJoaz4HnKdUfQ)  |  Optional  |  Status of the plot request.  |  
|  SenderName  |  String  |  Optional  |  Name of the sender submitting the plot job.  |  
|  PrinterName  |  String  |  Optional  |  Name of the output device specified in the plot request.  |  
|  DocumentName  |  String  |  Optional  |  Name given to the output job for the printer.  |  
|  ProcessTime  |  Complex  |  Required/optional  |  Group of time- related attributes: MessageArrivedTime StartTime EndTime  |  
Diagram
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/JmDbaGDDtua4T48Phg9qZw-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=760534f0a217fef4&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)

##### PlotStatusType
Applies To
[RemotePlottingStatus Element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GgjHi~fPuAc24t1SsPsfAg)
[PlotStatus Element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GgjHi~fPuAc24t1SsPsfAg)
[Error element](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GgjHi~fPuAc24t1SsPsfAg)
These are the PlotStatusType values:  
|  Value  |  Data Type  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  PLOT NOT RECEIVED  |  String  |  The request has not yet been received by the designated plot server. No other elements of the RemotePlottingStatus are populated in this case.  |  
|  PLOT STARTED  |  String  |  The request has been received and is currently being processed by the designated plot server.  The MessageArrivedTime element indicates the time that the message was delivered to the plot server.  The StartTime element indicates the time at which processing began.  |  
|  SUCCESS  |  String  |  The request was successfully processed by the plot server. The MessageArrivedTime attribute indicates the time that the message was delivered to the plot server.  The StartTime attribute indicates the time at which processing began. The EndTime attribute indicates when processing completed.  |  
|  FAILURE  |  String  |  The request was not successfully processed by the plot server. The Errors element is populated with one or more error messages indicating the problem.  |

#### ApplicationServerName Property

#### AreaExtent Property
[Example](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258166?tocId=8wxok4rxlkfVg7rQEeU6ng)
This example uses the [AreaExtent property](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8wxok4rxlkfVg7rQEeU6ng) in the GNetExportControl or GNetExportClient. 
When using GNetExportControl, paste the corresponding code example into the Form_Load section of the form, with a GNetExportControl with the name GNetExportControl1, and then load the form. 
When using GNetExportClient, paste the corresponding code example by first instantiating the GNetExportClient object and then assigning it to NetExportClient variable.   
|  GNetExportControl VB6 Code Example Private Sub Form_Load ()  GNetExportControl1.AreaExtent =   
"12.34,56.12,123.454,2323.2323,32.3223,323.23232"  End Sub GNetExportClient C# Code Example netExportClient.AreaExtent = "12.34,56.12,123.454,2323.2323,32.3223,323.23232";  |  
| --- |  
Applies To
[GNetExportControl Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Pd8V0ET6lpn4vrD4plK_3w)
Description
The AreaExtent property lists the points bounding an area for an export.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258166?tocId=8wxok4rxlkfVg7rQEeU6ng) When you have an alternate coordinate system for readouts and key-ins or you have published data to a coordinate system other than the storage system, the coordinate value of the points specified here should match the storage system coordinates. 
Data Type
read-write Variant
Remarks
Specifying the AreaExtent property is optional and/or required and applies only when calling the [SubmitExportRequest method](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/tFrtAS0ScS1lzoYRYOmaqQ). The bounding area must be specified through the ExtractGeomFeatureNumber and ExtractGeomFeatureID properties or through the AreaExtent property. 
The list of points must be provided in the following format:
x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3[,x4,y4...]
At least three points must be provided. Point coordinates should be listed in the English format.

#### AttributeFilterComponentView
[Example](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/567424?tocId=G_DGfZIQrVhLb5CDk4VKRg)
This example uses the [AttributeFilterComponentView property](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/G_DGfZIQrVhLb5CDk4VKRg) in the GNetExportControl or GNetExportClient. 
When using GNetExportControl, paste the corresponding code example into the Form_Load section of the form, with a GNetExportControl with the name GNetExportControl1, and then load the form. 
When using GNetExportClient, paste the corresponding code example by first instantiating the GNetExportClient object and then assigning it to NetExportClient variable.   
|  GNetExportControl VB6 Code Example Private Sub Form_Load () GNetExportControl1.AttributeFilterComponentView = True  End Sub GNetExportClient C# Code Example netExportClient.AttributeFilterComponentView = True;  |  
| --- |  
Applies To
[GNetExportControl Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Pd8V0ET6lpn4vrD4plK_3w)
Description
The AttributeFilterComponentView property specifies whether the filter should be directly applied to the component view or the output recordset generated by first applying the spatial filtering. 
Syntax
GNetExportControl.AttributeFilterComponentView
Elements
GNetExportControl.AttributeFilterComponentView
Optional.
Data Type
Read-write Boolean
Remarks
This property when set to True applies the filter to the individual component view only when [G3E_FILTER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/k~4HRxK77SW0c8T2aHMJLg) is not NULL and contains at least one parameterized value. Otherwise, the specified area extent is used to filter the component view. The default value for this property is False.

[GNetExportControl Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Pd8V0ET6lpn4vrD4plK_3w)
Description
The ExtractGeomFeatureID property specifies the feature ID of the geometry bounding the export. The bounding geometry must be specified either through the [ExtractGeomFeatureNumber](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OoXSxl4nF1lynNHQy3Pzhg) and ExtractGeomFeatureID properties or through the [AreaExtent property](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8wxok4rxlkfVg7rQEeU6ng). 
Data Type
Read-write Long
Remarks
Specifying the ExtractGeomFeatureNumber property is optional and/or required. This property applies only when calling the [SubmitExportRequest method](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/tFrtAS0ScS1lzoYRYOmaqQ).

#### FTPLogins Property
[Example](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258184?tocId=8upAbHuOM1rBYSh13TVs9A)
This example uses the [FTPLogins property](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8upAbHuOM1rBYSh13TVs9A) in the GNetExportControl or GNetExportClient. 
When using GNetExportControl, paste the corresponding code example into the Form_Load section of the form, with a GNetExportControl with the name GNetExportControl1, and then load the form. 
When using GNetExportClient, paste the corresponding code example by first instantiating the GNetExportClient object and then assigning it to NetExportClient variable.   
|  GNetExportControl VB6 Code Example Private Sub Form_Load()  Dim FTPLogins As Variant   
FTPLogins = "FTPServerName=xxx;UserName=yyy;Password=zzz";Secure=true  
  
GNetExportControl1.FTPLogins = FTPLogins  End Sub GNetExportClient C# Code Example string ftpLogins; ftpLogins = "FTPServerName=xxx;UserName=yyy;Password=zzz";Secure=true netExportClient.FTPLogins = ftpLogins;  |  
| --- |  
Applies To
[GNetExportControl Object](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Pd8V0ET6lpn4vrD4plK_3w)
Description
The FTPLogins property specifies the login information for the Export file server as FTP server. This FTPLogins information is used to create a folder to hold the input and output files for every export request on the FTP server. 
The user must have read and write permissions on the FTP server.
Data Type
Read-write Variant
Remarks
Specify this property when you want to use FTP server as the Export File Server. Specifying the FTPLogins property is optional, but either FTPLogins or WebFolderLogins property must be specified. If both properties are specified, WebFolderLogins is used. 
The FTPLogins information must be provided in the following format:
FTPServerName=<Computer Name>{/<FTP Folder Name>};UserName=[<Value>];Password=[<Value>];Secure=[<Value>] 
Braces mean zero or more repetitions of /<FTP Folder Name>. When anonymous access is allowed for the FTP server, specifying username and password is not required. 
To make Secure calls to FTP, set the Secure flag to true. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258184?tocId=8upAbHuOM1rBYSh13TVs9A) The "Secure" option overrides the default HttpsEnabled flag value. If "Secure" is not provided in FTPLogins, FTP will use the HttpsEnabled value instead.

Description
The HttpsEnabled property specifies to use a secure HTTPS communication channel for Export Web Server and Web Folder. Setting the flag to true indicates that all calls to the Web Server and Web Folder will be made using HTTPS protocol. The same setting will be applied to FTP by default, unless it uses its own “Secure” parameter in FTPLogins to override. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1084600) The HttpsEnabled setting will be applied to both the Web Server and Web Folder. i.e. both should be HTTPS or both should be HTTP. Mixed mode is not allowed. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1084600) The Web Server and FTP case supports mixed mode, i.e. none, either, or both can be secure. FTP uses HttpsEnabled value by default, unless it overrides the security option. 
Data Type
Boolean
Remarks
Specifying the HttpsEnabled property is optional. 
The default value is False.

The WebFolderLogins property specifies login information for the web folder.
Data Type
Read-write Variant
Remarks
Specify this property when you want to use the web server as the Export File Server. Specifying the WebFolderLogins property is optional, but either FTPLogins or WebFolderLogins property must be specified. If both properties are specified, WebFolderLogins is used. 
The WebFolderLogins information must be provided in the following format:
WebFolder=<Computer Name>{/<Web Folder Name>};UserName=[<Value>];Password=[<Value>] 
Braces mean zero or more repetitions of /<Web Folder Name>. When anonymous access is allowed for the web server, specifying username and password is not required.

# External Interfaces

## Analysis Extraction Utility
NetWorks Core supports extracting [traced network and analysis data](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/3TFHbdDapnD6ljnXblcEuA) and generating the output into the following third-party analysis formats: 
  * [SynerGEE E](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/w6xg0GepJLUvWVtcXgFjZg)
  * [CADPAD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/F8F6KtxxsiTBLG4lqslmvA)
  * [ADEPT (PTI)](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/af0i0sMdalnuGW90hCRYeQ)


In addition to the interactive command, you can extract data for analysis from the command prompt. The Analysis Extraction Utility (AnalysisExtractionUtility.exe, delivered in the \GTechnology)\Program folder) is used to extract network and analysis data and generate output specific to the analysis package such as SynerGEE, CADPAD, or ADEPT (PTI) based on the selected formatter. The selection of the formatter is done based on the value of [G3E_ANALYSISPACKAGES](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aLqq6lgk57QK1rsmsVKLmg).G3E_PROGID for a particular analysis package.   
|  Example To generate output in Middle Link 3.7 file format for SynerGEE E, type the following in G3E_ANALYSISPACKAGES.G3E_PROGID:  Intergraph.GTechnology.SampleFormatter.SynerGEE:  
Intergraph.GTechnology.SampleFormatter.SynerGEE.SynerGEEFormatter   |  
| --- |  
NetWorks Core provides an example formatter based on SynerGEE E. It is delivered in the GTechnology\Services\Samples\NetSamples folder if you select the Administrative Tools feature during setup. Based on the SynerGEE E formatter example, you can use the Network Extraction Library and Analysis Data Extraction Library API to write formatters to output to other analysis packages, such as CADPAD, or PTI. 
The delivered generic network extraction and analysis data extraction library can be shared across different analysis package formats to implement formatter which generates output specific to analysis package specified.   
|  Examples Example of command line parameters to run AnalysisExtractionUtility.exe using the SynerGEE E formatter:  "C:\Program Files\Intergraph\GTechnology\Program\AnalysisExtractionUtility.exe"  
"TraceName=TestA;SeedFID=8201;SeedFNO=300;TraceID=307;  
ExtractPackageName=MLE;Config=ALLTEST943;Username= ALLTEST943;  
Password= ALLTEST943;Output=C:\ExtractUtility\8201.csv,UseCurrentStatus:  
0;UserAttributes=xyz,J2904,2,FilterCriteria~ abc,J2904,1,FilterCriteria;XML=false"  Example of command line parameters to run AnalysisExtractionUtility.exe and generate the traced network and analysis data in an XML file:  "C:\Program Files\Intergraph\GTechnology\Program\AnalysisExtractionUtility.exe"  
"TraceName=TestA;SeedFID=8201;SeedFNO=300;TraceID=307;ExtractPackageName=MLE;  
Config=ALLTEST943;Username= ALLTEST943;Password= ALLTEST943;  
Output=C:\ExtractUtility\8201.xml;UserAttributes=xyz,J2904,2,FilterCriteria~  
abc,J2904,1,FilterCriteria;XML=true"   |  
| --- |  
The following are the parameters for AnalysisExtractionUtility.exe.   
|  Parameter  |  Required/Optional  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  TraceName  |  Required  |  Name of the trace to be extracted  |  
|  SeedFID  |  Required  |  Seed feature identifier  |  
|  SeedFNO  |  Required  |  Seed feature number  |  
|  TraceID  |  Required  |  Represents G3E_TRACEID field in [G3E_TRACEMAPPING_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WgCoNlKft~FyxvOufQfBwA)  |  
|  ExtractPackageName  |  Required  |  Analysis Package Name SynerGEE E = MLE  
CADPAD = CIF  
Adept (PTI) = PSSE   |  
|  Config  |  Required  |  Configuration name  |  
|  Username  |  Required  |  Username for the specified configuration  |  
|  Password  |  Required  |  Password for the specified configuration  |  
|  Output  |  Required  |  Generated output file path  |  
|  UserAttributes  |  Required  |  Specifies all the user attributes which are to be substituted in the stop, filter, and trace path cost criteria. They are specified in the following format: AttributeName,AttributeValue,Oridinal,Criteria. If there is more than one user attribute, they are separated by '-'. Criteria are as follows:  'FilterCriteria' StopCriteria' 'PathCost'.  |  
|  [TraceStopCriteria](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aXTBFL5lmssKnN1AOkKPmg)  |  Optional  |  Restricts features from being traced through  |  
|  [TraceFilterCriteria](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/NSADNMqA4Q5m2sAKmavTYA)  |  Optional  |  Excludes features from the trace  |  
|  [TracePathCost](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7WTpRTTfbA~71nMaSmsrwg)  |  Optional  |  Specifies an expression whose value can be used to determine the cost of a path in the connectivity network   |  
|  XML  |  Optional  |  Specifies if the output is in XML. If this parameter is not specified, the output is specific to the format required for Electrical Analysis package (ExtractPackageName).   |  
If the optional arguments, TraceStopCriteria, TraceFilterCriteria and TracePathCost, are not defined, AnalysisExtractionUtility.exe gets that information from the G3E_TRACEMAPPING_OPTABLE table.

## Batch SAP Update
Use BatchSAPUpdate.exe to update the SAP information for features that are imported as the result of data migration or to update the SAP information for a set of features outside the NetWorks Core environment. 
Batch SAP Update creates or appends the start and end system time, missing feature IDs, the process ID, and errors into a log file (BatchSAPUpdate.log) located in the %TEMP% folder. 
  * To update SAP information using a batch process:


From a command prompt, change to the \GTechnology\Program folder, and type the following: 
  1. BatchSAPUpdate.exe Config=<G/Technology database configuration name>; username=<your userID>; password=<your password>[;KeyTable=<Feature Keys Table>][;FeatureTable=<Feature Table>][;where=<sql condition>] [;SAPSYSNUM=<SAP system No>; SAPLANG=<Language>; SAPUSERID=<SAP UserID>; SAPPASSWD=<SAP User Passwd>; SAPSYSNAME=<SAP System Name>; SAPCLIENT=<SAP Client No>; SAPAPPSRV=<SAP Server>; SAPGROUP=<SAP Environment(group)>;][;] 
  2. OR
  3. Navigate to the \GTechnology\Program folder and double-click BatchSAPUpdate.exe
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/lBx5_tlr2MGuJjFO6DCbLA-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=b1cef74b9e733970&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
    1. Type the appropriate NetWorks Core login information: 
    2. User name—Login  
Password—Password  
Configuration—NetWorks Core connection configuration name  
Feature table—Name of the table to get the feature recordset. All features with a component in this table are validated. If this field is left blank, the software uses COMMON_N as the Feature table name.   
Feature keys table—Name of the table where feature keys are stored. If this field is left blank, the software uses DATACONVFIDKEYS as the feature keys table name.  
Where condition on feature keys table—SQL condition for a filter on the feature keys table to get all or a subset of records. If this field is left blank, the software gets all records in the feature keys table. 


Type the appropriate SAP login information:
  1. User name—SAP login  
Password—SAP password  
System number—System number. Defaults to 0 on the dialog box, but required on the command line.  
System name—The name of the system  
Client—SAP client  
Language—Language. Defaults to EN (English) on the dialog box, but required on the command line.  
Application server—Server IP address (for example, abc.xyz.com)  
Environment (Group name)—Group 
  2. Click OK. 
  3. The software updates the features identified in the feature keys table. Any features that fail to be updated are logged into an error log table ([G3E_SAP_ERROR](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/10WLUZyQvoe5qlCRAEoD6w)). 
  4. Each time the batch update is run the error log shows the date and time of the update (start and end times), system date, and process ID. When the batch update is complete, a message box appears telling you that the batch update is finished. 


Use the error log to generate SAP update error reports.

## CADPAD

### CADPAD Analysis Objects

#### CADPAD Bus Data Analysis Object
The following analysis parameters must be defined for the CADPAD Bus Data Analysis object in the [G3E_ANALYSISPARAMETERS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~Ph4Bg4UcJzi2171RVz7w) table:   
|  Card  |  Field  |  Description  |  Parameter Name  |  Data Type  |  Units  |  Comment  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  1  |  1  |  Identifier  |   |   |   |  Set to the NetWorks Core connectivity node number by the extract process   |  
|   |  2  |  Name  |   |   |   |  Extract process is set to a meaningless value  |  
|   |  3  |  Connection code  |  CONN_CD  |  Integer  |   |  -1 = Single (interpreted as wye or delta based on number of phases)

### CADPAD Configuration Parameter Values
When you define the values for the Operating Status configuration parameters CURRENT_STATUS and NORMAL_STATUS in [G3E_ANALYSISCONFIGURATION.G3E_VALUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/95Dik0JxQHCezVJl5D2V8w), use SQL expressions to translate the values in your data schema into values CADPAD analysis extraction can understand. 
The analysis extraction does not know the specific method used by an application to model whether or not each feature is open or closed, and this is different for each data model. So, to be understood, the SQL expression defined for the configuration value must map into a numeric value that is understood by CADPAD:   
|  0 (zero)  |  = The operating status for the feature is closed.  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  >0 (greater  
than zero)   |  = The operating status for the feature is open.  |  
The SQL expression must evaluate to a numeric value regardless of the data type of the column used to store the value.   
|  Examples For a character column This is an SQL expression for calculating valid operating status values for a schema that stores this information in a character column. For this schema, the CD_STATUS column in the connectivity table is set to closed or open to define the operating status. The expression uses the INSTR function to return valid values by searching for a capital O in the CD_STATUS column values.  INSTR(NVL(conn.CD_STATUS,'O'),'O') INSTR returns the position of the located character. So, if there is a capital O in the CD_STATUS column, the return value is some number greater than zero which the analysis extraction understands to mean open. If there is no capital O in the CD_STATUS column, INSTR returns zero, indicating closed.  The NVL function is used to handle cases where the CD_STATUS column is Null or unknown. For those cases, the string 'O' replaces the Null value. A capital O is always be found in 'O', so the end result of an unknown operating status is that it is open.  For a numeric column This is an SQL expression for calculating valid operating status values for a schema that stores this information in a numeric column. For this schema, the CD_STATUS column in the connectivity table is set to 5 for closed or 2 for open to define the operating status. This expression compares the open numeric value to the value of the CD_STATUS column and computes a valid number for the operating status: 1. ABS(SIGN(2- conn.CD_STATUS)) The expression returns a value of 1 only if the value of CD_STATUS = 2 (open). Any other value for CD_STATUS returns a zero (closed).   |  
| --- |  
DECODE function
Another method for handling multiple status values uses the Oracle DECODE function to map the status values in a schema to the values expected by CADPAD. This method is beneficial when there are multiple values in the schema that must mapped to the values understood by CADPAD. This method works for both numeric and character data types. 
Example
The schema has three values for the operating status:  
1 for open  
2 for closed  
3 for something else meaning closed 
The following expression can be used:  
DECODE( conn.CD_STATUS, 1, 1, 2, 0, 3, 0 ) 
This expression does not attempt to handle Null values for the conn.CD_STATUS column.

### Determining Connection Codes for CADPAD
The extraction logic uses the following workflow to determine the [connection code (CONN_CD)](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/n9HndTJumVhXyE0Za9PAUQ) and the connected load (CONN_LOAD_A, CONN_LOAD_B, and CONN_LOAD_C) parameter values: 
  1. The value of each of these parameters for each feature connected to the bus is determined.
  2. When all of the values from each feature are known, the final value of these parameters is calculated. 


Connection Code
If all of the features are connected in the same way, the CONN_CD value is set to that common type. If there are both delta- and wye-connected features at the bus, then the connection code is set to wye. 
Single connection codes are interpreted as being delta connected if the feature is connected to 2 phases, AB, BC, or CA. Otherwise it is interpreted as being wye connected. The phase value used is the one determined from the PHASE configuration parameter specified in the [G3E_ANALYSISCONFIGURATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/95Dik0JxQHCezVJl5D2V8w) table. 
Connected Loads
If all of the connection codes are the same, the connected load per phase is computed by summing up the values for that phase from each feature at the bus. If both delta and wye are connected features at the bus, the connection type is considered to be wye connected, and the loads are allocated per phase using the following workflow: 
  1. Wye-connected loads are added to their respective phases.
  2. Delta-connected loads are distributed evenly among their constituent phases.
  3. The A phase for a delta connection is actually connected to the A and B phases, so half of its load is added to both the A and B phase load values. 
  4. The B phase is evenly distributed between the B and C phases and the C phase is evenly distributed to the C and A phases.

## Customer Assignment Interface

### Metadata for Customer Assignment Interfaces
The Customer Assignment interface is configured in the [G3E_COMMIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/4Gp7g5vbqXez~bEdYaOZHA) table. Two parameters in this table are used to specify the ProgIDs of the Designer/Analyst and Mobile Assignment interface.   
|  G3E_TYPE  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Customer Assignment interface   |  Specifies the ProgID of the primary implementation of the Customer Assignment interface object used by the Designer/Analyst client and NetViewer client in connected mode.   |  
|  Mobile Assignment Interface  |  Specifies the ProgID of the mobile implementation of the Customer Assignment interface object used by the Field Review client in disconnected mode. Field Review first tries to instantiate the primary interface. If the primary interface is not available (Customer Assignment interface definition), the system fails over to the mobile interface.   |  
Example
The G3E_PARAMETER1 values in this example are customer generated and are not delivered with the product.   
|  G3E_CINO  |  G3E_TYPE  |  G3E_TABLE  |  G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE  |  G3E_PARAMETER1  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  5  |  Customer Assignment interface  |   |   |  TCAIServer.TCAI  |  
|  20  |  Mobile Assignment Interface  |   |   |  TCAIMobile.TCAI  |

### Updating an Assignment System Interface
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/263112) The Assignment System interface in versions of NetWorks Core after 9.2.1 is implemented as the IGTAssignmentInterface interface to support enhancements to loop makeup. All the software that used to access the Assignment System interface now uses the IGTAssignmentInterface and cannot access the old interface. 
This following are changes to the interface:
  * The Language parameter is now required and is the first parameter of all the methods on the interface. 
  * The Pair parameter in the GetXConnect and GetPhoneNum methods has been changed from an Integer to a Long. 
  * The GetPhoneNum method has two new parameters, Designation and Pair. The implementation of the assignment interface must use these parameters to return the designation and pair that the specified phone number is using at the point of termination, most likely a terminal. 


Updating an implementation of the Assignment System interface is fairly straightforward, with only GetPhoneNum requiring much additional work. 
  * To update an Assignment System interface to IGTAssignmentInterface:


  1. In the Microsoft Visual Basic Editor, add a reference to the NetWorks Core Public Custom Automation type library: Select References from the Tools menu. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/EVFOEzscq~hEWlAR_FRfpw-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=42bd10681f2f1ddb&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  2. Implement the IGTAssignmentInterface interface by adding the following line to the top of the class: 
Implements IGTAssignmentInterface
  3. Most methods in the interface can be implemented as wrappers to the existing implementation. In the example below, the IGTAssignmentInterface_GetAssignment method simply calls through to the existing GetAssignment method (not the location of the Language parameter):   
|  Private Function IGTAssignmentInterface_GetAssignment(ByVal Language As Integer, ByVal LocationCode As String, ByVal PairCount As ADODB.Recordset, Result As ADODB.Recordset) As String IGTAssignmentInterface_GetAssignment = mGetAssignment(LocationCode, PairCount, Result, Language) End Function  |  
| --- |  
  4. Update the GetXConnect method to use a Long type for Pair. This can be done by updating the existing implementation to accept a long for the Pair parameter or by converting the value returned in the existing method to a Long before returning it in the new implementation. 
  5. Update the GetPhoneNum method to return the Designation and Pair of the conductor that feeds the terminal. This implementation depends on how your assignment information is stored.

## PTI

### Extracting Transformer Objects
You can use one of two approaches to extract Transformer objects:
  * Extract a banked feature.
  * [Extract each unit](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/af0i0sMdalnuGW90hCRYeQ) in the source feature. 


With both approaches you must specify the analysis parameter definitions one time for each feature type that creates Transformer Analysis objects. 
Extracting a Banked Feature
In this method, you extract a source feature as a bank, resulting in the creation of a single Transformer Analysis object. Set the EXTRACT_AS_UNITS parameter definition constant value to Y to extract separate transformers for each unit in a banked feature. If you set the EXTRACT_AS_UNITS parameter to any other value or do not set it at all, a single Transformer Analysis object is extracted. 
The number of units extracted in the bank are determined by the number of rows found for the source feature for one of its parameter definitions. Typically, if the individual units of a source transformer feature are expected to be extracted, a repeating nongraphic component is required for the source feature that contains the information specific to each unit. 
If the Transformer object is not derived from an attribute of the repeating nongraphic component, set the value of the UNIT_CONTROL_PARAMETER parameter to the name of another parameter. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261350) Use one of the unit candidate parameter types listed below as the control parameter. The PHASE parameter is a typical unit control parameter. 
When extracting multiple Transformer Analysis objects for a single feature, the analysis object parameters are grouped into 2 categories: 
  * Static Parameters — These parameter values are determined once and set to the same value for each extracted unit. 


Unit Candidate Parameters — If these parameters exist in the repeating nongraphic component, they are determined once per unit. Otherwise, a single value for the parameter is specified for each unit. 
If the application must support varying values for these parameters per unit, do the following: – Define the parameters as attribute- based parameters – Assign them to the same repeating nongraphic component as specified for the UNIT_CONTROL_PARAMETER value. 
This procedure ensures related values are grouped together as part of the same row in the component table. Also, those parameters that are derived from attributes in this repeating component should not return Null as a value. 
This table maps the Transformer Analysis object parameters into the static or unit candidate categories:   
|  Static Parameters  |  Candidate Unit Parameters  |  
| --- | --- |

This method results the creation of one or more Transformer Analysis objects, one for each unit in the bank.

#### PTI Protection Equipment Pack Analysis Object
A protection equipment pack is a container for protective devices, such as a fuse or recloser. 
The protection equipment pack does not have a separate analysis object. The protective device triggers the creation of the equipment pack. No additional metadata is required to generate protection equipment packs. 
A maximum of two protection equipment packs can be specified on a branch: one at the To node and one at the From node. Therefore, the equipment packs are associated with the three-phase branch on which they are placed. Since only one equipment pack is allowed on each node of a three- phase branch, the equipment pack is created only if no equipment packs exist on the specified node. 
The following algorithm is used to get the handle for each protective device:
If the current traced feature (protective device) is a three-phase branch (features belonging to Switch, Series Capacitor, Three Phase Line and Transformer Analysis objects): 
If Not:
If one node feature:
  * Find if there is a single connected section upstream or downstream. If yes, then associate its handle with the equipment pack created. If not, then add a dummy node and create a zero impedence three-phase branch between the original and the dummy node and then associate its handle with the equipment pack created. 


Else:
  * Give an error saying that this feature needs to be specified as a three- phase branch.


If Yes:
If feature is a transformer:
  * Add two dummy nodes and create zero impedance three-phase branches between each original and the dummy nodes and then associate its handle with the equipment pack created at the specified node. 


Else:
  * The current feature is used to associate its handle with the equipment pack created.


The following parameters must be defined in the [G3E_ANALYSISPARAMETERS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~Ph4Bg4UcJzi2171RVz7w) table for the PTI Protection Equipment Pack Analysis object:   
|  Description  |  Parameter Name  |  Data Type  |  Units  |  Comment  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Identifier of the three- phase node where this equipment pack is located  |   |   |   |  The Node parameter information of the protective device provides the handle of the node where the equipment pack is created.   |  
|  Identifier of three-phase branch where this protection equipment pack is located  |   |   |   |  The three- phase branch handle (features belonging to Switch, Series Capacitor, Three Phase Line, and Transformer Analysis objects) at which it is placed   |  
|  Name of the protection equipment pack  |   |   |   |  Derived from the Name parameter of the three- phase branch feature, that triggered the creation of this equipment pack   |  
|  Description of the protection equipment pack  |   |   |   |  Derived from the Desc parameter of the first protective device, that triggered the creation of this equipment pack   |

|  Controller status  |  CTRL_STATUS  |  Integer  |   |  1 = In service  
0 = Out of service   |  
|  What is being controlled?  |  CTRL_TYPE  |  Integer  |   |  8 = Control average of the phase voltages 16 = Control the maximum of the phase voltages 24 = Control the minimum of the phase voltages  |  
|  Phases considered by the controller  |  CTRL_PHASE  |  Character  |   |  The PTI phase is determined by looking at the characters contained in this value.· If the letter A is in the string, the PTI phase includes the PHASE_A value. If the letter B is in the string, the PTI phase includes the PHASE_B value. If the letter C is in the string, the PTI phase includes the PHASE_C value.  |  
|  Invert the control action?  |  CTRL_INVERT  |  Integer  |   |  0 = No  
1 = Yes   |  
|  Is the voltage line-to- line?  |  CTRL_VOLT_IS_LL  |  Integer  |   |  0 = Voltage is line-to- neutral  
1 = Voltage is line-to- line   |  
|  Is the controller not ganged? (Does it switch capacitors independently for each phase?)  |  CTRL_NOT_GANGED  |  Integer  |   |  0 = Ganged  
1 = Not ganged   |  
|  Maximum allowable voltage at controlled node  |  CTRL_MAX_V  |  Double  |  Per unit of the controlled node's nominal voltage  |   |  
|  Minimum allowable voltage at controlled node  |  CTRL_MIN_V  |  Double  |  Per unit of the controlled node's nominal voltage  |   |  
|  Maximum per unit kvar of the switched capacitor  |  CTRL_MAX_KVAR  |  Double  |  Per unit  |   |  
|  Minimum per unit kvar of the switched capacitor  |  CTRL_MIN_KVAR  |  Double  |  Per unit  |   |  
|  Per unit kvar switching step  |  CTRL_KVAR_STEP  |  Double  |  Per unit  |   |

#### PTI Transformer Analysis Object
The following analysis parameters must be defined for the PTI Transformer Analysis object in the [G3E_ANALYSISPARAMETERS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~Ph4Bg4UcJzi2171RVz7w) table. They also define the analysis parameters used for the extraction of PTI Transformer Controller Analysis object. 
Transformer Parameters  
|  Description  |  Parameter Name  |  Data Type  |  Units  |  Comment  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Indicates whether to extract multiple objects, one for each unit in a banked feature  |  EXTRACT_AS_UNITS  |  Character  |   |  To extract individual banks, set to Y. To extract a single distribution transformer, set to N or do not set.   |  
|  Defines the number of units to extract  |  UNIT_CONTROL_PARAMETER  |  Character  |   |  Set only if EXTRACT_AS_UNITS is set to Y. Must be equal to the name of one of the [unit parameters](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/af0i0sMdalnuGW90hCRYeQ). Define this parameter based on an attribute value. This attribute should be part of the repeating nongraphic component containing the individual unit data for the banked feature.   |  
|  From node  |   |   |   |  Is set to a node object. Generally, should be the high voltage side. See the [FROM_NODE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/af0i0sMdalnuGW90hCRYeQ) parameter for details on how the From node and To node are specified in the PTI network.   |  
|  To node  |   |   |   |  Set to a node object. Generally should be the low voltage side.  |  
|  Which of the two nodes of the traced feature should correspond to the from-side nameplate voltage   |  FROM_NODE  |  Integer  |   |  Set to one of the following: 0 for the source node (the upstream node as seen by the trace)  
1 for the downstream node as seen by the trace  
2 for NODE1_ID  
3 for NODE2_ID  
4 for the node having the highest voltage. The voltage is determined from the BASE_VOLTAGE parameter for the node analysis objects corresponding to the node connected to the transformer.  For some transformer types, this value is ignored and the From node is specified as follows:  For Auto transformers and Center- tapped delta transformers, the From node is set to the highest voltage side. Same as the value 4 above.  For Auto regulators, the From node is set to the source node. Same as the value 0 above.   |  
|  Which of the two nodes of the traced feature should correspond to the to-side nameplate voltage   |   |  Integer  |   |  The node not specified for the FROM_NODE parameter  |  
|  Unique name of the transformer  |  NAME  |  Character  |   |  Should be unique so that any controller on the transformer can be linked back to it.  |  
|  Status  |  STATUS  |  Integer  |   |  1 = In service  
0= Out of service   |  
|  Transformer type  |  TYPE  |  Integer  |   |  Supported transformer types: 1 = Wye-wye  
2 = Delta- wye, +30° shift  
3 = Wye- delta, - 30°shift  
4 = Delta- delta  
5 = Wye- inverted wye, 180° shift  
6 = Delta- inverted delta, 180° shift  
7 = Wye- inverted delta, +30° shift  
8 = Inverted delta-wye, - 30° shift  
9 = Wye connected auto transformer  
10 = Delta connected auto regulator  
11 = Wye connected auto regulator  
12 = Center- tapped delta  
14 = Center- tapped wye   |  
|  Single phase kVA rating  |  kVA  |  Double  |  kVA  |   |  
|  Nominal voltage on From side of transformer  |  VOLT_FROM  |  Double  |  kV  |   |  
|  Nominal voltage on To side of transformer  |  VOLT_TO  |  Double  |  kV  |   |  
|  Leakage resistance  |  LEAK_R  |  Double  |  Per unit based on device- per- phase kVA  |   |  
|  Leakage reactance  |  LEAK_X  |  Double  |  Per unit based on device- per- phase kVA  |   |  
|  The half winding leakage resistance(Auxiliary resistance)  |  AUX_R  |  Double  |  Per unit based on device- per- phase kVA  |   |  
|  The half winding leakage reactance(Auxiliary reactance)  |  AUX_X  |  Double  |  Per unit based on device- per- phase kVA  |   |  
|  Resistance of the grounding impedence on the From side  |  GROUND_R_FROM  |  Double  |  Ohms  |  Only for wye- (Y) and inverted (A) wye- connected transformers.  |  
|  Reactance of the grounding impedence on the From side  |  GROUND_X_FROM  |  Double  |  Ohms  |  Only for wye- (Y) and inverted (A) wye- connected transformers.  |  
|  Resistance of the grounding impedence on the To side  |  GROUND_R_TO  |  Double  |  Ohms  |  Only for wye- (Y) and inverted (A) wye- connected transformers.  |  
|  Reactance of the grounding impedence on the To side  |  GROUND_X_TO  |  Double  |  Ohms  |  Only for wye- (Y) and inverted (A) wye- connected transformers.  |  
|  Phases present in the transformer  |  PHASE  |  Character  |   |  The PTI phase is determined by looking at the characters contained in this value: If the letter A is in the string, the PTI phase includes the PHASE_A value.  
If the letter B is in the string, the PTI phase includes the PHASE_B value.  
If the letter C is in the string, the PTI phase includes the PHASE_C value.   |  
Transformer Controller Parameters  
|  Description  |  Parameter Name  |  Data Type  |  Units  |  Comment  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Controlled node  |  CTRL_NODE  |  Integer  |   |  Set to one of the following: 0 for the source node (the upstream node as seen by the trace)  
1 for the downstream node as seen by the trace  
2 for NODE1_ID  
3 for NODE2_ID·  
4 for the node having the highest voltage  
5 for the node having the lowest voltage  For values 4 and 5, the voltage is determined from the BASE_VOLTAGE parameter for the Node analysis objects corresponding to the nodes connected to the transformer. If the voltage is the same at both nodes, then the controlled node is set to the downstream node.   |

### Shunt Capacitor Controllers
Each shunt capacitor added to the network should have a corresponding controller, whether or not the capacitor actually has a controller in the field. If there is no actual capacitor controller, define one that has its STATUS parameter set to Out of service (0) so a controller is defined for the capacitor in the PSS network. 
Example  
|  Parameter  |  Value  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  CTRL_STATUS  |  0(Out of service)  |  
|  CTRL_TYPE  |  8  |  
|  CTRL_PHASE  |  A  |  
|  CTRL_INVERT  |  0  |  
|  CTRL_VOLT_IS_LL  |  0  |  
|  CTRL_NOT_GANGED  |  0  |  
|  CTRL_MAX_V  |  1.05  |  
|  CTRL_MIN_V  |  0.95  |  
|  CTRL_MAX_KVAR  |  1  |  
|  CTRL_MIN_KVAR  |  1  |  
|  CTRL_KVAR_STEP  |  1  |

### Transformer Controllers
Each transformer added to the network must have a corresponding controller, regardless of whether the transformer actually has a controller in the field. If no actual transformer controller exists, define one with the STATUS parameter set to Out of service (0) so a controller is defined for the transformer in the PSS network. 
The following are example parameter values for this situation:
