### G3E_COMPCONFIGURATION (Component Configurations Table)
Table name: G3E_COMPCONFIGURATION 
Defines chained groups of components that participate in component configurations. Component configurations let a user quickly and easily place a group of components as a single unit, for example, a grouping of several labels and a leader line used to label a feature. 
To ensure that all of the components are automatically placed, all components defined as part of a component configuration are required. If you want derived components to be placed when the component configuration is placed, you must define the derived component as part of the component configuration. This table requires an entry in [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_CCROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CCNO  |  Identifier for the set of rows in this table that comprise a component configuration.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name of the component configuration that appears in the user interface: On the Feature Explorer Graphic Components tab.  On the dialog displayed by the New Component command.  |  No  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Number of the feature of which this component is a part.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CNO  |  Number of the component included in this component configuration. The same CNO can be listed multiple times in a given component configuration. It can also occur in more than one component configuration. Metadata validation should include checking that the G3E_CNO is appropriately associated with the specified G3E_FNO.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  Specifies the order that this component is placed when this component configuration is placed.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_AUTOREPEAT  |  Denotes if a repeating component should automatically repeat during placement of a component configuration.  0 = Only one instance of the component is placed before moving on to the next component defined in the configuration.  1 = Placement loops on this component, continuing to place more and more instances, until the user presses SHIFT+ESC to move on to the next component within the configuration  Autorepeat can be set only on components marked as repeating in [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_REPEATING](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w) or [G3E_PLACEMENTCONFIGURATION.G3E_REPEATING](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wv7TUo~kYJ6ZhasaVrDMXQ).  Metadata validation checks that only components marked as repeating in G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT and G3E_PLACEMENTCONFIGURATION are marked as autorepeating in G3E_COMPCONFIGURATION.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_PINO  |  Value to indicate information that controls placement of the component. This is a key into the G3E_PLACEMENTINTERFACE table and identifies the placement technique to be used to place this component when the configuration is being placed.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_INTERFACEARGUMENT  |  Array of variants containing arguments for the placement technique. The technique is automatically passed the SelectSet and the current FeatureRecordset arguments that you set. Not all techniques require [additional arguments](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GwhfuMU_SR9gkPE_ULIEkQ).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  RAW (2000)  |   |  
|  G3E_REFRESH  |  Used during feature placement and edit operations. Refresh causes the Graphic Component grid and the data grids to update. This is a Boolean value where Yes (1) indicates that a refresh should occur. These are typical occasions to set this value to Yes:  If the attribute from a graphic component is shown on a dialog tab. (This allows additions or deletions of components from other dialog tabs to be reflected on the Graphic Components tab.)  If the attribute appears on multiple dialog tabs. If the attribute participates in a style rule and consequently affects dynamics. To avoid extraneous refreshing (a performance penalty), set this property to Yes in these cases or when the addition of an attribute (or graphic) component generates a corresponding graphic (or attribute) component through a functional interface.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_SILENTRGNO  |  Number of the silent relationship group. This number is a reference into the [G3E_SILENTRELATIONSHIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/fkOOdphFCekSUjtVVUyL_Q) table for this component when this component configuration is defined to be part of a placement configuration. It allows the component configuration to automatically build a relationship without interaction from the user. It can only build a relationship to another feature in the placement configuration. The definition allows some relationships to be defined silently and others to be interactive. However, you cannot configure part of a relationship to be silent and part of a relationship to be interactive. If this value is Null, all the relationships are processed interactively. Generate a new G3E_SILENTRGNO for each FNO/CNO/FIDX combination for which relationships can be established silently.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/260733?tocId=YHO9TgRk7Beh5fF22~iN_g) This field applies only when the component configuration is part of a placement configuration in the G3E_PLACEMENTCONFIGURATION table. It is ignored if the component configuration is part of a feature in the G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT table.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO  |  A detail component number that corresponds to the geographic G3E_CNO value in a given row. You can optionally populate G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO in rows where G3E_CNO is a geographic component. It should be NULL when G3E_CNO is a detail component.  G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO should only be populated for this reason: To specify implicit geographic versus detail component placement for the two components identified in G3E_CNO and G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO. When a geographic window is active, G3E_CNO is placed. When a detail window is active, G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO is placed.  If populated, the G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO value must correspond to another row in G3E_COMPCONFIGURATION where G3E_CCNO and G3E_FNO match that of the geographic component and where G3E_CNO has the same value as the G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO.  Among other things, the corresponding row defines the placement technique and parameters for placing the G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO.  This row should have a G3E_ORDINAL value that is higher than the G3E_ORDINAL value of the geographic G3E_CNO.  When a G3E_CNO in one row is used as the G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO of another row, it is not automatically placed as part of the component configuration. It is placed only if a detail map window is active when the geographic row with the populated G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO value is processed.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are used within the application. This information is provided by the administrator and is not defaulted.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |

### G3E_COMPONENT (Component Table)
Table name: G3E_COMPONENT 
Contains one row for each conceptual [component used to define a feature](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/K113PpOsAczZ2dRZqFBX_w). This is a global list that spans all feature classes so that common characteristics can be defined once for components that are shared by many features. This requires that most graphic components be uniquely named—TransformerSymbol and SwitchSymbol rather than Symbol, for example. However, components such as MiscellaneousText can be defined once and used by multiple features.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |

|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name of the component that appears in the user interface: On the Feature Explorer Graphic Components tab.  On the dialog displayed by the New Component command. If the component is a detail component, include some indication of that fact in the user name.   |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_NAME  |  Internal component name used in naming fields. The name can contain no spaces or special characters except the underbar.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_TOOLTIP  |  String displayed for the tooltip or status message.  |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  [G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/MnSNe2k7Xndz0jiF9Wu~6w)  |  [Type of component](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/MnSNe2k7Xndz0jiF9Wu~6w), point, line, area, or text.  This information is used to find features with certain geometry types. The value stored in the column is the numeric value of the mnemonic.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  [G3E_GEOMETRYTYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mDqgW7iYAHOkNs1n9Fiq6g)  |  [Geometry type](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/MnSNe2k7Xndz0jiF9Wu~6w) of the component.  This information is used to create the appropriate geometry element for subsequent storage in the database.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

Graphic table names can contain no more than 16 characters.  Each component can be a separate table (typical), or many components can reference the same table or view for storage of the component instances (graphics). Tables that describe facility data must contain [certain columns](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/lLfp_1ij2BapLCwLmZwIyg).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

### G3E_COMPONENTVIEWCOMPOSITION (Component View Composition Table)
Table name:  G3E_COMPONENTVIEWCOMPOSITION 
Contents of this table affect how graphics are displayed during placement. A view is defined for each graphic component in G3E_COMPONENTVIEWDEFINITION. These are the published data views. The views include graphics and nongraphic components. If any changes are made to the G3E_COMPONENTVIEWCOMPOSITION table, execute the following in an SQL editor: 
SQL> execute GDOtriggers.Create_GDOTriggers  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_CVCNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_VNO  |  Number identifying the view.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  The feature within the model that contributes to this view. Typically, only one feature contributes to a view. Although multiple features can be used, the component view belongs to one overriding G3E_FNO. The combination of the overriding G3E_FNO and G3E_CNO represents a valid entry in [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w) unless the component is a synthesized component, in which case it does not appear in G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CNO  |  The component within the model that contributes to this view. Only one graphic component can be associated with a view, but zero to N nongraphic components may also be included. For synthesized components, it is possible to include multiple graphic component definitions in the view. Metadata validation warns you when this condition is encountered.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FIELDS  |  Comma-separated list of field tuples to use in the construction of the view recordset. The fields should be ordered as they appear in the Oracle view for the component view, and they should have the same names.  Each attribute in the list follows [one of two formats,](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/oDdlh7DC2A4McrJuhQPLfw) depending on whether it is to be loaded with an input field value or a hard-coded value. In each of these cases, the tokens in the tuple are separated by at least one space. If the view has a definition that does not fit either of these formats, this field should be left blank.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/257589?tocId=X9EcOVIWIsiQzIZGdzin3A) You must populate the G3E_FIELDS column with the attributes you want listed in the Filter dialog box in Viewer applications.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (720)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_COMPONENTVIEWDEFINITION (Component View Definitions Table)
Table name: G3E_COMPONENTVIEWDEFINITION 
Contains the rules used to generate the display cache. You use the database tools to define the views. This list of data are used to feed into the legend Display Control commands. 
A [component view is defined](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/VPnAdb8GziKP4NU7jimaVw) for graphic components to enable the organization of data in the display cache. Data are published in the display cache for efficiency of indexing and retrieval. The granularity of display groups—component views—enables efficient visualization of the data set (quick on/off capability).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_VNO  |  Number assigned to this view.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_VIEW  |  The view name in the SQL statement that creates the view. Example SQL> create view <ViewName> as select <G3E keys and required columns> from ComponentTable1 C1, ComponentTable2 C2 where C1.G3E_FID=C2.G3E_FID;   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  The feature with which the view is associated. Include only one feature class in a view definition. With [synthesized components](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/BHztsPXCkqRWc8ufJn_Dkg), the data can be retrieved from multiple features.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CNO  |  Component within the feature with which this view is associated. You can specify only one component with the view. A view must have a one- to-one correspondence with a graphic component as associated with a particular feature. This component need not be part of the G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT list for a synthesized component view. See the description of [synthesized components](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/BHztsPXCkqRWc8ufJn_Dkg) for certain extensions.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/255993?tocId=3HXuJCbhR4Htau5yrp55kw) The combination of G3E_FNO and G3E_CNO must be unique within the table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LENO  |  Legend entry identifier in [G3E_LEGENDENTRY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw) that should be used to construct a legend entry for a query. This provides the appropriate style rule information. It is also used for default style information during placement.  If the field is Null, the proper style rule is not applied during placement, and metadata validation raises an error.  For synthesized views, check if the style rule can be obtained from the legend entry of another component view.   |  Yes  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ATTRAFFECTSMEMBERSHIP  |  A flag to tell if the membership of the component view membership depends on a certain value of an attribute.   
 |  Example For a component view defined as SELECT A.G3E_GEOMETRY A.OPENCLOSED FROM A WHERE OPENCLOSED = 'OPEN', this flag must be set to Yes (1).   |  
| --- |  
Because most component views are not defined using the value of an attribute to determine membership, this column is generally set to No (0). 
|  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_FIELDS  |  Comma- separated list of field names to use in the construction of the view recordset. This information applies only to secondary data.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_COMPOSITELINESTYLE (Composite Line Style Table)
Table name: G3E_COMPOSITELINESTYLE 
The table corresponds to the information in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA) and describes how a composite line style is defined. See [G3E_LINESTYLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/b3vQwQ~YtLlgn5feW4cuvA) for definitions of simple line styles. 
The metadata publishing process stores styles in binary form in the G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE column. This column has a size limit of 2000 bytes. 
A composite line style that has complex stroke patterns can exceed the size limit of 2000 bytes when converted to binary format, causing the publishing process to fail. 
To avoid the publish failure, make sure the composite line style is not complex enough to exceed 2000 bytes. The BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger on the G3E_COMPOSITELINESTYLE table checks the style size and raises an error: The Composite Line style size is beyond 2000 bytes”. 
Because these fields represent the localized metadata, none of them are localized.
An entry must exist in G3E_METADATASUPPORT for this table. The table is not published.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SNO  |  Identifier for the style. This value is copied from the G3E_STYLE table. You cannot edit this value.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name found in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_LINE1  |  Identifier for the linear style drawn first to form a multiple linear style.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LINE2  |  Identifier for the linear style drawn second to form a multiple linear style  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LINE3  |  Identifier for the linear style drawn third to form a multiple linear style.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LINE4  |  Identifier for the linear style drawn forth to form a multiple linear style.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LINE5  |  Identifier for the linear style drawn fifth to form a multiple linear style.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_STARTSYMBOL  |  Identifier for the point style to use as the composite line start.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ENDSYMBOL  |  Identifier for the point style to use as the composite line terminator  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_PLOTREDLINE  |  Boolean indicator of whether this style should appear in the plotting style control list. The value is found in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_PLOTREDLINE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA).  0 = The style is not available in plotting redlines. 1 = The style is available in plotting redlines.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_STYLEUNITS  |  Determines how the various "size" properties of styles (size, offset, width, and so forth) are interpreted.  1 = The style is scale dependent. The appearance of the components that use the style to draw vary based on the current zoom scale.  3 = The style is scale independent. The appearance of the components that use the style to draw are always the same regardless of the zoom scale.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  1  |

### G3E_CONFIGURATIONS (Configurations of Subsets and Coordinate Systems Table)
Table name:  G3E_CONFIGURATIONS 
Maps configurations to their regions and published coordinate systems.
[Regional subsetting](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pojLH5IuIFXzS9HmohODXQ) lets you publish models covering a large geographic extent in sections of the service territory into different coordinate systems. The G3E_CONFIGURATIONS table lets you define subset configurations which are composed of specific regions and published in specific coordinate systems.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_CONFNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONFIGURATIONNAME  |  Name of a Configuration. Must be a reference to [G3E_DATACONNECTION.G3E_LOCATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XVSORnBdhQjIxL9aNJ0TPw). The configuration name is repeated in this table if the configuration has multiple regions.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_REGIONNAME  |  The name of a region used to filter tables that are subsetted as part of this configuration. G3E_REGIONNAME must reference a value of the region name attribute of the feature in the [G3E_WORKMGMT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KME_1L76HZEDZ5lzihAbeQ) table of the region. This name cannot contain commas or semicolons.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_CSNAME  |  Name of the coordinate system in which this configuration should be published. G3E_CSNAME must reference the NAME column in the [GCOORDSYSTEMTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XwuKVI_U5ObpDp0hIkR1tA) table. This means that configuration names in the CCM file come from the G3E_DATACONNECTION table. This field is joined to the primary language definition. Use the Define Coordinate System command to create a new coordinate system. If this column is Null, there is no transformation during publish.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (100)  |   |  
|  G3E_OGCCRSNAME  |  Used to map the [CRS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256972?tocId=vWwv39pUkFaofbuloNJ4lQ) string associated with the coordinate system of the given configuration. This normally stores the corresponding [EPSG](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256972?tocId=vWwv39pUkFaofbuloNJ4lQ) string (example: EPSG:4326) that the configuration represents.  Coordinate Reference System. This is an (Open Geospatial Consortium) OGC-specific terminology used to define the coordinate system.  European Petroleum Survey Group is an organization that maintains a data set of coordinate reference systems and coordinate transformation which may be global, regional, national, or local in its application. Each of these coordinate reference systems have a code, which is known as EPSG code. By mapping your coordinate system configuration to one of these named definitions, your data can be shared through web services and appropriately matched to a location on the earth to align properly with other data.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  No  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_CONSTRUCTIONAID (Construction Aid Definition Table)
Table name:  G3E_CONSTRUCTIONAID 
Contains information necessary to support customizing the NetWorks Core construction aids and is used by the Construction Aids control to retrieve data needed to display and execute custom construction aids.

The ordinal value is located in the .h file associated with the .drx file. If no bitmap is specified, the framework provides a default bitmap; however, this bitmap value is not displayed in metadata. See [Creating Placement Icons](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/xGgxn7TZS~Le32Qi7DBg6w) and [Sample Icons](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ir60WAdXWAgsWIyJlk13JA) for more information.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  0  |

See [Metadata for .NET Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aOcRgNV~zssw9YmOFCG54A) for an example.

### G3E_CSSFEATURE (CSS Features Table)
Table name: G3E_CSSFEATURE 
Defines the features in the data model that have associated work management information. Specifically, the table identifies the customer feature and transformer and/or primary meter features. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/263263?tocId=z493CBnXvqx4XVnEoMQOJA) This capability is not supported in NetWorks Core version 9.3 and later. However, the table can be used by custom software.

Customer  
Load Device   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

For the customer feature, this is the repeating customer component that holds a foreign key to the customer account and consumption data. It also carries the average load per customer. For the load device features, this is the component that contains the summed load for all customers served by this load device. This feature must be an owner of the customer feature.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |

|  G3E_CONSUMPTIONTABLE  |  For the customer feature, contains the name of the table referenced by G3E_CNO. This is the foreign key table containing detailed information about the consumption for the customers. For the load device, this value is Null.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_ACCOUNTINTERCHANGE  |  For the customer feature, this contains the name of the table that mirrors the table specified in G3E_ACCOUNTTABLE. This table is assumed to be identical in structure. This is the table used for monthly update processing. For the load device, this value is Null.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

### G3E_CSSFIELD (CSS Fields Table)
Table name: G3E_CSSFIELD 
Defines the fields in the features defined for the CSS information that are exchanged between CSS and NetWorks Core. It also identifies the load fields for transformer processing. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/263264?tocId=VB~gRZFcdJz3jaMbib~qVw) This capability is not supported in NetWorks Core version 9.3 and later. However, the table can be used by custom software.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_TYPE  |  Type indicator to signal how this field is interpreted. These are the valid values: A Null Value Account Number Update Indicator Critical Customer Indicator Energy KWH Demand KW Demand KVA Month Indicator Load Device Number  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_CNO  |  Component number, if applicable for this set of fields. For the Customer feature, this is the repeating customer component that holds a foreign key to the customer account and consumption data. It also carries the average load per customer. For the Load Device features, this is the component that contains the summed load for all customers served by this Load Device. This feature must be an owner of the Customer feature. This field is Null for the non-feature tables.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_KEY  |  Indicates if this field definition contains the table's key. 0 = The field definitions does not contain the table's key. 1 = The field definitions contains the table's key.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_TABLENAME  |  Table name corresponding to the component or the table name as specified in the previous table entries.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_FIELDNAME  |  Field name corresponding to the component or the field name in the table specified in G3E_TABLENAME. Each field processed by the interface is specified. For date fields, the contents of this field should look like this:  TRANSACTION_DATE DATE(20) "MM-DD- YYYY" Where TRANSACTION_DATE is the name of the field, DATE(20) is the format and length of the field in the file, and the last string is the format definition of the date data in the file. These parameters must be separated by spaces.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

### G3E_CUSTOMCOMMAND (Custom Command Table)
Table name: G3E_CUSTOMCOMMAND 
Contains most of the information necessary to define and support the use of custom commands in NetWorks Core. The G3E_ROLEASSOCIATION table contains the command role. G3E_CUSTOMCOMMAND.G3E_CCNO appears as the OBJECTCONTROLID in the [G3E_ROLEASSOCIATION table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/zh3qB4osHGP2VkpCluxGBg).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_CCNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  Increment up with table- specific sequence.  |  
|  G3E_AONO  |  Foreign key into the G3E_ADDON.G3E_AONO number the Add-On the custom command is grouped with.   |  No  |  Yes  |  NO  |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_INTERFACE  |  Name of the.NET project interface for the custom command. This value is input by the command designer.  [Click here](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256952?tocId=TnT4ya5S9F75dJaSN86qXg) for information more about .NET implementations.  The G3E_PROGID value for [analysis packages table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aLqq6lgk57QK1rsmsVKLmg). The G3E_INTERFACE value for the interface tables.  <AssemblyName>:<TypeName> where <AssemblyName> is the filename of the assembly containing the .NET custom extension and <TypeName> is the type name (namespace.classname) of the .NET custom extension.  See [Metadata for .NET Extensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/aOcRgNV~zssw9YmOFCG54A) for an example.   
 |   |  
| --- |  
|   |  
|  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (256)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Name of the custom command as it appears in the user interface (the command name on a menu, for example). Not used in the Project Manager display listing.   |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |  New Command  |  
|  G3E_DESCRIPTION  |  Text description of the command function. For administrative use only.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_AUTHOR  |  Name of the person who created the command. For administrative use only.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_COMMENTS  |  Text field for author/editor comments. For administrative use only.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_LARGEBITMAP  |  Specifies a large bitmap for the command using an ordinal value that points to an icon in a DRX file. Both large and small icons are stored in this file. Large bitmaps are 32x32 pixels and have 32-bit color. If no bitmap is specified, a default bitmap is provided by the framework, but its value is not displayed in metadata. The ordinal value specifies the 1- based index into the icon file. For example, to display the first icon in the file, type 1 in the G3E_CUSTOMCOMMAND.G3E_LARGEBITMAP field in Metadata Explorer.  The location of the DRX file is determined by the entry in the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table where [G3E_USERNAME = CustomCommandIconDRXFile](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OQ5eJGmN8hHE5WKzX6N1fQ).  Alternatively, the command icon can be loaded directly from the assembly containing the custom command. To set this up, set this field to 0. In the assembly with the command, add an icon resource with exactly the same name as the command. For this icon resource, add a new device type with resolution 16x16 and another one with resolution 32x32 pixels, both in 32-bit color. The resource can be added to any resource type inside the assembly.  Example: For a command defined as "MyCoolAssembly:MyNamespace.Commands.MyCoolCommand", add an icon resource with name MyCoolCommand to project resources of MyCoolAssembly.  ![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256952?tocId=TnT4ya5S9F75dJaSN86qXg) The icons in the .ico file must be in the correct order to display properly. The 32x32 icon must be before the 16x16 icon.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_SMALLBITMAP  |  Specifies a small bitmap for the command using an ordinal value that points to an icon in a DRX file. Both large and small icons are stored in this file. Small bitmaps are 16x16 pixels and have 32-bit color. If no bitmap is specified, a default bitmap is provided by the framework, but its value is not displayed in metadata. The ordinal value specifies the 1- based index into the icon file. For example, to display the first icon in the file, type 1 in the G3E_CUSTOMCOMMAND.G3E_SMALLBITMAP field in Metadata Explorer.  The location of the DRX file is determined by the entry in the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table where [G3E_USERNAME = CustomCommandIconDRXFile](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OQ5eJGmN8hHE5WKzX6N1fQ).  Alternatively, the command icon can be loaded directly from the assembly containing the custom command. To set this up set this field to 0. In the assembly with the command, add an icon resource with exactly the same name as the command. For this icon resource, add a new device type with resolution 16x16 and another one with resolution 32x32 pixels, both in 32-bit color. The resource can be added to any resource type inside the assembly.  Example: For a command defined as "MyCoolAssembly:MyNamespace.Commands.MyCoolCommand" add an icon resource with name MyCoolCommand to project resources of MyCoolAssembly.  ![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256952?tocId=TnT4ya5S9F75dJaSN86qXg) The icons in the .ico file must be in the correct order to display properly. The 32x32 icon must be before the 16x16 icon.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_TOOLTIP  |  Tooltip text for the command.  |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |  G3E_USERNAME  |  
|  G3E_STATUSBARTEXT  |  Concise command description shown in the status bar when a user hovers the mouse over the command button or menu item.   |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  [G3E_COMMANDCLASS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bIbY1hn76N86msoBms4bug)  |  Command class or command priority. This value is used to manage collisions between commands and is used only if the modality of the command has been set to 0 (modeless).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  0  |  
|  [G3E_ENABLINGMASK](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/xwzPfYm5paXoHApHPaMwlw)  |  Enabling mask. The value that controls when a custom command is enabled based on a select set contents. Multiple enabling conditions may be selected.  Optional.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number(9,0)  |  0 (command is always enabled)  |  
|  G3E_MODALITY  |  Specifies whether the new custom command is modal or modeless. 0 = Modeless. A command that releases the application to respond to events while the command is still active. A modeless command listens for events at the windows that it created or that it is attached to, and it remains active until it receives an event that tells it to deactivate.  1 = Modal. A command that takes control of the entire application until the command returns.  Not editable after initially entered.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1 (modal command)  |  
|  [G3E_SELECTSETENABLINGMASK](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/xk0X6mx7uq2FQ2HX3y0QPQ)  |  Select set enabling mask. The value controls when a custom command is enabled based on select set contents. Multiple enabling conditions may be selected.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  0 (none)  |

### G3E_DATABASE_MESSAGES (Database Messages)
Table name:  G3E_DATABASE_MESSAGES 
Contains information necessary to [localize error messages](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AXU4GZfTAgYbvg8yl8rVQw) for the PL/SQL code. This table stores multiple versions of the same message, localized and distinguished by a locale identifier. 
This table must be referenced in the [G3E_DATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/_ZuCX4G4mblLkZOTURP~6g) table.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_FUNCTIONALID  |  The identifier to which a group of messages belongs. This typically is a set of NetWorks Core functionality contained within a database package.   |  No  |  No  |  Yes*  |  No  |  Number (38)  |  
|  G3E_MSGNO  |  The user-defined message number, typically an Oracle error message number, a negative integer in the range of -20000 to -20999. This number may or not be the same as the error number used in RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR. This number cannot exceed the range for the database NUMBER(5), and the message numbers within a functional subsystem must be unique.   |  No  |  No  |  Yes*  |  No  |  Number(5)  |  
|  G3E_LCID  |  The locale identifier for the message. This is a foreign key to [G3E_METADATALANGUAGE.G3E_LCID](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/J_swCLicivDPWmDMyDJePQ).   |  No  |  No  |  Yes*  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (4)  |  
|  G3E_MESSAGE  |  The localized message  |  No  |  No  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2(2048)  |  
* The combination of G3E_FUNCTIONALID, G3E_MSGNO, and G3E_LCID is the primary key.

### G3E_DATACONNECTION (Data Connections Table)
Table name: G3E_DATACONNECTION 
Contains one row for each data connection used to define the facility model and any backdrop data. Metadata for the backdrop or secondary data are stored and maintained in the facility database. However, there are restrictions on the behavior and manipulation of that data since it is read-only. Additionally, validation rules for metadata are different if the source is secondary. As such, this table identifies all the data connections used to create the complete facility model.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Description of the data connection; probably the connection name.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCATION  |  Information regarding the primary file or data access mechanism for the server.  For NetWorks Core native databases, this is the configuration name.  For secondary connections, it is either the file or folder name on the local machine or a mapped folder on the machine where publishing is done. You cannot use a [FileUNCPaths](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/vh0Kk8wYIT3X~Tvx5EvjTQ) location.  Must be uppercase.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONNECTINFO  |  Other connection parameters that are necessary to reestablish a database connection. For an MGE data source only, the connection information required to connect to an MGE server. For example, ODBC;DSN=fpcland;SERVER=fpctst. Parameters can include other files or password information.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  CLOB  |   |  
|  G3E_GDOTYPE  |  The connection type - that is, which GDO server. Contains the ProgID for the database object. These are valid values for the GDOTYPE:  Access.GTDatabase AI.GTDatabase ArcInfo.GTDatabase ArcView.GTDatabase AV.GTDatabase FM0.GTDatabase G3E.GDatabase MapInfo.GTDatabase MGE.GTDatabase MI.GTDatabase WFS.GTDatabase  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  Indicates the nature of the data connection: 1 = Development 2 = Test 3 = Production 4 = Field 5 = Secondary 6 = Import 8 = WFS  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_OUTPUTDIRECTORY   |  Name of the folder to store the generated SQL*Loader files for an Import type of connection. This field is applicable only to import connections.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_LASTASSIGNEDFID  |  Value of the last assigned G3E_FID value for features imported from a GDO server. This value is applicable only to an import connection.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CSNAME  |  Name of the coordinate system reference in the [GCOORDSYSTEMTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XwuKVI_U5ObpDp0hIkR1tA) for this data server. The value can be Null for non-NetWorks Core data connections as secondary data connections can have multiple coordinate systems. Foreign key assumes that CSNAME is a primary key in the GCOORDSYSTEMTABLE.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (100)  |   |  
|  G3E_OFFICE  |  Identifier of the data connection definition of the office configuration associated with this field connection. The G3E_DATASUPPORT table is used by the database server procedures to create synonyms and grant appropriate privileges. It is also used by the PublishSubset process to determine what database objects to include in the published subset database that are not identifiable in other metadata tables. 
This table contains the names of database tables, views, sequences, packages, procedures, functions, or types. The LTT_ROLE package uses the whole list to create synonyms and grant privileges to the appropriate roles of users within the environment.

|  G3E_TABLE  |  Name of the database object in uppercase letters (table, view, sequence, package, procedure, function, type) that is to be processed. The foreign key is logical to underlying database table/view, sequence, or package/procedure/function or type.  The foreign Key must be a table in the database.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

|  G3E_GRANTPRIVILEGE  |  A semicolon- separated list of privileges applicable to this object. If more than one set of privileges is specified, G3E_GRANTROLE must contain a matching set of roles.  If this field is left Null, the following privileges are granted: Tables/views: select, insert, update,delete  
Sequences: select  
Packages/Procedures/Functions or types: execute   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |

### G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE (Sample Legend Definition Table)
Table name: G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE 
Contains the definition of the legend entry order for a single legend. Legends are used to populate a map window or an embedded map on a plot sheet. The actual name of this table is specified in the G3E_LEGEND table. An instance of the definition table contains the ordered list of legend entries (from the [G3E_LEGENDENTRY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw) table) to display. 
The complete legend entry is defined by joining this table and G3E_SETTINGSTABLE to the G3E_LEGENDENTRY.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LENO  |  Number of the legend entry.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTER  |  [SQL](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) [WHERE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) [clause](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) indicating the subset of instances from this component view that should actually be displayed. If no filter is wanted, this field should contain an empty string or a Null value. Do not include the word Null in the field.  Before populating this field, consider using synthesized components. They yield much better display performance. See [Create Synthesized Components (Display by Feature State Example)](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bq8KPGX7I0bun0GXV1G04g).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_DISPLAYORDINAL  |  Relative position in the legend. A value of 1 has the highest priority and is drawn on the top of all other data. If duplicate values are used rather than making the value unique per table, you are not guaranteed that the order of the displayed data is constant from one metadata publish to the next. Metadata publishing uses the Oracle sorting algorithm on this column. When two values are the same, Oracle does not guarantee the order in which rows are returned. If guaranteed order is important, you must make the values unique. For some graphic elements like text nodes within the same feature, order may not be important for your display and non-unique values are acceptable.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |

### G3E_DETAIL (Detail Relationship Table)
Table name: G3E_DETAIL 
The detail relationship is the mechanism by which unique detail group identifiers are generated. These identifiers are stored in the detail identifier field of each detail graphic component. The G3E_DETAIL table defines which features can reference detail components. This table also defines which component (within a referencing feature) triggers the creation of detail or schematic windows and which component is used to store window attribution. 
The identifier information stored in the attribute component of the referencing feature enables the review of the detail graphics from various feature classes associated with this identifier. The detail relationship software lets you generate a new identifier and description of the detail area. It also lets you link to another existing detail area. The reestablish method on the relationship software allows the generation of another detail area only if the attribute component containing the detail information is a repeating component. 
A feature can reference or define a detail area and not actually have any of its own components participate in that detail. For example, a geographic substation references several detail windows: for breaker details, bus details, or regulator details. Each of these detail windows contains features that are within the substation, but the substation itself is not in the detail window.

### G3E_DIALOG (Property Dialogs Table)
Table name: G3E_DIALOG 
Presentation of attribute data are governed by the definition of tabs on the dialog box. This table defines the group or set of tabs that are presented as a unit. Single components (required, nonrepeating) can be combined on a single tab. Optional or optional/repeating components are typically presented in a horizontal grid that is limited to attributes from a single component. The individual tabs are defined in G3E_DIALOGTAB. The software supports an unlimited number of tab types or classifications to support placement configurations. However, each secondary feature should define a Properties type that describes the display of attributes for the component view definition. For Feature Explorer, each feature should define a Review type of tabs for displaying reviewable attributes. 
For job data, attribute presentation is controlled by the definition of tabs on the dialog boxes. The definition for the G3E_TYPE = G3E_EDITJOB is required.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DNO  |  Identifier for the dialog box (set of tabs). The number is repeated in the table and consequently it is not actually a primary key. However, the display cache treats it as a key for grouping purposes. This should be assigned for a Type and FNO combination since access to the set of tabs is based on this information. The same number is assigned to each tab within the set, even if not all of the tabs are displayed due to filtering. The same dialog box number must be assigned to each tab in the group.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DTNO  |  Identifier of the tab to include in this dialog box display. This is a reference to the identifier defined in [G3E_DIALOGTAB](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/IKdrSlfHQUZZzLVLFu5dTQ).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  The context in which this tab is used. The type is user definable. You can define as many types as you want to support placement configurations. The Properties type is used to define a tab for presentation of the component views in the display cache for secondary data. There should be only one tab of this type per feature, and it should correspond to the view of the primary graphic component. There should also be one definition per feature with the type Placement, one or more definitions with the type Edit, and one or more definitions with the type Review for use by Feature Explorer.  Additionally, the type can reference a placement configuration. These are the reserved type values: Placement Edit Review Properties Bulk Edit Single Edit Multi Edit Single Review Merged Placement Merged Review Merged Edit For any of the Single * or Multiple * entries, only one dialog tab pair should be referenced for a given G3E_FNO value. This check occurs only in metadata validation. These G3E_Type values are used by the [Duct Configuration control](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AKYI3Kuz~5qBsCiyjhGFrQ) and [Cable Edit control](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Zn_9lmDaJE11oZfURbtkRg). The [Bulk Edit dialog tab](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/e6vZLByjrTVM4DuZIv9IQg) is only used for the features that can be bulk edited. Only features with [G3E_FEATURE.G3E_BULKEDIT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/VFyFq8MbVW9PQDgb03TtpQ) set to Yes (1) can have this kind of dialog tab defined.  For the Merged * entries, all of the dialog tabs referenced for a given G3E_FNO value should have the same structure: the attributes referenced should have the same column names and the same data types and formatting. These dialog tabs are used to form a horizontal grid containing multiple components merged together so that they appear to be one single component with common attributes.  Only one pair of components can be specified per feature—one detail component and one geographic component. If the associated dialog tab references the Cable Edit control, no other merged entries can be defined.  These types are allowable for attribute presentation for the job commands: G3E_EDITJOB G3E_NEWJOB G3E_JOBENVIRONMENT G3E_POSTJOB G3E_DISCARDJOB G3E_CLOSEJOB G3E_COPYJOB G3E_NETJOBS  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  G3E_FNO of the feature that this tab should be used in conjunction with. If a tab is to be used by multiple features, it must be listed for each feature. If this dialog box represents a configuration in the Type field, this field should still be populated. Multiple features within one configuration can use the same dialog tab.  A G3E_FNO of zero is allowed in the case where type equals the following: G3E_EDITJOB G3E_NEWJOB G3E_JOBENVIRONMENT G3E_POSTJOB G3E_DISCARDJOB G3E_CLOSEJOB G3E_COPYJOB G3E_NETJOBS  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  The position of this tab when displayed during feature placement or edit. A value of 1 indicates the first tab in the sequence from left to right.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTER  |  [SQL clause](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) used to control the selection of the tabs to use during the review or edit of a feature. This query is a not a database query, and works only for filters against the primary geographic component’s view, like a style rule filter works. The G3E_FILTER column is ignored when the placement or named configuration dialog boxes are requested. An evaluation of True for the filter includes the tab. An evaluation of False excludes the filter. Filter ordering is not used here, and all filters are evaluated. The Null filter (catch-all case) should contain an empty string or a Null value. Do not include the word Null in the field.  If the feature is defined as nongraphic, the primary attribute component is used instead of the primary geographic component view. The same restrictions on the filter apply. If the feature is geographic, the logic checks for occurrences of first the primary geographic, primary detail, and alternate geographic until it finds an occurrence. If no occurrence is found, it uses the primary attribute component. The filter clause must be valid for all of these components or component views.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_USERNAME  |  String to appear on the tab to describe this data.  |  No  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORIENTATION  |  The orientation of the grid, vertical (V) or horizontal (H). All tabs used for displaying repeating components should be horizontal but are not required. If vertical is specified for a repeating component, only the first occurrence is presented. You can correct this by making the presentation horizontal. If G3E_SUPPORTINTERFACE is populated and references the MergedAttributeGrid, set this field to V. Then, any attributes associated with this dialog tab are displayed in a vertical attribute grid within the merged attribute control.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (1)  |   |  
|  G3E_WIDTHINTWIPS  |  A number indicating the number of twips to use to define the width of the descriptive attribute column on vertical grids. On horizontal grids, this is the default value for any attributes that do not have their width specified explicitly. If this value is left Null, the software determines a best fit by calculating the width of the field descriptions (maximum for all fields on vertical grids) up to half of the width of the control. The specification is in the resolution independent unit called TWIPS. You can approximate the width as a more familiar measurement unit as follows:  There are approximately 15 twips in one pixel. On Microsoft Windows-based machines, there are approximately 96 pixels per logical inch. So, to make the column one inch wide, you would set the twips to 1440. The actual presentation of the data should be checked based on the font used and the resolution of the machine.   |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDERBYKEY  |  Order by field. This must be uppercase. This field is the complete order-by clause including field name and the DESC clause if necessary. It may include multi-column ordering. In the case of multi-column ordering, list the fields, and the DESC clause if needed, as a comma(,) separated list. It must be null if the orientation is not horizontal or the attributes for the tab are taken from more than one table or view.  The order-by clause is typically applied to component tables. However, if all of the attributes displayed on a dialog tab refer to a non-component table or view such as a foreign key or domain table, the order-by clause is applied to the non-component table or view.   |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_SUPPORTINTERFACE  |  The ProgID of the software that supports the tab construction and presentation. The service must support the defined interfaces. If the entry is Null, the standard horizontal or vertical tabs are presented based on G3E_ORIENTATION.  These special controls are supported: GTCtlInfo.CableEditControl GTCtlInfo.DuctConfigurationControl GTCtlInfo.PairCountControl GTCtlInfo.MergedAttributeGrid Only one instance of each of these can appear for a given mode (placement, edit, review) within a feature. Also, CableEditControl and MergedAttributeGrid are mutually exclusive and can appear only once within a feature definition.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (256)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_DIMORTHOGONAL (Orthogonal Dimension Component Table)
Table name: G3E_DIMORTHOGONAL 
Contains metadata of orthogonal dimension components. This table also contains information about dimensioning relationship fields. Lengths and distances are interpreted by NetWorks Core to be in the same unit of measure as the ground unit of the coordinate system definition. 
This table contains multiple fields which reference entries in [G3E_ATTRIBUTE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw) table. G3E_CNO of all these referenced entries must match the G3E_CNO in the referencing row in this table.

|  G3E_DIMTEXTLOC1  |  Default position of the first dimension text along the dimension line. The value is in percent with 0% as the start point of the dimension line and 100% as the endpoint of the dimension line.  For [stacked dimensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/vAsnjYWXINWTtu_hw2cVKg), the dimension text is placed between the endpoint of the associated dimension line and the endpoint of the longest shorter dimension line. The endpoint of the longest shorter dimension line is 0%, and the endpoint of the associated dimension line is 100%.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,2)  |  50  |

### G3E_DIMRELATIONSHIP (Dimensioning Relationship Table)
Table name: G3E_DIMRELATIONSHIP 
Describes the dimensioning relationship between individual feature components. For each possible pair of related components (1 - Dimensioning component, 2 - Related feature component), there must be a record in this table. The record also indicates the type of the relationship: dimension base or dimensioned feature.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DRNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DIMFNO  |  FNO of the feature that contains a dimensioning component.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DIMCNO  |  CNO of the dimensioning component.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONNECTEDFNO  |  FNO of the feature related to the dimension.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONNECTEDCNO  |  CNO of the triggering component of the related feature.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DIMRELTYPE  |  Type of the dimensioning relationship:  
 |  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  1  |  Dimension-base subrelationship; feature related to the dimension is a base feature.  |  
|  2  |  Dimensioned-feature subrelationship; feature related to the dimension is a dimensioned feature.   |  
|  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DRIVINGDRIVENDEFAULT  |  Default value of the field identified by G3E_DRIVINGDRIVENANO (driven or not-driven). These are the valid values if G3E_DIMREELTYPE=2: 0 = Not driven. The dimension is not driven by the dimensioned feature. 1 = Driven. The dimension is driven by the dimensioned feature. If G3E_DIMRELTYPE=1, the value in this field must be Null.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_DIMSTYLEGROUP (Dimension Style Groups Table)
Table name: G3E_DIMSTYLEGROUP 
Contains assignments of style rules to individual segments of dimension graphics such as dimension line and dimension text. Since each dimension graphic consists of multiple segments while it is displayed in a map view through a single legend entry, this table enables the definition of a group of style rules that are used to render dimensions. The group is identified by the same value in G3E_DSGNO. G3E_DSGNO is referenced by [G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_SRNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw). 
Omitting an entry for any dimension segment does not result in an error. The segment is simply not rendered. For example, if you do not want baselines to be shown, the entry for baseline should not exist. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256639?tocId=ul1ZNWnC4F6edCUnp9eURQ) If [small dimensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/IrX~FbRNYEMNuVXwnCfn4Q) are not supported in the data model, you can define dimension line styles (G3E_DIMSEGMENT is 1 or 2) with point styles for arrowheads at start and endpoints. Then, it is not necessary to populate the metadata for the endpoint styles (G3E_DIMSEGMENT is 9,10,11, or 12). 
If small dimensions are supported in the data model, you must define these endpoint styles for the arrowheads to be correctly rotated and offset for small dimensions.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DSGROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DSGNO  |  Identifier for the style group. This number is repeated in the table for each member of the same style group.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DIMSEGMENT  |  Identification of the dimension segment to which the style rule is applied. 1 = Dimension line 2 = Second dimension line 3 = Witness line 4 = Second witness line 5 = Baseline 6 = Dimension text (the length) 7 = Second dimension text 8 = Dimension angle text (for polar dimensions) 9 = Endpoint at the start of dimension line 10 = Endpoint at the end of dimension line 11 = Endpoint at the start of the second dimension line 12 = Endpoint at the end of the second dimension line  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_SRNO  |  Identifier of the style rule to be used to render the dimension segments identified by G3E_DIMSEGMENT.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  The order of rendering. The segment with the highest ordinal is rendered first.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE (Sample Legend Display Control Table)

An instance of the Display Control table contains the presentation of the Display Control tree view.

|  G3E_LEVEL  |  Level of item in the tree. One is a root or top level.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  Order of item in tree construction.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |

|  G3E_ROLE  |  Name of the database role the user must have to see this item displayed in the Display Control's user interface (tree view). A trigger on the table sets it to 'EVERYONE' if it is left Null.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  EVERYONE  |

### G3E_DUCT (Duct Parameters Table)
Table name: G3E_DUCT 
Contains information necessary for [defining duct parameters](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA) such as which attributes specify the duct's row and column position within the formation. You typically have either one row or two rows in this table; one row if you only use ducts in your model, and two rows if you use both ducts and inner ducts. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/257714?tocId=bdWhvnmf~2S3I4TRh9CzHw) The attributes referenced by G3E_FROMROWPOSANO, G3E_FROMCOLPOSANO, G3E_TOROWPOSANO, and G3E_TOCOLPOSANO must all be contained in the same component.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_FNO  |  Duct or innerduct's FNO.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ASSIGNMENTANO  |  Assignment field, which is a user-specified identifier for the duct. Often it is a number, but not always. NetWorks Core provide tools to automatically number ducts in a formation, but you can also use your own scheme. Most data models require the assignment to be unique, so NetWorks Core displays ducts that have a duplicate assignment with a red background in the Duct Configuration control. However, uniqueness is not enforced. This value can be stored in a different component than the to/from indicators.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FROMROWPOSANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the row positional information for the From end of the duct. It is assumed that G3E_FROMROWPOSANO, G3E_FROMCOLPOSANO, G3E_TOROWPOSANO and G3E_TOCOLPOSANO are contained in the same component. The user should never directly edit these attributes.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FROMCOLPOSANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the column positional information for the From end of the duct.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TOROWPOSANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the row positional information for the To end of the duct.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |

|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_DUCTCONFIGGRAPHIC (Duct Configuration Graphic Table)
Table name: G3E_DUCTCONFIGGRAPHIC 
Specifies the graphic components to create when [creating a new formation or duct feature](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA). When placing a formation or duct, you probably have to place more than one graphic component. 
This table should have one or more entries for the formation, duct, and (if required) innerduct features. For each of these feature classes, there should be a row in this table for each component that is to be created by the [Place Formation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/76EATu7MgiaMcS7PvLjl_Q) command.

|  G3E_FNO  |  FNO of feature being placed. Can be either a duct, inner duct, or a formation.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CNO  |  CNO of component to place.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |

|  G3E_ORIGINGRAPHIC  |  Specifies whether this component is the origin graphic component for the duct or formation. If G3E_ORIGINGRAPHIC is Yes (1), this component's origin is the origin of this end of the duct or formation. The location of all other components of this end of the duct or formation are derived from this point.  0 = This component's origin is not the origin of this end of the duct or formation. 1 = This component's origin is the origin of this end of the duct or formation.  
 |  Example Setting this field to Yes (1) for the formation From Geo Line component indicates that the position of the graphics for the duct feature's From Geo component within a formation is calculated based on the initial point of the formation From Geo Line. Similarly, setting this field to Yes for the Duct To Detail symbol component indicates that the position of the graphics for the innerduct feature's To Detail components are calculated based on the origin of the Duct To detail symbol.   |  
| --- |  
For a given feature, G3E_ORIGINGRAPHIC should be Yes for one component of each of the following sets of components: From/Detail, From/Geo, To/Detail, To/Geo.

### G3E_DUCTFORMATION (Duct Formation Table)
Table name:  G3E_DUCTFORMATION 
Contains information necessary for [predefining duct configurations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA). A duct configuration is essentially the number of rows and columns of ducts. This table specifies which configurations are valid for formations (specified in [G3E_DUCTIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WU8MlP9KTpz4DA2jW5KJ1w) by the entry Formation Feature) and what type of duct to create (specified by the FNO of the duct). 
The G3E_DFNO field specifies the FNO of either the duct or inner duct feature. All of the rows specifying the duct FNO are presented in the Duct Configuration control when editing a formation as possible predefined configurations of ducts that the user can add to the formation. The rows specifying the inner duct FNO are presented when editing a duct as possible predefined configurations of inner ducts.

|  G3E_DFNO  |  FNO of duct or inner duct to create when creating this duct formation.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Username/Description to show on the user interface.  |  No  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_NUMROWS  |  The number of rows in this duct formation.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_NUMCOLS  |  The number of columns in this duct formation.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |

### G3E_EDTPOLEMOMENT (Electric Design Tools Pole Moments Table)
Table name: G3E_EDTPOLEMOMENT 
Provides the parameter information used to perform the Pole Moment and Guying calculation. It also provides the means by which the information is presented on the Pole Moment and Guying dialog box. 
The following are ways that the value for a given parameter can be retrieved.
Feature Attribute—A parameter value can be associated with an attribute of a feature by specifying its attribute number. This parameter is listed as part of the data grid. The analysis identifier parameter for pole, attachment, equipment, and guy should always be defined by feature attribute. 
  * Some data models might have reference field data to be retrieved directly from the attribute data and not from the reference table. In this instance, do not define this reference field type into G3E_EDTREFFIELD. Instead, map an attribute number to the parameter information. The G3E_VALUE field contains the G3E_ANO of the attribute that belongs to the feature. 
  * Constant—A parameter can be defined as a constant. This parameter is listed as part of the data grid. 


A read / write flag is provided for the feature attribute and constant parameter types so you can edit the values.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_EDTPMNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  [G3E_GRIDTYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mifqKLc0~PV0rT2Q39NU2g)  |  Associates the column definition to the appropriate grid. Each grid represents a feature group.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Since more than one feature can be associate with either pole, conductor, equipment, or guy type feature, this field identifies the feature number associated with the parameter from where the defined attribute should be retrieved. Define each parameter set separately for each feature; therefore. there can be more than one entry for the same parameter. Only applicable when G3E_VALUETYPE is -1 (feature attribute). This field should be Null if G3E_VALUETYPE less than or equal to -1.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUETYPE  |  The type of the parameter value: -1 = Feature attribute (a reference to G3E_ATTIBUTE.G3E_ANO). The parameter value is retrieved from feature attribute.  1 = Constant. The parameter value is considered as a constant. -2 = Calculation Output. Since this table is also used for the presentation of outputs of Pole Moment and Guying calculation, this value type defines whether the calculation output is displayed on the grid.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  [G3E_PARAMETER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/3ciLOMpGq~U5Fpk5kPbYHA)  |  Represents the parameter name. Foreign key to [G3E_EDTPOLEMOMENTPARAMTYPE.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Egy~uGu1pAwcz_eMwzuqkQ).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name of the parameter that is displayed on the grid.  |  No  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  Specifies the value of the parameter, which can be either a constant or an attribute number. Only applicable when G3E_VALUETYPE equals -1 or 1. If G3E_VALUETYPE equals -1, this should contain the G3E_ANO of the attribute.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  Indicates the order in which the parameter needs to be displayed on data grid.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_READONLY  |  Indicates if the field should be treated as read-only. Only applicable when G3E_VALUETYPE = -1 or 1. If G3E_VALUETYPE equals 1 and G3E_READONLY equals 0, this parameter is treated as user input.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_PNO  |  Indicates the picklist table that needs to be associated with the parameter. Only applicable when G3E_VALUETYPE equals -1 or 1 and G3E_READONLY equals 0.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONVERSIONFACTOR  |  Different utilities can maintain attributes in different units but they should be finally converted into single unit system throughout Pole Moment and Guying calculation. If a conductor diameter is defined in inches, attachment height is defined in feet, the final required output should be in feet, and conductor diameter should be converted into feet before being used in the calculation. In this case, the conversion factor is 1/12 (populate this field as 0.083). That is, before using this value in calculation, the parameter attribute value is multiplied by the specified conversion factor. Only applicable when G3E_VALUETYPE equals -1. If this field is Null, the conversion factor is assumed to be 1.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (10,5)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_EDTPOLEMOMENTCATEGORY (Electric Design Tools Pole Moment Category Table)
Table name: G3E_EDTPOLEMOMENTCATEGORY 
Since some utilities model their guys based on individual feature category, this table provides an ability to list the categories they want to use. For example, a feature category may be primary, secondary, or neutral. Even if the guys are not modeled based on individual feature category, this table should contain at least one entry with a default category. 
An entry must exist in [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) for the table. The optimized table [G3E_EDTFEATURE_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/if19uumcXZuDk462Cts4QA) should contain the category information. [G3E_EDTFEATURE.G3E_EDTPMCNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/jIJyyrPrDZ5543k9snLd_g) is a foreign key that points to G3E_EDTPOLEMOMENTCATEGORY.G3E_EDTPMCNO. The optimized table should contain G3E_NAME and G3E_GUYATTACHMENTHEIGHT from this table as G3E_CATEGORY and G3E_GUYATTACHMENTHEIGHT, respectively.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_EDTPMCNO  |  Row identifier for the table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |
