### G3E_EXPORTSTYLEx (Export Style Mapping Table)
Table name:  G3E_EXPORTSTYLEx 
Used by the Export interface to determine the correct style number to output for various [styles](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pqTEElyS8Am77mqi129RjA) defined in the application and what they map to in the various output formats. Multiple export style mapping metadata tables can exist. Each table name is required to be populated in the [G3E_EXPORTLIST.G3E_TABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/X0Oy6~3emw6bzMEzt_4otQ) field. The table must exist before it is populated in the G3E_EXPORTLIST.G3E_TABLE field. The MG3ENetExportUtils metadata package creates the table. Run the following procedure to create an Export Style Mapping table and its optimized table package: 
SQL> execute MG3ENetExportUtils.CreateExpStyleTableAndPackage ('TableName', 'TableAbbreviation');
TableName must be less than or equal to 22 characters and TableAbbreviation must be less than or equal to 17 characters. To recreate the optimized table packages for all Export Style Mapping tables listed in the G3E_EXPORTLIST table, run this procedure: 
SQL> execute MG3ENetExportUtils.InstallExportStylePackages;
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258214?tocId=JxIchzoCk526YrQ0h307Rw) Text weight and text width-to-height ratio are honored only for TrueType fonts.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SNO  |  Unique number for the NetWorks Core style object. Identifier associated with the needed style object from the [G3E_STYLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA) table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  Yes  |  Number (9, 0)  |   |  
|  G3E_COLORMAP  |  Color number (0-255 for IGDS and 0- 256 for AutoCAD® to use in place of the color found in the specified style. Only applicable to IGDS and AutoCAD output format. See the IGDS seed file for the color number. See the AutoCAD template file (G3E_TEMPLATE row)for the color number. See the IGDS seed file for the cell name. See the AutoCAD template file for the shape, line style, and area style names.  For AutoCAD, a value of 0 indicates that the enclosing block color should be used. A value of 256 or Null indicates that layer color should be used. All other numbers (1-255) are treated as the color specification of the element.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5, 0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CELLNAMEMAP  |  Name of the cell to use in place of the symbol found in the specified style. Metadata Configurations
You can configure metadata in the following ways to write point features to the AutoCAD format as Shape, Multi-text, or Block:   
|  Feature  |  Use the applicable fields:  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Shape  |  G3E_FILENAME Stores AutoCAD shape file name (.shx). The full AutoCAD shape file path information is required with the shape file name when one of the following applies:  The G3E_GLYPHLOCATION field is not populated. The user does not set the GNetExportControl.GlyphLocation property. The G3E_GLYPHLOCATION field value is not the same as the AutoCAD shape file location  |  
|   |  G3E_CELLNAMEMAP Stores AutoCAD shape name in the AutoCAD shape definition file (.shp).   |  
|   |  G3E_FONTNUMBERMAP Stores AutoCAD shape index in the AutoCAD shape definition file (.shp).   |  
|   |  G3E_COLOR Stores symbol color number. Range 0-256 for AutoCAD. See the AutoCAD template file for the color number.   |  
|  Multi-text  |  G3E_FILENAME Stores the TrueType font name (and not the true TrueType file name). Because this field stores only the TrueType font name, no path or filename information is needed. However, the specified TrueType font must be installed on the system.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258214?tocId=JxIchzoCk526YrQ0h307Rw) The symbol- encoded fonts do not work with the AutoCAD export of TrueTypeFont symbols.   |  
|   |  G3E_CELLNAMEMAP Stores the character value corresponding to the required symbol from the TrueType font file. See the TrueType font file for the character value for the required symbol.   |  
|   |  G3E_FONTNUMBERMAP Not applicable.  |  
|   |  G3E_COLOR Stores the symbol color number. Range 0-256 for AutoCAD. See the AutoCAD template file for the color number.   |  
|  Blocks  |  G3E_FILENAME This field should be empty.  |  
|   |  G3E_CELLNAMEMAP Stores the name of the AutoCAD block as defined in the AutoCAD template file with which the symbol needs to be exported.   |

### G3E_EXPORTx (Export Output List Table)
Table name: G3E_EXPORTx 
Used by the Export interface to determine the views to extract according to the named extraction. Several tables of this format exist. Each table is required to be populated in the [G3E_EXPORTIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/w_3GBp6CrR6DNa_wkMw6Ug) table with G3E_TYPE = 'ExportFormat'. The table must exist before it is populated in the G3E_EXPORTIFACE table. A metadata package named MG3ENetExportUtils is provided with the product to create the table. 
Run the following procedure to create an Export Output List table and its optimized table package: 
SQL> execute MG3ENetExportUtils.CreateExpOutputTableAndPackage ('TableName', 'TableAbbreviation');
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258154?tocId=k~4HRxK77SW0c8T2aHMJLg) TableName must be less than or equal to 22 characters, and TableAbbreviation must be less than or equal to 17 characters. 
To recreate the optimized table packages for all Export Output List tables listed in the G3E_EXPORTIFACE table, run this procedure: 
SQL> execute MG3ENetExportUtils.InstallExportOutputPackages;
When text elements are exported, the size of the text is calculated as follows:
"autocad_scale" = SizeInPoints
where
SizeInPoints = size/scale in points [= dSize * FROM_HI_METRICS].
FROM_HI_METRICS is constant [= 0.02834651918918]
dSize is size/scale in hi-metrics [= (dConversion * PaperScale) / DBCSHorizResByGroundDistMagnitude]
where
PaperScale is the value specified by (in following order):
  1. Client ActiveX Property (property overrides metadata)
  2. Metadata (G3E_EXPORTLIST.G3E_PAPERSCALE) (metadata overrides coordinate system)
  3. Database CoordinateSystem Nominal Paper Scale


DBCSHorizResByGroundDistMagnitude value is retrieved from database coordinate system
dConversion = conversion of the PointStyle.Size value from points to units of the database   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_EFNO  |  Unique number for the row.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_VNO  |  View number for the component view. The combination of G3E_VNO and G3E_LENO should be unique. You can configure the database to enforce this unique combination. Generally, a view is exported only one time, and you use the G3E_FILTER field to determine which features to export for a specific view.  The exported component view attributes are export-format specific. When exporting to ArcInfo, ArcView, AutoCAD, and MapInfo formats, all component view attributes are exported. For MicroStation, a user-linkage of type ‘framme’ is created containing the G3E keys (G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO, and G3E_CID). The sixteen-byte linkage is defined as follows: 
  * Bytes 1-2: FRAMME tag value of 0x1007 
  * Bytes 3-4: Always a value of 0x0020
  * Bytes 5-8: G3E_FID
  * Bytes 9-10: G3E_FNO
  * Bytes 11-12: Always a value of 0x0000
  * Bytes 13-14: G3E_CNO
  * Bytes 15-16: G3E_CID

The G3E_CNO values is the value found in the component view data – typically the G3E_CNO of the graphic component.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LENO  |  Legend entry from which to retrieve the style and label rules  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTER  |  [Filter expression](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) for eliminating data from the extraction process. G3E_FILTER determines which features to export for a view. For example, you can filter the view to extract only the features flagged as Proposed or In Service.  The filter expression can include dynamic parameters that are substituted at runtime with the values from the [parameter values collection](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/F_oDes8I0UzhCKRJzrDPQw). For example, the G3E_FILTER value can be STATE = ‘%1$s’ where 1 represents the first parameter value. Similarly, you can have %2$s, %3$s,…%n$s where n represents the index of the parameter within the parameter values collection. The number of parameters used within the table should match the number of entries in the parameter values collection.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_LAYERNAME  |  If not Null, this value is used to group the data in the extract format on a particular level or layer of the data model. In MapInfo, this is the layer name. In MicroStation, this is the level number. If Null, the name of the component view is used.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT (Feature-Component Relationship Table)
Table name:  G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT 
Lists the components that make up each feature. The G3E_FNO column stores the feature identifier. Through this key and the information in this table, you manage the integrity of the relationship between features and their components. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/255959?tocId=Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w) Synthesized components should not be included in this definition.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_FCNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  The feature number. The specified number must already exist in the feature table.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |

G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO should only be populated for these reasons: To specify implicit geographic versus detail component placement for the two components identified in G3E_CNO and G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO. When a geographic window is active, G3E_CNO is placed. When a detail window is active, G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO is placed. In these additional rows, G3E_INCLUDEINPLACEMENT must be 1. However, even though G3E_INCLUDEINPLACEMENT is 1, this detail component is not listed separately in the Graphic Components user interface because G3E_DETAILPLACEMENTCNO is populated in the row of the geographic component. Export of individual attributes can be controlled via setting G3E_EXPORT to 1 in the G3E_ATTRIBUTE table. Attributes will only be exported where: 
  * G3E_EXPORT is set to 1 in G3E_ATTRIBUTE 

and
  * attributes are present in a component table marked by G3E_EXPORT set to 1 in G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.

Example 1: If G3E_EXPORT is set to 0 in the G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT of the primary geometry component of the building feature then only the primary geometry will be exported. The attributes will not be exported.  Example 2: To export a pole feature so that its primary geometry is exported along with the attributes pole_attribute_component.height and my_common_component.date_placed, set the G3E_EXPORT to 1 in G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT for the pole_attribute_component and my_common_component component of the pole feature. Determine the height attribute and date_placed attribute by setting G3E_EXPORT to 1 in the G3E_ATTRIBUTE table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |

### G3E_FEATUREJOBCLASS (Feature Attribute Specification Table)
Table name: G3E_FEATUREJOBCLASS 
Contains information necessary to assign feature values for a job classification. The values are preloaded while placing features of the specified kind and while in a job of this classification. 
These attributes apply only to the specific feature instance being placed.

### G3E_FIELDFORMAT (Field Formats Table)
Table name: G3E_FIELDFORMAT 
Contains information necessary for the field format check constraint on the metadata tables. Its primary usage is for Boolean and double type fields. It also defines the legal values for the field format of all data types. It is only extensible for Boolean and double formats. ### G3E_FINDCOMPATTRIBUTE (Find Component Attributes Table)

### G3E_FINDQUICK (Quick Reference Find Table)
Table name: G3E_FINDQUICK 
Contains information necessary to support [Quick Reference Find](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SgekrGq__JC7N5L2OYpoEg). An entry must exist in [G3E_FINDMETHOD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/~yh_nP3UzVZyGCMF8WCpQg) for the table and its optimized table to include this metadata in the published cache.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_FQNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name of the predefined query that appears in the Quick Reference Find dialog box.   |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_SQL  |  The [SQL](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256628?tocId=AoGKL7_Ay5AepP5qmfgKLA) statement with substitution parameters. The Order By clause is not supported in Quick Reference Find.  Occasionally, you might use an Oracle query that is extremely complicated, such as when you are composing SQL for queries and finds. If you are having problems running a complicated query, Hexagon suggests one of the following solutions: 
  * Put the query into an Oracle view, which is used in the SQL statement.
  * Add the query as code in a PL/SQL procedure, which is called from inside the SQL statement.

Substitution parameters must be indicated by question marks (?). ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256628?tocId=AoGKL7_Ay5AepP5qmfgKLA) If the number of parameters (question mark placeholders) in the statement does not match the number of attributes defined for the query, the software may yield unexpected results, including possibly getting into an infinite loop.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256628?tocId=AoGKL7_Ay5AepP5qmfgKLA) Because SQL Server 2012 and 2014 do not support TRIM, use RTRIM and/or LTRIM in statements in the G3E_ATTRIBUTEQUERY.G3E_SQL and G3E_FINDQUICK.G3E_SQL columns for Field Review.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256628?tocId=AoGKL7_Ay5AepP5qmfgKLA) The SQL statement must return G3E_FNO and G3E_FID.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256628?tocId=AoGKL7_Ay5AepP5qmfgKLA) Because the results of the query go through xml special characters are limited to hyphen, underscore, and period in column aliases.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (2000)  |   |  
|  G3E_AOILI  |  Flag to indicate if an AOI Location Indicator is required to execute this Quick Reference Find.  0 = An AOI Location Indicator is not required to execute this Quick Reference Find. 1 = An AOI Location Indicator is required to execute this Quick Reference Find.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_ROLE  |  Name of the database role that the user must have to enable the object control. If the user has the role, the specific type would be displayed on the Quick Reference Find dialog box.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  EVERYONE  |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
|  G3E_APPLICATION  |  Contains the bit mask value representing the product combination. Each product with the bit enabled in the mask will show the query on the list of available queries.  1 = Designer only  2 = NetViewer only  4 = Field Review only  8 = Portal only  16 = Mobile only  To make the query available in multiple products, merge the bitmap masks of individual products. For example, if you configure a query with mask 9 (8+1), it will be available in the Portal application and in the Designer application.  If you specify a query as being in the NetViewer application, then it is not visible in Designer. You must configure the G3E_NETPAGES to include the query in NetViewer or Field Review.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  1  |

### G3E_FORMATION (Formation Parameters Table)

### G3E_GEOMGENINTERFACE (Geometry Generation Interface Table)
Table name: G3E_GEOMGENINTERFACE 
Contains a list of the functions available to support placement operations in [duct generation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA). Each function is effectively an automated object that supports the geometry generation interface. It is called during the creation of graphic components. 
The [Place Formation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/76EATu7MgiaMcS7PvLjl_Q) command uses geometry generators to generate the geometries of the components it creates. The geometry generators are like silent placement techniques, except that they typically use information from the attributes of the feature and the formation as a whole to compute the geometry. This table is populated in the default metadata and updated by metadata upgrade scripts, so you should typically not need to modify this table. 
NetWorks Core supports two generators: DuctPoint and FormationPoint. Use FormationPoint for all formation components and DuctPoint for all duct and innerduct components. 
When you create an empty database, this table is automatically populated with the default entries defined in the \GTechnology\Services\MetadataEntries\PopulateDuctMetadata.sql script.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_GGINO  |  Identifier for the geometry generation interface.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name of the technique which appears in the user interface list.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_INTERFACE  |  ProgID of the software component to support this function. It should contain no space and begin with a letter.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (256)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPEMASK  |  Indicator of the component type (see [G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw)) values to which this technique applies.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_GGDATA (Geometry Generation Parameters Table)
Table name: G3E_GGDATA

The values in the G3E_VALUE field control the layout and spacing of the formation and duct components when placed by the Place Formation command. 
This diagram shows how these arguments, plus the parameters in [G3E_DUCTIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WU8MlP9KTpz4DA2jW5KJ1w), are used to place the formation line and duct symbol. The alignment of the symbol is assumed to be center-center in this example. This diagram purposely exaggerates the distances for clarity.

### G3E_IATRACESUMMARYOUTPUT (Interactive Trace Summary Output Table)
Table name: G3E_IATRACESUMMARYOUTPUT 
Defines filter expression to calculate the cost factor of a summary output.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localized  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_IATSONO  |  Unique identifier.  |  Y  |  N  |  N  |  Y  |  N  |  Number(9)  |   |  
|  G3E_IATDONO  |  Detail output identifier that the summary output is associated with. Foreign key to G3E_IATRACEDETAILOUTPUT. IATDONO.  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  Y  |  Number(9)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Name of column used with displaying as part of the Trace Summary section in Interactive Trace command.   |  N  |  N  |  Y  |  N  |  N  |  Varchar2(80)  |   |  
|  G3E_NAME  |  Defines the name of the field in the expression.  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  Varhar2(80)  |   |  
|  G3E_AGGREGATOR  |  This defines the aggregator used in computing the values.  Valid values are Average Count Percent Sum (default value)  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  Varchar2(16)  |  Sum  |  
|  G3E_EXPRESSION  |  An expression to be used to determine the cost of the summary output. Parts of the expression The expression that evaluates the value of the G3E_NAME followed by a comma. The cost factor calculation if the expression is met followed by 2 commas. The cost factor calculation if the expression is not met Example: LENGTH2 = 0 or LENGTH2 is null,1,,LENGTH2 * 2 Where LENGTH2 is the GE_NAME Expression is LENGTH2 = 0 or LENGTH2 is null 1 if the calculation to do if expression is not met LENGTH2*2 is the calculation to do if the expression is not met.  |  N  |  Y  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  Varchar2(512)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  Used internally by the Interactive Trace command.  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  Number(5)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  N  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_IMPORTLIST (Net Import List Table)
Table name:  G3E_IMPORTLIST 
Information necessary for the specification of several import formats. It contains the named import definitions.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_ILNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  A key name indicating the name of the import type. This is a descriptive name that is meaningful to the user. It cannot have values 'MICROSTATION', 'MICRO STATION', 'AUTO CAD', or 'AUTOCAD'. These are case insensitive values and space between letters does not matter. For example, 'M i c ro STATION' is not a valid value.   |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  [IMPORTFORMAT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qmP4RxA2J6YEG~qu9wqLTA)  |  The import format for the GDAL/Teigha translator. These values are case sensitive.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_OUTPUTLOCATION  |  Identifies where the imported files are output on the server. This can either be Registry=<registry key> where the contents of the key identifies the folder location, or it can be Directory=<folder path> where the path identifies where the files are placed. This is the location on the server to which the output files are written. This field value is not used by the Export application or the Web page. It is not the [GNetExportControl.ExtractLocation property](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qcWuHj9GWrOKkpaDGtvt9A). G3E_OUTPUTLOCATION is used only when the back end export service is used directly in NetWorks Core or by some other server-based program.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_TEMPLATE  |  The coordinate system file for the imported data. A transformation is applied from this file to the NetWorks Core database coordinate system to be used when creating the import file. If not specified, the parameter can be provided through the control automation. Corresponds to the [GNetExportControl.TemplateFileName](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/lVkE7pw0_776teDiM2vDhQ) property property. If this parameter is not provided in either case, then transformation is not applied.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (256)  |   |  
|  G3E_OUTPUTFILENAME  |  The output file name. This is the name of the file that is generated during the import. If not specified, the parameter must be provided through the control automation, [GNetExportControl.OutputFileName](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XAJW3Ty8EN3J7EEe0J7gZg) property.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |

### G3E_JOBCLASSIFICATION (Job Classification Table)
Table name: G3E_JOBCLASSIFICATION 
Contains information necessary for user-defined job classifications. A job classification is a means of describing the nature of the work in the job. Based on this classification, attributes can be automatically assigned to features. 
The following information must be available to support the definition of job classifications:
  * Job classification name and description.
  * Common attribute specification associated with the classification.
  * Feature-specific attribute specification associated with the classification.
  * Field specification in the [G3E_JOBDEFINITION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TBQDr_BsRYh8ej2Rr97t2g) table indicating which field on the job table holds the job classification name. 
  * Indicator of attributes that should be copied as stated in [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_COPY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw). Some attributes, such as an owner identifier, should not be copied. 
  * The default job classification is stored in the [G3E_TABATTRIBUTE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/DQvudRU4TKitmHAp03~qGQ) table as a G3E_NAME, G3E_VALUE pair with the G3E_NAME value equal to DefaultJobClassification. The G3E_VALUE value must equal one of the G3E_JCNO values in the G3E_JOBCLASSIFICATION table; otherwise, the default job classification is <none>. 

  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_JCNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name for the classification.  |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_DESCRIPTION  |  Description of this classification.  |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_ROLE  |  Name of the database role the user must have to enable the object control. The specific type of job class is available to the user who has the role.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  EVERYONE  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

This value corresponds to the Keyword group on the Key Criteria tab of the [Select Job dialog box](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OV36qNYCfC~yj_1o~F_XVw).   |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_JOBPREFIX  |  Default job prefix value prepended to the job identifier when the user [creates a new job](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SyT9lcV2eeceSwXLzo0KfA). Generally, the user accepts the default job ID, and this value is a prefix to the default job number. However, if the user manually enters a job identifier, this prefix value is not prepended when NetWorks Core is integrated with STORMS or Logica and the job is not designated as a maintenance job.  A maintenance job is always specified whenever the user is connected to the production database when Logica or STORMS integration is defined. The user cannot override this setting. When connected to the field database, the user can specify a maintenance job when creating a new job. Hence, when connected to the production database, the New Job dialog always appears as a maintenance job and the G3E_JOBPREFIX is prepended.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (30)  |   |

|  G3E_REGIONFIELD  |  Name of the field in the table containing the region value populated from the work management system   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_DISTRICTFIELD  |  Name of the field in the table containing the district value populated from the work management system   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_JOBTYPEFIELD  |  Used to define which column in the job table is used as the job type. The job type can be used to exclude certain jobs types from being processed by JobLifeCycle batch processing:  Specify the column that is to be used as the job type within the job table Define an entry in the [G3E_STORMSIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/eEbhntNS3hCuflwFGSvrZA) table with G3E_TYPE=’JobTypeExceptionList’.  Use the G3E_PARAMETER1 values as the job types to be excluded.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (30)  |   |

|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_JOBLIFECYCLE (Job Life Cycle Management Table)
Table name: G3E_JOBLIFECYCLE 
Contains the logic for controlling automatic manipulation of GIS jobs.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_TRIGGERDESCRIPTION  |  Describes when the action occurs. The trigger or procedure is responsible for setting the WR_STATE_CODE and G3E_STATUS_CODE attributes appropriately.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |  S  |  
|  G3E_WR_STATE_CODE  |  The value of the [G3E_JOBSTATUS.WR_STATE_CODE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GD8BWxQMRuSWnKE5qHh7JA) attribute in the job record that is set by the trigger described in this entry. This is the key field for the monitor program to determine the appropriate actions to perform on the job.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (10)  |  S  |  
|  G3E_GIS_JOB_STATUS  |  The value to which the trigger described in this entry sets [G3E_JOB.GIS_JOB_STATUS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/NBpHv2zHWYS1W~0EQ7FgwQ) when initiated.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (10)  |   |  
|  G3E_DISCARD  |  Indicates whether the job and associated alternatives should be discarded when this WR_STATE_CODE is encountered in the job record.  0 = Discard operation. 1 = Discard alternatives. 2 = Discard job and all alternatives.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_POST  |  Indicates whether the feature data pending in the job should be posted. 0 = No post operation. 1 = Full post of pending data. 2 = Partial post of specified data. 3 = Full post of pending data excluding work points. 4 = Partial post of pending data excluding work points.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_TRANSITION  |  Indicates whether the pending data are transitioned to the next state in its life cycle.  0 = No state transition. 1 = State transition from current state to the next state. In the case of multiple possible transitions, if one is flagged as the default ([G3E_TRANSITION.G3E_DEFAULT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ACMZjVsrW8BQ2DZD8ftZdA)), the software makes that transition. |  G3E_VALIDATE  |  This column is no longer used to make a determination to validate job data. A validation of data automatically occurs when G3E_JOBLIFECYCLE.G3E_POST= 1 or 2.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_ACTION  |  Reserved for future use.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  0  |

### G3E_LABELRULE (Label Rule Table)
Table name: G3E_LABELRULE 
Manages the mapping between a label rule and the possible formats that can be returned by that rule. Also includes the filters used to choose the label format. 
Every G3E_LABELRULE entry should have a Null expression. This is effectively the default label for the feature. It should always be the last filter evaluated. This is a Null value or the empty string. Do not use the word Null.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LRROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LRNO  |  Identifier for the label rule. The number is repeated in the table and is not actually a primary key. However, the display cache treats it as a key for grouping purposes. Referenced in the [G3E_LEGENDENTRY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw) table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_RULE  |  Name of the label rule.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTER  |  [SQL WHERE clause](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) based on the attributes of the associated component view definition. The successful (True) evaluation of this filter renders the text based on the format specified by the G3E_LABELINDEX property. The Null filter (catch- all case) should contain an empty string or a Null value. Any field names referenced in the filter must be in uppercase. String literals used in comparisons must be quoted. Oracle built-in functions are not supported.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTERORDINAL  |  Ordinal value indicating the order that the filters should be evaluated. The filter that is most common in terms of the most associated data should be assigned a value of 1.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LFNO  |  Identifier associated with this particular label format from the G3E_LABEL table. The associated format is used based on a True evaluation of the filter.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

Preconfigured legends available to the NetWorks Core client. Each entry in this table corresponds to a table representing the individual legend instances. The metadata system provides storage for this information, and Metadata Explorer provides the GUI.

This name is populated by the MG3ELegendUtils.CreateTables(DefTableName, DCTableName, SetTableName, DefTableAbbr, SetTableAbbr) procedure. This number should correspond to the alternate set of components defined in [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  0  |

### G3E_LEGENDENTRY (Legend Entries Table)
Table name: G3E_LEGENDENTRY 
Defines all available legend entries. That is, each row in this table is the association of a component view to a style rule, a unique name, and, optionally, a label rule. 
A particular component view can appear multiple times to accommodate different display scale ranges. The geometry field name is retrieved from the [G3E_COMPONENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw) definition. 
If the G3E_LEGENDENTRY table is populated when an upgrade script is run, the G3E_SETTINGSTABLE is automatically populated. The G3E_SETTINGSTABLE is the primary table that drives the layering for output to PDF.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LENO  |  Identifier for the legend entry.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LEGENDENTRY  |  Name of the layer used for setting the default layer names for the first legend settings of a legend.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name presented in the Display Control for this legend entry.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_VNO  |  Component view definition.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_SRNO  |  Identifier of a rule within the [G3E_STYLERULE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA) table. There is only one style rule per legend entry. This value can be Null when the component view is against a gdbCoverage component. Style groups used to render dimensions are configured in G3E_DIMSTYLEGROUP. The value of G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_SRNO for a dimension element is the style group number ([G3E_DIMSTYLEGROUP.G3E_DSGNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ul1ZNWnC4F6edCUnp9eURQ)).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes, Logical  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LRNO  |  Identifier of a rule within the [G3E_LABELRULE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XhCqhW831qxPA3~bdSlxhw) table. There is only one label rule per legend entry.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes Logical  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LAYERNAME  |  Name of the layer that is used for setting default layer names in [G3E_SETTINGSTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5UJi_D2EF3RLbqldV6jGhQ).G3E_LAYERNAME when a new legend is created.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256637?tocId=kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw) If the G3E_SETTINGSTABLE.G3E_LAYERNAME is Null, this value is not used to create the PDF layer names.   |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ROLE  |  Name of the database role the user must have to enable the object control. If the user has the role, the specific legend entry is displayed on the legend Display Control.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  EVERYONE  |  
|  G3E_TRANSLUCENCY  |  If specified, the translucency applied to all styles displayed by the specified legend entry, except any area background fills. This value does not apply to any hatching or to area backgrounds. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null means that there are no overrides at the legend entry level, that is, the styles are drawn with the translucencies defined in their individual style metadata entries. A value of 0 means that the pertinent styles of the legend entry are opaque. Nothing behind the style is visible. A value of 100 means that the pertinent styles are invisible. Everything behind the pertinent style is visible.  If specified, this value overrides any non-area background fill translucencies defined in the styles themselves. For example if a line whose style is defined to have 30% translucency is being drawn by a legend, that line is drawn by the non-Null translucency specified by this entry. The 30% value is ignored.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_FILLTRANSLUCENCY  |  If specified, the translucency applied to any area background fills for the specified legend entry. This value applies to any hatching of the areas and to their backgrounds. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null means that there are no overrides for area background fills at the legend entry level. The styles are drawn with the translucencies defined in their individual style metadata entries. A value of 0 means that any area fill is opaque. Nothing is visible behind it. A value of 100 means that any area fill is invisible. Everything is visible behind any area fill.  If specified, this value overrides any area background fill translucencies defined in the styles themselves. For example if an area whose background fill style is defined to have 30% translucency is being drawn by a legend, that fill is drawn by the non-NULL translucency specified by this entry. The 30% is ignored.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_LEGENDFILTER (Legend Filter Table)
Table name:  G3E_LEGENDFILTER 
Defines the available legend filters for use with each Display Control presentation.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LFROWNO  |  Unique row in the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LNO  |  The legend number to which this filter is applicable. This number is a key into the [G3E_LEGEND](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/dkXBUKhJYRP6rlMPMUk7Kg) table. From this table, the appropriate [G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/U27QBJy1LkijFwfEFQHj0Q) table is determined. Values from G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE.G3E_DCROWNO are used to populate the next field.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DCROWNO  |  The value of G3E_DISPLAYCONTROL(N).G3E_DCROWNO to which this filter is applicable. This field is not a true foreign key. However, a constraint or validation exists such that for the G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE table associated with the legend (in G3E_LNO), this value must exist in the table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  The text value displayed in the predefined filters interface. While the field is not unique within the table, it should be unique within a legend for this G3E_DCROWNO and any higher G3E_DCROWNO up to each root entry in the tree (where G3E_ORDINAL < current DCROWNO's ordinal and G3E_LEVEL < current DCROWNO's level). This restriction controls Display Control presentation to the user.   |  No*  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTER  |  An [SQL WHERE clause](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) expression as would be defined in G3E_LEGDEF(N).G3E_FILTER that indicates what data should be excluded from the legend entry(ies) when this filter is applied. When the G3E_DCROWNO is a grouping item (not a leaf), the filter is applied to all subordinate legend entries. Hence, the filter must be a valid filter for all of those legend entries.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
* While the field is not unique within the table, it should be unique within a legend for this G3E_DCROWNO and any G3E_DCROWNO higher than it up to each root entry in the tree (where G3E_ORDINAL < current DCROWNO's ordinal and G3E_LEVEL < current DCROWNO's level). This restriction is for presentation purposes (clarity to the user).

There can be two default legend settings rows - one for geographic viewing and one for detail viewing.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |

### G3E_LIFECYCLE (Life Cycle Management Table)
Table name: G3E_LIFECYCLE 
Contains information necessary for the seamless operation of the system as related to life cycle or state management.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LCNO  |  Row for this format.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Name of the state.  |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  Value associated with the state name to be stored in the state attribute.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_DELETE  |  Indicates whether the feature should be deleted when transitioned to this state. 0 = The feature should not be deleted when transitioned to this state. 1 = The feature should be deleted when transitioned to this state. This action occurs during posting of the job.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_ALLOWBATCH  |  Indicates whether processing is allowed to transition the state from the currently assigned state. The flag can be used to prevent state transitioning from certain states during batch processing. For example,  Example An event occurs indicating that batch processing should occur and should transition all features for a job to the next default state, for example In Service. If the current state of a feature indicates that batch processing should not be allowed to change the state for the feature (G3E_LIFECYCLE.G3E_ALLOWBATCH = 0), the state transitioning for that feature is skipped.  0 = Any feature with this state is not affected by the batch processing. 1 = Any feature with this state is affected by the batch processing. This is necessary only if there are transitions out of this state. For example, you might have transitions from In Service to Proposed Removed or Proposed Abandoned.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_RELATEDLCNO  |  The number of the life cycle state in a related feature that corresponds to this state. This might be used in models that have two sets of life cycle paths. One set is for your network facilities and the other set is for reporting facilities. Assuming there is a relationship between your network facilities and the reporting facilities, this value indicates the matching state for the reporting facilities.  Example A gas pipeline has states Proposed, In Service, and Removed. The pipeline's casing is related to the pipeline and it has only two states, Active and Inactive. When the pipeline transitions to a Removed state, the casing should become Inactive. Assuming the current G3E_LCNO corresponds to Removed, the value of G3E_RELATEDLCNO should be Inactive. The command software can automatically transition or set the state of the related feature when the pipeline is removed.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_LINESTYLE (Line Style Table)
Table name: G3E_LINESTYLE 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256776?tocId=b3vQwQ~YtLlgn5feW4cuvA)
  * G3E_WIDTH is overridden by G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT. However, plot window redline style overrides and style overrides on traces and queries are given priority over G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT during export to MicroStation V7 and V8 formats. 
  * G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT value is applied when export is performed from the SaveAsDGN API method. 
  * G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT is not considered for HxGN NetWorks Core Export workflows. 


The table corresponds to the information in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA) and describes how a line style is defined. See [G3E_COMPOSITELINESTYLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/8h2YXC5Z7UbxyJRKgC9_7A) for definitions of multiline styles. 
Because these fields represent the localized metadata, none of them are localized.
An entry must exist in G3E_METADATASUPPORT for this table. The table is not published.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SNO  |  Identifier for the style. This value is copied to the G3E_STYLE table. You cannot edit this value.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name found in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_COLOR  |  RGB value for the color of the style. -3 = Style color is the same as the map view background color  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_WIDTH  |  Width of the line style in points.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_OFFSET  |  Value in points to offset from the line geometry at which to draw the style. A positive value means the offset is to the left (relative direction of digitization). A negative value means the offset is to the right.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_STARTSYMBOL  |  Identifier for the point style to use as the line start symbol for the line geometry.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ENDSYMBOL  |  Identifier for the point style to use as the line terminator symbol for the line geometry.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_STROKEPATTERN  |  Identifier for the stroke pattern used in the line style. A Null value in this field produces a solid line.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_PLOTREDLINE  |  Boolean indicator of whether this style should appear in the plotting style control list. The value is found in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_PLOTREDLINE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA).  0 = The style is not available in plotting redlines. 1 = The style is available in plotting redlines.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_STYLEUNITS  |  Determines how the various "size" properties of styles (size, offset, width, and so forth) are interpreted.  1 = The style is scale dependent. The appearance of the components that use the style to draw vary based on the current zoom scale.  3 = The style is scale independent. The appearance of the components that use the style to draw are always the same regardless of the zoom scale.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_TRANSLUCENCY  |  The translucency applied to the line style. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null is interpreted as 0. A value of 0 means that the line is opaque, that is, nothing is visible behind the line. A value of 100 means that the line is invisible, that is everything is visible behind the line.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT  |  Line weight override value to be used during export to MicroStation V7 and V8.  |  No  |  es  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_LMUFEATURE (Loop Makeup Features Table)

#### G3E_LMUFEATURE.G3E_TYPE Values
G3E_LMUFEATURE.G3E_TYPE Values  
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Cable  |  One or more features must be defined as Cable. They should have a G3E_CONTYPE of 0. The view specified for G3E_VIEW for this feature type must expose the fields COMPOSITION, ALPHA_CODE, FIBER_MODE, TOTAL_LENGTH, GAUGE, PERCENT_AERIAL, and PERCENT_BURIED. The COMPOSITION field should expose the values "COPPER", "FIBER", or "COMPOSITE".   |  
|  Capacitor  |  One feature must be defined as Capacitor. It should have a G3E_CONTYPE of 2. The view specified for G3E_VIEW for this feature type must expose the field LENGTH.   |  
|  Connector  |  One feature must be defined as Connector. It should have a G3E_CONTYPE of 1. The view specified for G3E_VIEW for this feature type must expose the field LOSS.   |  
|  Interface  |  One feature must be defined as Interface. It should have a G3E_CONTYPE of 1.  |  
|  LoadCoil  |  One feature must be defined as LoadCoil. It should have a G3E_CONTYPE of 2.  |  
|  Resistor  |  One feature must be defined as Resistor. It should have a G3E_CONTYPE of 2. The view specified for G3E_VIEW for this feature type must expose the field RESISTANCE.   |  
|  Terminal  |  One feature must be defined as Terminal. It should have a G3E_CONTYPE of 2.  |  
|  Other  |  Other types can be defined for the command which can be processed using the IGTLoopMakeup custom extender interface.   |

### G3E_MANYOWNERSHIP (Many-to-Many Ownership Relationship Table) (Sample)
Table name: G3E_MANYOWNERSHIP 
An ownership relationship can be described as "has-a" or parentage. For example, a pole owns a transformer in the sense that the transformer resides on the pole. If something happens to the pole, the transformer must be accounted for. This relationship extends this concept to support a child having many parents. 
An edit operation against either a parent or child in this relationship typically has no effect on the other member. A graphic edit of a parent may affect the child but typically not vice versa. 
A delete operation against the parent has a ripple effect to the child or children. The child must also be deleted or reowned to another parent. A delete operation against a child has no effect on the parent. 
This relationship requires a common component that exists in all the child and parent features. The component must include the G3E key fields plus G3E_OWNERFNO (same data type as G3E_FNO) and G3E_OWNERFID (same data type as G3E_FID).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MONO  |  Unique row identifier  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_SOURCEFNO  |  Feature being placed or the active feature in an edit operation  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_OWNERFNO  |  Number of the feature that owns or is associated with the source feature  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TRIGGERINGCNO  |  The number of the component in the source feature that initiates the relationship software   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_OWNERTRIGGERINGCNO  |  The number of the component in the owner feature that initiates the relationship software  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ENFORCEMENT  |  Indicates if ownership is required or optional. The system enforces ownership based on this flag when posting occurs.  0 = Allow child to pass validation without a parent. However, a warning message will be produced.  1 = Enforce parentage by posting an error if a child does not have a parent. 5 = Connectivity is optional. A warning message does not appear if features are improperly connected.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DELETE  |  Indicates if the child (owned) feature should be deleted, reowned, or orphaned on the deletion of its parent  The parent feature should not be deleted as long as any child exists with this column set to Do Not Delete.  In many-to- many ownership, delete logic is applied recursively. 1 = Delete child when deleting the parent. When the parent is deleted, all children with value 1 are deleted along with the  2 = Reown the child feature to other parent feature if the current parent is deleted. The parent feature is deleted, and the child tries to locate some other parent feature. If the child feature finds another parent feature, a new relationship is established between the child and the found parent.  3 = Orphan the child feature if the current parent is deleted. The parent feature is deleted and the child does not try to establish a relationship with some other parent.  4 = Refuse to delete the parent if this child exists. On attempting to delete the parent feature, do not delete the parent feature as long as any child having this value (4) exists.   
 |  Example Feature A owns B and B owns C. Feature C has G3E_DELETE value 4; feature B has value 1.  Check value of feature B before deleting feature A. Delete feature B along with A (value 1). Because the logic applied is recursive, if you delete feature B, the following scenario occurs:  It owns feature C that has value 4.  
You cannot delete feature B because child C exists.  
You also cannot delete feature A.   |  
| --- |  
|  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_BREAKLINEAR  |  Controls whether the source feature breaks linear features during the establishing of ownership  0 = Does not break linear features during ownership. 1 = Breaks linear features during ownership. This is rarely used, but is necessary in span accounting where cables/conductors are broken at pole locations. Each cable/conductor has two owners.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  [G3E_BREAKBEHAVIOR](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/_v7EYKyzayxGdSnqT1lWvw)  |  Indicates what processing should be done with the related child features when a parent feature is broken. Also specifies the required behavior for related parent features when a child feature is broken.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_MAXOFFSET  |  Used in relationship validation, the maximum allowable offset that is valid for this pair of features in this relationship. This value is also used in the creation of a tolerance square to be used in placement. This tolerance square is the area around a relationship point that the user can interactively place a feature and still maintain a relationship with related features.  A maximum offset may not be needed for a given feature relationship. For instance, the user may want the ability to move a related feature with no restraints as to relationship validity. In this case, the value of G3E_MAXOFFSET would be set to -1.00.  The G3E_MAXOFFSET can be a whole or fractional number of database units, for example, feet, meters, and so forth, that matches the projected coordinate system of your data.  When G3E_MAXOFFSET is set, it should be the same or greater than AverageSymbolSize in the [G3E_GENERALPARAMETER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/OQ5eJGmN8hHE5WKzX6N1fQ) table.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |  - 1.00  |  
|  G3E_OFFSETVALIDATIONPRIORITY  |  The severity of the error to report if the related pair of features is not within the specified G3E_MAXOFFSET. Valid values are P1- P5. If this value is NULL, the value for the General Parameter OffsetValidationPriority is used.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (4)  |   |  
|  G3E_BREAKTOLERANCE  |  The maximum allowable distance between the active feature and the related feature before initiating a break operation. This value is used to create a tolerance square for placement. This tolerance square is the area around a relationship point in which a user can interactively place a feature and initiate a break operation.  The G3E_BREAKTOLERANCE can be a whole or fractional number of database units, for example, feet, meters, and so forth, that matches the projected coordinate system of your data.  G3E_BREAKTOLERANCE must be less than or equal to G3E_MAXOFFSET * SQRT 2.  If G3E_MAXOFFSET is -1, then G3E_BREAKTOLERANCE defaults to zero. For the metadata upgrade, the value is copied from G3E_MAXOFFSET unless G3E_MAXOFFSET is -1, in which case the value is zero.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |  0  |  
|  G3E_PARENTMERGEALLOW  |  Specifies when to allow merge of parent features with respect to their child features 1 = Always allow. There is no restriction on related child features with respect to allowing the merge.  2 = Allow if same direct child features. The parent features being merged must own the same set of child features. Merge is also allowed when none of the parent features owns any children. For example, use this option when merge of trenches should be allowed only if both trenches contain the same cables.  3 = Allow if matching subtrees with child features. The parent features being merged must own matching subtrees of child features. This option should be used for primary parent features in the [communications data models](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TPZC3LMqS7HcyxkFNRJbmw).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_CHILDMERGEALLOW  |  Specifies when to allow merge of child features with respect to their parent features 1 = Always allow. There is no restriction on related parent features with respect to allowing the merge.  2 = Allow if same set of parent features. The child features being merged must be owned by the same set of parent features. Merge is also allowed when both child features do not have any parent feature.  3 = Allow if same type of parent feature. The child features being merged must be owned by the same parent feature.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_MERGEBEHAVIOR  |  Specifies the processing type after feature merge. Relationships to parent features are always preserved. These options specify various ways to process child features.  1 = Inherit all relationships. All relationships of the second feature are transferred to the first feature.  2 = Keep relationships from the first feature; drop the child relationships of the second feature.  3 = Keep relationships from the first feature; delete related child features of the second feature. The depth of deleting the hierarchy of children is controlled by G3E_DELETE. Use this option for primary parent features in the [communications data models](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TPZC3LMqS7HcyxkFNRJbmw).  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/257742?tocId=cLQKIifBDRbAd4EkpI9HgQ) This metadata controls how the relationships are initially inherited. However, each relationship (both from the first and second feature) may be dropped later in the processing because of attribute validation, distance validation criteria, or RGI's not allowing to keep the relationship.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_IGNOREOFFSETONMERGE  |  Specifies whether or not to check the spatial proximity between the merged feature and the related child features.  0 = Honor the spatial proximity. If the spatial proximity criteria are not satisfied, drop the relationship.  1 = Ignore the spatial proximity. Even if the spatial proximity criteria are not satisfied, do not drop the relationship.  A value of Yes in this column is normally paired with G3E_MAXOFFSET = -1 (spatial proximity criteria are not checked during validation) or with G3E_OFFSETVALIDATIONPRIORITY set to the priority that passes validation. Distance criteria are checked during validation, but the severity of that error is so low that the features may be posted.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

![Warning](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1212785?tocId=WexD0xxj8zJs0P0xzbj5GQ) IMPORTANT: Attributes with G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_EXCLUDEFROMEDITS set to 1 cannot be included in the workflows configured for the Mark feature command.

### G3E_MARKFEATUREFEATURE (Mark Feature Workflow Features Definitions Table)
Table name: G3E_MARKFEATUREFEATURE 
Lists the features in which attributes of workflow can be edited by the Mark Features command.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MFFNO  |  Identifier for the feature.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_WNO  |  Identifier for the workflow.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Feature Number  |  No  |  No   |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1212786?tocId=a4iAl2nNzxllIFwAwUcslQ) Populate the table G3E_MARKFEATUREFEATURE using this sql statement: 
insert into g3e_markfeaturefeature (G3E_WNO, g3e_fno, G3E_MFfNO)
select G3E_WNO, g3e_fno, G3E_MARKFEATUREfeature_seq.nextval from (
--anything that needs to be configured for all workflows/attributes
select distinct w.G3E_WNO, f.g3e_fno from 
g3e_feature f, G3E_MARKFEATUREWORKFLOW w, G3E_MARKFEATUREattribute wa, g3e_attribute a, g3e_featurecomponent fc where
w.g3e_wno = wa.g3e_wno and a.g3e_ano = wa.g3e_ano and a.g3e_cno = fc.g3e_cno and f.g3e_fno = fc.g3e_fno
-- optionally AND w.g3e_wno=<the new workflow being added>
minus
--anything that is already configured
select g3e_wno, g3e_fno from g3e_markfeaturefeature);
If any features should not be edited in a specific workflow, delete the appropriate row in this table mapping feature to a workflow.

### G3E_MARKFEATUREWORKFLOW (Mark Feature Workflows Definitions Table)
Table name: G3E_MARKFEATUREWORKFLOW 
Lists the available Mark Features workflows.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_WNO  |  Identifier for the workflow.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name of the workflow as it appears in the command's combo box.  |  Yes  |  No   |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  Specifies the order in which the workflows are shown in the combo box.  |  No, but it’s handy  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  [G3E_OPERATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XubFYbwVj8uATXGQMsmeLA)  |  The operation the workflow will perform on save.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (14)  |  Update  |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. Used by the database administrator for informational purposes only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
Example 1:
A manager named Bill in an organization needs to approve changes in a project. He selects all features edited in the project and runs the Mark Features command. The command shows a list of workflows applicable to the selected features. The manager selects the "Construction approval" workflow from the combo box and types "approved by Bill" into the row listing the "Approval comments" attribute. When he clicks OK, all features will have this comment applied to them. 
Example 2:
Water features require a special workflow for approval as they are not the main focus of the company and changes in that area could result in additional cost. The manager Bill will use the same workflow as in the previous example but in metadata the administrator limited the features where he can add his approval even though he selected also water feature. Another workflow needs to be used for approval of water features. TODO: LINK See G3E_ MARKFEATUREFEATURE. 
Example 3:
An inspector Anne carries out an inspection to a network and selects the features she inspected. She runs the Mark Features command. She then selects the "Network inspection" workflow and in the attribute grid for this workflow selects the today’s date. When she clicks ok, all features will have had a new audit row added to the "inspections component" with the current inspection date. 
Example 4:
The network operator Phil selects all features in an electricity path which has just been repaired after failure. He runs the Mark Features command. He selects the "Repairs verified" workflow and in the attribute grid for this workflow selects the today’s date. He also selects the "Defect" in the picklist of the Filter column of the grid and specifies the new state "In operation" for the status attribute. When he clicks OK, all selected features will have their "status from" date updated to today and all features which had the status "Defect" will now have status "In operation". Features which had status "Reserved" will have the date updated but their status will remain unchanged. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1212784?tocId=9nhdrRTwpaHLWOwAUnsymQ) IMPORTANT: Attributes with G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_EXCLUDEFROMEDITS set to 1 cannot be included in the workflows configured for the Mark feature command.

Based on the type, NetWorks Core populates the correct field G3E_STRING, G3E_NUMBER, G3E_BINARY.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (50)  |   |

### G3E_MESSAGE (Message Table)
Table name: G3E_MESSAGE 
Contains information necessary to support XML message processing. It is referenced in the [G3E_WORKMGMT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KME_1L76HZEDZ5lzihAbeQ) table. The [Job Processing Service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j3dODE7yUK4XgK5dffnpqg) uses this metadata table to determine actions to take on an incoming message received by the [Message Monitor service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/lYWD_9NHU7BHb5NZXei9sg).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MSGNO  |  Row identifier for the table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_INCOMING  |  Name of incoming message to NetWorks Core  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_INQUEUENO  |  Incoming queue number  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  [G3E_ACTION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/UND0JgX~t6qNvqsBAJNseg)  |  Action to be performed on incoming message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  0 (No action)  |  
|  G3E_OUTGOING  |  Name of outgoing message from NetWorks Core  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_OUTQUEUENO  |  Outgoing queue number  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ERRORQUEUENO  |  Error queue number  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_JLCNO  |  JobLifeCycle number. Populated only when G3E_ACTION is 6 or 7.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TIMEOUT  |  Timeout period (in seconds) for NetWorks Core to listen for a response message on the G3E_INCOMING queue. This value is used for the messages defined by ExportMessageNO, BeforePostMessageNO, and AfterPostMessageNO in G3E_GENERICWMSIFACE. A value of 0 indicates that the software does not need to wait for a response. A null value, or -1, indicates that the software waits for a response without a timeout occurring.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256366?tocId=3rSs8kZREniCtp_VMhw~Aw) The software could be left in a wait state if no response is received when the timeout is null or -1.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number(5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256366?tocId=3rSs8kZREniCtp_VMhw~Aw)
  * The fields G3E_INCOMING and G3E_OUTGOING are foreign keys to G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT.G3E_NAME, meaning the value entered in these columns must be from the G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT.G3E_NAME field. These are not true foreign keys as G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT.G3E_NAME is not a primary key nor a unique field of table G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT. 
  * The fields G3E_INQUEUENO, G3E_OUTQUEUENO, and G3E_ERRORQUEUENO are foreign keys to G3E_QUEUE.G3E_QNO.

### G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT (Message Format Table)
Table name: G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT 
Contains information necessary to support XML message formats. The message format is a description of the name of the message and then the definition of each element or field in the message. Each element is mapped to either an attribute in the NetWorks Core model or a literal value. This table is referenced in the [G3E_WORKMGMT table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KME_1L76HZEDZ5lzihAbeQ). The [Job Processing Service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j3dODE7yUK4XgK5dffnpqg) uses this metadata table to read and write message formats. See the [Message Format tool topics](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/BpkKOMrwXQSfSpGNibZFgw) for more information.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MFNO  |  Row identifier for the table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_NAME  |  Name of this message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  Element type referenced by the interface software. Some of the elements are significant to the processing of the message. These are identified by specific types. They are transferred to the specified G3E_ANO. This is a foreign key to [G3E_MESSAGEFORMATTYPE.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SUJ9BmTvA0cfmvtjNUFwaw). All other elements are untypes (Null).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEMENTTAGNAME  |  Tag name for an element of a message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_PARENTTAGNAME  |  Tag name of the parent element of a message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEATTRNAME  |  Attribute name of an element of a message  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEATTRVALUE  |  Attribute value of an element of a message  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  Literal value for this element. This value is only used in outgoing messages.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ANO  |  NetWorks Core attribute that stores this tag's value   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9, 0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  The order number element tag within this message. Must be equal to or greater than zero. Must be unique for a specific G3E_NAME when it is not zero. Should be zero if the element tag order is not considered.   |  Yes*  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
* Unique for a specific G3E_NAME. Checked on validation.
Example 1 input message:
<?xml version="3.0" ?>
<MSG_EXT_SETUPPOLYGON>
<POLY:CMP_POLYGON_XY xmlns:POLY="POLYGON">
<POLY:X>only text</POLY:X>
<POLY:Y>only text</POLY:Y>
</POLY:CMP_POLYGON_XY>
</MSG_EXT_SETUPPOLYGON>

### G3E_MESSAGEFORMATTYPE (Message Format Types Table)
Table name: G3E_MESSAGEFORMATTYPE

It need not be published but is used to describe the type of value that the Message Monitor retrieves as part of its parameters.

Contains information necessary for the publishing of metadata. The records in this table include normalized and optimized metadata tables, keys for the additional XML metadata, picklist tables that need to be published, and entries required for publishing components in RAW format. This table is repopulated when the procedure MG3EPopulateMetadataKeys is called.

It can also be the name of the keys for the additional XML metadata. The entry for the components is named like CNO with the G3E_CNO value as the suffix. Entries must be uppercase.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |
