|  G3E_DIMTEXTANGLE1  |  [Dimension text angle](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/JnYrPDRIVEVI8rt_~g_SRg) relative to dimension line.  1 = Parallel 2 = Perpendicular  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_DIMTEXTLRNO2  |  G3E_LRNO of the label rule used to generate the second dimension text.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |

For stacked dimensions, the dimension text is placed between the endpoint of the associated dimension line and the endpoint of the longest shorter dimension line. The endpoint of the longest shorter dimension line is 0%, and the endpoint of the associated dimension line is 100%.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  50  |

#### G3E_DIMRELATIONSHIP (Dimensioning Relationship Table)
Table name: G3E_DIMRELATIONSHIP 
Describes the dimensioning relationship between individual feature components. For each possible pair of related components (1 - Dimensioning component, 2 - Related feature component), there must be a record in this table. The record also indicates the type of the relationship: dimension base or dimensioned feature.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DRNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DIMFNO  |  FNO of the feature that contains a dimensioning component.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DIMCNO  |  CNO of the dimensioning component.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONNECTEDFNO  |  FNO of the feature related to the dimension.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONNECTEDCNO  |  CNO of the triggering component of the related feature.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DIMRELTYPE  |  Type of the dimensioning relationship:  
 |  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  1  |  Dimension-base subrelationship; feature related to the dimension is a base feature.  |  
|  2  |  Dimensioned-feature subrelationship; feature related to the dimension is a dimensioned feature.   |  
|  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DRIVINGDRIVENDEFAULT  |  Default value of the field identified by G3E_DRIVINGDRIVENANO (driven or not-driven). These are the valid values if G3E_DIMREELTYPE=2: 0 = Not driven. The dimension is not driven by the dimensioned feature. 1 = Driven. The dimension is driven by the dimensioned feature. If G3E_DIMRELTYPE=1, the value in this field must be Null.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_DIMSTYLEGROUP (Dimension Style Groups Table)
Table name: G3E_DIMSTYLEGROUP 
Contains assignments of style rules to individual segments of dimension graphics such as dimension line and dimension text. Since each dimension graphic consists of multiple segments while it is displayed in a map view through a single legend entry, this table enables the definition of a group of style rules that are used to render dimensions. The group is identified by the same value in G3E_DSGNO. G3E_DSGNO is referenced by [G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_SRNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw). 
Omitting an entry for any dimension segment does not result in an error. The segment is simply not rendered. For example, if you do not want baselines to be shown, the entry for baseline should not exist. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256639?tocId=zkWiH5C30Ie_fAmfV0SjEg) If [small dimensions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/IrX~FbRNYEMNuVXwnCfn4Q) are not supported in the data model, you can define dimension line styles (G3E_DIMSEGMENT is 1 or 2) with point styles for arrowheads at start and endpoints. Then, it is not necessary to populate the metadata for the endpoint styles (G3E_DIMSEGMENT is 9,10,11, or 12). 
If small dimensions are supported in the data model, you must define these endpoint styles for the arrowheads to be correctly rotated and offset for small dimensions.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DSGROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DSGNO  |  Identifier for the style group. This number is repeated in the table for each member of the same style group.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DIMSEGMENT  |  Identification of the dimension segment to which the style rule is applied. 1 = Dimension line 2 = Second dimension line 3 = Witness line 4 = Second witness line 5 = Baseline 6 = Dimension text (the length) 7 = Second dimension text 8 = Dimension angle text (for polar dimensions) 9 = Endpoint at the start of dimension line 10 = Endpoint at the end of dimension line 11 = Endpoint at the start of the second dimension line 12 = Endpoint at the end of the second dimension line  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_SRNO  |  Identifier of the style rule to be used to render the dimension segments identified by G3E_DIMSEGMENT.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  The order of rendering. The segment with the highest ordinal is rendered first.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

##### G3E_ALLOCATIONRULE (Allocation Business Rules Table)
Table name:  G3E_ALLOCATIONRULE 
Contains a list of the allocation business rules. An allocation business rule consists of a database package that implements the allocation business rule functions and an associated argument data list. This means that you can create multiple allocation business rules by associating a single package with multiple argument lists. Each allocation business rule must have a unique G3E_USERNAME.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |

|  G3E_USERNAME  |  The name of the business rule displayed by the user interface.  |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ARPNO  |  G3E_ARPNO of the Allocation Business Rule package that implements the algorithm for this allocation business rule. This field corresponds to the G3E_ARPNO in the G3E_ARPACKAGE table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ARAGROUPNO  |  Argument data for this business rule. This field corresponds to the G3E_ARAGROUPNO column in the G3E_ALLOCATIONRULEARGVAL table.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

This field corresponds to the G3E_RNO field in the [G3E_RELATIONSHIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA) table. Metadata validation ensures that the G3E_FNO specified is a valid source feature for the G3E_RNO specified.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

##### G3E_ALLOCRULEARGVAL (Allocation Rule Argument Values Table)
Table name: G3E_ALLOCRULEARGVAL 
Used to specify the argument values to be passed to the database package that implements an allocation business rule. When a particular allocation rule ([G3E_ALLOCATIONRULE.G3E_ARNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/02GSTlMYF2i3uBj4cHuHzA)) is being used, the package is determined by looking at the G3E_ARPNO column in the [optimized table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/A3WJC1NdvKXTTFhE3LeoIQ). G3E_ARPNO is used to query this table, G3E_ALLOCRULEARGVAL, to get the values of the parameters to use for that package. Each parameter value is set on the package by using the argument name (present in the optimized version of this table) and the argument value (G3E_ALLOCRULEARGVAL.G3E_VALUE).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_ARAGROUPNO  |  The argument group to which this value belongs. All arguments that are to be sent to the same allocation rule should have the same G3E_ARAGROUPNO value.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ARANO  |  The allocation rule argument for this data. This is the number of the argument, as found in the [G3E_ALLOCATIONRULEARG](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/fc~a6q2jCdfi5eXKJorySQ) table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  The value of this argument.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

##### G3E_ARPACKAGE (Allocation Business Rules Packages Table)
Table name: G3E_ARPACKAGE 
Contains a list of the allocation business rule packages. An allocation business rule definition consists of a database package that implements allocation business rule functions and an associated argument description list. This means that you can create multiple allocation business rules by associating a single package with multiple argument data lists, uniquely naming each combination. Each package appears once in this table, but could appear more than once in [G3E_ALLOCATIONRULE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/02GSTlMYF2i3uBj4cHuHzA), each time with a different set of argument values.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_ARPNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_PACKAGE  |  Name of the database package containing the implementation of a specific business rule.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_DUCT (Duct Parameters Table)
Table name: G3E_DUCT 
Contains information necessary for [defining duct parameters](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA) such as which attributes specify the duct's row and column position within the formation. You typically have either one row or two rows in this table; one row if you only use ducts in your model, and two rows if you use both ducts and inner ducts. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/257714?tocId=jGOsm5v3R8FGjw_xIg8h3g) The attributes referenced by G3E_FROMROWPOSANO, G3E_FROMCOLPOSANO, G3E_TOROWPOSANO, and G3E_TOCOLPOSANO must all be contained in the same component.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Duct or innerduct's FNO.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ASSIGNMENTANO  |  Assignment field, which is a user-specified identifier for the duct. Often it is a number, but not always. NetWorks Core provide tools to automatically number ducts in a formation, but you can also use your own scheme. Most data models require the assignment to be unique, so NetWorks Core displays ducts that have a duplicate assignment with a red background in the Duct Configuration control. However, uniqueness is not enforced. This value can be stored in a different component than the to/from indicators.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FROMROWPOSANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the row positional information for the From end of the duct. It is assumed that G3E_FROMROWPOSANO, G3E_FROMCOLPOSANO, G3E_TOROWPOSANO and G3E_TOCOLPOSANO are contained in the same component. The user should never directly edit these attributes.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FROMCOLPOSANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the column positional information for the From end of the duct.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TOROWPOSANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the row positional information for the To end of the duct.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TOCOLPOSANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the column positional information for the To end of the duct.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FROMGEOMSTALEANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the [stale graphics](javascript:;) information for the From end of the duct.  The field name associated with the ANO should match the field name defined by G3E_FORMATION.G3E_FROMGEOMSTALEANO.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TOGEOMSTALEANO  |  ANO of the attribute that contains the stale graphics information for the To end of the duct.  The field name associated with the ANO should match the field name defined by G3E_FORMATION.G3E_TOGEOMSTALEANO.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_DUCTCONFIGGRAPHIC (Duct Configuration Graphic Table)
Table name: G3E_DUCTCONFIGGRAPHIC 
Specifies the graphic components to create when [creating a new formation or duct feature](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA). When placing a formation or duct, you probably have to place more than one graphic component. 
This table should have one or more entries for the formation, duct, and (if required) innerduct features. For each of these feature classes, there should be a row in this table for each component that is to be created by the [Place Formation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/76EATu7MgiaMcS7PvLjl_Q) command.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DCGROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  FNO of feature being placed. Can be either a duct, inner duct, or a formation.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CNO  |  CNO of component to place.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FROM  |  Specifies whether this component is a From or To component. 0 = This is a To component. 1 = This is a From component.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORIGINGRAPHIC  |  Specifies whether this component is the origin graphic component for the duct or formation. If G3E_ORIGINGRAPHIC is Yes (1), this component's origin is the origin of this end of the duct or formation. The location of all other components of this end of the duct or formation are derived from this point.  0 = This component's origin is not the origin of this end of the duct or formation. 1 = This component's origin is the origin of this end of the duct or formation.  
 |  Example Setting this field to Yes (1) for the formation From Geo Line component indicates that the position of the graphics for the duct feature's From Geo component within a formation is calculated based on the initial point of the formation From Geo Line. Similarly, setting this field to Yes for the Duct To Detail symbol component indicates that the position of the graphics for the innerduct feature's To Detail components are calculated based on the origin of the Duct To detail symbol.   |  
| --- |  
For a given feature, G3E_ORIGINGRAPHIC should be Yes for one component of each of the following sets of components: From/Detail, From/Geo, To/Detail, To/Geo. 
|  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_GGINO  |  Reference to [G3E_GEOMGENINTERFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/B0KQ9olEVKTY~SpGdpJtdA) defining the method to use to generate the geometry data.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_GGARGGROUPNO  |  Reference to the [G3E_GGDATA](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/s_2yRcE3PZqMF6G74GVkxA) table for the specific arguments to use for this FNO/CNO and GGINO combination.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_DUCTFORMATION (Duct Formation Table)
Table name:  G3E_DUCTFORMATION 
Contains information necessary for [predefining duct configurations](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA). A duct configuration is essentially the number of rows and columns of ducts. This table specifies which configurations are valid for formations (specified in [G3E_DUCTIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WU8MlP9KTpz4DA2jW5KJ1w) by the entry Formation Feature) and what type of duct to create (specified by the FNO of the duct). 
The G3E_DFNO field specifies the FNO of either the duct or inner duct feature. All of the rows specifying the duct FNO are presented in the Duct Configuration control when editing a formation as possible predefined configurations of ducts that the user can add to the formation. The rows specifying the inner duct FNO are presented when editing a duct as possible predefined configurations of inner ducts.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DFROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DFNO  |  FNO of duct or inner duct to create when creating this duct formation.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Username/Description to show on the user interface.  |  No  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_NUMROWS  |  The number of rows in this duct formation.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_NUMCOLS  |  The number of columns in this duct formation.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |

#### G3E_DUCTIFACE (Duct Interface Table)

##### G3E_DUCTIFACE.G3E_TYPE Values
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  DuctConfigGraphic  |  The [G3E_DUCTCONFIGGRAPHIC](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0_fusOYXeV2LW7qKBQMbDg) table, which defines the graphic components to create when a formation is placed. These configurations are presented as choices to the user in the Duct Configuration control, and the user can define custom configurations.   |  
|  DuctParameters  |  The [G3E_DUCT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bdWhvnmf~2S3I4TRh9CzHw) table that describes the attributes within the duct or innerduct features that contain the From/To position values within the formation.   |  
|  Duct Feature  |  [G3E_PARAMETER1](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bdWhvnmf~2S3I4TRh9CzHw) identifies the duct feature number. There can be only one duct feature class.   |  
|  DuctFormation  |  The [G3E_DUCTFORMATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/tKLWvtuvQ6XDR4N0HD89gQ) table, which describes some predefined duct formation configurations. A predefined duct formation is a pair of numbers: number of rows, number of columns that gives you a way to set up some often-used configurations. For instance, you may know that users often create formations with 3 rows and 4 columns, so you can predefine that configuration as a choice for the user in the Duct Configuration control. Configurations are presented as choices to the user in the Duct Configuration control, and the user can create other configurations.   |  
|  Innerduct Feature  |  [G3E_PARAMETER1](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/tKLWvtuvQ6XDR4N0HD89gQ) identifies the innerduct feature number. There can be only one innerduct feature class. If your data model does not require innerducts, you can omit this entry.   |  
|  Formation Feature  |  The formation feature. There can be only one formation feature class.  |  
|  FormationParameters  |  The [G3E_FORMATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/zStlwzYYFFlYHe5QtjPZ9Q) table, which describes the attributes within the formation feature that contain the [stale graphics flag.](javascript:;)  |  
|  GeometryGenerationInterface  |  The [G3E_GEOMGENINTERFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/B0KQ9olEVKTY~SpGdpJtdA) table, which describes the available GeometryGeneration software components. These components define the methods available for placing the graphics in a duct formation.   |  
|  GeometryGenerationData  |  The [G3E_GGDATA](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/s_2yRcE3PZqMF6G74GVkxA) table, which describes the parameters used to generate the geometry for formation and duct graphics.   |  
|  GeometryGenerationArgument  |  The [G3E_GEOMGENARGUMENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/uI5AmeasvMWdCHqhzstKoQ) table, which describes the arguments to the geometry generation components.   |  
|  G3E_VSPACING  |  Specifies how far apart, vertically, to generate duct geometries in a geo view. See the diagram in G3E_GGDATA that illustrates the effect of this and the following parameters. Generally, you define this parameter to be equal to the height of the duct symbols so that the duct symbols are vertically adjacent.   |  
|  G3E_HSPACING  |  Specifies how far apart, horizontally, to generate duct geometries in a geo view. Generally, you define this parameter to be equal to the width of the duct symbols so that the duct symbols are horizontally adjacent.   |  
|  G3E_HOFFSET  |  Specifies how far, horizontally, from the start point of the formation line to generate the first duct geometry in a geo view. This value determines how much, if any, of the formation line extends horizontally to the left of the first duct and to the right of the last duct.   |  
|  G3E_VOFFSET  |  Specifies how far, vertically, from the start point of the formation line to generate the first duct geometry in a geo view.   |  
|  G3E_DHSPACING  |  Specifies how far apart, horizontally, to generate duct geometries in the detail view.  |  
|  G3E_DVSPACING  |  Specifies how far apart, vertically, to generate duct geometries in the detail view.  |  
|  G3E_DHOFFSET  |  Specifies how far, horizontally, from the start point of the formation line to generate the first duct geometry in the detail view.   |  
|  G3E_DVOFFSET  |  Specifies how far, vertically, from the start point of the formation line to generate the first duct geometry in the detail view.   |  
|  G3E_IDUCT_VSPACING  |  Specifies how far apart, vertically, to generate inner duct geometries in a geo view. This parameter is logically equivalent to the G3E_VSPACING parameter. See the diagram in G3E_GGDATA that illustrates the effect of this and the following parameters.   |  
|  G3E_IDUCT_HSPACING  |  Specifies how far apart, horizontally, to generate inner duct geometries in a geo view. This parameter is logically equivalent to the G3E_HSPACING parameter.   |  
|  G3E_IDUCT_HOFFSET  |  Specifies how far, horizontally, from the start point of the formation line to generate the first inner duct geometry in a geo view. This value determines how much, if any, of the formation line extends horizontally to the left of the first inner duct. This parameter is logically equivalent to the G3E_HOFFSET parameter.   |  
|  G3E_IDUCT_VOFFSET  |  Specifies how far, vertically, from the start point of the formation line to generate the first inner duct geometry in a geo view. This parameter is logically equivalent to the G3E_VOFFSET parameter.   |  
|  G3E_IDUCT_DHSPACING  |  Specifies how far apart, horizontally, to generate inner duct geometries in the detail view. This parameter is logically equivalent to the G3E_DHSPACING parameter.   |  
|  G3E_IDUCT_DVSPACING  |  Specifies how far apart, vertically, to generate inner duct geometries in the detail view.This parameter is logically equivalent to the G3E_DVSPACING parameter.   |  
|  G3E_IDUCT_DHOFFSET  |  Specifies how far, horizontally, from the start point of the formation line to generate the first inner duct geometry in the detail view. This parameter is logically equivalent to the G3E_DHOFFSET parameter.   |  
|  G3E_IDUCT_DVOFFSET  |  Specifies how far, vertically, from the start point of the formation line to generate the first inner duct geometry in the detail view. This parameter is logically equivalent to the G3E_DVOFFSET parameter.   |

#### G3E_FORMATION (Formation Parameters Table)
Table name:  G3E_FORMATION 
Contains information necessary for processing duct formations. It contains the ANO for the attribute of a formation that contains the formation's [stale graphics flag](javascript:;). This table should have only one row (specifying two ANOs, one for the From end and one for the To end). The fields are like those in the [G3E_DUCT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/bdWhvnmf~2S3I4TRh9CzHw) table. See [Duct Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA) for more information.

|  G3E_FNO  |  The formation's FNO.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FROMGEOMSTALEANO  |  ANO of field that contains the From geometry stale attribute for a formation (G3E_FNO). The field name associated with the ANO should match the field name defined by G3E_DUCT.G3E_FROMGEOMSTALEANO.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |

#### G3E_GGDATA (Geometry Generation Parameters Table)
Table name: G3E_GGDATA 
Contains additional data for a feature component needed by the geometry generator. See [Duct Management](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/683BYJfXgkU_aNo6BK5ZgA) for more information. 
The values in the G3E_VALUE field control the layout and spacing of the formation and duct components when placed by the Place Formation command. 
This diagram shows how these arguments, plus the parameters in [G3E_DUCTIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WU8MlP9KTpz4DA2jW5KJ1w), are used to place the formation line and duct symbol. The alignment of the symbol is assumed to be center-center in this example. This diagram purposely exaggerates the distances for clarity. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/257708?tocId=Agqehzpgt9vGhdIlmAb~1g)  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_GGROWNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_GGARGGROUPNO  |  Argument group number that logically associates parameters as input to a GGINO.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ARGUMENTNAME  |  Geometry generation parameter name. Must match definition in G3E_GEOMGENARGUMENT for the G3E_GGINO associated with this argument group.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  Geometry generation parameter value.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

The following explains how current is tested. The same process is used for Voltage, KVA, Min KVAR, Max KVAR, Sym Amp, Asym Amp, Momentary Amp, and Fault Voltage ratings: 
Feature Types (G3E_FNO) that have PTI current ratings and the attributes (G3E_ANO) that point to the current rating value are assigned in the G3E_EDTATTRIBUTE table where G3E_TYPE = PTICurrentRating. Multiple feature numbers (G3E_FNO) may have current ratings, not just branch devices. The software checks current ratings on all feature IDs (FIDs) in the network that match the feature type or types. The G3E_ANO is the number of the attribute from a component table that contains the current rating value. The rating is displayed in the load flow grid and used to compare current values for under and over limit color coding.

|  PTIGroundTripRelaySetting  |  46 — Used for the ground settings check in the Load Flow results and for non time-based Fault Analysis results checks. Also used for the MinimumFault3phGDownLine(EOL) check in Fault Analysis results.   |

##### G3E_EDTFEATURE (Electric Design Tools Feature Table)

###### G3E_EDTFEATURE.G3E_TYPE Values
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  LoadBearing  |  1  |  
|  LoadAccumulation  |  2  |  
|  Transformer  |  3  |  
|  SecondaryConductor  |  4  |  
|  Streetlight  |  5  |  
|  Consumer  |  6  |  
|  Duct  |  7  |  
|  Trench  |  8  |  
|  Pole  |  9  |  
|  Attachment  |  10  |  
|  Guy  |  11  |  
|  Meter  |  12 — Used by the PTI Analysis command to specify which types of devices from the SqTran and SqSwitch PTI device objects are included in the Source Readings Grid on the Unscaled Load Flow and Scaling Specifications dialog box   |  
|  TransformerBank  |  13 — Used by the PTI Analysis command to specify which types of devices in GIS are Transformer Banks.   |  
|  SubstationTransformer  |  14 — Used by the PTI Analysis command to specify which types of devices in GIS are Substation Transformers.   |  
|  ProtectiveDevic  |  15 — Used by the PTI Analysis command to specify which types of devices in GIS are protective devices. Time Based Fault Analysis only show results for Protective Devices(fuse, circuit breaker, recloser).   |  
|  PrimaryConductor  |  16 — Used by the PTI Analysis command to specify which types of devices in GIS are Primary Conductors.   |  
|  CircuitBreaker  |  17 — Used by the PTI Analysis command to specify which types of devices in GIS are Circuit Breakers.   |  
|  Recloser  |  18 — Used by the PTI Analysis command to specify which types of devices in GIS are Reclosers.   |  
|  Switch  |  19 — Used by the PTI Analysis command to specify which types of devices in GIS are Switches.   |  
|  Equipment  |  20 — Ground Sequence Current is calculated for all SqSwitch, SubstationTransformer, and PrimaryConductor devices.   |  
The ground trip relay setting check in Load Flow results is done for CircuitBreaker, Recloser, PrimaryConductor, and SubstationTransformer devices with the ground tripping function. PTI_RELAY_N.PHASE_CURRENT = Neutral. 
The MinimumFault3ph_ungDownLine calculation is shown for all ProtectiveDevice and PrimaryConductor devices. The Primary conductors must have PTI_RELAY_N.PHASE_CURRENT<>Neutral. 
The MinimumFault3phGDownLine(EOL) calculation is shown for all CircuitBreaker, Recloser, and PrimaryConductor devices. All 3 device types must have the ground tripping function: PTI_RELAY_N.PHASE_CURRENT=Neutral. 
Time-based Fault Analysis is shown for all ProtectiveDevice, Switch, and SqMach devices.
The asymmetrical amp rating in Time-based fault results is only checked for ProtectiveDevice devices.

###### G3E_EDTIFACE.G3E_TYPE Values
|  Electric Design Tools Interface Type Values  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Attributes  |  Identifies attributes by type for use by the different Electric Design Tools. List of the attributes required (phase or load, for example). For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  BeginPointCNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations, and identifies the component number of the beginning point of the cable pull. This component is placed at the beginning point of the selected duct (or ducts) after the computations are performed. This component must be a component on the conduit feature as specified in G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT. The string is interpreted as a long integer.   |  
|  BendSearchDistance  |  Name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computation. For this type, the G3E_PARAMETER1 value along with the MinimumBendAngle identifies the distance (in meters) along a linear feature the command searches before defining a bend. The string is interpreted as a long integer.   |  
|  CableAttachmentRetrievalMode  |  Cable attachment retrieval mode is used in Pole Guying Command. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 contains three options:  1 = Look for parent-to-child ownership from Pole. 2 = Look for a repeating attachment CNO for the Pole. 3 = Both 1 and 2 modes.  |  
|  CableDefault  |  Name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 identifies a row in the CABLE table to be used as the default cable. The string is interpreted as an integer and corresponds to the CINO column in the CABLE table.   |  
|  CablePullTensionProgID  |  Name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 identifies the automation object that is created to perform the tension computations.   |  
|  [CatalogDistanceUnits](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/gUxPd29KQpNFlYbAVFobxQ)  |  For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 identifies the unit of measure referenced by the values in the catalog tables used in Pole Moment.   |  
|  [CatalogTensionUnits](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/yVIJ7rO84b7~A9eVJ2QnFw)  |  For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 identifies the unit of measure referenced by the values in the catalog tables used in Pole Moment and Sag calculations.   |  
|  ChangeInCircumferencePerUnit  |  The pole circumference changes from bottom to top. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 specifies the change in circumference per unit. It is used in determining the pole base circumference at ground level. If the base circumference provided in the catalog table is at the ground level, this value must be 0.   |  
|  CLCConsumerTrace  |  For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 identifies the name of the consumer trace defined as type CircuitLoadCalculation. This trace is used by the circuit load calculator function to determine projected load from consumers connected to a load-bearing feature. The trace name defined here must be the same as the consumer trace defined in G3E_TRACE.   |  
|  ColdLoad  |  Name/value pair for maximum cold load factor for transformers. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 identifies the value used by secondary calculation to check against transformer cold load. The percent load of the transformer is compared to this value. Transformers exceeding this percent rating are flagged as overloaded.   |  
|  ConduitConnectivityTolerance  |  For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 identifies the value used by the Cable Pull Tension command. When multiple features are present in the select set, the command uses this value to determine if the endpoints of the features lie within this radial value from each other. Each endpoint can have at most one other endpoint that falls within this tolerance. This string is interpreted as a single precision floating point number expressed in meters. This value is not displayed on the user interface and its unit of measure is not converted.   |  
|  Config2Wire  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type determines the string value of configurations that are to represent a 2-Wire configuration within the [Ohmsmap type table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/BNmF2Mvo9TCVbSsxuNtjyw).   |  
|  DefaultBendRadius  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is used by the [Cable Pull Tension](javascript:;) command. Whenever a bend is inserted between straight-line segments, this value is placed in the grid for each bend. The user can change this value as needed before the tension is calculated. The string is interpreted as a single- precision floating point number expressed in meters and is converted to the correct units for display.   |  
|  DefaultConversion  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair used as a default value used by Secondary Calculation to display units keyed in by the user for override of loads on the consumer features. The additional names/values for conversion factors are stored in the ConversionFactor reference table, referenced by G3E_EDTREFTABLE. This value must also be contained in that ConversionFactor table.   |  
|  DefaultGuyOCF  |  Indicates the default NESC Guy OverLoad Capacity Factor. Since this factor is based on the type of the guy, it can also be added to the [Guy Catalog/Reference Table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/uxz3L8Cwz6pfWSzAdvFjzA). If the Guy OCF is found on the Guy Catalog/Reference Table, this default information is ignored.   |  
|  DefaultIceThickness  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is used as a default value by the Pole Guying command for moment calculations. This value must also be contained in the Ice Thickness reference table.   |  
|  DefaultModulusofElasticity  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the default Modulus of Elasticity, which is used in determining the Buckling Capacity. Since this factor is based on the Material of the pole, it can also be added to the Pole Catalog/Reference Table table. If the Modulus of Elasticity is found on the Pole Catalog/Reference Table table, this default information is ignored.   |  
|  DefaultPoleStrengthFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the default Pole Strength Factor, which is used in determining the pole percent usage. Since this factor is based on the Material/Class of the pole, it can also be added to the Pole Catalog/Reference Table table. If the Pole Strength Factor is found on the Pole Catalog/Reference Table table, this default information is ignored.   |  
|  DefaultPowerFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for default power factor value to be used in Secondary Optimization. The additional names/values for power factor are stored in the PowerFactor reference table, referenced by [G3E_EDTREFTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Aj5ZjrNAcWTj2ccQM87HWg). This value must also be contained in that PowerFactor table.   |  
|  DefaultStreetLightVoltageDrop  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the name/value pair used in calculations.  |  
|  DefaultTensionOCF  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the default NESC Tension OverLoad Capacity Factor. Since this factor is based on the Material of the pole, it can also be added to the Pole Catalog/Reference Table. If the Tension OCF is found on the Pole Catalog/Reference Table, this default information is ignored.   |  
|  DefaultVerticalOCF  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the default NESC Vertical OverLoad Capacity Factor. Since this factor is based on the Material of the pole it can also be added to the Pole Catalog/Reference Table. If the Vertical OCF is found on the Pole Catalog/Reference Table, this default information is ignored.   |  
|  DefaultWindDirectionInterval  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the default value that is loaded when the Pole Moment and Guying dialog box is displayed. This allows the user to use the standard wind direction interval instead of updating it when the command is executed.   |  
|  DefaultWindLoad  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair used as a default value by the Pole Guying command for moment calculations. This value must be contained in the WindLoad reference table.   |  
|  DefaultWindOCF  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the default NESC Wind OverLoad Capacity Factor. Since this factor is based on the material of the pole, it can also be added to the [Pole Catalog/Reference Table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pmTXk8HSuJpsUaspeicjuA). If the Wind OCF is found on the Pole Catalog/Reference Table, this default information is ignored.   |  
|  DuctDefault  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. This value identifies a row in the DUCTTRENCH table to be used as the default duct. If the attributes of the features in the select fail to locate a specific duct, this value is used as the default. The string is interpreted as an integer and corresponds to the DTNO column in the DUCTTRENCH table.   |  
|  EndPointCNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations, and identifies the component number of the ending point of the cable pull. This component is placed at the endpoint of the select duct (or ducts) after the computations are performed. This component must be a component on the conduit feature as specified in G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT. The string is interpreted as a long integer.   |  
|  Features  |  Groups features by type for use by the different Electric Design Tools. List of the categories of features required (poles, transformers, secondary, conductors, for example). For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  IceWeightPerCuUnit  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the weight of ice per cubic unit.  |  
|  Interface Types  |  Assists metadata maintenance by providing a foreign key table for the EDT Interface Types. This table should be populated by the product center with values expected by the Electric Design Tools. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE field.   |  
|  IsAttachmentHeightFromTopofPole  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this typeindicates the attachment height for all features. If the value is not equal to zero, indicates that the attachment height for all the features should be considered from the top of the pole instead of from ground.   |  
|  JamRatioSwitchPoint  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. If there are three cables in a cradled configuration and the computed jam ratio falls below this value, the object automatically switches the cable configuration to a triangular configuration. The CableConfiguration is set to the triangular value allowing the calling module to check this value and react as needed. The string is interpreted as a single precision floating point number.   |  
|  JamWarningHighValue  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type name/value pair is used in Cable Pull Tension computations. When the jam ration is computed, if it is less than or equal to this value and greater than or equal to the JamWarningLowValue, an error message is displayed. The computations do not complete, and the tension properties and tension values in the recordset are not set. The string is interpreted as a single precision floating point number.   |  
|  JamWarningLowValue  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type name/value pair is used in Cable Pull Tension computations. When the jam ratio is computed, if it is greater than or equal to this value and less than or equal to the JamWarningHighValue, an error message is displayed. The computations are not complete and the tension properties and tension values in the recordset are not set. The string is interpreted as a single precision floating point number.   |  
|  LengthAtBaseCircumference  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the length at which the base circumference of the pole is provided in the catalog/reference table. The normal standard used by the utility companies is that the buried length should be 10 percent pole length plus two feet. For performing the pole moment calculation, the base circumference used should always be at the ground level but the base circumference provided in the reference/catalog table might be relative to a fixed length. For example, for a 50-foot pole, the buried length should be seven feet, but the base circumference provided in the catalog /reference table might be relative to six feet from the actual base of the pole. Calculate the base circumference at ground level by using the following equation:  Base circumference at ground level = Base circumference provided in the reference/catalog table - (Buried length - LengthAtBaseCircumference) * ChangeInCircumferencePerUnit  This equation is useful even if the actual buried length < six feet. If ChangeInCircumferencePerUnit is 0, ignore this parameter.   |  
|  LoadGrowthPerYear  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for load growth per year value used by Secondary Calculation in calculating load on secondary conductors. Value is in percent.   |  
|  LockedRotorAmpsMulti  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for locked rotor amps multiplier used by Secondary Calculation in calculating motor current.   |  
|  MaxAllowedGuyPercentStrength  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the maximum allowed Guy percent strength. Some utilities might not want to give 100 percent as the allowed guy percent strength to check for overloads and might prefer percent less than 100; therefore, this value provides the flexibility to decide the overload pole percent usage.   |  
|  MaxAllowedPolePercentUsage  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the maximum allowed pole percent usage. Some utilities might not want to give 100 percent as the allowed pole percent usage to check for overloads and might prefer percent less than 100; therefore, this value gives the flexibility to decide the overload pole percent usage.   |  
|  MaxAllowedResultPoleMoment  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type provides the maximum allowed resulting pole moment. If the absolute value of the resulting pole moment exceeds this value, an overload exists.   |  
|  MaxWireFlicker  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for maximum flicker in conductor wires. This is the value used by Secondary Calculation as a maximum value allowed for flicker across each conductor wire. Conductors exceeding this value are flagged as undersized.   |  
|  MaxWireVoltageDrop  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value is the name/value pair for maximum voltage drop in conductor wires. This is the value used by Secondary Calculation as a maximum value allowed for voltage drop across each conductor wire. Conductors exceeding this value are flagged as undersized.   |  
|  MaxXfmrVoltageDrop  |  Name/value pair for maximum voltage drop in transformers. This is the value used by Secondary Calculation as a maximum value allowed for voltage drop across each transformer. Transformers exceeding this value are flagged as undersized.   |  
|  MaxXfmrFlicker  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value is the name/value for maximum flicker in transformers. This is the value used by Secondary Calculation as a maximum value allowed for flicker across each transformer. Transformers exceeding this value are flagged as undersized.   |  
|  MinimumBendAngle  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value is used by the Cable Pull Tension command. Each vertex is evaluated and compared to this value. If the sweep angle (180 - included angle) is greater than this amount, a bend is defined at that vertex. This string is interpreted as an integer expressed in degrees.   |  
|  NumberGrowthYears  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value is the name/value pair for number of years to apply load growth used by Secondary calculation in calculating load on secondary conductors.   |  
|  Overload  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value is the name/value pair for maximum overload factor for transformers. This value is used by Secondary Calculation to check against transformer overloading. The percent loading of the transformer (including diversity factor) is compared to this value. Transformers exceeding this percent rating are flagged as overloaded.   |  
|  PoleChildRNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value is the G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_RNO of the child relationship that the pole uses. This is used by the Pole Moment command. This should be the pair relationship of that specified in 'PoleParentRNO.'   |  
|  PoleMomentCalculationProgID  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value indicates the automation object used to perform the pole moment calculation. Lets you change the calculation interface to meet specific project needs.   |  
|  PoleParentRNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value is the G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_RNO of the parent relationship in which the pole participates. This is used by the Pole Moment command.   |  
|  PoleParenttoChildRNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value is a pointer to the G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_RNO field indicating the pole parent-to-child relationship that is used to find the attachments, equipment, and guys owned by the pole.   |  
|  PTIUnbalanceMax  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default value used in PTI load flow analysis. Specifies the percent unbalance limit allowed before it if flagged in the load flow results.   |  
|  PTIConvergenceMax  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default value used in PTI load flow analysis. Specifies how close the PTI engines must come to solving the network before stopping the calculations.   |  
|  PTIConvergenceIteration  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default value used in PTI load flow analysis. Controls the number of attempts the software makes to determine the load flow results.   |  
|  PTIHighVoltageLimit  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default value used in PTI load flow analysis. Percentage of low ranges voltage measurements on devices that have voltage characteristics before they are flagged as violations.   |  
|  PTILowVoltageLimit  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default value used in PTI load flow analysis. Percentage of high ranges voltage measurements on devices that have voltage characteristics before they are flagged as violations.   |  
|  PTIPowerFactorMin  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default value used in PTI load flow analysis. The Power Factor (angle between kW and kVA) is flagged if it is below this default minimum value.   |  
|  PTIDefaultLoadDeviceFixed  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default fixed value used in PTI load profile selection. Indicates that the load for the particular device should not be scaled if scaling is applied to this analysis. 0 for No, 1 for Yes.   |  
|  PTIDefaultAdjustmentPercent  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default adjustment value used in PTI load profile selection. This value is a percentage of the load and is used to vary the analysis of the network percentage(%).   |  
|  PTIDefaultFaultCycles  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default number of cycles used in PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study parameters.   |  
|  PTIMachineImpedanceHz  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default machine impedance hertz value selected in PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study parameters. This must be 50 or 60.   |  
|  PTIFaultResistanceRf  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default Rf parameter value used in PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study.   |  
|  PTIFaultReactanceXf  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default XF parameter value used in PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study.   |  
|  PTINeutralResistanceRg  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default Rg parameter value used in PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study.   |  
|  PTINeutralReactanceXg  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default Xg parameter value used in PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study.   |  
|  PTIRegulatorTargetLoss  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default target loss reduction parameter value used in the Regulator Performance settings of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTIRegulatorTargetVoltsMin  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default target volts minimum parameter value used in the Regulator Performance settings of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTIRegulatorTargetVoltsMax  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default target volts maximum parameter value used in the Regulator Performance settings of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTITapAdjustTargetVoltsMin  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default system wide lower limit of node voltage in pu. Used in the Transformer Tap Adjustments settings of the PTI Analysis command as a VTRM Engine parameter.   |  
|  PTITapAdjustTargetVoltsMax  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default system wide upper limit of node voltage in pu. Used in the Transformer Tap Adjustments settings of the PTI Analysis command as a VTRM Engine parameter.   |  
|  PTIOverLimitColor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default over the limit color selected for the PTI Analysis command. This value identifies a row in the PTIColorValues table to be used as the default color. The string corresponds to the Username column in the PTIColorValues table. The color is used to flag devices that are over their limits. The rows and cells of the PTI results grids should be color-coded to indicate this.   |  
|  PTIUnderLimitColor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default under the limit color selected for the PTI Analysis command. This value identifies a row in the PTIColorValues table to be used as the default color. The string corresponds to the Username column in the PTIColorValues table. The color is used to flag devices that are under their limits. The rows/cells of the PTI results grids should be color-coded to indicate this.   |  
|  PTIRegulatorPowerUnits  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default Power Units combo box value used in the Regulator Performance Setting of the PTI Analysis command. Should be kW, kVAR, or KVA.   |  
|  PTIRegulatorMaxAdjustments  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type sets the number of adjustments that can be made during LMVA Analysis. Multiple adjustments to the same device are all counted, even if the device ends up back on its original setting. If the maximum number of adjustments is exceeded, LMVA Analysis stops. Used in the Regulator Performance settings of the results calculations of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTIGroundTripMax  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default value used in PTI load flow analysis. This is a parameter to the unbalance checks performed on the features with ground trip settings.   |  
|  PTIDefaultConductorLoading  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default value used in PTI load flow analysis. Specification of which rating to use to check the feature against in the analysis. This is a G3E_FIELD in G3E_REFFIELD table associated with the PTICONDUCTORMAPPING table. In the G3E_REFFIELD table, the G3E_USERNAME of the G3E_REFFIELD is displayed in the conductor loading combo box.   |  
|  PTIDefaultCapacitorQuantity  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default capacitor quantity used in the Install Capacitor Parameters of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTISwitchOptimReacEnergyCost  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the price of reactive energy (monetary units/kvar-h. Used to compute the Switch Optimization Results of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTISwitchOptimRealEnergyCost  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default price of reactive power (monetary units/kvar- h) used to compute the Switch Optimization Results of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTISwitchOptimReacPowerCost  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default price of reactive power (monetary units/kvar) used to compute the Switch Optimization Results of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTISwitchOptimRealPowerCost  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default price of real power (monetary units/kW) used to compute the Switch Optimization Results of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTISwitchOptimInService  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the string used to represent that a Branch in the network is 'In Service' after running the TOPO engine used in the Switch Optimization Results of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTISwitchOptimOutofService  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the string used to represent that a Branch in the network is 'Out of Service' after running the TOPO engine used in the Switch Optimization Results of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTIDefaultLoadKW  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the value used in PTI Adjust Loads dialog box. This value is used if the SAS value is not found for a Device.   |  
|  PTIDefaultLoadKVAR  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the value used in PTI Adjust Loads dialog box. This value is used if the SAS value is not found for a Device.   |  
|  PTICapacitorConnectionDelta  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the string used to represent 'Delta' for the Connection Type Combo in the Install Capacitors Parameters dialog box of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTICapacitorConnectionWye  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the string used to represent 'Wye' for the Connection Type Combo in the Install Capacitors Parameters dialog box of the PTI Analysis command.   |  
|  PTILineLineFaultChecked  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default state of the Line-Line fault checkbox in the PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study parameters. A value of 1 indicates checked. 0 is unchecked.   |  
|  PTILineGndFaultChecked  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default state of the Line- Ground fault checkbox in the PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study parameters. A value of 1 indicates checked. Zero is unchecked.   |  
|  PTILineLineGndFaultChecked  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default state of the Line- Line-Ground fault checkbox in the PTI Analysis Fault Analysis Event Study parameters. A value of 1 indicates checked. 0 is unchecked.   |  
|  PTICapacitorDiscountRate  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the discount rate(pu/year). Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorInflationRate  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the inflation rate for energy(pu/year). Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorMinPFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the acceptable power factor value. Must be between 0 and 1. Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorMinWorth  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type sets the minimum acceptable present worth (monetary units). Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorRealEnergyCost  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the price of real energy (monetary units/kWh). Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorReacEnergyCost  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the price of reactive energy(monetary units/kvar- h). Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorEvalPeriod  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the evaluation period (years). Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorPFactCost  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the power factor price (monetary units/0.01). Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorVMaxAtNode  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the maximum allowed node voltage (pu). Used in the Install Capacitors calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a CAPO engine parameter.   |  
|  PTICapacitorOptimCriteria  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the Optimization Criteria used in running the CAPO Engine. This value identifies a row in the PTICapacitorOptimizationTypes table to be used as the default Optimization Criteria for the CAPO Engine. The string corresponds to the Criteria column in the PTICapacitorOptimizationTypes table. Used in the Install Capacitors of the PTI Analysis command calculations.   |  
|  PTIFaultVoltageRatingMult  |  Default Fault Voltage Rating Multiplier used in PTI Analysis command’s Fault Analysis Results. This value is multiplied by the Voltage Rating in the non time- based fault results grid, and the result is compared against the Voltage pu ratings for the device.   |  
|  PTIEOLTripPercentage  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the default EOL Trip Percentage used in the Fault Analysis Results of the PTI Analysis command. This value is multiplied by the MinimumFault3ph_ungDownLine value in the non timebased fault results grid, and the result is compared against the PTIPhaseTripRelaySetting for the device. This value is also multiplied by the MinimumFault3phGDownLine (EOL) value in the non timebased fault results grid, and the result is compared against the PTIGroundTripRelaySetting for the device.   |  
|  PTITapAdjustMaxNumSteps  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the maximum number of voltage trimming steps. This is a protection against problems that may take too long to solve. Used in the Transformer Tap Adjustments calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a VTRM engine parameter.   |  
|  PTITapAdjustPrimaryObjective  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the objective (primary function) that the voltage trimming algorithm uses. This value identifies a row in the PTITapAdjustmentObjectiveTypes table to be used as the default Primary Adjustment for the VTRM Engine. The string corresponds to the Objective column in the PTITapAdjustmentObjectiveTypes table. Used in the Transformer Tap Adjustments calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a VTRM engine parameter.   |  
|  PTITapAdjustSecondaryObjective  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the objective (secondary function) that the voltage trimming algorithm uses. This value identifies a row in the PTITapAdjustmentObjectiveTypes table to be used as the default Secondary Adjustment for the VTRM Engine. The string corresponds to the Objective column in the PTITapAdjustmentObjectiveTypes table. Used in the Transformer Tap Adjustments calculations of the PTI Analysis command as a VTRM engine parameter.   |  
|  PTISwitchOptimTargetVoltsMin  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the minimum system voltage (pu). Used in Switch Optimization settings of the PTI Analysis command as a TOPO Engine parameter.   |  
|  PTISwitchOptimTargetVoltsMax  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the minimum system voltage (pu). Used in Switch Optimization settings of the PTI Analysis command as a TOPO Engine parameter.   |  
|  RadialIce  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the provides the radial of ice and is used in determining the total diameter that is used in calculating the ice and wind load. It is assumed that the ice is evenly distributed along the circumference of the conductor; therefore, while calculating the ice and wind load, the diameter used is the diameter of the conductor plus twice the radial ice.   |  
|  Reference Tables  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type identifies an expected list of reference tables.  |  
|  Reference Fields  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type identifies the needed fields on each reference table.   |  
|  Reference Table Types  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type assists metadata maintenance by providing a foreign key table for the EDT Reference Table Types. This table must be populated by the product center with values expected by the Electric Design Tools.   |  
|  Reference Field Types  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type assists metadata maintenance by providing a foreign key table for the EDT Reference Field Types. This table must be populated by the product center with values expected by the Electric Design Tools.   |  
|  SLDMaxWireVoltageDrop  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for maximum voltage drop in conductor wires for streetlight networks. This is the value used by Streetlight Design as a maximum value allowed for voltage drop across each conductor wire. Conductors exceeding this value are flagged as undersized.   |  
|  SpanDelta  |  Since Span Length of an attachment feature can be a calculated value, there is a possibility of some precision loss during graphic placement. While searching for tension in the [tension catalog/reference table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/IMIRorI7j38xVDh4qVloYQ), span length is required, but the span length stored in the table can be a whole value. The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type helps in selecting a range of span length that can be valid for a given analysis type. If the parameter is read / write and is associated with picklist table or if an exact combination of analysis type and span length is found in the Tension reference/catalog table, the SpanDelta is ignored. If the parameter is marked as read / write, a drop-down list displays containing span lengths ranging from Attachment Span Length — SpanDelta to Attachment Span Length + SpanDelta. The first one in the list is the default. You can override the value if required. If the parameter is marked as read-only, no drop-down list displays, and the selection is based on the closest value found.   
 |  Example The SpanDelta defined is 100, the tension catalog/reference table contains values 100,200,300, and so forth for a given analysis type. The attachment span length stored is 210.5. The tension catalog/reference is queried for the given analysis type and span length ranging from 210.5 — 100 to 210.5 + 100, which returns two rows with span length 200 & 300. If the parameter is marked as read / write, 200 & 300 are displayed on the drop-down list, and 200 is selected as default. If the parameter is marked as read-only, 200 is selected and no drop-down displays. This occurs only when the attachment information is retrieved from the attachment type features using the ownership relation with the pole.   |  
| --- |  
If new rows are added, you must enter a span length value that exists in the tension catalog/reference table or it prompts an error. 
 |  
|  SWBPConversion  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. The automation object produces tension expressed in pounds per foot. The system can be configured to display these values in other units. This conversion string is used to find a corresponding conversion factor in the CONVERSIONFACTORS table. The portion of the string before the second / is used to label the output. The default, LB/FT/LB/FT, has a corresponding value of 1.0 in the CONVERSIONFACTORS table.   |  
|  SWBPSafetyFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. When the SWBP is computed, a multiplier is used to over- estimate the SWBP. The computed SWBP is multiplied by this factor to yield a safety margin. The string is interpreted as a single precision floating point number.   |  
|  TensionConversion  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. The automation object produces tension expressed in pounds. The system can be configured to display these values in other units. This conversion string is used to find a corresponding conversion factor in the CONVERSIONFACTORS table. The portion of the string before the '/' is used to label the output. The default, LB/LB, has a corresponding value of 1.0 in the CONVERSIONFACTORS table.   |  
|  TensionSafetyFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. This value is used for the final tension calculations to allow for a safety margin. This is typically used to provide an over-estimation of the tension. The last tension value (either forward or reverse) from the values in the recordset is multiplied by this value to produce the final tension. The string is interpreted as a single precision floating point number.   |  
|  WeightCorrectionFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair used in Cable Pull Tension computations. For one- cable and three-cable configurations, the object computes the weight correction factor automatically. For two-cable configurations, this value is used instead of a computed value. A value of 1.5 means that a two-cable configuration produces the same tension as a single cable weighing 1.5 times its original weight. The string is interpreted as a single precision floating point number.   |  
|  WindDirectionIntervalIncrement  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the increment at which the wind direction interval is updated whenever a user clicks the up arrow.   |  
|  WindLoadPerSqUnit  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type indicates the wind load per square unit.  |  
|  WireFlickerSafetyFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for flicker safety factor used by Secondary Calculation in calculating percent flicker across conductor wires.   |  
|  WireVoltageDropSafetyFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for voltage drop safety factor used by Secondary Calculation in calculating percent voltage drop across conductor wires.   |  
|  XfmrFlickerSafetyFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for flicker safety factor used by Secondary Calculation in calculating percent flicker across transformers.   |  
|  XfmrVoltageDropSafetyFactor  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the name/value pair for voltage drop safety factor used by Secondary Calculation in calculating percent voltage drop across transformers.   |

##### G3E_EDTINTERFACETYPE (Electric Design Tools Interface Type Table)
Table name: G3E_EDTINTERFACETYPE 
Contains the types that can be entered into the [G3E_EDTIFACE.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/G2xjD3_QGkyR0y7MuUOOXQ) field. This table is pre-populated by the product center.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  A valid type.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_DESCRIPTON  |  A lengthier description of the type.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

##### G3E_EDTPOLEMOMENT (Electric Design Tools Pole Moments Table)

###### G3E_POLEMOMENT.G3E_GRIDTYPE Values
Associates the column definition to the appropriate grid.  
|  Value Name  |  Value  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Pole  |  9  |  
|  Attachment  |  10  |  
|  Guy  |  11  |  
|  Equipment  |  20  |

###### G3E_POLEMOMENT.G3E_PARAMETER Values
Pole Data Grid
The following table describes the parameters that can be defined for the pole. This is applicable only when G3E_GRIDTYPE = 9.   
|  Parameter  |  Input/Output  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  PoleAnalysisIdentifier  |  Input  |  Attribute representing the analysis type of the Pole.  |  
|  PoleDescription  |  Input  |  This defines a short description indicating the type of pole or any descriptive information.  |  
|  PoleAttachmentHeight  |  Input  |  Since attachment height attribute can be associated with the pole feature, this parameter provides the capability to retrieve the attachment height information directly from conductors, equipment, or guys, or from the pole itself.   |  
|  PoleLength  |  Input  |  Attribute representing pole length. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  PoleTipCircumference  |  Input  |  Attribute representing pole tip circumference. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  PoleBaseCircumference  |  Input  |  Attribute representing pole base circumference. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  PoleBuriedLength  |  Input  |  Attribute representing pole buried length. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  PoleFiberStress  |  Input  |  Attribute representing pole fiber stress. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  PoleWeightDensity  |  Input  |  Attribute representing pole weight density. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  PoleTipDiameter  |  Output  |  Calculated Pole Tip Diameter.  |  
|  PoleBaseDiameter  |  Output  |  Calculated Pole Base Diameter.  |  
|  PoleArea  |  Output  |  Calculated Pole Area.  |  
|  PoleSectionModulus  |  Output  |  Calculated Pole Section Modulus.  |  
|  PoleExposedArea  |  Output  |  Calculated Pole Exposed Area.  |  
|  PoleWindMoment  |  Output  |  Calculated Pole Wind Moment.  |  
Attachment Data Grid
The following table describes the parameters that can be defined for the conductors. Only applicable when G3E_GRIDTYPE = 10.   
|  Parameter  |  Input/Output  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  ConductorAnalysisIdentifier  |  Input  |  Attribute representing the analysis type of the conductor.  |  
|  ConductorDescription  |  Input  |  This defines a short description that the user wants to display indicating the type of attachment or any descriptive information.   |  
|  ConductorAttachmentHeight  |  Input  |  Attribute representing Attachment height of the conductor.  |  
|  ConductorNumberofWires  |  Input  |  Attribute representing number of wires.  |  
|  ConductorSpanLength  |  Input  |  Attribute representing Conductor span length.  |  
|  ConductorBearing  |  Input  |  Attribute representing conductor bearing (line angle) in degrees.  |  
|  ConductorDiameter  |  Input  |  Attribute representing conductor diameter. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  ConductorWeight  |  Input  |  Attribute representing conductor weight. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  ConductorTension  |  Output  |  The value is retrieved using the combination of Conductor Span Length and the Conductor Analysis Identifier.   |  
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265395) Most utilities model their conductors as a single feature with multiple conductor wire records where each wire can have a different set of characteristics. The ConductorAnalysisIdentifier parameter value is used to find the individual conductor wires. 
Equipment Data Grid
The following table describes the parameters that can be defined for the equipment. This is applicable only when G3E_GRIDTYPE = 20.   
|  Parameter  |  Input/Output  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  EquipmentAnalysisIdentifier  |  Input  |  Attribute representing the analysis type of the equipment.  |  
|  EquipmentDescription  |  Input  |  This defines a short description that the user wants to display indicating the type of equipment or any descriptive information.   |  
|  EquipmentAttachmentHeight  |  Input  |  Attribute representing attachment height of the equipment.  |  
|  EquipmentWeight  |  Input  |  Attribute representing equipment weight + ice. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  EquipmentWindLoad  |  Input  |  Attribute representing equipment wind load. This parameter can be retrieved either from feature attribute data or from catalog table.   |  
|  EquipmentQuantity  |  Input  |  Attribute representing the quantity of equipment. This is useful in bank transformer where than can be more than one can and the information provided in the reference/catalog table is per unit of the transformer instead of the entire bank.   |  
|  EquipmentWindMoment  |  Output  |  Calculated equipment wind moment.  |  
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265395): If equipment like a transformer can exist as single unit, there can be more than one transformer with different characteristics. EquipmentAnalysisIdentifier parameter value is used to find the individual transformer units associated with the transformer equipment feature. 
Guy Data Grid
The following table describes the parameters that can be defined for the guys. This is applicable only when G3E_GRIDTYPE = 11.   
|  Parameter  |  Input/Output  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |
