|  G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE  |  Table in the database used to store the legend definition. This name is populated by the MG3ELegendUtils.CreateTables(DefTableName, DCTableName, SetTableName, DefTableAbbr, SetTableAbbr) procedure. The first parameter, DefTableName, is for the definition table name which is G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE column.  The procedure checks that DefTableName is a legal table name and creates the table. The name can be no longer than 30 characters.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_SETTINGSTABLE  |  Name of the table in the database used to store the legend settings. This name is populated by the procedure to encapsulate checking for legal table names and collisions. This must be uppercase.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE  |  Table in the database used to store the presentation of the display groups in the Display Control.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

This number should correspond to the alternate set of components defined in [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  0  |

|  G3E_OVERVIEW  |  Indicates whether this legend is an overview legend. 0 = The legend is not an overview legend. 1 = The legend is an overview legend. Only one legend can be defined as the overview and G3E_DETAIL must be No (0).  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1, 0)  |  0  |

### G3E_LEGENDENTRY (Legend Entries Table)
Table name: G3E_LEGENDENTRY 
Defines all available legend entries. That is, each row in this table is the association of a component view to a style rule, a unique name, and, optionally, a label rule. 
A particular component view can appear multiple times to accommodate different display scale ranges. The geometry field name is retrieved from the [G3E_COMPONENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw) definition. 
If the G3E_LEGENDENTRY table is populated when an upgrade script is run, the G3E_SETTINGSTABLE is automatically populated. The G3E_SETTINGSTABLE is the primary table that drives the layering for output to PDF.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LENO  |  Identifier for the legend entry.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LEGENDENTRY  |  Name of the layer used for setting the default layer names for the first legend settings of a legend.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name presented in the Display Control for this legend entry.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_VNO  |  Component view definition.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_SRNO  |  Identifier of a rule within the [G3E_STYLERULE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA) table. There is only one style rule per legend entry. This value can be Null when the component view is against a gdbCoverage component. Style groups used to render dimensions are configured in G3E_DIMSTYLEGROUP. The value of G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_SRNO for a dimension element is the style group number ([G3E_DIMSTYLEGROUP.G3E_DSGNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ul1ZNWnC4F6edCUnp9eURQ)).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes, Logical  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LRNO  |  Identifier of a rule within the [G3E_LABELRULE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XhCqhW831qxPA3~bdSlxhw) table. There is only one label rule per legend entry.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes Logical  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LAYERNAME  |  Name of the layer that is used for setting default layer names in [G3E_SETTINGSTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5UJi_D2EF3RLbqldV6jGhQ).G3E_LAYERNAME when a new legend is created.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256637?tocId=hwoZKKRcMCDdCnj2vDvNZA) If the G3E_SETTINGSTABLE.G3E_LAYERNAME is Null, this value is not used to create the PDF layer names.   |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ROLE  |  Name of the database role the user must have to enable the object control. If the user has the role, the specific legend entry is displayed on the legend Display Control.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  EVERYONE  |  
|  G3E_TRANSLUCENCY  |  If specified, the translucency applied to all styles displayed by the specified legend entry, except any area background fills. This value does not apply to any hatching or to area backgrounds. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null means that there are no overrides at the legend entry level, that is, the styles are drawn with the translucencies defined in their individual style metadata entries. A value of 0 means that the pertinent styles of the legend entry are opaque. Nothing behind the style is visible. A value of 100 means that the pertinent styles are invisible. Everything behind the pertinent style is visible.  If specified, this value overrides any non-area background fill translucencies defined in the styles themselves. For example if a line whose style is defined to have 30% translucency is being drawn by a legend, that line is drawn by the non-Null translucency specified by this entry. The 30% value is ignored.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_FILLTRANSLUCENCY  |  If specified, the translucency applied to any area background fills for the specified legend entry. This value applies to any hatching of the areas and to their backgrounds. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null means that there are no overrides for area background fills at the legend entry level. The styles are drawn with the translucencies defined in their individual style metadata entries. A value of 0 means that any area fill is opaque. Nothing is visible behind it. A value of 100 means that any area fill is invisible. Everything is visible behind any area fill.  If specified, this value overrides any area background fill translucencies defined in the styles themselves. For example if an area whose background fill style is defined to have 30% translucency is being drawn by a legend, that fill is drawn by the non-NULL translucency specified by this entry. The 30% is ignored.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_LEGENDFILTER (Legend Filter Table)
Table name:  G3E_LEGENDFILTER 
Defines the available legend filters for use with each Display Control presentation.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LFROWNO  |  Unique row in the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LNO  |  The legend number to which this filter is applicable. This number is a key into the [G3E_LEGEND](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/dkXBUKhJYRP6rlMPMUk7Kg) table. From this table, the appropriate [G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/U27QBJy1LkijFwfEFQHj0Q) table is determined. Values from G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE.G3E_DCROWNO are used to populate the next field.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DCROWNO  |  The value of G3E_DISPLAYCONTROL(N).G3E_DCROWNO to which this filter is applicable. This field is not a true foreign key. However, a constraint or validation exists such that for the G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE table associated with the legend (in G3E_LNO), this value must exist in the table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  The text value displayed in the predefined filters interface. While the field is not unique within the table, it should be unique within a legend for this G3E_DCROWNO and any higher G3E_DCROWNO up to each root entry in the tree (where G3E_ORDINAL < current DCROWNO's ordinal and G3E_LEVEL < current DCROWNO's level). This restriction controls Display Control presentation to the user.   |  No*  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTER  |  An [SQL WHERE clause](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) expression as would be defined in G3E_LEGDEF(N).G3E_FILTER that indicates what data should be excluded from the legend entry(ies) when this filter is applied. When the G3E_DCROWNO is a grouping item (not a leaf), the filter is applied to all subordinate legend entries. Hence, the filter must be a valid filter for all of those legend entries.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
* While the field is not unique within the table, it should be unique within a legend for this G3E_DCROWNO and any G3E_DCROWNO higher than it up to each root entry in the tree (where G3E_ORDINAL < current DCROWNO's ordinal and G3E_LEVEL < current DCROWNO's level). This restriction is for presentation purposes (clarity to the user).

### G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS (Legend Settings Table)
Table name: G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS 
Settings of predefined legends available to the end user so you can define multiple ways to represent the same legend. Each entry in this table corresponds to a table representing the individual legend instances. You use Metadata Explorer to define these settings.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_LNO  |  Foreign key into the G3E_LEGEND table.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Legend settings name as seen by the end user.  |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_JOINTABLE  |  Name of the optimized table in the database that is constructed from the join of the G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE, G3E_SETTINGSTABLE, and the G3E_LEGENDENTRY table for a specific legend. This is necessary for metadata publishing and version management. This must be uppercase.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_DEFAULT  |  Value indicating that the legend settings row should be used as the default. A value of 1 indicates True while a value of 0 indicates False. There can be two default legend settings rows - one for geographic viewing and one for detail viewing.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_PDFLAYERSVSTRANSLUCENCY  |  Not used  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  PDF LAYERS  |  
|  G3E_SEEDLSNO  |  Value indicating the G3E_LSNO whose legend settings should be used to initialize the new legend settings. A value of 0 indicates that default values should be used to initialize the new legend settings.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ROLE  |  Name of the database role that the user must have to enable the object control. If the user has the appropriate role, this specific legend settings item is displayed in the legend list for the user to replace or append.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  EVERYONE  |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |

### G3E_SERVICEURL (NetWorks Web Services Table)
Table name: G3E_SERVICEURL 
Contains information necessary for the 3D map configuration.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SUNO  |  Row identifier for the table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  NUMBER (10)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONFNO  |  Database configuration number. G3E_CONFNO is a reference to the G3E_CONFNO in G3E_CONFIGURATIONS table.   |  No  |  No  |   |   |  Yes  |  NUMBER (10)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  Type of the service. For a 3D map, the type of a service name is ‘3DPortal’  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  VARCHAR2 (50)  |   |  
|  G3E_URL  |  NetWorks Portal 3D service URL for the selected configuration  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  VARCHAR2 (4000)  |   |

![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1445061?tocId=EGTVz3~zCZfvtCHUE~gMsg) Due to a unique constraint used on columns G3E_CONFNO, G3E_TYPE, and G3E_URL, one configuration can be associated with only one NetWorks Portal 3D service URL. 
Sample insert query:
Insert into G3E_SERVICEURL (G3E_SUNO, G3E_CONFNO, G3E_TYPE, G3E_URL, G3E_EDITDATE) values (G3E_SERVICEURL_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 1, '3DPortal', 'http://serviceurl', SYSDATE);

### G3E_SETTINGSTABLE (Legend Entry Settings Table)
Table name: G3E_SETTINGSTABLE 
Contains one or more groups of legend settings information for a single legend. These groups define multiple ways to view the same legend. For example, the same Electric legend can be configured so users can view it with different data displayed (G3E_DISPLAYMODE=1). Legends are used to populate a map window or an embedded map on a plot sheet. The actual name of this table is specified in the [G3E_LEGEND](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/dkXBUKhJYRP6rlMPMUk7Kg) table. An instance of the settings table contains the display scale range, default statuses, and properties. 
The complete legend entry is defined by joining this table and G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE to the G3E_LEGENDENTRY table. 
If the G3E_LEGENDENTRY table is populated when an upgrade script is run, the G3E_SETTINGSTABLE is automatically populated. The G3E_SETTINGSTABLE is the primary table that drives the layering for output to PDF.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LSROWNO  |  Primary key for this table so that the rows can retain identity to support localization.  |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  Varchar2 (14)  |   |  
|  G3E_LENO  |  The number of the legend entry. A legend entry appears only once per G3E_LSNO, but may be referenced by multiple display groups within a legend. The combination of G3E_LENO and G3E_LSNO must be unique.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LSNO  |  Foreign key into the G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS table. Defines the different legend settings that can be applied to a given G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE. The combination of G3E_LENO and G3E_LSNO must be unique.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5)  |   |  
|  G3E_LAYERNAME  |  Name of the layer on which the legend entry is placed in exported PDF files using the Export to PDF command. If this field is not set, the legend entry is put on the default PDF layer.   |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_DISPLAYMODE  |  Indicates the default display of the data, either on or off. 0 = Display is off. 1 = Display is on.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_DISPLAYSCALEMIN  |  Lower extent of the display scale range. This is a ratio value and is independent of units.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (10)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_DISPLAYSCALEMAX  |  Upper extent of the display scale range. This is a ratio value and is independent of units. The default maximum is 1,000,000,000.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (10)  |  1000000000  |  
|  G3E_USEDISPLAYSCALE  |  A Boolean value that indicates if the display scale range should be honored for this particular legend entry.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_LOCATABLE  |  Indicates if the data associated with the legend entry can be located.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_BINARYRASTERCOLOR  |  RGB color value for symbolizing binary raster component views.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_STYLE (Style Format Table)
Table name: G3E_STYLE 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256632?tocId=pMS9V4Zq5fTJUKAqpsv9~Q)
  * G3E_WIDTH is overridden by G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT. However, plot window redline style overrides and style overrides on traces and queries are given priority over G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT during export to MicroStation V7 and V8 formats. 
  * G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT value is applied when export is performed from the SaveAsDGN API method. 
  * G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT is not considered for HxGN NetWorks Core Export workflows. 


Describes the style format. This is the same as the G3E_SNO referenced by the [G3E_STYLERULE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA) table.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SNO  |  Style index number. This is the key used by the style/rendering system.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Name of format. Example Concrete40FtPole Concrete35FtPole Metal40FtPole Metal35FtPole  |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  Class name of the style object. These are the style types: TextStyle PointStyle LineStyle AreaStyle CompositeLineStyle  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  Binary blob containing the style characteristics. ![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256632?tocId=pMS9V4Zq5fTJUKAqpsv9~Q) So that you can have different styles for different locations, metadata publishing does not update existing rows in localized style tables you update using the Admin user interface. If you do not want this behavior for any of the style entries, truncate the localized value in G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE, (for example, G3E_STYLE_0007.G3E_VALUE) before you publish. If you want certain values to be the same for all languages, use standard Oracle tools to copy the value in G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE to the G3E_VALUE field of the locale-specific table. For example, if the locale identifier is 0007 and the G3E_SNO number of the style that should be the same in both the default language and the alternate language is 101, use this update statement:  Update G3E_STYLE_0007 set G3E_VALUE = ( select G3E_VALUE from G3E_STYLE where G3E_SNO = 101) where G3E_SNO = 101;  |  No  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Raw (2000)  |   |  
|  G3E_TRANSLUCENCYEXISTS  |  The calculated value that tells if this style can have translucency. This value considers any sub-styles that this style is displaying. The value is calculated by the software during metadata publishing. It should not be changed once it is calculated. If it is, the behavior of drawing and printing is undefined.  This column exists on both the normalized table and the optimized table. The default is always overridden while publishing metadata.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_PLOTREDLINE  |  Boolean indicator of whether this style should appear in the plotting style control list. The default is Yes (1) so the style is available in plotting redlines.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_MICROSTATIONOVERRIDEWEIGHT  |  If G3E_TYPE is LineStyle, this is used as the line weight override value to use during export to MicroStation V7 and V8. For other types this value is null.   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_STYLERULE (Style Rule Table)
Table name: G3E_STYLERULE 
Maps a [style rule](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256634?tocId=0mNcGilSKhX9f2Pth81M2Q) to the possible formats that can be returned by that rule (StyleRule-StyleFormat Mapping). Also includes the expressions used to choose the style. 
A description of when to use a particular style definition. The technique used to achieve attribute-based symbology. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256634?tocId=0mNcGilSKhX9f2Pth81M2Q) Every style rule should have a Null filter. This is effectively the default style for the particular legend entry for this component view. It should always be the last filter evaluated. This is a Null value or empty string, not the word Null.

#### G3E_COMPOSITELINESTYLE (Composite Line Style Table)
Table name: G3E_COMPOSITELINESTYLE 
The table corresponds to the information in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA) and describes how a composite line style is defined. See [G3E_LINESTYLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/b3vQwQ~YtLlgn5feW4cuvA) for definitions of simple line styles. 
The metadata publishing process stores styles in binary form in the G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE column. This column has a size limit of 2000 bytes. 
A composite line style that has complex stroke patterns can exceed the size limit of 2000 bytes when converted to binary format, causing the publishing process to fail. 
To avoid the publish failure, make sure the composite line style is not complex enough to exceed 2000 bytes. The BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger on the G3E_COMPOSITELINESTYLE table checks the style size and raises an error: The Composite Line style size is beyond 2000 bytes”. 
Because these fields represent the localized metadata, none of them are localized.
An entry must exist in G3E_METADATASUPPORT for this table. The table is not published.

#### G3E_NORMALIZEDSTROKE (Stroke Pattern Table)
Table name: G3E_NORMALIZEDSTROKE 
Describes how a stroke pattern is defined. There is one row for each stroke pattern. Stroke patterns are defined only once for the entire configuration. You must populate the G3E_SEQUENCE_0 and G3E_SEQUENCE_1 columns. The remaining G3E_SEQUENCE_x columns, if populated, must be populated in pairs; for example, populate two columns, four columns, and so forth. The G3E_SEQUENCE_x field can contain a [negative value](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/wqbG4nmQgWZVsWW6GLLt_Q), which indicates that the dash or gap is stretchable. 
An entry must exist in G3E_METADATASUPPORT for this table and its optimized table to include this metadata in the published cache. The optimized table is G3E_STROKENAME_OPTABLE.

|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name for a stroke pattern.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_REPETITIONS  |  Represents the number of times the dash sequence is to be repeated along the line. The value must be greater than or equal to zero.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_VISIBLEDASHES  |  Specifies if dashes are visible when the stroke pattern is applied to a line. 0 = Dashes are not visible. 1 = Dashes are visible. If you set G3E_VISIBLEDASHES to 0, you may experience issues locating or panning the symbols defined in G3E_STROKESYMBOL_0 through G3E_STROKESYMBOL_4. If this is the case, you should: 
  * Set G3E_VISIBLEDASHES to 1.
  * Set G3E_TRANSLUCENCY on the parent’s line style in G3E_LINESTYLE to 100.

 |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |

SHRINK – The pattern is always shrunk to fit the line. #### G3E_POINTSTYLE (Point Style Table)
Table name: G3E_POINTSTYLE 
Corresponds to the information in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA) and describes how a point style is defined. 
Because these fields represent the localized metadata, none of them are localized.
An entry must exist in G3E_METADATASUPPORT for the table and its optimized table to include this metadata in the published cache. The optimized table is G3E_POINTSTYLEFONT_OPTABLE. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256749?tocId=~WwX6QEVR9~Y26H1TTC2SA) All fonts must be installed on the publish server during metadata publish.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SNO  |  Identifier for the style. This value is copied to the G3E_STYLE table, and you cannot edit it.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name found in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA)  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_COLOR  |  RGB value for the color of the style. -3 = Style color is the same as the map view background color  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FONTNAME  |  Name of the font used for the style.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (40)  |   |  
|  G3E_SYMBOL  |  Symbol for the font glyph. It is a single character.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (1)  |   |  
|  G3E_MASKSYMBOL  |  Symbol used for masking. It is a single character. This is used only when the G3E_USEMASK is set to 1.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (1)  |   |  
|  G3E_SIZE  |  Size of the style in points.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_USEMASK  |  Indicates the type of symbol masking used. 0 = No mask. 1 = A symbol mask is applied. The symbol used is the one specified in the G3E_MASKSYMBOL column.  2 = A rectangle mask is applied.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ALIGNMENT  |  Symbol alignment. [There are nine possible alignment positions](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Nvd43rB_pYWjjXs_AJY5wg).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_PDNO  |  An optional port definition for this style. This is a foreign key to [G3E_PORTDEFINITION.G3E_PDNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/3GqB0DMMCvo_X6OpxUXI0w).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ROTATION  |  Specifies the rotation in degrees to apply to the style when it is drawn. Specify this field when there is a need to use a single font glyph with a rotation instead of having to define a new font symbol.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |  0  |  
|  G3E_PLOTREDLINE  |  Boolean indicator of whether this style should appear in the plotting style control list. The value is found in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_PLOTREDLINE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA).  0 = The style is not available in plotting redlines. 1 = The style is available in plotting redlines.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_STYLEUNITS  |  Determines how the various "size" properties of styles (size, offset, width, and so forth) are interpreted.  1 = The style is scale dependent. The appearance of the components that use the style to draw vary based on the current zoom scale.  3 = The style is scale independent. The appearance of the components that use the style to draw are always the same regardless of the zoom scale.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_TRANSLUCENCY  |  The translucency applied to the point style. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null is interpreted to be 0. A value of 0 means that the point style is opaque, that is, nothing is visible behind the point. A value of 100 means that the point symbol is invisible, that is, everything is visible behind the point.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_MASKTRANSLUCENCY  |  The translucency applied to the mask on the point style. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null is interpreted as 0. A value of 0 means that the mask area is opaque, that is, nothing is visible behind the point. A value of 100 means that the mask area is invisible, that is, everything is visible behind the point.  Setting a non-zero translucency is useful if you want the mask to only partially block out features behind the mask.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_STYLELANGMAPPING (Style Language Mapping Table)
Table name: G3E_STYLELANGMAPPING 
Contain information necessary to support different style objects for non-default languages. For a style object, if the style number is the same as the alternate style number, then the blob value is the same for the default and non-default language. Otherwise, the style has a different blob value in the non-default language, and the blob value can be found through G3E_ALTERNATESNO. This table contains all entries in all non-default language sub-tables for [G3E_STYLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA). None of these fields are localized because they represent the localized metadata. 
An entry must exist in [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) for the table. The table is not published.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SLMNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_SNO  |  Identifier for the style.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LCID  |  Value of the locale identifier found in [G3E_METADATALANGUAGE.G3E_LCID](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/J_swCLicivDPWmDMyDJePQ) for this particular instance.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2(4)  |   |  
|  G3E_ALTERNATESNO  |  Row identifier for the table for the style that has a different blob value in the language sub- table. If the blob value in the sub- table is the same as the value in G3E_STYLE, G3E_ALTERNATESNO has the same value as G3E_SNO.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_PLOTNAME  |  Descriptive name found in G3E_STYLE_NNNN.G3E_USERNAME  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2(240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_TEXTSTYLE (Text Style Table)
Table name: G3E_TEXTSTYLE 
The table corresponds to the information in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_VALUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA) and describes how a text style is defined. There is one row for each style definition. 
Because these fields represent the localized metadata, none of them are localized.
An entry must exist in [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) for the table and its optimized table to include this metadata in the published cache. The optimized table is G3E_TEXTSTYLEFONT_OPTABLE. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256782?tocId=sXInmbf3aGetV2EUQrqPiA) All fonts must be installed on the publish server during metadata publish.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SNO  |  Identifier for the style. This value is copied from the G3E_STYLE table. You cannot edit this value.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name found in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_COLOR  |  RGB value for the color of the text.  -3 = The style color is the same as the background color. Setting this value to -3 might be useful in the case where you want the text box to have a specific color, but want the actual text in the background color. This creates the necessary contrast to see the actual text   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TRANSLUCENCY  |  The translucency applied to the actual text of a style. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null is interpreted to be 0. A value of 0 means that the text is opaque, that is nothing is visible behind it. A value of 100 means that the text is invisible, that is everything is visible behind the text.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_FONTBOLD  |  Specifies whether the bold formatting is applied in the text style. Select a value in G3E_FONTBOLD or in [G3E_FONTWEIGHT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA), not both. Using G3E_FONTWEIGHT gives you more choices in font selection.  0 = No bold formatting. 1 = Bold formatting is applied. The G3E_FONTBOLD value is a shorthand for specifying a weight; selecting Bold formatting is applied (1) in Metadata Explorer is generally equivalent to specifying a value of Bold (700) for G3E_FONTWEIGHT.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_FONTITALIC  |  Specifies whether the italic formatting is applied in the text style. 0 = No italic formatting. 1 = Italic formatting is applied.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_FONTNAME  |  Name of the text font.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_FONTSTRIKETHROUGH  |  Specifies whether the strikethrough formatting is applied in the text style. 0 = No strikethrough formatting. 1 = Strikethrough formatting is applied.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_FONTUNDERLINE  |  Specifies whether the underline formatting is applied in the text style. 0 = No underline formatting. 1 = Underline formatting is applied. This value is independent of the underlining style specified by G3E_UNDERLINESNO.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_FONTWEIGHT  |  The weight or boldness of the font. Select a value in [G3E_FONTBOLD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA) or in G3E_FONTWEIGHT, not both. Using G3E_FONTWEIGHT gives you more choices in font selection. The G3E_FONTWEIGHT value is equivalent to the Weight property of the Windows GDI font object. Some True Type fonts support multiple weights, while others do not, although most support a bold weight (700). Therefore, specifying a weight value other than normal (400) may or may not have an effect.  This value can be any integer between 0- 1000. The following are typical values and their meanings:  0 = Defaulted by the font implementation 100 = Thin 200 = Extra light 300 = Light 400 = Normal 500 = Medium 600 = Semi-bold (also known as demi-bold) 700 = Bold 800 = Extra bold (also known as ultra-bold) 900 = Black  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_SIZE  |  Text size in points.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOX  |  Specifies whether a text box is to be displayed. 0 = No text box is displayed. 1 = Text box is displayed before drawing the text.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXFILLCOLOR  |  Specifies the RGB value of the fill color used when the text box is displayed (G3E_TEXTBOX = 1). Using this option provides a masking of any previously drawn graphics which may appear under the text.  -3 = The text box fill color is the same as the map view background color. This value corresponds to the column G3E_AREASTYLE.G3E_FORECOLOR  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number( 9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXFILLTRANSLUCENCY  |  The translucency applied to the background fill for the area style of the text box surrounding the text. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null is interpreted to be 0. A value of 0 means that the background fill of the text box is opaque, that is nothing is visible behind it. A value of 100 means that the background fill is invisible, that is everything is visible behind the fill area of the text box.  0 = Typical value to mask features behind the text.  100 = Typical value to put a frame around the text without masking.  To partially obscure features, set to an intermediate value.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXFILLTYPE  |  The type of fill pattern to be applied when the text box is displayed. The specified pattern is displayed using the text box fill color parameter.  0 = Fill solid. No hatching pattern. 1 = Vertical hatch. 2 = Horizontal hatch. 3 = Diagonal hatch, downward left to right. 4 = Diagonal hatch, upward left to right. 5 = Cross hatch. 6 = Diagonal cross hatch.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXHATCHCOLOR  |  The color for any hatching specified by this style. This corresponds to the column G3E_AREASTYLE.G3E_FORECOLOR   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXHATCHTRANSLUCENCY  |  The translucency applied to the foreground fill for the area style of the text box surrounding the text. This translucency is applied to any hatch pattern required for the style. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null is interpreted to be 0. A value of 0 means that the hatching is opaque, that is, nothing is visible behind it. A value of 100 means that any hatching is invisible, that is everything is visible behind any hatching.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXFRAME  |  When the text box is displayed (G3E_TEXTBOX = 1), this value controls the display of the text box frame (boundary of the text box).  0 = Do not display the frame. 1 = Display the frame.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXFRAMECOLOR  |  When the text box is displayed and the text box frame is On, this parameter defines the RGB color value to be used during the display of the frame.  This value corresponds to the column G3E_AREASTYLE.G3E_FORECOLOR.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXFRAMETRANSLUCENCY  |  The translucency applied to the boundary (or border or frame) for the area style of the text box surrounding the text. This translucency is applied to the boundary required for the text style. The legal values can be from 0 to 100 or Null. Null is interpreted to be 0. A value of 0 means that the boundary is opaque, that is, nothing is visible behind it. A value of 100 means that any boundary is invisible, that is, everything is visible behind any boundary.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_TEXTBOXFRAMEWIDTH  |  When the text box is displayed and the text box frame display is On, this parameter specifies the width of the line of the frame in points.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_PLOTREDLINE  |  Indicates whether this style should appear in the plotting style control list. The value is found in [G3E_STYLE.G3E_PLOTREDLINE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA).  0 = The style is not available in plotting redlines. 1 = The style is available in plotting redlines.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_JUSTIFICATION  |  Indicates the position of the text within the text box. 1 = Justification left. 2 = Justification center. 3 = Justification right. 4 = Justification alignment.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number(5,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_UNDERLINESNO  |  Identifier for the line style used as the text underline. This value is independent of the value in G3E_FONTUNDERLINE.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number(9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LEFTTEXTBOXOFFSET  |  Value in points for the left offset from the text box. When the text box display is on, this parameter defines the left offset of the box relative to the minimum bounding rectangle of the text characters being displayed.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_RIGHTTEXTBOXOFFSET  |  Value in points for the right offset from the text box. When the text box display is on, this parameter defines the right offset of the box relative to the minimum bounding rectangle of the text characters being displayed.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_TOPTEXTBOXOFFSET  |  Value in points for the top offset from the text box. When the text box display is on, this parameter defines the top offset of the box relative to the minimum bounding rectangle of the text characters being displayed.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_BOTTOMTEXTBOXOFFSET  |  Value in points for the bottom offset from the text box. When the text box display is on, this parameter defines the bottom offset of the box relative to the minimum bounding rectangle of the text characters being displayed.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number  |   |  
|  G3E_STYLEUNITS  |  Specifies how the various "size" properties of styles (size, offset, width, and so forth) are interpreted.  1 = The style is scale dependent. The appearance of the components that use the style to draw vary based on the current zoom scale.  3 = The style is scale independent. The appearance of the components that use the style to draw are always the same regardless of the zoom scale.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

## Metadata Administration Tables

### G3E_COMMANDDEPENDENCY (Command Dependency Table)
Table name: G3E_COMMANDDEPENDENCY 
Contains information necessary to support dynamic metadata edits. This table is referenced in the [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) for publishing. The table is used to define how each command or logical functional area uses the optimized table definitions. Because metadata is managed only in the default language, the functional group names are not localized. The contents of this table are provided by Hexagon. Do not add records to this table or delete records from it.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Name of the command or logical functional group.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_OTSNO  |  Index into the set of optimized tables used by this command or logical group. If not Null at a non-leaf level, these tables must be updated for any of the subentries, even if this level is not selected. This field is a foreign key to [G3E_OPTABLESET.G3E_OTSNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qRTCgelWutUCWwW5QNpSAA).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LEVEL  |  Level of the item in the tree. One is a root or top level.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LEAFINDICATOR  |  Indicates if this entry is a leaf in the tree. 0 = The command or logical functional group can be expanded further. 1 = The command or logical functional group cannot be expanded further. G3E_OTSNO must be populated   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  Indicates the order of the complete tree layout to support publishing the tree in order.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_CONFIGURATIONS (Configurations of Subsets and Coordinate Systems Table)
Table name:  G3E_CONFIGURATIONS 
Maps configurations to their regions and published coordinate systems.
[Regional subsetting](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pojLH5IuIFXzS9HmohODXQ) lets you publish models covering a large geographic extent in sections of the service territory into different coordinate systems. The G3E_CONFIGURATIONS table lets you define subset configurations which are composed of specific regions and published in specific coordinate systems.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_CONFNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CONFIGURATIONNAME  |  Name of a Configuration. Must be a reference to [G3E_DATACONNECTION.G3E_LOCATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XVSORnBdhQjIxL9aNJ0TPw). The configuration name is repeated in this table if the configuration has multiple regions.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_REGIONNAME  |  The name of a region used to filter tables that are subsetted as part of this configuration. G3E_REGIONNAME must reference a value of the region name attribute of the feature in the [G3E_WORKMGMT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KME_1L76HZEDZ5lzihAbeQ) table of the region. This name cannot contain commas or semicolons.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_CSNAME  |  Name of the coordinate system in which this configuration should be published. G3E_CSNAME must reference the NAME column in the [GCOORDSYSTEMTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XwuKVI_U5ObpDp0hIkR1tA) table. This means that configuration names in the CCM file come from the G3E_DATACONNECTION table. This field is joined to the primary language definition. Use the Define Coordinate System command to create a new coordinate system. If this column is Null, there is no transformation during publish.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (100)  |   |  
|  G3E_OGCCRSNAME  |  Used to map the [CRS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256972?tocId=hmkJnb6545UMNJdfEZGpBA) string associated with the coordinate system of the given configuration. This normally stores the corresponding [EPSG](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256972?tocId=hmkJnb6545UMNJdfEZGpBA) string (example: EPSG:4326) that the configuration represents.  Coordinate Reference System. This is an (Open Geospatial Consortium) OGC-specific terminology used to define the coordinate system.  European Petroleum Survey Group is an organization that maintains a data set of coordinate reference systems and coordinate transformation which may be global, regional, national, or local in its application. Each of these coordinate reference systems have a code, which is known as EPSG code. By mapping your coordinate system configuration to one of these named definitions, your data can be shared through web services and appropriately matched to a location on the earth to align properly with other data.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  No  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_DATASUPPORT (Data Support Table)
Table name:  G3E_DATASUPPORT 
The G3E_DATASUPPORT table is used by the database server procedures to create synonyms and grant appropriate privileges. It is also used by the PublishSubset process to determine what database objects to include in the published subset database that are not identifiable in other metadata tables. 
This table contains the names of database tables, views, sequences, packages, procedures, functions, or types. The LTT_ROLE package uses the whole list to create synonyms and grant privileges to the appropriate roles of users within the environment.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

|  G3E_TABLE  |  Name of the database object in uppercase letters (table, view, sequence, package, procedure, function, type) that is to be processed. The foreign key is logical to underlying database table/view, sequence, or package/procedure/function or type.  The foreign Key must be a table in the database.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_COPYDATA  |  Boolean to indicate if the table data should be included in a published subset, including contents, or if only the table structure should be created.  0 = Do not include the table contents in a published subset 1 = Include the contents during replication  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_GRANTPRIVILEGE  |  A semicolon- separated list of privileges applicable to this object. If more than one set of privileges is specified, G3E_GRANTROLE must contain a matching set of roles.  If this field is left Null, the following privileges are granted: Tables/views: select, insert, update,delete  
Sequences: select  
Packages/Procedures/Functions or types: execute   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_GRANTROLE  |  A semicolon- separated list of roles applicable to this object. If more than one set of roles is specified, G3E_GRANTPRIVILEGE must be a matching set of privileges.   
 |  Example In this example, The DESIGNER, FINANCE, and MARKETING roles have the Select and Update privileges. The ADMINISTRATOR role has the Select, Insert, Delete, and Update privileges.  G3E_GRANTPRIVILEGE entry: SELECT,UPDATE;SELECT,INSERT,DELETE,UPDATE; G3E_ROLE entry: DESIGNER,FINANCE,MARKETING;ADMINISTRATOR; If this field is left Null, the following roles are granted: Tables/Views: public Sequences: public Packages/Procedures/Functions/Types: public  |  
| --- |  
|  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_OBJECTTYPE  |  Type of the database object. This is used by the Publish Subset process. For database objects that exist in the local database, this is the USER_OBJECTS.OBJECT_TYPE value. This field should be set to SYNONYM for tables/views from a remote database such as STORMS. The object is not replicated if this field is not populated. The value in this field should be uppercase.  These are the valid values for objects in the local database: TABLE SEQUENCE VIEW PACKAGE PROCEDURE FUNCTION TYPE  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (18)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

Presented as part of the [Review Metadata Changes](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1fHOxa1K2OT_BlU4YSWPrw) dialog box to show what has been deleted. The actual value is a combination of the original field name and the value, <FieldName>=<Value>. In the cases where one field is insufficient to indicate uniqueness, additional field and/or value pairs are appended to the string.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |

### G3E_FIELDFORMAT (Field Formats Table)
