### G3E_GENERALPARAMETER (General Parameter Table)

#### BreakModelType Values
|  Value  |  Model Type  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  1  |  DetailAsContinuation  |  Detail linear components represent a continuation of their geographic counterparts. For instance, a primary conductor can run from a pole outside a substation to a structure inside the substation. This is one continuous piece of conductor, but it is represented by a geographic linear and a detail linear. Thus, the detail linear component is a continuation of the geographic.   |  
|  2  |  DetailAsDualRepresentation  |  Detail linear components offer another view of the same linear in the geographic view. For instance, a geographic linear component may be placed from a fuse to a switch in the geographic window within a vault. A detail window depicting this vault might have detail components for the same switch, fuse, and primary conductor linear component. This conductor is not a continuation, but is another representation of the same conductor in the geographic window.   |  
|  3  |  DetailAsDualRepresentationWithAlternateGeoRepresentation  |  This parameter is the same as the DetailAsDualRepresentation parameter with the addition of alternate geographic components. This value should be used if the same conductor is represented in its entirety in geographic, detail, and alternate geographic windows.   |

#### G3E_GENERALPARAMETER.G3E_NAME Values
When you change a value in G3E_GENERALPARAMETER.G3E_NAME, either [refresh the metadata in Metadata Explorer](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/BjKfaBm1ZdzY9Gs0KVlKVQ) or [republish metadata](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/liGwSHeRBi9gFccnbK5oiQ). The parameters that require a full publish are noted in this table.   
|  Parameter Name  |  Definition  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  3DMeasurementCalculation  |  This flag indicates whether the Linearlabel and CalculateLength Functional Interfaces are measured in 3D or in 2D. If set to 1, they are measured in 3D. If set to 0, then they are measured in 2D. The Placement Length Display dialog box and the Component Length dialog box honor this settings. 3D measurement only applies to length calculations and not angles or area. The default value is zero.   |  
|  3DSupport  |  This flag indicates whether 3D functionality is enabled or disabled. It has the highest precedence and has final control on all the new 3D operations. If set to 1, all of the 3D functionality is enabled. If set to 0, all of the 3D functionality is disabled. The default value is zero.   |  
|  AdjustRelationshipsInEditTool  |  Determines the behavior of both the [Reestablish Relationships On/Off button](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7Q2j5lebgt_o2gL~4hs6Zw) on the Edit Tool and the Reestablish Relationships checkbox on the Edit Geometry command's context menu. This flag indicates whether the software automatically updates relationships or maintains the existing relationships after an edit. If the setting is Off, relationships are not updated. 
  * UserOn—The setting is On and enabled. Relationships are reevaluated at the end of an edit. All current metadata candidates and offsets are honored. This behavior is the default. 
  * UserOff—The setting is Off and enabled. Relationships are not processed. The user can change press the button so that relationships reevaluate at the end of the edit. 
  * NoChange—The setting is Off and disabled. Relationships are not processed for geometry edits. Component deletion is honored. The user cannot change the setting. 
  * AlwaysChange—The setting is On and disabled. Relationships are always reestablished for all geometry edits. Component deletion is honored. The user cannot change the setting. 

 |  
|  AllConfigurations  |  Specifies the G3E_DATACONNECTION.G3E_LOCATION that is referenced from [G3E_CONFIGURATIONS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/vWwv39pUkFaofbuloNJ4lQ) that contains all of the regions in a subset database. If you have not implemented regional subsetting, this value should be the name of the production data connection.   |  
|  AllowNullsInFilteredPicklists  |  Sets a flag to allow Null values to be included as part of the field- value filtered picklists. If False (0), a Null value in one of the fields causes the filter to be ignored such that all values are seen. If True (-1), a Null value still executes the filter. However, it is expected that the metadata for these filters be updated so the queries produce the expected rows. The following is an example of the filter without Null support:  (#1001=REF_MATERIAL) & (#1002=REF_DIAMETER) This is an example of the filter that supports Nulls in picklist processing.  (#1001=REF_MATERIAL | #1001 IS Null) & (#1002=REF_DIAMETER | #1002 IS Null) Set these filters in G3E_TABATTRIBUTE.G3E_FIELDVALUEFILTER. Using the IS NULL clause changes the behavior so that if attribute 1001 or 1002 has a Null value it acts as a wildcard value in the picklist filter.  If your database has picklist filters that were coded to use special initial values to act as wildcards, modify those filters to read as indicated above. Change the default values for those attributes to Null.   |  
|  AOIMultiThreshold  |  Like AOIThreshold defined for Ad Hoc query command, this parameter restricts the user from executing queries against the database that potentially return more than the specified number of rows. The G3E_AOIOverwriteThreshold parameter applies here as well. A user who has the role associated with this parameter, may continue the execution of the query, even if the threshold check has been exceeded.   |  
|  AOIOverwriteThreshold  |  Allows overwriting of the threshold value. When the value is False (0), the command displays a message when the number of features within Area of Interest process exceeds the threshold and terminates processing. When the value is True (-1), the command displays a message box, and the user is asked to proceed with the query or terminate. The AOIOVERWRITETHRESHOLD role is checked to determine if the user has the permission to override the AOIOverwriteThreshold parameter used in [spatial](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5Tg7tsVwYH6ZVnn_t6NlEw) and [ad hoc](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/yBDnFnvBk8U5lYAlkeXHFQ) queries.   |  
|  AOIThreshold  |  The maximum number of allowable feature instances to process. This value is compared to the number of features returned using a spatial query with the Active Area of Interest as the filter.   |  
|  AttachDDCDisplayScaleRange  |  Specifies the display scale range for a DDC file attached using Attach Vector Data. The format for this parameter is: <Minimum Display Scale>:<Maximum Display Scale>. The DDC file content is displayed only when the display scale is between the <Minimum Display Scale> and <Maximum Display Scale> values. The default value for this parameter is 1:10000. You can use the Display Scale ON/OFF to control the display of the file content both at the file and layer level.   |  
|  AttachRasterComponentNumber  |  Specifies the G3E_CNO for all attached raster files. This number should not correspond to a real component in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767.   |  
|  AttachRasterFeatureNumber  |  Specifies the G3E_FNO for all attached raster files. This number should not correspond to a real feature in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767.   |  
|  AutoCADBackdropAreaThreshold  |  Specifies the maximum area of the backdrop in square meters that can be displayed without distortion. This is always greater than or equal to zero. If the area of the AutoCAD or MicroStation file that is being attached is greater than the value mentioned in this parameter, the software displays a warning message to the user. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  AutoCADComponentNumber  |  Applicable for attaching both native (AutoCAD and MicroStation) and DDC files (the source format is DDC, and requires Export configuration and registration). Specifies the G3E_CNO value to populate in the backdrop feature recordset for ad hoc vector files. This number should not correspond to a real component in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  AutoCADFeatureNumber  |  Applicable for attaching both native (AutoCAD and MicroStation) and DDC files (the source format is DDC, and requires Export configuration and registration). Specifies the G3E_FNO value to populate in the backdrop feature recordset for ad hoc vector files. This number should not correspond to a real feature in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  AutoCADBackdropStyleRule and AutoCADBackdropTempStyleRule  |  Applicable for attaching DDC files only (source format in Attach Vector Data command is DDC). Specifies the G3E_SRNO value to use to create the default style object. The style specified here overrides the original backdrop element styles. The style rule specified in AutoCADBackdropStyleRule is used to display the backdrop graphics in the map window. The style rule specified in AutoCADBackdropTempStyleRule is used to display the backdrop graphics in temporary (new) map window only at the time of registration. AutoCADBackdropTempStyleRule specification is optional; if not specified, the style rule value for AutoCADBackdropStyleRule is used for a temporary map window at the time of registration. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  AverageSymbolSize  |  Used by relationship services. The AverageSymbolSize parameter defines the length of an average point symbol. This value is used by relationship services to define the default maximum offset range between related features and control the area searched for relationship candidates. This value is specified in database units. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  BingMapsKey  |  Specifies the Bing Maps Key used for adding consumer maps as backdrops to feature information.  You must have a valid license with Bing Maps to use this feature. [Bing Maps TOU](http://aka.ms/enduserembeddedmapstou)  |  
|  [BreakModelType](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/G6TIC88PByWIyJ6o0l8P1g)  |  Used by the break linear service within relationship processing. The BreakModelType parameter describes the use of detail linear components so that the break software can properly assign these components to the features resulting from the break. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  CatalogRelationship  |  Number of an ownership relationship that should be used to traverse the entries in this catalog table. The [G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA) must be three (3) for this particular G3E_RNO. Only one relationship can be used within catalog data processing.   |  
|  CatalogSchemaOwner  |  Name of the owner of the catalog data tables. The administrator must grant all users select permissions on this table. These tables are the "E$" tables that match the facility data model.   |  
|  CheckGeometryConflicts  |  This parameter specifies whether to check if a geometry has been posted by another user when you attempt to edit it.  If the value is 1, check if the geometry has been posted when editing a feature. If the value is 0, do not check if the geometry has been posted when editing a feature.   |  
|  CheckZ  |  If the value is 0, the geometries with an out of range Z value display in the map window  If the value is 1, any geometries with an out of range Z value do not display in the map window.   |  
|  ConcurrentEditDetection  |  This parameter specifies whether [Concurrent Edits](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/h9ycJbgkDSiGTEKS0q5XGg) are automatically detected when a user attempts to edit a feature.  If the value is 1, the Job pane is highlighted red if concurrent edits are detected.  If the value is 0, concurrent edits are not automatically detected.  |  
|  CreateConstraintScript  |  This parameter specifies the path and name of the Oracle SQL script that contains the statements to create database constraints for all the user- defined metadata tables that are populated in the [G3E_ANALYSIS.G3E_TABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/2bLFqVwB0MTsyBVENDw8bg) field or the G3E_TABLE field of the tables specified in G3E_ANALYSIS.G3E_TABLE. For example, the G3E_METADATASUPPORT table is populated in G3E_ANALYSIS.G3E_TABLE. So, you should include the constraint creation for any user-defined metadata table that is populated in G3E_METADATASUPPORT.G3E_TABLE in the SQL script.  The Upgrade Wizard drops all the constraints on any user-defined metadata table that is not delivered with NetWorks Core. The script provides a way for the Upgrade Wizard to reinstall constraints for user-defined tables. You must specify the full path to the SQL script, for example, c:\temp\createConstraints.sql.  The following is the format of the SQL script: SQL> whenever sqlerror exit -1  
whenever oserror exit -1  
spool <LogFilePath>\createConstraints.log <constraint creation SQL statements>  
spool off  
exit;  |  
|  CustomCommandAutoStartArgument  |  Specifies a string that is made available to the custom command defined in the CustomCommandAutoStartCCNO parameter. If the command expects no arguments, this parameter should be set to 0. In this case, no entry is added to the [IGTApplication](Ms-its:Intergraph.GTechnology.Desktop.API.Reference.chm::/html/T_Intergraph_GTechnology_API_IGTApplication.htm) properties collection. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  CustomCommandAutoStartCCNO  |  Specifies the G3E_CUSTOMCOMMAND.G3E_CCNO value that represents the custom command that is to be automatically started when a connection is made in the HxGN NetWorks Core Designer/Analyst HxGN NetWorks Core | Designer/Analyst application. If the value for the parameter is 0, no custom command is automatically started. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  CustomCommandIconDRXFile  |  Specifies the location and name of the resource file that contains icons for use with the Custom Commands menus and toolbars. If not specified or not found, default icons are used. The icon file contains 16-bit color bitmaps. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  DataGridMaximum  |  The maximum number of rows that can be displayed on the data table grids. Commands such as Trace, Spatial Analysis Query, Discard Jobs by Feature ID, and so forth, use the data table grids to display read-only results. The default value is 500 for this parameter. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  DatabaseLocalDirectory  |  References an Oracle directory, G3E_DATABASELOCALDIRECTORY pointing to a physical folder on the database host system. Used by NetWorks Core database packages to write files to.   |  
|  DatabaseUNCDirectory  |  Defines a UNC (Universal Naming Convention) path to the directory on the database server defined in the DatabaseLocalDirectory parameter  The specified folder must be shared. If the folder is not shared, even though the folder might be on the same system on which you are running NetWorks Core, you get a path/file access error  When your database resides on a UNIX operating system, the DatabaseUNCDirectory allows UNIX machines to share drives through the UNC conventions. See [Publishing Metadata for UNIX](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/cHx4IsuBAb1dIMLX0Fzypw) for further information.   |  
|  DefaultZ  |  Specifies the initial height value in meters displayed in the Precision Coordinate control. It is the default height value used when placing features. The default value is zero. If the value is non-zero, it should be in range between "MinZ" and "MaxZ" values.   |  
|  DetailGridXOrigin  |  Specifies the X coordinate value that identifies the upper-left corner of the detail grid. This parameter is associated with the [IDBasedGeoLocation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AThZ6ddtle5cxf6vE5IjOg) method of choosing the correct detail positioning algorithm.   |  
|  DetailGridYOrigin  |  Specifies the Y coordinate value that identifies the upper-left corner of the detail grid. This parameter is associated with the [IDBasedGeoLocation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AThZ6ddtle5cxf6vE5IjOg) method of choosing the correct detail positioning algorithm.   |  
|  DetailGridXOffset  |  Specifies the width or distance on the X-axis of the grid that defines a detail area. This value is interpreted as units of the coordinate system associated with the data (meters, feet, and so forth). This parameter is associated with the [IDBasedGeoLocation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AThZ6ddtle5cxf6vE5IjOg) method of choosing the correct detail positioning algorithm.   |  
|  DetailGridYOffset  |  Specifies the height or distance on the Y-axis of the grid that defines a detail area. This value is interpreted as units of the coordinate system associated with the data (meters, feet, and so forth).  These values should be sized such that, for most occurrences, data are not drawn outside of this area for a given detail area. The values should also be sized such that the total grid does not exceed the size of the design plane (coordinate range) based on the specified origin. This parameter is associated with the [IDBasedGeoLocation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AThZ6ddtle5cxf6vE5IjOg) method of choosing the correct detail positioning algorithm.   |  
|  DetailWindowSizing  |  Specifies the size and location for new detail windows.
  * RelativeToActiveWindow – New detail window size and location is relative to the active window (if it is a map window). The new detail window is sized to 80% of the active window while maintaining the aspect ratio of the detail's extents. 
  * Default – New detail window is created with the default size and location determined by the extents of the application. 

 |  
|  EditCommonAttributesThreshold  |  Limits the number of features a user can select for editing common attributes. This parameter limits memory usage by limiting the number of features being edited. If users select more features than is allowed by the value in this parameter, the Edit > Features > Edit Common Attributes command informs the user of the following: 
  * How many features they have selected and that the number exceeds the value in the parameter 
  * To select fewer features than the threshold value
  * To restart Edit Common Attributes. 

The default for s 100.  |  
|  EditToolThreshold  |  The maximum number of allowable feature instances to process during the Edit Tool command operations. If users select more features than is allowed by the value in this parameter, the Edit Tool command informs the user of the following: 
  * How many features they have selected and that the number exceeds the value in the parameter 
  * To select fewer features than the threshold value
  * To restart the Edit Tool. 

The default for s 100.  |  
|  EditToolOverrideThreshold  |  Sets a flag to allow overriding of the Edit Tool threshold value. When value is False (0), the command displays a message if number of features selected to process exceeds the threshold and terminates processing. When the value is True (-1), the command displays a message box and the user must choose to proceed with the edit or terminate.   |  
|  EnforceFIGeneratedDetailName  |  Forces the detail name to remain as it was generated by the functional interface or lets the user adjust it after it was generated. If this parameter is set to 1, the dialog displays the detail name generated by the FI in a disabled text box (the user is not allowed to change it). If this parameter is set to 0, the dialog displays the detail name generated by the FI as a proposed default, and the user is allowed to edit the detail name. Default value is 0.   |  
|  FindCountThreshold  |  Maximum number of features/components to report in the Find command user interface for the results of a find operation. If a find operation returns more rows than this, the user is warned and, based on the setting of G3E_FindOverwriteThreshold in G3E_ROLEASSOCIATION.G3E_OBJECTCONTROL, is allowed to continue or is stopped. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  ForceLegendUpdate  |  Updates the out-of-date legends in a workspace. Available values are 0 and 1. If set to 1, all the out-of-date legends in a workspace are updated automatically. If set to 0, the "Replace Legend" dialog is displayed and the user can choose whether to update or discard the out-of-date legends. The default setting is 0.   |  
|  G3E_SCHEMAOWNER  |  The name of the schema associated with facility and reference tables. Any table found in G3E_COMPONENT or G3E_PICKLIST and any G3E_*_OPTABLE is prepended with this schema owner. This parameter is used by the Publish Subset utility and Field Review and enables multiple users to publish subsets without logging in as the schema owner. It is also used by metadata publishing to publish without logging in as the schema owner, such as an OS-authenticated user.   |  
|  GeocodingStyleID  |  Specifies the G3E_POINTSTYLE.G3E_SNO value used to create the temporary point geometries for the Geocode From Spreadsheet command. The default value is -1.  Before anyone can use this command, you must specify a style number in this field so users can see the temporary geometry they are placing.   |  
|  GetNextLevelOfLicense  |  Sets a flag to indicate the acceptable use of higher-level license when the appropriate license is not available. When the value is False (0), the software does not request a higher-level license. When the value is True (-1), the software attempts to retrieve a higher- level license until one is available or until the product list is exhausted. The default is False (0).   |  
|  GoogleMapsAPIKey  |  Specifies the Google Maps Platform API Key used for adding consumer maps as backdrops to feature information and for displaying Google Street View.  ![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265338) The Maps Static API and the Maps JavaScript API must be enabled for the given API Key.  ![Warning](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265338) You must have a valid Google Maps Platform license to use these features.   |  
|  GoogleMapsClientID  |  Specifies the Google Maps for Work Client ID used for adding consumer maps as backdrops to feature information and for displaying Google Street View.  ![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265338) A Google Maps Client ID can only be used by existing Google Premium Plan customers or Premium Plan customers who have migrated their account to the new Google Maps Platform.  You must have a valid license with Google Maps to use these features.  |  
|  GoogleMapsCryptoKey  |  Specifies the Google Maps for Work Client CryptoKey used for adding consumer maps as backdrops to feature information.  You must have a valid license with Google Maps to use this feature.  |  
|  GoogleMapsMaxSize  |  Specifies the maximum image size you can retrieve with your Google Maps account. Applies to Google map images used as a backdrop.  For current Google Premium customers and previous Google Premium customers who have migrated their accounts to the new Google Maps Platform, the maximum size is 2048 (maximum image size is 2048 x 2048). The maximum size for new Google Maps Platform customers is 640 (maximum image size is 640 x 640).   |  
|  GrantPrivilegeScriptName  |  Specifies the name of a user-defined SQL file to be run as the final step of a metadata publish. The path of this file must by specified in FileUNCPaths file under <OTHERPATHS>. Typically the SQL file contains statements to grant privileges to user-defined database objects, such as packages or procedures. If a user-defined package or procedure is dependent on an OPTABLE defined by the product, the privileges for the object may have been revoked as a result of publish recreating the OPTABLE. This parameter provides a means for the privileges to be automatically regranted as part of the metadata publishing process.   |  
|  IgnoreSubsettingForLTT  |  Controls the construction of the LTT views and the execution of the LTT triggers. This entry must exist in the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table: 
  * If it does not exist, the creation of the LTT triggers raises an error.
  * If the value associated with the entry is 0 and a subset attribute is configured in the data model, the LTT views are subsetted. 
  * If the value associated with the entry is 1, the LTT views do not honor subsetting even if there is a subset attribute configured in the data model. 

An error is raised if a value other than 0 or 1 value is specified. If you change this parameter, you need to recreate the LTT views and LTT triggers. To create the LTT views over the B$ tables, type the following using a SQL editor:  SQL> execute CREATE_VIEWS.CREATE_ALL_LTT_VIEWS; To install the LTT triggers on the LTT tables, type the following using a SQL editor: SQL> execute CREATE_TRIGGERS.CREATE_ALL_LTT_TRIGGERS;  |  
|  LifeCycleActiveState  |  Indicates the life cycle number of the active state. It must be one of the G3E_LIFECYCLE.G3E_LCNO. This parameter is only required in the Pipeline data model. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  LookForSynthesizedComponent  |  Allows the software to find synthesized components in the data and display the appropriate information in the Feature Explorer Geometry tab. If the value is set to 1, the software iterates through all the synthesized component views and displays the geometry information for the FID. The default is 0.   |  
|  MarkFeaturesThreshold  |  Optional general parameter which can be used to limit the maximum selected features the Mark Features command will process. Parameter type is integer.If not specified, the command will use the default value of 100.   |  
|  MaxFieldsInMetadataCache  |  Controls the size of a metadata cache for the filtered recordsets that are fetched from the published DDC files. Used to help reduction of memory consumption. This field is reserved for the Product Center. Do not edit it.   |  
|  MaxZ MinZ  |  These parameters are user defined and represent the valid z value range in meters. MinZ, MaxZ, and Result
  * NONE, Defined, Value must be less than or equal to MaxZ.
  * Defined, NONE, Value must be greater than or equal to MInZ.
  * Defined, Defined, Value must be greater than or equal to MInZ and less than or equal to MaxZ. 
  * NONE, NONE, All values are valid.

 |  
|  MoveRelatedRepeatingLocTol  |  Specifies the distance in units of the published data to use to find the nearest related component occurrences to move or stretch when processing the move of related features. This only applies when the triggering component is repeating.   |  
|  OffsetValidationPriority  |  Default priority error used in processing of node-edge connectivity, ownership, and many-to-many ownership when the feature pair is related but geographically farther away than their specified limit. The priority can also be specified per pair of features. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  NullDerivedAttrWhenNotUnique  |  Sets a flag indicating that the derived attributes should be set to Null when a distinct (single row) match is not found based on the triggering attributes. If False (0), any value stored in the derived attribute is left even if it does not match the associated picklist subset of the triggering attribute. If True (-1), a Null value is assigned to the derived attribute. The default is True (-1) for this parameter.   |  
|  PDFLayersVsTranslucency  |  Not used  |  
|  PicklistDisplayMaximum  |  The maximum number of values that can be displayed when user selects the drop-down list for an attribute that has a picklist defined. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767. The default value is 32767. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  PickQuickMaxLabelLength  |  Specifies the maximum length of an item label. The full label is still available using tooltips. The default value is -1, which indicates that no maximum size is enforced.   |  
|  PlacementSelectionIconDRXFile  |  Specifies the name of the resource file that contains [icons](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/xGgxn7TZS~Le32Qi7DBg6w) for use in the New Feature control tree and toolbar and the temporary geometry controls. If not specified or not found, default icons are used. The locations listed in the <OtherPaths> section of the FileUNCPaths file are searched for the file.  To use icons from this file, reference the appropriate G3E_ICONORDINAL file in the [G3E_PLACEMENTSELECTION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/CER72g2Ys4bpQ9~jNI78Ng) or [G3E_TEMPORARYGEOMETRYPLACEMENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/__D0mhsXjD55Yr6slEiMYg) definition. The ordinal is 1-based.  The icon file must have the small (16x16) icons. The software ignores other resolutions (32x32).  A [sample](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/ir60WAdXWAgsWIyJlk13JA) (very general and non-feature-specific) .DRX file with icons is located in \GTechnology\program\PlacementIcons.drx. Use this file if you do not like the default icons but have no capability to create your own set of icons.  If you use the [sample icons delivered for temporary geometry](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/4zGWlZmbqI0vhZ1l7qyrLQ) or create your own temporary geometry icons, you must add them to your PlacementSelectionIconDRXFile before they can be used.  You must publish metadata after changing this value.  |  
|  PrimarySchematicsCNO  |  Specifies the G3E_CNO value that is assigned to node and edge schematic geometries. This number should not correspond to a real component or any synthesized component in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  ProjectOrthogonalBaseLineStyleID  |  Specifies the [G3E_LINESTYLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/b3vQwQ~YtLlgn5feW4cuvA).G3E_SNO value to be used to style the baseline geometry. It must be a linear line style. You can specify the color, width, patten, and so forth for the project orthogonal baseline line style. The default value is 0. .   |  
|  PublishSubset  |  Indicates whether this configuration is used with Field Review. This parameter is one of the criteria that tells the system to insert records in the table GDT_TABLEMODLOG upon any change in master facility data.  Values: -1 = Publish Subsets are used, so entries for attribute components are created in GDT_TABLEMODLOG.  0 = Publish Subsets are not used. A change of this parameter has to be followed by running GDOTRIGGERS.Create_GDOTriggers.  |  
|  PublishSubsetNlsNumericCharacters  |  Sets the NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS Oracle parameter value to ., when the publish subset process is running.  This is important because of the following situation. For Oracle columns of type NUMBER, when the precision is null and the scale is null AND the decimal separator is a comma (,), as opposed to a period (.), then the resulting data value in the output SQL Server database may be missing the decimal separator and would not be correct. For example, 3,9 becomes 39. If the decimal separator is a period, then the resulting data value is correct. This has been observed in German operating systems.  The possible values are 0 and .,
  * 0 means that publish subset does not set NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS.
  * ., means that publish subset does set NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS to .,

 |  
|  RasterFileLockingEnabled  |  Indicates whether raster file locking should be turned on for the Erase Raster, Reregister Raster Feature, Edit Tool, and Edit Feature commands. If this parameter is absent or False (0), the raster file locking logic is not exercised. If the value is True (- 1), the raster file locking logic is exercised. When the parameter value is True, users are prevented from editing raster files when they do not have access to the master copy. That is, they do not have access to the path where the file physically resides. The default value is False (0).   |  
|  RedlineComponentNumber  |  Specifies the G3E_CNO value to populate in the redline recordset. Supports tooltip presentation. This number should NOT correspond to a real component in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  RedlineFeatureNumber  |  Specifies the G3E_FNO value to populate in the redline recordset. Supports tooltip presentation. This number should not correspond to a real feature in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  [RedlineStyleRule](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XLXeHxVk9_L92mxDj6RFUw)  |  Specifies the G3E_SRNO value to use to create the default style object. The style overrides from the actual redline elements apply to this object. The important part here is that the base style include the correct line style pattern. The result of the style information like color are retrieved from the redline conversion. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  ReferenceGridMarkerCount  |  The default number of grid markers (∙) per major grid marker (+).  |  
|  ReferenceGridOriginX  |  The default X value from which all grid markers will be offset. This value is interpreted as units of the coordinate system associated with the data (meters, feet, and so forth).   |  
|  ReferenceGridOriginY  |  The default Y value from which all grid markers will be offset. This value is interpreted as units of the coordinate system associated with the data (meters, feet, and so forth).   |  
|  ReferenceGridSpacing  |  The default spacing between grid markers. This value is interpreted as units of the coordinate system associated with the data (meters, feet, and so forth).   |  
|  RemoveUnusedQueries  |  Determines if queries or traces that are removed from the Display Control are removed from the queries collection or retained so the user can redisplay the query or trace.  0=Keep the query/trace in the queries collection even if it is not used on the Display Control.  1=Remove any queries/traces from the queries collection when they are no longer used in the Display Control.  The default is zero. Setting the value to 1 can reduce memory usage.  |  
|  RoleVersion  |  Indicates the version of the roles in the database. It can be any positive integer where higher means newer. You update this value when changing roles. The default value is 1.  This parameter is used by the NetViewer to determine whether the metadata cache needs to be flushed and whether the cached lists of roles need to be updated so both the server and client-side in memory role- filtered metadata caches are not out of date.  NetViewer periodically queries the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER_OPTABLE to react to changes to this variable. If necessary, you can [modify roles for existing users](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/47Xujnav99CDMCFu~ld92Q) without publishing metadata.   |  
|  RRALowRange and  RRAHighRange  |  Specified for the right-reading angle range (low and high). These parameters are used by most software that can rotate text, by the Edit Tool, and by a common adjustment which is used by a number of placement techniques. The software defaults these parameters to 95 and 265, but you can set them to any value for any software that uses them. If the rotation of the text falls between the two values you set, the text is flipped in place (rotated 180 degrees and alignment switched to the other side). To disable RightReadingAngle, reverse the values (set Low to 265 and High to 95). Not defining these parameters does not disable RightReadingAngle. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  SchematicsArtificialEdgeStyleID  |  Specifies the [G3E_LINESTYLE.G3E_SNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/b3vQwQ~YtLlgn5feW4cuvA) value to be used as the default style for artificial edges in schematics. For best results, select a style that differentiates artificial edges from other schematic edges.   |  
|  SecondaryImportDelimiter  |  The character to be used as a delimiter in the SQL*Loader files (.dat files) that are generated by the Data Import utility.   |  
|  SecondaryImportRecordTerminator  |  Specifies a special character as part of the record terminator in a SQL*Loader control (.ctl) file. The special character is automatically followed by a carriage return and linefeed character. The valid special characters are as follows:  ˜ (tilde), ^ (caret), | (pipe), { (opening brace), [ (opening bracket) If you set the value of the SecondaryImportRecordTerminator parameter to None or anything other than the valid special characters, no record terminator is specified in the SQL*Loader control (.ctl) file. Specify different characters for SecondaryImportRecordTerminator and SecondaryImportDelimiter. The record terminator is used only for the SQL*Loader files for the component tables.   |  
|  SecondarySchematicsCNO  |  Specifies the G3E_CNO value that is assigned to label schematic geometries. This number should not correspond to a real component or any synthesized component in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32 767. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  SelectedFeatureHatchPattern  |  Specifies the hatching pattern to be used when highlighting or selecting an area that does not already have one. The possible values are 0 through 6, as follows:  0 = No hatch pattern is shown. Area fills do not participate in highlighting. 1 = Vertical hatch. 2 = Horizontal hatch. 3 = Diagonal hatch, downward left to right. 4 = Diagonal hatch, upward left to right. 5 = Cross hatch. 6 = Diagonal cross hatch. The default is 5.  |  
|  SelectSetDataGridThreshold  |  The maximum number of features that can be highlighted on a map window from the selected items of the data grid. The default value is 500 for this parameter. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  ShowMissingRelativeComponentPrompt  |  Used by the OffsetPointSPT placement technique to control if a message box displays that informs the user that a component is not placed because the component that it is to be placed relative to has not been placed. If this parameter is set to False (0), no message is displayed to the user, and the placement technique fails silently. The default is True (1) for this parameter.   |  
|  StreetsideStyleID  |  Specifies a valid point style, used to indicate the location and heading in the map window during the initial specification and during navigation in Bing Streetside.  If no valid point style is specified (default value of -1), the initial location and heading are indicated in the map window by a dynamic line segment, and locations are indicated by a generic geometry handle (a small square).  To point in the correct direction, the symbol identified in the point style should be oriented to the right when not rotated. For example, ![WindingsRightArrow](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265338) is the Wingdings 3 font. To ensure the symbol is visible at any display scale, use a scale independent style.   |  
|  StreetViewStyleID  |  Specifies a valid point style, used to indicate the location and heading in the map window during the initial specification and during navigation in Google Street View.  If no valid point style is specified (default value of -1), the initial location and heading are indicated in the map window by a dynamic line segment, and locations are indicated by a generic geometry handle (a small square).  To point in the correct direction, the symbol identified in the point style should be oriented to the right when not rotated. For example, ![WindingsRightArrow](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265338) is the Wingdings 3 font. To ensure the symbol is visible at any display scale, use a scale independent style.   |  
|  TemporaryGeometryComponentNumber  |  Specifies the G3E_CNO value to populate in the temporary geometry data recordset. This number should not correspond to a real component in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767.   |  
|  TemporaryGeometryFeatureNumber  |  Specifies the G3E_FNO value to populate in the temporary geometry data recordset. This number should not correspond to a real feature in the data model. This parameter must be a positive number less than or equal to 32767.   |  
|  TraversalANOBehavior  |  When the traversable attribute value of a component is not found in its associated foreign key, domain, or picklist table, this parameter specifies how its component instance is represented in the horizontal dialog tab.  These are valid values: 
  * 1 = An empty row is displayed to represent the component instance containing the traversable attribute value. 
  * 0 = No row is displayed for the component instance containing the traversable attribute value. 

![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265338) This parameter is applicable when a horizontal dialog tab only has traversable attributes.   |  
|  UseAOILIToFilterDetails   |  When the UseAOILIToFilterDetails parameter is enabled, Open Detail Window picks the details from the appropriate list depending on the following data conditions: 
  * The active AOI contains a location identifier attribute and its value is not empty. 
  * The location identifier attribute field exists as part of the published component view of the selected detail referencing feature and the attribute's value is equal to the value of the location identifier attribute of the active AOI. 

When this parameter is disabled or none of the above data conditions are met, Open Detail Window list details that are within the active AOI.  The default value of this parameter is 0 (disabled).  |  
|  UseLegendEntryFilterForQuery  |  This parameter affects Analysis commands that add a query result to the Display Control. It also affects the IGTDisplayControl.AppendQuery method in the public Desktop API.  These are valid values:
  * A value of 1 means that each component view in the query result is further filtered by its corresponding metadata-defined legend entry filter. 
    * The legend associated with each map window or frame where the query result is seen dictates which metadata-defined filters are used. 
    * With this setting, query results do not include extra graphics because all pertinent metadata-defined filters are honored. 
  * A missing parameter or a value of 0 means that each component view in the query result is NOT further filtered, even if it has a corresponding metadata-defined legend entry filter. 
    * This is the default setting.
    * With this setting, query results might include extra graphics if a legend has multiple legend entries that refer to the same component view, but each legend entry has a different metadata-defined filter. 

![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265338) Metadata-defined legend entry filters are specified in each legend definition table. See the "G3E_FILTER" field in the [G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE (Sample Legend Definition Table)](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/37fQRgD9_K5cgp1rZXsMGg) topic.   |  
|  ValidationGroupSize  |  Reduces memory usage for validation. This parameter applies primarily to the following commands: 
  * Tools > Validation > Validate Job Edits
  * Jobs > Post Job Edits
  * Jobs > Post Partial

This parameter tells the validation workflows how many features to validate at a time. It is necessary in high-memory use situations. The optimum value for this parameter depends on the following: 
  * The number of components in the features
  * The number of attributes in the components
  * The number and complexity of the relationships the features are involved in
  * The memory usage of the application as a whole

As a very general rule, Hexagon suggests these values:
  * Very high memory usage applications: 250
  * Normal use applications: 500 (The default is 500.)
  * Low memory use applications: 1000.

 |  
|  ValidationPriority  |  Lets you flag errors in data but still allow the posting of data with these errors. If the error priority from model validation is this value or less, the data does not post. An omission of this entry is the same as an entry of P4. No data are posted with P4 errors. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  ValidationPriorityFilter  |  Lets you filter or reduce the errors presented to the user. If the error priority from model validation is this value or greater, the error is not presented. The omission of this entry is the same as an entry of P5. For example, if you specify P4 for this parameter, the recordset of errors is filtered such that only P1, P2, and P3 errors are presented to the user. You should not make this parameter the same or less than the ValidationPriority parameter. If you do, the user may not be allowed to post and may not see all of the errors. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |  
|  WebServerProxy  |  Specifies the proxy server, if any, you use to access the internet. Lets you use third party licensed information, such as consumer maps.   |  
|  WMSRequestTimeout  |  Specifies the timeout value in milliseconds for URL requests made to a WMS when retrieving the site’s capabilities or images.   |  
|  ZoomFactor  |  Specifies what factor to zoom out after fitting in the Find command. You must publish metadata after changing this value.   |

### G3E_METADATAKEYS (Metadata Keys Table)
Table name: G3E_METADATAKEYS 
Contains information necessary for the publishing of metadata. The records in this table include normalized and optimized metadata tables, keys for the additional XML metadata, picklist tables that need to be published, and entries required for publishing components in RAW format. This table is repopulated when the procedure MG3EPopulateMetadataKeys is called.

|  G3E_TYPE  |  Value of publish mode. The allowable values are METADATA, PICKLIST, DEFAULTFEATURES, and ADDONS.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

It can also be the name of the keys for the additional XML metadata. The entry for the components is named like CNO with the G3E_CNO value as the suffix. Entries must be uppercase.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

### G3E_METADATALANGUAGE (Language Definitions Table)
Table name: G3E_METADATALANGUAGE 
Used by the Metadata subsystem to allow you to define the languages supported for the client operations. This allows the metadata to be localized to the appropriate language. The table must contain one default language and can only have one default language. Other languages should be flagged as non-default. An entry is required in [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) for this table.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MLNO  |  Identifier for the language record.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LCID  |  Value of the language identifier as defined in the Microsoft® Software Developers Kit (SDK) for national language support. This is a four character representation of the hexadecimal value the long integer returned from MAKELANGID. It is a value in the range '0200' to '03FF' for user defined languages. Other values are system defined. The default for English as the system language is '0009'.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (4)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Description of the language for informational purposes only.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_DEFAULT  |  Boolean indicator to specify the base or default language. 0 = Not the default language. 1 = The default language. Only one row can contain a value of 1.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_METADATASUPPORT (Metadata Support Table)
Table name: G3E_METADATASUPPORT 
Supports publishing of the metadata. It is also used to drop the metadata when posting metadata between schemas. Any table referenced in this table is published if there is an entry in the optimized table column. 
Use the G3E_METADATASUPPORT G3E_XMLKEY and G3E_XMLQUERY columns to add customized or project metadata to your model. Use a consistent prefix for your custom metadata table names to distinguish them from the NetWorks Core metadata tables which have a G3E_ prefix.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MSNO  |  Identifier for the metadata support definition.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TABLE  |  The name of the table that describes the metadata information. The field can be Null if G3E_XMLKEY is populated.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE  |  The name of the optimized table that describes the metadata information for publishing. The procedure for performing the optimization must be named like the table with a _PKG suffix.   |  Yes  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_XMLKEY  |  The key for the additional metadata for publishing. This key name must not conflict with any of the other metadata optimized table names in this table or any other optimized tables.   |  Yes  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_XMLQUERY  |  The full SQL needed to publish additional metadata for the key specified in G3E_XMLKEY. The G3E_XMLQUERY cannot be Null if G3E_XMLKEY is specified. These two entries ensure that all necessary views are included in the G3E_METADATAKEYS_OPTABLE for RAW file publishing without requiring each configuration to remember the list of views.   |  Yes  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### G3E_METADATAVERSION (Metadata Version Table)

### G3E_METAEXPLORERNAME (Metadata Explorer Name Table)
Table name: G3E_METAEXPLORERNAME 
Contains a list of names that are displayed to the user in Metadata Explorer. This table is not published in the traditional meaning of the term. A separate standalone executable, [PublishMENames.exe](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/E2W8bt5rdDQ6O0yPsKkNSQ), reads the localized version of this table and loads the information into structures used by Metadata Explorer at runtime. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258503?tocId=Rub7mH~1WDsupW3k49Ixkg) Because this table is used only by the PublishMENames.exe, do not include it in the list of tables that are published. An optimization process is performed to support localization. You can access the optable so that the publishing utility can access the correct locale data. This entails the entry in G3E_DATASUPPORT for the SELECT and SYNONYM privileges. Normally, optimized tables are listed in G3E_METADATASUPPORT, and the optables are constructed and readied for publishing through this list. Even though this table is not published, you must post the normalized table between schemas, so only the normalized table is populated in the [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) table. The optimized table is listed in [G3E_DATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/_ZuCX4G4mblLkZOTURP~6g).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MENID  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number(9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  The type of Metadata Explorer name. This column can be one of the following values: 
  * TreeNodeName
  * QueryNodeName
  * ParameterName
  * DescriptiveNodeName
  * CommandNodeName. 

This field is defined by the product center and should not be modified.  |  No  |  No  |  No  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (20)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPEID  |  A unique value within a type of name. This field is defined by the product center and should not be modified.   |  No  |  No  |  No  |  No  |  No  |  Number (10,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  A string containing the name displayed to the user for this type and identifier.  |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

##### G3E_EXPORTSTYLEx.G3E_CELLNAMEMAP for IGDS
For IGDS (MicroStation) output format, you can specify cell type (point or graphic) for [G3E_EXPORTSTYLEx](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/JxIchzoCk526YrQ0h307Rw).G3E_CELLNAMEMAP in the following syntax: 
CellName[[:]GraphicCellRelativeMode]  
|  Parameter  |  R/O  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  CellName  |  Required for both point and graphic cell types  |  Case-sensitive name of the cell from a cell library  |  
|  :  |  Required only for graphic cells  |  Graphic cell type indicator after CellName specifies that it is a graphic cell type   |  
|  GraphicCellRelativeMode  |  Optional  |  Specifies the relative mode of graphic cell type. Only applicable for graphic cells. Valid values are 0 (graphic cell relative mode is off) and 1 (graphic cell relative mode is on). The default value is 0.   |  
All offset levels should be provided in the seed file, otherwise the cell is skipped. See the IGDS seed file for the cell names and levels. 
For graphic cells, color and fill color information is taken from the cell library, and any values specified in the [G3E_EXPORTSTYLEx](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/JxIchzoCk526YrQ0h307Rw).G3E_COLORMAP and G3E_FILLCOLORMAP fields are ignored. 
For graphic cells with relative mode on, the lowest cell member value is specified in the NetWorks Core metadata field G3E_EXPORTx.G3E_LAYERNAME and must be a level number. 
Example
A graphic cell created on levels 5 and 6 with GraphicCellRelativeMode set to 0 places the cell on levels 5 and 6. A [G3E_EXPORTx.](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/k~4HRxK77SW0c8T2aHMJLg)G3E_LAYERNAME field value of 10 and GraphicCellRelativeMode set to 1 places the cell on levels 10 and 11.

#### G3E_EXPORTx (Export Output List Table)
Table name: G3E_EXPORTx 
Used by the Export interface to determine the views to extract according to the named extraction. Several tables of this format exist. Each table is required to be populated in the [G3E_EXPORTIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/w_3GBp6CrR6DNa_wkMw6Ug) table with G3E_TYPE = 'ExportFormat'. The table must exist before it is populated in the G3E_EXPORTIFACE table. A metadata package named MG3ENetExportUtils is provided with the product to create the table. 
Run the following procedure to create an Export Output List table and its optimized table package: 
SQL> execute MG3ENetExportUtils.CreateExpOutputTableAndPackage ('TableName', 'TableAbbreviation');
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/258154?tocId=a0FpfigFWtX8pO_GRdOqsQ) TableName must be less than or equal to 22 characters, and TableAbbreviation must be less than or equal to 17 characters. 
To recreate the optimized table packages for all Export Output List tables listed in the G3E_EXPORTIFACE table, run this procedure: 
SQL> execute MG3ENetExportUtils.InstallExportOutputPackages;
When text elements are exported, the size of the text is calculated as follows:
"autocad_scale" = SizeInPoints
where
SizeInPoints = size/scale in points [= dSize * FROM_HI_METRICS].
FROM_HI_METRICS is constant [= 0.02834651918918]
dSize is size/scale in hi-metrics [= (dConversion * PaperScale) / DBCSHorizResByGroundDistMagnitude]
where
PaperScale is the value specified by (in following order):
  1. Client ActiveX Property (property overrides metadata)
  2. Metadata (G3E_EXPORTLIST.G3E_PAPERSCALE) (metadata overrides coordinate system)
  3. Database CoordinateSystem Nominal Paper Scale


DBCSHorizResByGroundDistMagnitude value is retrieved from database coordinate system
dConversion = conversion of the PointStyle.Size value from points to units of the database   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_EFNO  |  Unique number for the row.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_VNO  |  View number for the component view. The combination of G3E_VNO and G3E_LENO should be unique. You can configure the database to enforce this unique combination. Generally, a view is exported only one time, and you use the G3E_FILTER field to determine which features to export for a specific view.  The exported component view attributes are export-format specific. When exporting to ArcInfo, ArcView, AutoCAD, and MapInfo formats, all component view attributes are exported. For MicroStation, a user-linkage of type ‘framme’ is created containing the G3E keys (G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO, and G3E_CID). The sixteen-byte linkage is defined as follows: 
  * Bytes 1-2: FRAMME tag value of 0x1007 
  * Bytes 3-4: Always a value of 0x0020
  * Bytes 5-8: G3E_FID
  * Bytes 9-10: G3E_FNO
  * Bytes 11-12: Always a value of 0x0000
  * Bytes 13-14: G3E_CNO
  * Bytes 15-16: G3E_CID

The G3E_CNO values is the value found in the component view data – typically the G3E_CNO of the graphic component.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LENO  |  Legend entry from which to retrieve the style and label rules  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTER  |  [Filter expression](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) for eliminating data from the extraction process. G3E_FILTER determines which features to export for a view. For example, you can filter the view to extract only the features flagged as Proposed or In Service.  The filter expression can include dynamic parameters that are substituted at runtime with the values from the [parameter values collection](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/F_oDes8I0UzhCKRJzrDPQw). For example, the G3E_FILTER value can be STATE = ‘%1$s’ where 1 represents the first parameter value. Similarly, you can have %2$s, %3$s,…%n$s where n represents the index of the parameter within the parameter values collection. The number of parameters used within the table should match the number of entries in the parameter values collection.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_LAYERNAME  |  If not Null, this value is used to group the data in the extract format on a particular level or layer of the data model. In MapInfo, this is the layer name. In MicroStation, this is the level number. If Null, the name of the component view is used.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_NETANALYSISOPTIONS (Net Page Extension Analysis Options Table)
Table name: G3E_NETANALYSISOPTIONS 
Defines all of the analysis commands in NetViewer and Field Review. This table is referenced in the G3E_NETPAGES_OPTABLE. All of the rows in this table have a corresponding row in the [G3E_NETPAGES](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/U_jTtX9ywikMmvnfKR~U_w) table. 
An entry must exist in [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) for the table and its optimized table to include this metadata in the published cache. The optimized table is [G3E_NETPAGES_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SzrCscOZZqMJxEWNCIAwtg). The G3E_NETPAGES_OPTABLE is a join between the G3E_NETPAGES and G3E_NETANALYSISOPTIONS.

#### G3E_NETCLASSES (Net Analysis Classes Information Table)
Table name: G3E_NETCLASSES 
Describes the analytical groups or classes or operations available in the Web-based applications. Available groups are Search, Report, and Trace. 
This table contains information necessary to support the grouping of analysis commands in NetViewer. This table defines the classes of analysis commands and general tools commands presented in the Analysis and Tools pages within NetViewer and Field Review.

|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_NETJOBFILTERATTR (Net Job Filter Attribute Table)
Table name: NETJOBFILTERATTR 
Contains information required for filtering jobs within NetViewer. This table represents a join between G3E_NETJOBFILTERATTR and [G3E_ATTRIBUTE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw) on G3E_ANO, pulling G3E_FIELD, G3E_USERNAME, and G3E_DATATYPE from G3E_ATTRIBUTE. This table is referenced in the [G3E_NETJOBFILTERATTR_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/_kjhIDDIw5Ll2HFaylzhuA). Each row in this table represents an attribute within a job filter used within the NetViewer the Jobs tab. 
An entry must exist in [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) for the table and its optimized table to include this metadata in the published cache.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_JFANO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_JFNO  |  Foreign key to the [G3E_NETJOBFILTER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GgE6CQIJTshfBLcjkGh19A) table.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ANO  |  Attribute Number. The [Filter Job](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/zsW0HKRlPQsuf0_UW8ffJw) tab lists only those attributes listed in this table. If this attribute value is used more than once in the filter, there needs to be as many rows for this ANO as the number of times it is referenced in the query. The order in which it is referenced is specified in G3E_ORDINAL column.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_NULL  |  Flag to indicate that a value is not required for this attribute in the filter. If the attribute can be Null, the filter must use the WHERE clause convention that checks for attribute equals single space for string type and checks for attribute is Null for non-string types. For example, if ATTRIBUTEFIELDNAME1 is a string type, the WHERE clause is (? = ' ' or ATTRIBUTEFIELDNAME1 = ?). If ATTRIBUTEFIELDNAME2 is a non-string type, the WHERE clause is (? is Null or ATTRIBUTEFIELDNAME2 = ?).  0 = Cannot be Null. 1 = Can be Null.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  The order of the value parameter for this attribute in the filter.  |  Yes*  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_REFERENCEORDINAL  |  Specifies if a repeating attribute (ANO) is presented to the user to get a different value. If an ANO is repeating and the same value is replaced in multiple places in the filter, the value for this column is the G3E_ORDINAL of the associated ANO for all repeating records of the same ANO. Contrarily, if the repeating ANO is to be presented to the user, this is 0. In such cases, you can enter a different name than the username in the G3E_PROMPT column to present it to the user. This is a logical key to G3E_ORDINAL for this attribute.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes Logical  |  Number (5,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_PROMPT  |  The alternate name for an attribute username when it is repeating in the user interface.  |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
* The value need only be unique within the particular job filter definition (G3E_JFNO).

|  Loop Makeup  |  NACInputLoopMakeup.asp  |  Performs a loop makeup report starting from the selected feature  |  Analysis > Telecom Cable > Loop Makeup  |

The G3E_FNO query string argument defines which feature this report is for (duct, conduit, and so forth.)   |  Tools > Report Using Select Set Select Duct Occupancy  |  
|  Cable Fill  |  NACExecCableFill.asp  |  Reports a summary of the use of the selected cable  |  Analysis > Telecom Cable > Cable Fill  |  
|  Trace Count  |  TraceCount.asp  |  Traces a pair through a network producing a highlighted route and report  |  Analysis > Trace  |  
|  Find Phone Number  |  FindPhoneNum.asp  |  Reports all terminals given a phone number  |  Tools > Find  |  
|  Send to Plotting  |  SubmitPlot.asp  |  Plot a map area from NetViewer  |  NA  |

|  Define Plot  |  DefinePlotInput.asp  |  Defines a plot by plot box  |  NA  |  
|  Details by Feature Class   |  DetailSearch.asp  |  Find all details associated with a specified feature class  |  NA  |  
|  Save As PDF  |  SaveAsPDF.asp  |  Save a file as PDF  |  File > Save as PDF  |

To restrict the views, add the INCLUDEDVIEWS=<ViewList> query string argument, where ViewList is a list of WMS views (separated by commas) to be in the pick list.   |  Analysis > Searches > WMS Attributes  |

#### G3E_UNITFORMAT (Units and Formatting Information Table)
Table name: G3E_UNITFORMAT 
Contains all of the information needed to determine how to format distance and coordinate values for presentation to the NetViewer user. Each row in the table completely defines the unit and format information for all types of coordinates and distances for a named coordinate system. If the coordinate system name associated with the current connection is not found in this table, then the values of the units and precision to present distances and coordinates are the defaults from the coordinate system. 
All of the *UNIT fields are localizable fields. Their values are defined by the Units of Measure system.

## Outage Management Tables

### CES Interface Tables

#### G3E_CESCOMPONENT (CES Component Extraction Table)
Table name: G3E_CESCOMPONENT 
Determines the components to extract within each feature.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_CCNO  |  Unique number for the row.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Feature number of the data to extract. The combination of G3E_FNO and G3E_CNO should be unique. The foreign key should be to G3E_CESFEATURE.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CNO  |  Number of the graphic and nongraphic component to extract. You should not list a component that is not needed by CES.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_HEIGHT  |  For point components, the height of the symbols as they should be drawn in CES. The units for the height are appropriate to the CES system and are not style point units.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,1)  |   |  
|  G3E_WIDTH  |  For point components, the width of the symbols as they should be drawn in CES. The units for the width are appropriate to the CES system and are not style point units.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (3,1)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_CESFEATURE (CES Feature Extraction Table)
Table name:  G3E_CESFEATURE 
Determines the features to extract.  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Number of the feature class to extract.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CESCLASS  |  Name of the CES class of data associated with this feature.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_FILTER  |  [Filter expression](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5~KO3Xd1dc9bIaicqthjuA) for eliminating data from the extraction process. For example, the removed or abandoned data cannot be extracted.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_NAME  |  Part of the output defining the feature in CES. This name must be one word.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_CESIFACE (CES Interface Table)

##### G3E_CESIFACE.G3E_TYPE Values
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Feature Table  |  Names of the features to extract. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1, G3E_PARAMETER3, and G3E_PARAMETER3 are Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Component Table  |  Components within the features to extract. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1, G3E_PARAMETER3, and G3E_PARAMETER3 are Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Grid  |  The area feature that represents the grid that controls the CES extraction G3E_PARAMETER1 - Defines the feature number of the grid feature.  
G3E_PARAMETER2 - Defines the G3E_ANO of the grid name attribute in the grid table.  
G3E_PARAMETER3 - The filter applied against the grid table when running the [Area Reporting Utility](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/MVY9RPCzYcQhuaVTz78vew). The filter should be syntactically correct and must reference fields in the component view.   |  
|  Full Data Table  |  The output from area reporting when the full data set is processed. G3E_PARAMETER1 is the name of the output data table. G3E_PARAMETER2 and G3E_PARAMETER3 are Null for this type.   |  
|  Incremental Data Table  |  The output from area reporting when the incremental data changes are processed. G3E_PARAMETER1 is the name of the output data table. G3E_PARAMETER2 and G3E_PARAMETER3 are Null for this type.   |  
|  Tile Update Table  |  The table that contains the list of tiles to update. G3E_PARAMETER1 is the name of the output data table. G3E_PARAMETER2 and G3E_PARAMETER3 are Null for this type.   |  
|  Log Table  |  The table to use for logging messages within area reporting. G3E_PARAMETER1 is the name of the output data table. G3E_PARAMETER2 and G3E_PARAMETER3 are Null for this type.   |  
|  Modification Log Table  |  The table that contains the feature modifications of interest to the CES extraction. G3E_PARAMETER1 is the name of the output data table. G3E_PARAMETER2 and G3E_PARAMETER3 are Null for this type.   |  
|  Output File Structure  |  G3E_TYPE = 'Output File Structure' describes how the file name is to be constructed for each tile or grid that is created in the extraction. The three parameters are concatenated to form a file name. Class and Grid Name can be used to tell the program to use the class name (defined in other CES metadata) of the current feature or the grid name of the current tile. The second parameter should not be Null for this G3E_TYPE entry.  Class and Grid Name can actually be used in any order, but this is a typical file name construction:  ClassValue_GridValue You do not have to use these key words, but you must specify a unique file name for each generated tile.   |  
|  Owner  |  The ownership relationship and attribute number of the location description for components to be output:  G3E_PARAMETER1 - Ownership table  
G3E_PARAMETER2 - Ownership attribute  
G3E_PARAMETER3 - Attribute number  Example G3E_PARAMETER1 = common_n, G3E_PARAMETER2 = owner1_id, G3E_PARAMETER3 = 360001  |  
|  Connectivity  |  The connectivity relationship in the Connectivity table: G3E_PARAMETER1 - Connectivity table; defaults to connectivity_n  
G3E_PARAMETER2 - Connectivity attribute for node 1; defaults to node1_id  
G3E_PARAMETER3 - Connectivity attribute for node 2; defaults to node2_id  Example G3E_PARAMETER1 = eleconnect_n, G3E_PARAMETER2 = node1_id, G3E_PARAMETER3 = node2_id  |

### OMS Interface Tables

#### G3E_OMSEXPORTLIST (InService Export List Table)
Table name: G3E_OMSEXPORTLIST 
Contains information necessary for the specification of OMS extract parameters. It contains the named OMS export definitions. An entry must exist in G3E_OMSIFACE for the table and its optimized table to include this metadata in the published cache. The optimized table is G3E_OMSEXPORTLIST_OPTABLE.

#### G3E_OMSFEATUREx (InService Feature Extraction Table)
Table name: G3E_OMSFEATUREx 
Used by the InService interface to determine the views to extract according to the named extraction. Several tables of this format exist. Each table is required to be populated in the G3E_OMSIFACE table with G3E_TYPE = 'Feature Extract'. The table must exist before it is populated in the G3E_OMSIFACE table. A metadata package named MG3EOMSExportUtils is provided with the product to create the table. Run the following procedure to create an OMS Export Feature table and its optimized table package: 
SQL> execute MG3EOMSExportUtils.CreateExpFeatureTableAndPkg ('<TableName>', '<TableAbbreviation>');
TableName must be less than or equal to 22 characters and TableAbbreviation must be less than or equal to 17 characters. 
If you want to recreate the optimized table packages for all OMS Export Feature tables listed in the G3E_OMSIFACE table, run this procedure: 
SQL> execute MG3EOMSExportUtils.InstallExportFeaturePackages;

## Pipeline Tables

### G3E_PROTAREAIFACE (Protection Area Interface Table)

#### G3E_PROTAREAIFACE.G3E_RNO Values
If G3E_RNO is populated, the valid values are as follows:  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  ProtZoneMMOwnership  |  Ownership definition where owners are pipelines and technical objects and source features are protection zones. G3E_RNO contains the relationship number of the [ManyOwnership relationship](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Vqt2Qr0hUpLn1pdFL4RMTQ), which defines the relationship between technical objects and pipelines (owners) and protection zones (owned features).   |  
|  ProtAreaMMOwnership  |  Ownership definition where owners are pipelines, technical objects and parcels, and source features are protection areas. G3E_RNO contains the relationship number of the ManyOwnership relationship, which defines the relationship between parcels, technical objects and pipelines (owners), and protection area (owned feature).   |  
A single record is allowed for these types: TechObjectProtZone, PipelineProtZone, ProtArea, ProtZoneMMOwnership and ProtAreaMMOwnership. There may be one or more records for the other types. 
ProtZoneMMOwnership and ProtAreaMMOwnership may reference the same ManyOwnership relationship. This may be the same ManyOwnership as the one referenced by NodeEdge, EdgeArea and AreaHierarchy in the [G3E_LMIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/6jHbOc7Q92oyp6mJuh5c0g) table. 
ProtZoneMMOwnership and ProtAreaMMOwnership must reference a record in [G3E_RELATIONSHIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA) for parent-to- child relationship; that is, G3E_SUBORDINATE = 1.
