### G3E_PAIRCOUNT (Pair Count Table)
Table name: G3E_PAIRCOUNT 
Contains the delimiters the pair count service uses to parse pair counts and control behavior. When you create an empty database, this table is automatically populated with the default entries defined in the \GTechnology\Services\MetadataEntries\PopulateCommMetadata.sql script.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_PCNO  |  Unique identifier for this table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_PARAMETER  |  Values in the G3E_PARAMETER field are defined by the business rules of the utility. The rows define the tokens used in company-specific nomenclature for defining pair counts.   |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  The value of the parameter. Entries in this field must be language independent since they are used in the construction of a string stored in the database. This should be Null for the G3E_UNKNOWN_FORMAT_MESSAGE parameter.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_MESSAGE  |  Specifies the message to be displayed that describes what steps required to properly set the G3E_COUNTFORMAT attribute and allow counts to be entered for the current feature instance. This is only populated for the G3E_UNKNOWN_FORMAT_MESSAGE parameter.   |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. Used by the database administrator for informational purposes only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
Count Subsystem Validation
The Count subsystem has the following naming conventions: pair count and the strip count. 
Several of the parameters serve as delimiters in the count labels. These are suffixed by _DELIMITER. The other parameters serve as message prioritization for the different parts of the count data that can fail to meet system expectations. To support configurability of messaging for count validation, the count validation error reporting is configurable. Using metadata, you can configure four of the discrete count validations to return ignore, warning, or error. If an ignore or warning is returned, the database update is allowed to proceed. If an error is returned, the database update is prevented. 
To prevent posting a count with these problems, you can write a custom functional interface. The parameters are configured based on the following priorities:   
|  Priority  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  0  |  The Count subsystem ignores the error. The user is not informed the error occurred.  |  
|  1  |  The Count subsystem presents the error to the user. The user can ignore the error or go back and fix it.   |  
|  2  |  The Count subsystem presents the error to the user. The user cannot continue until the error has been resolved.   |  
|  Key  |  Description  |  Mandatory  |  Default Value  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_SIZE_MISMATCH  |  Specifies the error priority when the total number of pairs entered does not match the total size of the feature that owns the count.  If the current feature does not have a TOTAL_SIZE attribute in its primary attribute component than this validation is skipped as there is no total size to compare the number of entered pairs with.   |   |  N  |  
|  G3E_DUPLICATE_COUNT  |  Specifies the error priority when one or more duplicate counts exist for an instance of a feature.   |   |  N  |  
|  G3E_NO_SOURCE_FEED  |  Specifies the error priority when one or more entered counts were not found in the located sources feeds.   |   |  N  |  
|  G3E_DEAD_QUANTITIES  |  Specifies the error priority when one or more quantities of dead count have been entered.  |   |  N  |  
|  G3E_DISPLAYWARNINGS  |  Add this key to the G3E_PAIRCOUNT table and set it to 0 if you want to supress warning messages. If this key is set to 0, the count command does not interactively display features with count validation warnings as they occur. The command accepts all warning messages but sends the warning for that feature to the resulting report. To turn on warning messages, delete this key from the table (decreases processing time) or set this key to -1.   |   |  N  |  
Count Subsystem Keys
Some keys are duplicated in the different naming conventions because the default values may be different. These are the available Count subsystem keys and their default values: 
Prefix  
|  Key  |  Description  |  Mandatory  |  Default Value  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_PREFIXDEFAULT  |  Specifies whether the label is to include the prefix or not by default.  |  N  |  True  |  
|  G3E_PREFIX_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter that separates the designation prefix from the designation. For example, OWSDON59/10,1-100   |  N  |  No Delimiter  |  
|  G3E_PREFIXOPTIONAL  |  Specifies whether the prefix is optional in a count or not.  |  N  |  True  |  
Formatting  
|  Key  |  Description  |  Mandatory  |  Default Value  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DEFAULT_FORMAT  |  Specifies the default notation used to annotate counts to map views and reports and the notation used to parse lines of count entered in the Pair Count control. These values are supported:  1 = Pairs 2 = Strips  |  N  |  1 = Pairs  |  
|  G3E_UNKNOWN_FORMAT_MESSAGE  |  Specifies the message to be displayed that describes what steps need to be performed to get the G3E_COUNTFORMAT attribute set properly and allow counts to be entered for the current feature instance.   |  N  |  G3E_COUNTFORMAT attribute not set. Unable to format counts.  |  
|  G3E_COUNT_EXTENDER  |  Defines the class that implements the count extender interface. If you want further validation of your pair counts to adhere to these rules:  Upgrade the severity of size mismatch validation failures to critical for cables, wires, capacitors, load coils, interfaces, resistors, and terminals. All other count bearing features use the global G3E_SIZE_MISMATCH severity level.  Allow duplicate dead count assignments in capacitors, load coils, resistors and terminals. All other count bearing features use the global G3E_DUPLICATE_COUNT severity level.  Include the G3E_COUNT_EXTENDER parameter with the value GcommsValidation.clsValidate in this table. If this validation is not required by your business practices, remove this parameter from the table. Specifying the GcommsValidation.clsCLLIPrefixValidate class provides the same validation as the default class but also includes designation prefix validation. This validation ensures that an eight- character prefix is included for each designation. This validation extends to the Throw Count and Trace Count commands.  The validation does not apply to dead or special counts, for example, 100D or counts belonging to a pair count class that is not defined to be validated against total size. See [G3E_PAIRCOUNTCLASS.G3E_VALIDATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/y~0mmKEqDqkr38WG5Iojhg) for more information.   |  N  |  GcommsValidation.clsValidate  |  
Pair Count  
|  Key  |  Description  |  Mandatory  |  Default Value  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_DESIGNATION_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to separate the designation from the pair range. For example, 10,1-100   |  N  |  ,  |  
|  G3E_RANGE_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to separate the low and high parts of the pair range. For example 10,1-100   |  N  |  -  |  
|  G3E_RANGES_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to separate multiple non-contiguous pair ranges that occur on the same line. For example, 10,1- 100+201-300.  If this key is added to G3E_PAIRCOUNT, ensure the attribute, range_seq is added to the count table.   |  N  |  No Delimiter. Multiple noncontiguous ranges not supported.  |  
|  G3E_REVERSE_FEED_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to identify that a line of count is fed in the reverse direction to the cable. For example, [R]10,1-100   |  N  |  [R]  |  
|  G3E_DEAD_INDICATOR  |  Specifies a comma- delimited list of delimiters or tokens that indicate that a pair range is dead. For example, D1- 100. Dead indicators exhibit the same behavior as special indicators, except that a dead indicator has a definite direction while a special indicator does not. A dead count can be forward or reverse, therefore, [R]D1-100 is also a valid dead count.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/260487?tocId=tqDUW07B~oRTxwHjhYgWpA):  The following script renames the current dead indicators to the G3E_SPECIAL_INDICATOR key. Type the following in an SQL editor:  SQL> UPDATE G3E_PAIRCOUNT SET G3E_PARAMETER = 'G3E_SPECIAL_INDICATOR' WHERE (G3E_PARAMETER = 'G3E_DEAD_INDICATOR'); To use current reverse dead counts, remove the appropriate dead indicators from the G3E_SPECIAL_INDICATOR key and move them back to the dead indicators key. Type the following in an SQL editor:  SQL> INSERT INTO G3E_PAIRCOUNT (G3E_PCNO, G3E_PARAMETER, G3E_VALUE, G3E_EDITDATE) VALUES (G3E_PAIRCOUNT_SEQ.NextVal, 'G3E_DEAD_INDICATOR', 'D,Dead', SYSDATE);  |  N  |  None  |  
|  G3E_SPECIAL_INDICATOR  |  Specifies a comma- delimited list of the delimiters or tokens that indicate that a pair range is special. For example, 50SP  |  N  |  None  |  
|  G3E_COLLAPSERIPPLEDCOUNTS  |  Specifies whether or not to collapse contiguous lines of count after a ripple has been performed. If 0, contiguous lines of count are not collapsed until the feature is thrown.   |  N  |  -1  |  
|  G3E_OPEN_THROW_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to identify the start of a thrown count. For example, (10,1-100)20,1-100   |  N  |  (  |  
|  G3E_CLOSE_THROW_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to identifier the end of a thrown count. For example, (10,1-100)20,1-100   |  N  |  )  |  
|  G3E_CLASS_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the token to place between the pair count class name and the line of count when annotating pair information in a map view or report. For example, In BP: 10,1-100   |  N  |  :  |

A dead count can be forward or reverse, therefore, [R]D1-100 is also a valid dead count.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/260487?tocId=tqDUW07B~oRTxwHjhYgWpA) The following script renames the current dead indicators to the G3E_SPECIAL_INDICATOR key. Type the following in an SQL editor:  SQL> UPDATE G3E_PAIRCOUNT SET G3E_PARAMETER = 'G3E_SPECIAL_INDICATOR' WHERE (G3E_PARAMETER = 'G3E_DEAD_INDICATOR');  To use current reverse dead counts, remove the appropriate dead indicators from the G3E_SPECIAL_INDICATOR key and move them back to the dead indicators key. Type the following in an SQL editor:  SQL> INSERT INTO G3E_PAIRCOUNT (G3E_PCNO, G3E_PARAMETER, G3E_VALUE, G3E_EDITDATE) VALUES (G3E_PAIRCOUNT_SEQ.NextVal, 'G3E_DEAD_INDICATOR', 'D,Dead', SYSDATE);   |  N  |  None  |  
|  G3E_SPECIAL_INDICATOR  |  Specifies a comma-delimited list of the delimiters or tokens that indicate that a pair range is special. For example, 50SP   |  N  |  None  |  
|  G3E_COLLAPSERIPPLEDCOUNTS  |  Specifies whether or not to collapse contiguous lines of count after a ripple has been performed. If 0, contiguous lines of count are not collapsed until the feature is thrown.   |  N  |  -1  |  
|  G3E_OPEN_THROW_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to identify the start of a thrown count. For example, (023:001- 010)024,001-010   |  N  |  (  |  
|  G3E_CLOSE_THROW_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to identifier the end of a thrown count. For example, (023:001- 010)024,001-010   |  N  |  )  |  
|  G3E_CLASS_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the token to place between the pair count class name and the line of count when annotating pair information in a map view or report. For example, In BP: 023:001-010   |  N  |  :  |  
|  G3E_STRIP_CHARWIDTH  |  Specifies the number of digits to pad each strip value when displaying it. For example, a value of three displays the first strip as: 023:001   |  N  |  3  |  
|  G3E_PAIRS_PER_STRIP  |  Specifies the number of pairs that are bundles into each strip. This value is constant for all count- bearing features.   |  N  |  10  |  
|  G3E_PARALLEL_INDICATOR  |  Specifies the token that indicates a parallel strip. For example, 023:001- 010P1  |  N  |  P  |  
|  G3E_PAIR_OPEN_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token that indicates the beginning or individual pairs within a strip. For example, 023:001A[5]   |  N  |  [  |  
|  G3E_PAIR_CLOSE_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token the indicates the end of individual pairs within a strip. For example, 023:001A[5]   |  N  |  ]  |  
|  G3E_PAIR_RANGES_DELIMITER  |  Specifies the delimiter or token used to separate multiple non-contiguous pairs within a strip. For example, 023:001A[1,5]   |  N  |  ,  |  
|  G3E_ANNOTATE_SPLIT_STRIP_PAIRS  |  Specifies whether or not to annotate the split strip pair range  |  N  |  False  |  
|  G3E_SPLIT_IDENTIFIERS  |  Identifies which values can follow a strip number to indicate that the strip is split. If no value is specified for this parameter, split identifier validation is not performed and users can use any strip identifiers.   |  N  |  No Delimiter  |

## User Mapping

### G3E_LOGINMAPPING (Login Mapping Table)
Table name: G3E_LOGINMAPPING (Deprecated) 
Contains information necessary for enabling [user login mapping](javascript:;) in NetWorks Core and NetViewer. 
A utility program, InstallUserMapping.exe, is provided with NetViewer Server and NetWorks Core to assist in populating this table. An entry must exist in [G3E_DATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/_ZuCX4G4mblLkZOTURP~6g) for this table. If the table contains no entries, the user-specified login/password is used. An entry must also exist in [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) to replicate the table between schemas.

|  G3E_FROMUSERNAME  |  Name that the user uses to log in in to NetWorks Core or NetViewer.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (256)  |   |  
|  G3E_TOUSERNAME  |  Contains the name that G3E_FROMUSERNAME should map to for actual access to the data.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (256)  |   |  
|  G3E_TOPASSWORD  |  Stores the encrypted password of the specified G3E_TOUSERNAME.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (256)  |   |

Specify one row in this table for each user for each application that they use. This requires two rows if the user accesses both applications. The rows can map to the same or different users for the different applications.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  G/NetViewer  |

Customer  
Load Device   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |

This field is Null for the non-feature tables.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |

#### G3E_CSSIFACE (CSS Interface Table)

##### G3E_CSSFACE.G3E_TYPE Values
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  ChangeIndicator  |  The value within the customer interchange data that indicates a changed entry. The default is C.   |  
|  CircuitAttribute  |  The attribute within all load features that contains the name of the circuit.  |  
|  EncloseField  |  The character used to optionally enclose fields in the data file (for example, ' [single quote]).   |  
|  Features  |  The table containing the list of features considered in the CSS processing. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Fields  |  The table containing the list of fields in the tables processed by the CSS interface. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  LastEditDateAttribute  |  The attribute within all features that contains the date of the last edit on this feature. This date should also be populated when the feature is initially placed so this logic can be used to find new features.   |  
|  NewIndicator  |  The value within the customer interchange data that indicates a new entry. The default is N.   |  
|  SizeAttribute  |  The list of feature/attribute combinations for the load features that contain the attribute used to choose the largest unit within a repeating component. This information is used in processing if any of the attributes identified as "Load Device Number" are contained in a repeating record. If this information is not specified for a repeating component, the first occurrence is used for the "Load Device Number". The format of this parameter is: <feature number>,<attribute number>;<feature number>,<attribute number>; That is, feature number followed by a comma followed by the attribute number and terminated by a semicolon. This pattern repeats for each load device feature that contains a repeating unit.   |  
|  TerminateField  |  The character used to terminate fields in the data file (for example, | [pipe]).  |

### G3E_JOBCLASSIFICATION (Job Classification Table)
Table name: G3E_JOBCLASSIFICATION 
Contains information necessary for user-defined job classifications. A job classification is a means of describing the nature of the work in the job. Based on this classification, attributes can be automatically assigned to features. 
The following information must be available to support the definition of job classifications:
  * Job classification name and description.
  * Common attribute specification associated with the classification.
  * Feature-specific attribute specification associated with the classification.
  * Field specification in the [G3E_JOBDEFINITION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TBQDr_BsRYh8ej2Rr97t2g) table indicating which field on the job table holds the job classification name. 
  * Indicator of attributes that should be copied as stated in [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_COPY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw). Some attributes, such as an owner identifier, should not be copied. 
  * The default job classification is stored in the [G3E_TABATTRIBUTE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/DQvudRU4TKitmHAp03~qGQ) table as a G3E_NAME, G3E_VALUE pair with the G3E_NAME value equal to DefaultJobClassification. The G3E_VALUE value must equal one of the G3E_JCNO values in the G3E_JOBCLASSIFICATION table; otherwise, the default job classification is <none>. 

  
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_JCNO  |  Row identifier for the table.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name for the classification.  |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_DESCRIPTION  |  Description of this classification.  |  No  |  Yes  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_ROLE  |  Name of the database role the user must have to enable the object control. The specific type of job class is available to the user who has the role.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |  EVERYONE  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

|  Work Management Integration Type  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  AncCUJobIDField  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the G3E_ANO in the ancillary CU component that contains the name of the active job that placed the CU. Job Revision and Copy Job functionality use this attribute to set Job Identifier. The G3E_SUPPORTANO and G3E_SUPPORTANOCNO fields must be set for this type.   |  
|  AreaManager  |  The metadata table that controls the area manager interface. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  DesignArea  |  The design area feature. The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type contains the feature number and the attribute number to contain the job key value. The primary geographic component of the feature must be a polygon or boundary. This is the component that is placed by the Create Design Area command.   |  
|  DisableCopyJob  |  Indicates the availability of the Copy Job functionality. If this parameter is not defined or is defined with a G3E_PARAMETER1 = 0, the default behavior enables the capability to copy a job. If this parameter is defined with a G3E_PARAMETER1 = 1, the ability to copy a job through the NetWorks Core interface is disabled.   |  
|  Feature  |  The G3E_SUPPORTCNO and G3E_SUPPORTANO value for this type identifies the component and attribute that contain the value for the life cycle state.   |  
|  HistoricalAncCU  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type represents the component that is to store the historical ancillary CU values. The ancillary CU values are copied into the historical component at job closure. The CNO value is stored in G3E_SUPPORTCNO.   |  
|  HistoricalApplDep  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type represents the component that is to store the historical application dependency values. The application dependencies are copied into the historical component at job closure. The CNO value is stored in G3E_SUPPORTCNO.   |  
|  JobIdentifier  |  The attribute value that contains the value for the job identifier in every feature. The attribute must be in a component shared by all of the features. Translate State uses this value to determine what records to process when translating. The Job Revision and Copy Job functionality use this attribute to set Job Identifier. The Send to Storms and Send to WMIS commands use this value to determine what common items to send to the work management system. The G3E_SUPPORTANO and G3E_SUPPORTANOCNO fields must be set for this type.   |  
|  JobLifeCycle  |  The table that describes the actions to take for the job when changes occur in the work request as initiated by LOGICA, STORMS or Generic WMS. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  JobManagementOption  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type defines the type of work management system. The following table outlines the acceptable values for this parameter and the license checks performed. The default value is Default.   
 |  Parameter Value  |  License Requested  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Default  |  No additional license is requested  |  
|  STORMS  |  A STORMS interface (UDS0111) license is requested  |  
|  SAP-PM  |  A SAP-PM interface (UDS0046) license is requested  |  
|  GenericWMS  |  A WMS interface (UDS0111) license is requested  |  
|  LogicaWMIS  |  A Logica WMIS Interface (UDS0111) license is requested  |  
 |  
|  LifeCycle  |  The names of the states associated with the life cycle management. It includes a descriptive name and the stored value. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Messages  |  The metadata table that contains information necessary to support messages. Used by both LOGICA and Generic Work Management System (WMS). For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  MessageFormat  |  The metadata table that contains information necessary to support message formats. Used by both LOGICA and Generic work management system (WMS). For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  ModifiedWorkRequestField  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field contains the attribute in the features that contain the name of the last modifying work request. This is used by JobLifeCycle for transitioning feature states and is also used by Job Revision and Copy Job functionality to set Job Identifier. The G3E_SUPPORTANO and G3E_SUPPORTANOCNO fields must be set for this type.   |  
|  PriCUJobIDField  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field contains the attribute number in the primary CU component that contains the name of the active job that placed the CU. Job Revision and Copy Job functionality use this attribute to set Job Identifier. The G3E_SUPPORTANO and G3E_SUPPORTANOCNO fields must be set for this type.   |  
|  Queues  |  The metadata table that contains the queue information. Used by both LOGICA and Generic Work Management System (WMS). For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Region   |  The region feature for geographic subsetting. This is used by the publishing process and during placement and/or edit to update the region attribute in the features. This parameter contains the feature number and the attribute number that contain the region value. The primary geographic component of the feature must be a polygon or boundary. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 contains the feature number of the region feature and the attribute number of the feature that contains the region name which is used as a subsetting attribute.   |  
|  ReplaceFilter  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field identifies the filter on the state attribute and prevents replacements on proposed features as well as abandoned or removed ones. The Replace command runs the selected feature against this filter (based on the SupportCNO and SupportANO in the feature entry). If the feature does not match, no replacement is done.   |  
|  ReplaceOffset  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field identifies the X,Y pair indicating how far the old feature should be adjusted in the replace operation. The offset values must be specified in the units of the database.   |  
|  ReplaceState  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field identifies the G3E_LCNO value of the state to assign to the newly created feature in the Replace command. If this parameter is missing, the state is not updated and is based either on the value copied from the original feature or the database default.   |  
|  Survey Points  |  The component view and published attributes for use by the Survey Point construction aid. The value in G3E_SUPPORTCNO is the view (G3E_VNO) number for some point component. The value in G3E_SUPPORTANO is the attribute number (G3E_ANO) for the attribute within the component view that represents a filterable attribute. This might be survey point batch number, material, or regional value. The value in G3E_PARAMETER1 is the attribute number (G3E_ANO) for the attribute within the component view that represents a unique identifier within each distinct filterable attribute. So, this might be the point number within a survey batch or a unique identifier. If this metadata is not defined, the construction aid is disabled.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/265665) To ensure adequate performance of the construction aid, the component view identified here should not contain a large amount of data. The expectation is that these features are transitory, imported into the facility model to assist in placement, and then deleted. If this component view yields more than a few thousand rows, performance is likely to be below user expectations.   |  
|  Transitions   |  The allowable transitions between states associated with the life cycle management. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  WorkPoint  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field contains the feature number of the work point feature. The attributes to pass for the work point are defined in [G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/s9GcPFxUsogokTRUglTFow) table in the Logica interface and the [G3E_CUKEYFIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/3TA0h4NSRbRLAc8aSckAMA) for STORMS. The G3E_TABLE field identifies the table containing work point placement offset information. Used by STORMS and LOGICA.   |  
|  WorkManagementPolygon  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field identifies the feature number of the polygon feature. Used by both LOGICA and Generic WMS.   |  
|  WorkManagementPolygonName  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field identifies the attribute number (G3E_ANO) of the attribute within the published component view for the primary graphic component of the WorkManagementPolygon feature that contains the name of the polygon. Used by both LOGICA and Generic WMS.   |  
|  WorkManagementPolygonType  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field identifies the attribute number (G3E_ANO) of the attribute within the published component view for the primary graphic component of the WorkManagementPolygon feature that contains the type or classification attribute. Used by both LOGICA and Generic WMS.   |  
|  WorkPointAutoGenANO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field contains the ANO for a Boolean type attribute on the work point feature indicating that the work point was auto- generated during the [Send to STORMS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/AJOS_8bbmYp4pg8OeHGvdQ) or [Send to WMIS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/v7brqAwAkspSW9U1EoRINQ) commands. If created by the commands, the attribute is set to True or 1. If omitted, this attribute is not set (left as Null).   |  
|  WorkPointWorkRequestField  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this field contains the attribute in the work point feature that contains the name of the work request that defined the work point. Job Revision and Copy Job functionality use this attribute to set Job Identifier. The G3E_SUPPORTANO and G3E_SUPPORTANOCNO fields must be set for this type.   |

### Generic Work Management Tables

#### G3E_GENERICWMSFEATURE (Generic WMS Features Table)
Table name: G3E_GENERICWMSFEATURE 
Defines the features in the data model that can be exported and have associated work management information. It also identifies the activity to perform for removals on the feature. An entry must exist in [G3E_GENERICWMSIFACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WdCQWt~w6RDEkBp18WPKsQ) for the table and its optimized table to include this metadata in the published cache. The optimized table is [G3E_GENERICWMSFEATURE_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/YzrkLexhlWY8vuXaNUkXHA).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  The feature number of the feature to pass attribute information to the WMS  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_REMOVALACTIVITY  |  Contains an R to indicate return of the feature to inventory on removal. An S indicates a scrap operation.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2(1)  |  S  |  
|  G3E_UNITCNO  |  Indicates the unit CNO per FNO that is the repeating component. This CNO is used by JobLifeCycle.exe to delete corresponding records that contain matching G3E_CID records from the CU component that are marked as removed.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number(5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_GENERICWMSIFACE (Generic WMS Interface Table)

##### G3E_GENERICWMSIFACE.G3E_TYPE Values
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  AbandonedState  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the [G3E_LIFECYCLE.G3E_VALUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/F_8zjvUTXpqWJGXxKtqBFw) of the state that represents abandoned data. This is necessary if cost information is stored on the feature so that it can be zeroed when the feature is abandoned. Used in batch processing.   |  
|  AfterPostMessageNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the G3E_MSGNO value from the G3E_MESSAGE table that corresponds to the post-post message. The message name is listed in the G3E_OUTGOING column of the G3E_MESSAGE table. This message is further defined inside the G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT table.   |  
|  AncillaryCU  |  The component defined as the ancillary CU for any feature sent to GenericWMS. The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the number of the component (G3E_CNO) that contains the ancillary CU data. The second argument is either zero or one to indicate if the component should be deleted (1) when the feature is transitioned to In Service. The G3E_CNO value and the flag are comma delimited.   |  
|  BeforePostMessageNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the G3E_MSGNO value from the G3E_MESSAGE table that corresponds to the prepost message. The message name is listed in G3E_MESSAGE.G3E_OUTGOING. This message is further defined inside the G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT table.   |  
|  ChildToParentRNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_RNO of the child-to-parent ownership relationship used in the GenericWMS-related features.   |  
|  ExportMessageNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the G3E_MSGNO value from the G3E_MESSAGE table that corresponds to the Export Design message. The message name is listed in the G3E_OUTGOING column of the G3E_MESSAGE table. This message is further defined inside the G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT table.   |  
|  Feature  |  The table containing the list of features considered in the work management interface. G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null for this type. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  JobTypeExceptionList  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the comma separated list of JOB_TYPE values that are looked at by JobLifeCycle. If the current job's JOB_TYPE matches a value in this list, then no processing is performed on the job even though it has been specified in G3E_JOBLIFECYCLE.   |  
|  OperationalState  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the value from the [G3E_LIFECYCLE.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/F_8zjvUTXpqWJGXxKtqBFw) value that is to represent the operational state. Used in batch processing.   |  
|  ParentToChildRNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_RNO of the parent ownership relationship used in the GenericWMS-related features.   |  
|  PrimaryCU  |  The component defined as the primary CU for any feature sent to GenericWMS. The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the number of the component (G3E_CNO) that contains the primary CU data. The second argument is either zero or one to indicate if the component should be deleted (1) when the feature is transitioned to In Service. The G3E_CNO value and the flag are comma delimited.   |

##### Values for G3E_ANALYSIS
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  G3E_TYPE  |  G3E_TABLE  |  G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE  |  G3E_TOOLTIP  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Generic WMS Interface  |  Work Management  |  G3E_GENERICWMSIFACE  |  G3E_GENERICWMSIFACE_OPTABLE  |  Provides access to information about the Generic WMS interface  |

#### G3E_MESSAGE (Message Table)
Table name: G3E_MESSAGE 
Contains information necessary to support XML message processing. It is referenced in the [G3E_WORKMGMT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KME_1L76HZEDZ5lzihAbeQ) table. The [Job Processing Service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j3dODE7yUK4XgK5dffnpqg) uses this metadata table to determine actions to take on an incoming message received by the [Message Monitor service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/lYWD_9NHU7BHb5NZXei9sg).   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MSGNO  |  Row identifier for the table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_INCOMING  |  Name of incoming message to NetWorks Core  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_INQUEUENO  |  Incoming queue number  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  [G3E_ACTION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/UND0JgX~t6qNvqsBAJNseg)  |  Action to be performed on incoming message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  0 (No action)  |  
|  G3E_OUTGOING  |  Name of outgoing message from NetWorks Core  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_OUTQUEUENO  |  Outgoing queue number  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ERRORQUEUENO  |  Error queue number  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_JLCNO  |  JobLifeCycle number. Populated only when G3E_ACTION is 6 or 7.  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TIMEOUT  |  Timeout period (in seconds) for NetWorks Core to listen for a response message on the G3E_INCOMING queue. This value is used for the messages defined by ExportMessageNO, BeforePostMessageNO, and AfterPostMessageNO in G3E_GENERICWMSIFACE. A value of 0 indicates that the software does not need to wait for a response. A null value, or -1, indicates that the software waits for a response without a timeout occurring.  ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256366?tocId=puLTy83z9p9ET8u04aMaCQ) The software could be left in a wait state if no response is received when the timeout is null or -1.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number(5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256366?tocId=puLTy83z9p9ET8u04aMaCQ)
  * The fields G3E_INCOMING and G3E_OUTGOING are foreign keys to G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT.G3E_NAME, meaning the value entered in these columns must be from the G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT.G3E_NAME field. These are not true foreign keys as G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT.G3E_NAME is not a primary key nor a unique field of table G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT. 
  * The fields G3E_INQUEUENO, G3E_OUTQUEUENO, and G3E_ERRORQUEUENO are foreign keys to G3E_QUEUE.G3E_QNO.

#### G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT (Message Format Table)
Table name: G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT 
Contains information necessary to support XML message formats. The message format is a description of the name of the message and then the definition of each element or field in the message. Each element is mapped to either an attribute in the NetWorks Core model or a literal value. This table is referenced in the [G3E_WORKMGMT table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KME_1L76HZEDZ5lzihAbeQ). The [Job Processing Service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j3dODE7yUK4XgK5dffnpqg) uses this metadata table to read and write message formats. See the [Message Format tool topics](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/BpkKOMrwXQSfSpGNibZFgw) for more information.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MFNO  |  Row identifier for the table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_NAME  |  Name of this message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  Element type referenced by the interface software. Some of the elements are significant to the processing of the message. These are identified by specific types. They are transferred to the specified G3E_ANO. This is a foreign key to [G3E_MESSAGEFORMATTYPE.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SUJ9BmTvA0cfmvtjNUFwaw). All other elements are untypes (Null).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEMENTTAGNAME  |  Tag name for an element of a message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_PARENTTAGNAME  |  Tag name of the parent element of a message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEATTRNAME  |  Attribute name of an element of a message  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEATTRVALUE  |  Attribute value of an element of a message  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  Literal value for this element. This value is only used in outgoing messages.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ANO  |  NetWorks Core attribute that stores this tag's value   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9, 0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  The order number element tag within this message. Must be equal to or greater than zero. Must be unique for a specific G3E_NAME when it is not zero. Should be zero if the element tag order is not considered.   |  Yes*  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
* Unique for a specific G3E_NAME. Checked on validation.

#### G3E_MESSAGEFORMATTYPE (Message Format Types Table)
Table name: G3E_MESSAGEFORMATTYPE 
Contains valid message format types for the [Job Processing Service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j3dODE7yUK4XgK5dffnpqg), the [Send to WMIS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/v7brqAwAkspSW9U1EoRINQ) command, and the [Compatible Unit Query dialog box](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/WagkV~4M9M8WJ3WYNQ5K5g). This table is referenced in the [G3E_METADATASUPPORT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/P0SCSQgrxakO8MZiQ2MQQw) table. It need not be published but is used to describe the type of value that the Message Monitor retrieves as part of its parameters.

|  [G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SUJ9BmTvA0cfmvtjNUFwaw)  |  Defined set of element types  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_DESCRIPTION  |  Short description of the type  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (120)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_QUEUE (Queue Table)
Table name: G3E_QUEUEContains information necessary to support XML message queues for work management. This table is referenced in [G3E_WORKMGMT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KME_1L76HZEDZ5lzihAbeQ). The [MessageMonitor](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SjFkXpVwupbaDhMGFiBfzQ) program and [Job Processing Service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j3dODE7yUK4XgK5dffnpqg) use this metadata table to determine the queue information. 
Only one set of queues can be defined in a database. If you need to reference different machines in your test environments, you have to temporarily change the queue location and reset it for production.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_QNO  |  Row identifier for the table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_NAME  |  Name of the queue  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_DCNO  |  Data connection number. G3E_DCNO is a foreign key to [G3E_DATACONNECTION.G3E_DCNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XVSORnBdhQjIxL9aNJ0TPw).   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  [G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0F5s6J5KV38idlLYQGFRlg)  |  Queue system type for this queue  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_MACHINENAME  |  Name of the machine that has this queue  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_LABEL  |  Label for this queue  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  VarChar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_AUTOCREATE  |  Indicates whether to automatically create the queue if it does not already exist 0 = Do not automatically create the queue. 1 = Automatically create the queue.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_PRIVATE  |  Indicates whether the queue is a private queue 0 = The queue is not a private queue. 1 = The queue is a private queue.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_RESPONSECORRELATION  |  Indicates the way to set the CorrelationID of the response message 0 = The MessageID of a request message is set as the CorrelationID of the response message.  1 = The CorrelationID of a request message is set.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_WORKPOINT (Work Point Table)
Table name: G3E_WORKPOINT 
Work Point features are necessary as a grouping mechanism within GIS for data manipulation. The work point is sent to work management systems with the associated work (data manipulation) at that location. You must identify the work point feature in the interface table. You must also identify the attribute that contains the work point number. The work point feature must be set up as child of structural features in your data model using the ownership relationship. Work points can be placed interactively by the designer, or they are automatically generated when CU data are sent to your work management systems. 
For each structure, identify the offset (X,Y) for the work point from each owner feature. You must still make the appropriate ownership entries in [G3E_OWNERSHIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ) for the work point.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Number of parent feature.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_XOFFSET  |  Delta X units to add to the location of the parent feature for positioning the work point instance.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_YOFFSET  |  Delta Y units to add to the location of the parent feature for positioning the work point instance.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

### Inspection Tables

#### G3E_INSPECTIONCU (Compatible Units Table)
Table name: G3E_INSPECTIONCU 
Defines the compatible units that are to be included in the inspection. It contains entries for each compatible unit component of any inspectable or related features that is to be inspected.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_ICUNO  |  Unique value associated with this set of metadata.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Feature number of a inspectable or related feature that contains the compatible unit to be inspected.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_CNO  |  Component number of the compatible unit to be included for inspection for the defined feature number.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (5,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DTNO  |  A dialog tab number (DTNO) associated with the compatible unit component. This DTNO is used to display attributes when the attributes tab of the [Field Inspection](javascript:;) dialog box is selected while a compatible unit is selected in the Inspected/Related Features tree of the Field Inspection dialog box.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_DESCRIPTION_ANO  |  The attribute number of the compatible unit attribute whose value is to be displayed to the user. If Null, the name of the component that represents the compatible unit is displayed to the user.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |  Null  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_INSPECTIONIFACE (Inspection Interface Table)

##### G3E_INSPECTIONIFACE.G3E_TYPE Values
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Attributes  |  The table that contains the deficiency- defining information for each feature. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Circuit Number  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the inspection feature circuit number attribute.   |  
|  Compatible Unit Deficiencies  |  The table that contains the compatible unit deficiencies information. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Compatible Units  |  The table that contains the compatible units per feature. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields. The parameter value is Null.   |  
|  Damage Assessment  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the component number of the damage assessment component of the damage assessment feature. This is the attribute component. The area boundary is assumed to be the primary geometry component.   |  
|  Damage Assessment FIDs  |  Name of the table that holds the FIDs of the inspection features that the Damage Assessment command finds in the Damage Assessment boundary. This table is a temporary holding location.   |  
|  Damage Assessment FNO  |  FNO value of the Damage Assessment feature.  |  
|  Damage Assessment ID ANO  |  Attribute number of the field in the Feature Class Damage component that refers to the G3E_ID of the Damage Assessment component. That is, it correlates or groups the records of the different feature types (and counts and percentages) to a particular assessment.   |  
|  Date Placed  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the inspection feature date placed attribute.   |  
|  Deficiencies  |  The table that contains the deficiency information. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields. The parameter value is Null.   |  
|  Deficiency Category  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the Deficiency component deficiency category attribute. For REAL type deficiency, this is the G3E_USERNAME from the [G3E_INSPECTIONFEADEF_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/pDM7s8CHAOn_T3uqS4nWCw) for the deficiency selected. For VALUE type deficiencies, this is the name of the field whose value is incorrect.   |  
|  Deficiency Component  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the CNO of the deficiency component in the inspection feature.   |  
|  Deficiency Count  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the inspection feature deficiency count attribute.   |  
|  Deficiency Count ANO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the attribute number of the field in the Feature Class Damage component that holds the count of how many of a particular FNO have deficiencies.   |  
|  Deficiency Items  |  The table that contains the deficiency items related to the deficiencies. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Deficiency Type  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the deficiency component deficiency type attribute. This identifies the type of deficiency. Initially there are only two types:  REAL — To identify that the deficiency is a true deficiency on the feature.  
VALUE — To identify that the deficiency is on a current value in the database.   |  
|  Deficiency Value  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the deficiency component deficiency value attribute. For deficiencies marked as REAL, this field contains the G3E_USERNAME from the [G3E_INSPECTIONDEFITEM_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/yaesad7H3jE61PE1Ra9rpQ). For deficiencies marked as VALUE, this field contains the value of the field.   |  
|  DeficiencyCID  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the Deficiency component deficiency CID attribute.   |  
|  DeficiencyCNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the Deficiency component deficiency CNO attribute.   |  
|  DeficiencyFID  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the Deficiency component deficiency FID attribute.   |  
|  DeficiencyFNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the Deficiency component deficiency FNO attribute.   |  
|  Feature Class Damage  |  Component number of the Feature Class Damage component of the Damage Assessment feature.  |  
|  Inspectable Features  |  The table that contains the inspectable features. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Inspected Count ANO  |  Attribute number of the field in the Feature Class Damage component that holds the count of how many of a particular FNO have been inspected.   |  
|  Inspected FNO ANO  |  Attribute number of the field in the Feature Class Damage component that holds the FNO of the feature that has been inspected.   |  
|  Inspection Feature  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the FNO of the inspection feature.  |  
|  Job Placed  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the inspection feature job placed attribute.   |  
|  Notes  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the inspection feature notes attribute.   |  
|  OwnerCNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the inspection feature owner CNO attribute.   |  
|  OwnerID  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the inspection feature owner ID attribute.   |  
|  Percent Inspected ANO  |  Attribute number of the field in the Feature Class Damage component that holds the percentage of those of a particular FNO that have been inspected that have deficiencies.   |  
|  Percent Inspected Damaged ANO  |  ANO of the attribute that stores the percentage of features that have been inspected: 100*(count of inspected features / Total Count).   |  
|  Percent Total Damage ANO  |  ANO of the attribute that stores the percentage of inspectable features with deficiencies: 100*(count of inspectable features with deficiencies / Total Count).   |  
|  Relationships  |  The table that contains the relationships to interrogate. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  Status  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type is the ANO value of the deficiency component status attribute. The status values might be Open, Work in Progress, or Resolved. A database default should be used and database triggers or constraints if special meaning or control is required.   |  
|  Total Count ANO  |  ANO of the attribute that stores the initial estimate of the total number of this feature that is damaged (from when damage assessment is first created).   |

|  G3E_DISCARD  |  Indicates whether the job and associated alternatives should be discarded when this WR_STATE_CODE is encountered in the job record.  0 = Discard operation. 1 = Discard alternatives. 2 = Discard job and all alternatives.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_POST  |  Indicates whether the feature data pending in the job should be posted. 0 = No post operation. 1 = Full post of pending data. 2 = Partial post of specified data. 3 = Full post of pending data excluding work points. 4 = Partial post of pending data excluding work points.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (2,0)  |  0  |

#### G3E_LIFECYCLE (Life Cycle Management Table)
Table name: G3E_LIFECYCLE 
Contains information necessary for the seamless operation of the system as related to life cycle or state management.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LCNO  |  Row for this format.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Name of the state.  |  Yes  |  No  |  Yes  |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  Value associated with the state name to be stored in the state attribute.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_DELETE  |  Indicates whether the feature should be deleted when transitioned to this state. 0 = The feature should not be deleted when transitioned to this state. 1 = The feature should be deleted when transitioned to this state. This action occurs during posting of the job.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_ALLOWBATCH  |  Indicates whether processing is allowed to transition the state from the currently assigned state. The flag can be used to prevent state transitioning from certain states during batch processing. For example,  Example An event occurs indicating that batch processing should occur and should transition all features for a job to the next default state, for example In Service. If the current state of a feature indicates that batch processing should not be allowed to change the state for the feature (G3E_LIFECYCLE.G3E_ALLOWBATCH = 0), the state transitioning for that feature is skipped.  0 = Any feature with this state is not affected by the batch processing. 1 = Any feature with this state is affected by the batch processing. This is necessary only if there are transitions out of this state. For example, you might have transitions from In Service to Proposed Removed or Proposed Abandoned.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_RELATEDLCNO  |  The number of the life cycle state in a related feature that corresponds to this state. This might be used in models that have two sets of life cycle paths. One set is for your network facilities and the other set is for reporting facilities. Assuming there is a relationship between your network facilities and the reporting facilities, this value indicates the matching state for the reporting facilities.  Example A gas pipeline has states Proposed, In Service, and Removed. The pipeline's casing is related to the pipeline and it has only two states, Active and Inactive. When the pipeline transitions to a Removed state, the casing should become Inactive. Assuming the current G3E_LCNO corresponds to Removed, the value of G3E_RELATEDLCNO should be Inactive. The command software can automatically transition or set the state of the related feature when the pipeline is removed.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_LOCALECOMMENT  |  String describing the fields within the table that are to be localized and how they are to be used within the application. For information only.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (240)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_TRANSITION (Life Cycle Transitions Table)
Table name: G3E_TRANSITION 
Contains a mapping of transition states that allows the JobLifeCycle executable to determine what state a feature- component should transition to based on the current state the feature-component is in and the work management event that is currently being processed.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_TNO  |  Row for this transition.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_FROMSTATE  |  Key value of the "from" or current state value.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_TOSTATE  |  Key value of the "to" state value.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_DEFAULT  |  If the G3E_TRANSITION.G3E_DEFAULT value = 1, this record is used to set the state in which to transition in batch processing (based on the current state of the feature). If a specific state has multiple states that are valid as a destination, you must define a default so you can do batch processing.  0 = The transition row is not a default. 1 = The transition row is a default. Example  
 |   |  G3E_DEFAULT  |  G3E_FROMSTATE  |  G3E_TOSTATE  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  (Constructed)  |  1  |  3 (In Service)  |  7  |  
|  (Constructed)  |  0  |  11 (Out of Service)  |  7  |  
|  (Operational Removed)  |  1  |  6 (Proposed Removed)  |  9  |  
|  (Operational Removed)  |  0  |  12 (Removed)  |  9  |  
A feature currently has a state of Constructed and a transition is requested by batch processing. The batch process performs a query to find all possible destination (or G3E_TOSTATE) states based on the current state of the feature. The query in the example returns the records for In Service and Out of Service. Because In Service is set as the default value, the feature is transitioned to In Service. 
|  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (1,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_JLCNO  |  Key value of job life cycle value that should execute this transition if data are found that meets the G3E_FROMSTATE criteria.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_LOGICAIFACE (Logica Interface Table) (Deprecated)

##### G3E_LOGICAIFACE.G3E_TYPE Values (Deprecated)
|  Value  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  AbandonedState  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 value for this type identifies the [G3E_LIFECYCLE.G3E_VALUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/F_8zjvUTXpqWJGXxKtqBFw) of the state that represents abandoned data. This is necessary if cost information is stored on the feature so that it can be zeroed when the feature is abandoned.   |  
|  AncillaryCU  |  The component defined as the ancillary CU for any feature sent to Logica. The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the number of the component (G3E_CNO) that contains the ancillary CU data. The second argument is either zero or one to indicate if the component should be deleted (1) when the feature is transitioned to In Service. The G3E_CNO value and the flag are comma delimited.   |  
|  ChildToParentRNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_RNO of the child-to-parent ownership relationship used in the Logica-related features.   |  
|  CommentsCUANOs  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains ANOs for storing the CU G3E_CNO and G3E_CID values on the comments component. These ANOs define how the comments record is associated with the correct CU record. The ANOs are comma delimited and in the order of CNO,CID. Both ANOs must be defined for the comments component records to be processed during the Send to WMIS command.   |  
|  CommentPassedANO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the ANO for the field inside the comments component that marks the comment record as having been passed successfully to WMIS. If a successful response message is received from WMIS during the Send to WMIS command, this field is updated to 1 and not passed to WMIS on additional executions of the command.   |  
|  ConditionFactorCUANOs  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains ANOs for storing the CU G3E_CNO and G3E_CID values on the condition factor component. These ANOs define how the condition factor record is associated with the correct CU record. The ANOs are comma delimited and in the order of CNO,CID. Both ANOs must be defined for the condition factor component records to be processed during the Send to WMIS command.   |  
|  ContributionCUANOs  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains ANOs for storing the CU G3E_CNO, G3E_CID, and Voucher-Contribution indicator values on the contribution component. These ANOs define how the contribution record is associated with the correct CU record. The ANOs are comma delimited and in the order of CNO, CID, Voucher-Contribution indicator. Both CNO and CID ANOs must be defined for the contribution component records to be processed during the Send to WMIS command. The Voucher-Contribution indicator must be populated if the voucher and contribution components share the same CNO number.   |  
|  CUCategoryXref  |  The table and optimized table containing the CU category mapping for ancillary CU processing. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  ExportMessage  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the string defintion of the Export GIS Design to WMIS message used by the [Send to WMIS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/v7brqAwAkspSW9U1EoRINQ) command. This message is further defined inside the [G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/s9GcPFxUsogokTRUglTFow) table. The value must exist in the G3E_MESSAGE.G3E_OUTGOING.   |  
|  ExportQNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the QNO value from the [G3E_QUEUE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Zo8XGsEl0tTLdslL6Qu5gg) table that corresponds to the queue information used during send the export message from GIS to WMIS on the [Send to WMIS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/v7brqAwAkspSW9U1EoRINQ) command.   |  
|  Feature  |  The table containing the list of features considered in the work management interface. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  MaterialCUANOs  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains ANOs for storing the CU G3E_CNO and G3E_CID values on the material component. These ANOs define how the material record is associated with the correct CU record. The ANOs are comma delimited and in order of CNO,CID. Both ANOs must be defined for the material component records to be processed during the Send to WMIS command.   |  
|  OperationalState  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the value from the G3E_TRANSITION_OPTABLE.G3E_TOSTATEUSERNAME value that is to represent the operational state. Used in batch processing.   |  
|  ParentToChildRNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the [G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_RNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA) of the parent ownership relationship used in the Logica-related features.   |  
|  PrimaryCU  |  The component defined as the primary CU for any feature sent to Logica. The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the number of the component (G3E_CNO) that contains the primary CU data. The second argument is either zero or one to indicate if the component should be deleted (1) when the feature is transitioned to In Service. The G3E_CNO value and the flag are comma delimited.   |  
|  QueryTable  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the name of the foreign key table associated with the feature attributes that initiates the CU selection dialog. This table contains all the Logica CU data. And example is the CONSTRUCTION_UNIT table, which is the database table within the Logica software that defines compatible units information.   |  
|  ResponseQNO  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the QNO value from the G3E_QUEUE table that corresponds to the queue information used to listen for a reponse message from WMIS after sending the export message using the Send to WMIS command.   |  
|  ResponseTimeout  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains the timeout number (in seconds) for the [Send to WMIS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/v7brqAwAkspSW9U1EoRINQ) command to wait for a response message after sending the export message.   |  
|  StaticAttributes  |  The table containing the static attribute mapping of CU and static feature attributes. For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |  
|  ThirdPartiesCUANOs  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains ANOs for storing the CU G3E_CNO and G3E_CID values on the third parties component. These ANOs define how the third parties record is associated with the correct CU record. The ANOs are comma delimited and in the order of CNO,CID. Both ANOs must be defined for the third parties' component records to be processed during the Send to WMIS command.   |  
|  VoucherCUANOs  |  The G3E_PARAMETER1 field contains ANOs for storing the CU G3E_CNO, G3E_CID, and Voucher-Contribution indicator values on the voucher component. These ANOs define how the voucher record is associated with the correct CU record. The ANOs are comma delimited and in the order of CNO, CID, Voucher-Contribution indicator. Both CNO and CID ANOs must be defined for the voucher component records to be processed during the Send to WMIS command. The Voucher-Contribution indicator must be populated if the voucher and contribution components share the same CNO number.   |

#### G3E_MESSAGE (Message Table)

##### G3E_MESSAGE.G3E_ACTION Values
|  G3E_ACTION  |  Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  0  |  No action  |  
|  1  |  Convert input point (Longitude/Longitude in decimal degrees) to NetWorks Core database coordinates.   |  
|  2  |  Convert input point (Longitude/Longitude in radians) to NetWorks Core database coordinates.   |  
|  3  |  Find polygon names and types that contain input points (in NetWorks Core database coordinates).   |  
|  4  |  Create a record in the NetWorks Core job table with input field values.   |  
|  5  |  Update the NetWorks Core job table with input field values.   |  
|  6  |  Create a record in the NetWorks Core job status table based on G3E_JLCNO value.   |  
|  7  |  Create a record in the NetWorks Core job status table based on G3E_JLCNO value, and update the NetWorks Core job table with input field values (for example, 5 + 6).   |  
|  8  |  Parse the export response message for status and text elements.  |  
|  9  |  Create a revision for the work request (number) passed using the definitions in [G3E_JOBDEFINITION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TBQDr_BsRYh8ej2Rr97t2g) table. If Job ID is specified, copy that job to the new revision job created.   |  
For more information see [Considerations When Creating a Message Format](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/UjGkGBzsXhaFaczOBw_ZRA)

##### Values for the G3E_WORKMGMT Table
|  G3E_TYPE Value  |  Description  |  G3E_TABLE Value  |  G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLEValue  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Messages  |  Metadata table for messages  |  G3E_MESSAGE  |  [G3E_MESSAGE_OPTABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/GSCfJH0yvu1QFMDOpFzLqQ)  |

#### G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT (Message Format Table)
Table name: G3E_MESSAGEFORMAT 
Contains information necessary to support XML message formats. The message format is a description of the name of the message and then the definition of each element or field in the message. Each element is mapped to either an attribute in the NetWorks Core model or a literal value. This table is referenced in the [G3E_WORKMGMT table](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KME_1L76HZEDZ5lzihAbeQ). The [Job Processing Service](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/j3dODE7yUK4XgK5dffnpqg) uses this metadata table to read and write message formats. See the [Message Format tool topics](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/BpkKOMrwXQSfSpGNibZFgw) for more information.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_MFNO  |  Row identifier for the table  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_NAME  |  Name of this message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_TYPE  |  Element type referenced by the interface software. Some of the elements are significant to the processing of the message. These are identified by specific types. They are transferred to the specified G3E_ANO. This is a foreign key to [G3E_MESSAGEFORMATTYPE.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/SUJ9BmTvA0cfmvtjNUFwaw). All other elements are untypes (Null).   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Varchar2 (30)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEMENTTAGNAME  |  Tag name for an element of a message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_PARENTTAGNAME  |  Tag name of the parent element of a message  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEATTRNAME  |  Attribute name of an element of a message  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ELEATTRVALUE  |  Attribute value of an element of a message  |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_VALUE  |  Literal value for this element. This value is only used in outgoing messages.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_ANO  |  NetWorks Core attribute that stores this tag's value   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  Yes  |  Number (9, 0)  |   |  
|  G3E_ORDINAL  |  The order number element tag within this message. Must be equal to or greater than zero. Must be unique for a specific G3E_NAME when it is not zero. Should be zero if the element tag order is not considered.   |  Yes*  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (5,0)  |  0  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |  
* Unique for a specific G3E_NAME. Checked on validation.

#### G3E_WORKPOINT (Work Point Table)
Table name: G3E_WORKPOINT 
Work Point features are necessary as a grouping mechanism within GIS for data manipulation. The work point is sent to work management systems with the associated work (data manipulation) at that location. You must identify the work point feature in the interface table. You must also identify the attribute that contains the work point number. The work point feature must be set up as child of structural features in your data model using the ownership relationship. Work points can be placed interactively by the designer, or they are automatically generated when CU data are sent to your work management systems. 
For each structure, identify the offset (X,Y) for the work point from each owner feature. You must still make the appropriate ownership entries in [G3E_OWNERSHIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ) for the work point.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_FNO  |  Number of parent feature.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  Yes  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_XOFFSET  |  Delta X units to add to the location of the parent feature for positioning the work point instance.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_YOFFSET  |  Delta Y units to add to the location of the parent feature for positioning the work point instance.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |  1  |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

#### G3E_CALCULATIONINTERFACE (Calculation Interface Table) (Deprecated)
Table name: G3E_CALCULATIONINTERFACE 
Contains a list of the functions available as calculation interfaces. Each function is effectively an automated object that supports the calculation interface definition. The calculation interfaces are called according to the rules in a number of metadata tables. Each interface calculates or derives a value from the feature's attribution, but the needed value is not stored in the feature. 
Input to the function is the recordset of the active feature. Any additional arguments are defined by the technique. This table is used in the creation of analysis output and in the interface to SAP.   
|  Column Name  |  Description  |  Unique  |  Null  |  Localize  |  PK  |  FK  |  Type  |  Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  G3E_CINO  |  Row identifier for the calculation interface.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  Yes  |  No  |  Number (9,0)  |   |  
|  G3E_USERNAME  |  Descriptive name of the interface. This appears in the user interface list.  |  Yes  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (80)  |   |  
|  G3E_INTERFACE  |  ProgID of the software component to support this function. This must be a Visual Basic class. It should contain no space and begin with a letter.   |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Varchar2 (256)  |   |  
|  G3E_ARGUMENTPROMPT  |  Array of variants containing prompts describing the arguments for the relationship attribute interface. When an interface is assigned to an attribute entry in the SAP metadata tables, the metadata definition tools request values for the interface's arguments using these prompts.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  Raw (2000)  |   |  
|  G3E_ARGUMENTTYPE  |  Array of variants containing the [data types](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Fq1pfuicpDm0jwjnFaF0tA) of the arguments for the relationship attribute interface. This information is used to prompt for and/or validate the values provided when instances of the interface are assigned to the attributes in SAP processing.   |  No  |  Yes  |   |  No  |  No  |  RAW (2000)  |   |  
|  G3E_EDITDATE  |  Date the record was created or last edited.  |  No  |  No  |   |  No  |  No  |  Date  |   |

For this type, G3E_PARAMETER1 is Null. Values are pulled from the G3E_TABLE and G3E_OPTIMIZEDTABLE fields.   |
