#### Defining Features in GPT

##### Adding a Feature
The Facilities node in the GPT tree view lists the features, or significant entities, in your data model. Each Facility node in the tree view has Components, Tabs, Dialog box, and Relations nodes under it. 
  * To add a feature:


  1. In the tree view, select the Facilites node.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259345)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Facility. 
OR
Right-click the Facilities node, and select Add New Facility. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259345), and select Add New Facility. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259345)
  3. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Name  |  [G3E_FEATURE.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/VFyFq8MbVW9PQDgb03TtpQ)  |  
|  Number  |  [G3E_FEATURE.G3E_FNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/VFyFq8MbVW9PQDgb03TtpQ)  |  
|  Tooltip  |  [G3E_FEATURE.G3E_TOOLTIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/VFyFq8MbVW9PQDgb03TtpQ)  |  
|  Primary geographic component  |  [G3E_FEATURE.G3E_PRIMARYGEOGRAPHICCNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/VFyFq8MbVW9PQDgb03TtpQ)  |  
|  Primary attribute component  |  [G3E_FEATURE.G3E_PRIMARYATTRIBUTECNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/VFyFq8MbVW9PQDgb03TtpQ)  |  
  4. In the Name field, type the name of your new feature. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259345) The Tooltip field populates as you type the feature name. You can change the tooltip. 
  5. To delete a row from the grid, highlight the row and click Remove. 
  6. Click Update to add the feature to the Facilities list.

##### Associating Components with a Feature
After you define components in NetWorks Core Tool (also known as GPT), you must associate them with a feature. 
  * To associate a component with a feature:


  1. In the Facilities node, expand the feature to which you want to add a new component.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259350)
  2. In the Components node, highlight the component you want to add to the feature.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259350)
  3. Drag and drop the component to the Components node under the appropriate feature. The primary geographic and primary attribute components are automatically assigned. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259350)
  4. Define the properties of the component.
    1. Highlight the component. The content panel shows the following information:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Required  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_REQUIRED](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Repeating  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_REPEATING](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Autorepeating  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_AUTOREPEAT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
    2. On the General tab, check Required, Repeating, and Autorepeating appropriately. If you leave the checkboxes empty, the component is optional. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259350)
    3. On the Advanced tab, select or type the appropriate values for the component. 
  5. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Break action  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_BREAKACTION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Component elimination  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_COMPONENTELIMINATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Component assignment  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_COMPONENTASSIGNMENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Geoproximity tolerance  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_GEOPROXIMITYTOLERANCE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Component adjustment  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_COMPONENTADJUSTMENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Break linear component  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_BREAKLINEARCNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Alternate geographic  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_ALTERNATEGEOGRAPHIC](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
|  Ordinal number for alternate geographic  |  [G3E_FEATURECOMPONENT.G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Rjj_uDxsdrE5MNsL_z1Q5w)  |  
The Alternate geographic textbox is disabled if the component type is nongraphic or if the component is a primary geographic component on the feature. If you check Alternate geographic, you must specify an ordinal value for the component. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259350)
  6. Click Update.

##### Defining a Component
You can use the NetWorks Core[graphic and nongraphic components](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/K113PpOsAczZ2dRZqFBX_w). G3E_JOB is the predefined component. The Components folder is one of the four main folders in a data connection. 
  * To define a component:


  1. In the tree view, select the Components node.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259357)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Component. 
OR
Right-click the Components node, and select Add New Component. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259357) and select Add New Component. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/PcoV_i4IP8YMyxv7JB3bWw-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=f0c0c3fd8aeaf604&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  3. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Description   |  Value  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
|  Name  |  The name of the component  |  [G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw)  |  
|  Number  |  The component number  |  [G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_CNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw)  |  
|  Table  |  The table name for the component  |  [G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_TABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw)  |  
|  Tooltip  |  The tooltip used for the component  |  [G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_TOOLTIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw)  |  
|  Type  |  The type of the component  |  [G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_TYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw)  |  
|  Subtype  |  The geometry type of the component, if any  |  [G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_GEOMETRYTYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw)  |  
  4. In the Name field, type the name of your new component. The name you type automatically reproduces in the Table field and in the Tooltip field. The name in the Table field is postfixed, depending on the component type:   
|  Type  |  Postifix   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Nongraphic  |  N  |  
|  SpatialLine  |  LN  |  
|  SpatialArea/SpatialCoverage  |  AR  |  
|  SpatialPoint  |  S  |  
|  Graphic text  |  LBL  |  
  5. Change the text in the Table and Tooltip fields as required. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259357) Nongraphic table names must be less than or equal to 24 characters. Graphic table names must be less than or equal to 16 characters. 
  6. In the Type field, select a component type from the drop-down list. 
  7. If you select a graphic type, in the Subtype field, select a component subtype from the drop-down list. 
  8. To add an item to the bottom of the Attributes grid, click Add. 
  9. To duplicate an item on the bottom of the Attributes grid, select the item and click Duplicate. 
  10. To remove an item from the Attributes grid, select the item and click Remove. 
  11. Check LTT Component if you want the component to participate in long-term transactions. 
  12. Click Update.

##### Defining An Attribute
After you use the GPT to create a component, you must [define attributes](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw) for it. 
  * To define an attribute:


  1. In the GPT tree view under the component you created, select the Attributes node.
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Attribute. 
OR
Right-click the Attributes node, and select Add New Attribute. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259361) and select Add New Attribute. 
The attribute is added to the end of the list of attributes.
  3. Select the attribute you created.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259361)
  4. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Attribute type  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_FIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw) The following are the types:  
Key: The attribute is a key (G3E_ID, G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO, G3E_CID).  
Geometry field: The attribute pertains to a component, whose type is GraphicText.  
General: User defined attributes.  Populated by the software.  |  
|  Number  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_ANO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Data precision  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_PRECISION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Data scale  |  Scale as defined in the Oracle data type for a numeric attribute. ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259361) Aligned with Data Scale at the extreme right, you may see the format with which the attribute is displayed. For example, if a data type has precision 7 and scale 3, ‘000.0000’ is displayed.  Retrieved from Oracle.  |  
|  Data size  |  Size as defined in the Oracle data type for a character type attribute. Retrieved from Oracle.   |  
|  Data default  |  Default value for the attribute (if any). Retrieved from Oracle.  |  
|  Null allowed  |  Indicates whether the attribute can have a Null value. Retrieved from Oracle.  |  
|  Name  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Column  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_FIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Tooltip  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_TOOLTIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  DataType  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_DATATYPE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Format  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_FORMAT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Exclude from replace  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_EXCLUDEFROMREPLACE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Copy  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_COPY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Break copy  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_BREAKCOPYCOPY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Required  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_REQUIRED](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Exclude from edit  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_EXCLUDEFROMEDIT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
|  Hypertext  |  [G3E_ATTRIBUTE.G3E_HYPERTEXT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/7SEquKvasMNJcZ25A9H4yw)  |  
  5. In the Name field, type the name of your new attribute. The name you type automatically reproduces in the Column field and in the Tooltip field. 
  6. Change the text in the Column and Tooltip fields as required. 
  7. In the Data type field, select a data type from the drop-down list. 
  8. If the data type is Single or Double, you can change the Precision field and/or the Scale field. 
  9. In the Format field, select a format for the attribute from the drop-down list. 
  10. In the Picklist field, select a picklist to which to add the attribute. 
  11. Click Update.

#### Defining Legends in GPT

##### Adding Components to a Legend
After you define a legend in GPT, you can add components to it.
  * To add a component to a legend:


  1. In the GPT tree view, select a legend setting (under the Legends node) to which you want to add a component. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259483)
  2. In the legend settings' Display Control tab, expand the tree to the position where you want to place the component. 
  3. Select the Dataconnections > <database> > Facilities > <facility> > Components > <component> node of the component you want to add. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259483)
  4. Drag and drop the component into the Display Control tab. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259483)
See [Defining a New Legend](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/2n_bvAoUZL86KrZb7rh7xQ)Legend panel. 
  5. Use the commands on the pop-up menu to position the legend entry in the Display Control tree:   
|  Command  |  Use to   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Add Into  |  Add the legend entry into a highlighted node or non-leaf subnode  |  
|  Add Before  |  Add the legend entry before a highlighted node or non-leaf subnode  |  
|  Insert Before  |  Place a copy of the legend entry before the highlighted item as a sibling item  |  
|  Insert Into  |  Place a copy of the legend entry into the highlighted non-leaf node and make it a child item   |  
|  Move Before  |  Move the legend entry into the highlighted non-leaf node and make it a sibling item  |  
|  Move Into  |  Move the legend entry into the highlighted non-leaf node and make it a child item  |  
  6. Filter the data displayed on this legend associated with the particular component view: 
    1. Select an operator from the drop-down list.
    2. Click Add, And, or Or. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259483) The filter fields are enabled only when you select a leaf node on the Display Control tab. 
  7. Type the appropriate numbers in the Display scale max and Display scale min fields. 
  8. Check Display, User display scale, and Locatable, as required. 
  9. On the Legend Items tab, click [Do Not Share](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/2n_bvAoUZL86KrZb7rh7xQ) as required. 
![Warning](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259483) To see which items are shared with another legend and which are not shared, scroll to the Shared column. 
  10. Click Update.

##### Adding Legend Settings to a Legend
After defining a legend in GPT, you can add legend settings to it. There are two ways to add new legend settings to a legend: using default values or using a selection. Adding a new legend setting inserts a row with the following values into the G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS table:   
|  Column   |  Value  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  G3E_LNO  |  Value of the selected legend setting.   |  
|  GE3_LSNO   |  Unique   |  
|  G3E_SEEDLSNO   |  0 if using default settings.  
G3E_LSNO of the selected legend setting if using the selection.   |  
  * To add legend settings to a legend using default values:


  1. In the tree view, select a legend settings' name that has the legend number of the legend you want to add to. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/hYX44d8PuBgJVfAm0c_uSQ-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=3faf3173cb846291&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add new Legend Settings using defaults. 
OR 
Right-click the legend settings' node under Legends, and select Add new Legend Settings using defaults. 


  * To add legend settings to a legend using existing values from the selected legend settings: 


  1. In the tree view, select the legend settings' username that has the legend setting number whose value you want to use. 
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add new Legend Settings using selection. 
OR 
Right-click the legend settings' node under Legends, and select Add new Legend Settings using selection.

##### Copy and Paste Legend Settings
You can copy a legend settings group in the NetWorks Core Project Tool (also known as GPT) tree view and paste it to create a new legend with the copied legend settings. 
  * To copy and paste a legend settings group:


In the GPT tree view, under the Legends node, select the legend settings name you want to copy. 
  1. From the Edit menu, select Copy. 
OR
Right-click the item, and select Copy. 
  2. Select the Legends node. 
  3. From the Edit menu, select Paste. 
OR
Right-click and select Paste. The following dialog box appears. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261503)
  4. Make the appropriate choices, and click OK.

##### Copying and Pasting a Legend Entry
You can copy a legend entry in the NetWorks Core Project Tool (also known as GPT) tree view and use it to create an entry for the same component on another legend. 
  * To copy and paste a legend entry:


  1. In the GPT tree view, select a specific legend entry.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261491)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Copy. 
OR
Right-click the item, and select Copy. 
  3. To paste the item you copied, click where you want to paste the legend entry.
  4. From the Edit menu, select Paste. 
OR
Right-click the item, and select Paste. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261491)
  5. Make the appropriate choice, and click OK.

##### Defining a Format Condition
You can use the Project Tool (GPT) to define a format condition only for label components. Format conditions are child nodes of individual legend entries. 
  * To define a format condition:


  1. In the tree view, select a label component node, and navigate to the Legend Entries > Format Conditions node. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259466)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Format Condition. 
OR
Right-click the Format Conditions node, and select Add New Format Condition. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259466) and select Add New Format Condition. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259466)
  3. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Name  |  [G3E_LABELRULE.G3E_RULE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XhCqhW831qxPA3~bdSlxhw)  |  
|  Number  |  [G3E_LABELRULE.G3E_LRNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XhCqhW831qxPA3~bdSlxhw)  |  
|  Ordinal  |  [G3E_LABELRULE.G3E_FILTERORDINAL](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XhCqhW831qxPA3~bdSlxhw)  |  
  4. In the Name field, type a name for the format condition. 
  5. Click the Ordinal arrows up or down, or type a value in the field. The maximum value is 99. 
  6. On the Filter tab, filter the data for the format condition: 
  7. Select a format condition from the drop-down list.
    1. Select an operator from the drop-down list.
    2. If you select the BETWEEN SQL operator, you can select a value from the Value 2 drop-down list. 
    3. Click the buttons as required to create the SQL statement.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259466)
  8. On the Content tab, select from the list of components and related attributes: 
    1. Select a component.
    2. Select an attribute.
    3. Click Add to Content. 
  9. Click Update.

##### Defining a New Legend Entry
You can use GPT to define a new [legend entry](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/e7yPWzKDClZ5gnxr2ug01A) for a specific graphic component. 
  * To define a legend entry:


  1. In the GPT tree view, select the Dataconnections > <database> > Facilities > <facility> > Components > <graphic component> > Legend Entries node. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259471)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Legend Entry. 
OR
Right-click the Legend Entries node, and select Add New Legend Entry. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259471) and select Add New Legend Entry. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/A8wortoZhsJg833pZBOn0w-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=6e5a73f132e0ff7e&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  3. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Name  |  [G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_LEGENDENTRY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw)  |  
|  Number  |  [G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_LENO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw)  |  
|  Display  |  [G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw)  |  
|  View  |  The value of [G3E_COMPONENTVIEWDEFINITION.G3E_VIEW](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/3HXuJCbhR4Htau5yrp55kw) that corresponds to [G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_VNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw).   |  
|  Available attribute fields  |  All feature component table column names excluding defaults and any attributes already used in [G3E_COMPONENTVIEWCOMPOSITION.G3E_FIELDS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/X9EcOVIWIsiQzIZGdzin3A). This field is used so the software can apply the style and label rules for presentation of dynamics while drawing or editing a feature component.   |  
|  View attribute fields used in filters  |  Legend filters: [G3E_STYLERULE.G3E_FILTER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA), [G3E_LABELRULE.G3E_FILTER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XhCqhW831qxPA3~bdSlxhw), [G3E_LABEL.G3E_CONTENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/3cbIOFsKiLyGeaWd3nw3nQ), [G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE.G3E_FILTER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/37fQRgD9_K5cgp1rZXsMGg)  |  
|  View additional attribute fields  |  G3E_COMPONENTVIEWCOMPOSITION.G3E_FIELDS excluding defaults and legend filters.  |  
|  Translucency  |  [G3E_LEGENDENTRY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw).G3E_TRANSLUCENCY   |  
|  Fill translucency  |  [G3E_LEGENDENTRY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw).G3E_FILLTRANSLUCENCY   |  
  4. In the Name field, type a name for the legend entry. 
  5. Change the text in the Display field if necessary. 
  6. Use the right and left arrows to add and remove items from the View additional attribute fields field. You are adding attributes to and removing attributes from the component view. 
  7. Select or type values in the Translucency and Fill translucency fields as required. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259471) The software automatically creates the component view in the database to support this legend entry. But it only uses the attributes referenced in the style conditions, format conditions, or the format for the label. You may need additional attributes for tooltips or to support relationship performance optimization. 
  8. To delete a style condition or a format condition, highlight a row on the appropriate tab, and click Remove. 
  9. To copy and paste a legend entry, right-click on the legend entry you want to copy, and select Copy. Click where you want to paste the legend entry, right-click, and select Paste. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259471)
  10. Select the appropriate settings, and click OK. 
  11. Click Update.

##### Defining a New Legend
After you use the Project Tool (GPT) to add the legend, you can add legend settings to it. The Legends folder is one of the four main folders in a data source. 
  * To define a new legend:


  1. In the tree view, select the Legends node.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259459)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Legend. 
OR
Right-click the Legends node, and select Add New Legend. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259459) and select Add New Legend. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/ZO5~RZV7gm0rMpYM7LiErQ-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=cdb4d7bd53eccc10&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  3. Review the information in the content panel for [G3E_LEGEND](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/dkXBUKhJYRP6rlMPMUk7Kg) or [G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5TsqlYTiAxwXTGbEqbC3Fg):   
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Legend number  |  G3E_LEGEND.G3E_LNO  |  
|  Detail  |  G3E_LEGEND.G3E_DETAIL  |  
|  Paper scale  |  G3E_LEGEND.G3E_PAPERSCALE  |  
|  Alternate geo ordinal  |  G3E_LEGEND.G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL  |  
|  Legend Settings number  |  G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS.G3E_LSNO  |  
|  Default  |  G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS.G3E_DEFAULT  |  
|  Name  |  G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS.G3E_USERNAME  |  
|  Honor PDF layers or translucency  |  G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS.G3E_USERNAME  |  
The content panel for legends contains the following tabs:
     * Display Control—Lists the components that can be displayed in the legend. 
     * Legend Items—Lists all legend items. 
     * Links—Contains redirections to other parts of GPT. The Display Control tab displays the legend as it is in NetWorks Core. Thus, there are nodes for each facility, and the children of each facility node are nodes themselves. They are the components a user can see in the map view. The leaf of each component node is a legend entry. 
  4. You can click a node or leaf in the tree structure of the Display Control tab or an item in the Legend Items tab to see the properties of a specific node or leaf as described in the following fields:   
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Legend entry number  |  [G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_LENO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kofwLrmyr06Gi_I92qslWw). This field is disabled if the selection is a node and not a leaf.   |  
|  Display ordinal  |  [G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE.G3E_DISPLAYORDINAL](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/37fQRgD9_K5cgp1rZXsMGg)  |  
|  Display scale MIN  |  [G3E_SETTINGSTABLE.G3E_DISPLAYSCALEMIN](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5UJi_D2EF3RLbqldV6jGhQ)  |  
|  Display scale MAX  |  [G3E_SETTINGSTABLE.G3E_DISPLAYSCALEMAX](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5UJi_D2EF3RLbqldV6jGhQ)  |  
|  Display  |  [G3E_SETTINGSTABLE.G3E_DISPLAYMODE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5UJi_D2EF3RLbqldV6jGhQ)  |  
|  Use display scale  |  [G3E_SETTINGSTABLE.G3E_USEDISPLAYSCALE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5UJi_D2EF3RLbqldV6jGhQ)  |  
|  Locatable  |  [G3E_SETTINGSTABLE.G3E_LOCATABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/5UJi_D2EF3RLbqldV6jGhQ)  |  
  5. In the Name field, type a name for the legend. 
  6. From the Paper scale drop-down list, select the paper scale. 
  7. Check the Detail and Default boxes as required. 
  8. From the Alternate geo ordinal drop-down list, select the ordinal. 
  9. Create a display filter:
    1. Select an operator from the drop-down list.
    2. Click Add, And, or Or. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259459) The filter fields are enabled only when you select a leaf node on the Display Control tab. 
  10. On the Legends Items tab, click [Do Not Share](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/2n_bvAoUZL86KrZb7rh7xQ) as required. To see which items are shared with another legend and which are not shared, scroll to the Shared column. 
  11. Click Update.

##### Defining a Style Condition
Define a style condition for each legend entry. Style conditions are child nodes of individual legend entries. 
  * To define a style condition:


  1. In the GPT tree view, select a Facility, and navigate to the Component > Legend Entries > Style Conditions node. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259476)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Style Condition. 
OR
Right-click the Style Conditions node, and select Add New Style Condition. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259476) and select Add New Style Condition. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259476)
  3. On the Select The Item dialog box, select a style from the drop-down list, and click OK. 
The Style Condition panel appears. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259476)
  4. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Name  |  [G3E_STYLERULE.G3E_RULE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA)  |  
|  Style  |  [G3E_STYLERULE.G3E_SNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA)  |  
|  Number  |  [G3E_STYLERULE.G3E_SRNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA)  |  
|  Ordinal  |  [G3E_STYLERULE.G3E_FILTERORDINAL](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA)  |  
|  Filter  |  [G3E_STYLERULE.G3E_FILTER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Jm_ou6DGz8E1PSeRsGtPxA)  |  
  5. In the Name field, type a name for the style condition. 
  6. Click the Ordinal arrows up or down, or type a value in the field. The maximum value is 99. 
  7. Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259476) to associate a style to this style condition. This is the connection to the [G3E_STYLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/0sEp1oH8BhJknBDlWdc4uA) table. 
  8. Click Reload to set the query to information currently in the database. 
  9. On the Filter tab, filter the data for the style condition: 
    1. Select a style condition from the drop-down list.
    2. Select an operator and values from the drop-down lists as required.
    3. Click the buttons as required to create the SQL statement.
  10. Click Update.

##### Deleting a Legend or Legend Settings
You can delete a legend settings group in the GPT tree view. When you delete a legend settings group, you are deleting a row from the G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS table. When you delete the last legend settings group, the corresponding legend is also deleted. 
To delete a legend, you have to delete each of its legend settings groups.
  * To delete a legend settings group:


In the GPT tree view, under the Legends node, select the legend settings name that you want to delete. 
  1. From the Edit menu, select Delete. 
OR
  2. Right-click the item, and select Delete. 
     * If the legend has multiple legend settings groups, the row corresponding to the selected legend settings name is deleted from the G3E_LEGENDSETTINGS table. 
     * If the legend has only one legend settings group, the following dialog box appears:
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261506)
  3. Click Yes if you want to delete the legend.

##### Manipulating Legend Items
After you have placed legend items in the GPT Display Control tree, you can manipulate them in several ways, including changing the display order and editing the display names. 
  * To edit legend items:


On the Legend panel Display Control tab, right-click an item you want to change. 
These commands are enabled depending on where you are in the Display Control tab.   
|  Command  |  Function  |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Edit  |  Change the name of an item  |  
|  Delete  |  Delete a legend item  |  
|  Copy  |  Copy a legend item  |  
|  Paste  |  [Paste a legend item](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/32DHXQXR0YQwRB_fV3R0uw) and select the appropriate operation from the drop-down list   |  
  * To change the order of legend items:


  1. Click the Legend Items tab. 
  2. Right-click the item you want to move.
  3. Copy the item.
  4. Right-click the location where you want to move the item.
  5. Paste the item.

##### Not Sharing a Legend Item
If the legend entry is shared, it appears more than once in one or more of the legends in your database. When a legend is not shared, GPT makes a copy of the legend entry or entries selected and updates the [G3E_DEFINITIONTABLE.G3E_LENO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/37fQRgD9_K5cgp1rZXsMGg) and [G3E_DISPLAYCONTROLTABLE.G3E_LEGENDITEM](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/U27QBJy1LkijFwfEFQHj0Q) with the newly created G3E_LEGENDENTRY.G3E_LENO. The software creates a new username and legend entry number and replaces the original legend entry with the new legend entry in the definition and display control tables. 
  * To not share a legend item:


  1. On the Legend dialog box, select the Legend Items tab. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/MlWDtqkntXsMVqhGzLlMBA-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=c8a3465c2db9bbce&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  2. Select the legend item that you do not want to share.
  3. Click Do Not Share to replace the legend entry with a new legend entry that is not shared.

##### Update Legend Settings
You can update a legend settings group in the GPT tree view.
  * To update a legend settings group:


  1. In the GPT tree view, under the Legends node, select the legend setting's username that has the legend entry you want to update. 
  2. In the Legend panel: 
    1. From the Display Control tab or the Legend Items tab, select the legend entry you want to update. 
    2. Change the writable values, as necessary.
    3. Click Update.

#### Defining Picklists in GPT

##### Associating a Picklist with Attributes
After you create a picklist in GPT, you must associate it with an attribute or with an attribute tab. The data type of the picklist key and the data type of the attribute must be the same, or data in the component can be a larger size than the data in the picklist. 
  * To associate a picklist with an attribute or attribute tab:


  1. Highlight the picklist you want to associate.
  2. Drag and drop the picklist over an attribute or an attribute tab.

##### Defining a Picklist Field
Picklist fields appear as child nodes of Fields under the Picklists node:
  * To define a picklist field:


  1. In the GPT tree view, select a Fields node under a picklist node.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261817)
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Picklist Field. 
OR
Right-click the Fields node, and select Add New Picklist Field. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261817) and select Add New Picklist Field. A new field appears under the picklist. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261817)
  3. In the Name field, type a name for the picklist field. 
  4. In the Data Type field, select the data type for the field. 
  5. Depending on your selection in the Data Type field, type values in the Data Precision, Data Scale, and Data Size fields. 
  6. Check if the field cannot be Null.
  7. Click Update.

##### Defining a Picklist from an Existing Picklist
You can use an existing picklist (table) as a base for your new picklist.
  * To define a picklist from an existing picklist:


  1. In the GPT tree view, select the Picklists node.
  2. From the Edit menu, select Create from Table. 
OR
Right-click the Picklist node, and select Create from Table. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261806) and select Create from Table. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261806)
  3. Select the table from which you want to create the picklist.
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261806) The new picklist appears at the bottom of the list. The tabs on the Picklist properties panel contain the information from the picklist table you selected. 
  4. Follow Steps 3-9 of the [define a new picklist workflow](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/n_sa5Y0dc1EtrAmv7zr3fQ), and use the table as guidance.

##### Defining a Picklist from Scratch
You define a new picklist when you do not already have a table that contains your special values. The Project Tool (GPT) lets you define the table and fields and the terms or items in the list. 
  * To define a new picklist from scratch:


  1. In the GPT tree view, select the Picklists node.
  2. From the Edit menu, select Add New Picklist. 
OR
Right-click the Picklists node, and select Add New Picklist. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261797) and select Add New Picklist. The new picklist appears at the bottom of the list. The tabs for the picklist are empty. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261797)
  3. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Name  |  [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw)  |  
|  Table  |  [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_TABLE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw)  |  
|  Number  |  [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_PNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw)  |  
|  Key Field  |  [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_KEYFIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw)  |  
|  Value Field  |  [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_VALUEFIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw)  |  
|  Order by  |  [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_ORDERBYKEY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw)  |  
|  Validation  |  [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_VALIDATION](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw)  |  
|  Publish  |  [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_PUBLISH](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw)  |  
  4. In the Name field, type a name for the picklist. 
  5. If necessary, modify the name in the Table field. 
  6. Select the key and value, respectively, in Key and Value fields. 
  7. In the Order by field, select the way you want the picklist ordered. This is the value of G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_ORDERBY. 
  8. In the Validation field, select the [type of validation](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/XwO2D6rCVtGKBm9zVen2vw). 
  9. If [publishing is required](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/Yvbd8coZJsv5vC_1ZB_Wjg), check Publish. 
  10. Click Update.

##### Filtering a Picklist
After you use GPT to create the picklist, you can create an SQL statement to filter it. The SQL statement is the value of [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_FILTER](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw). 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261803) If the filter contains a string variable, the expression for the variable must be contained within single quotes (') so the database can identify that the filter contains a string. 
  * To filter a picklist:


  1. On the Picklist properties panel, select the Filter tab. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261803)
  2. From the Field drop-down list, select a column name from the applicable table, and click the appropriate button to add the information to the statement box. 
  3. From the Operator drop-down list, select an SQL operator, and click the appropriate button to add the information to the statement box. 
  4. From the Value drop-down list, select a value that relates to the field you selected in Step 2. Click the appropriate button to add the information to the statement box. 
  5. If you select the BETWEEN SQL operator, you can select a value from the Value 2 field. 
  6. Click Reset to delete information from the filter, and click Reload to set the filter to the information currently in the database. 
  7. Click Update.

##### Inserting Terms in the Picklist
After you create the picklist in GPT, you can add new terms to the list.
  * To add new terms to a picklist:


  1. On the Picklist properties panel, select the Value tab. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/O_jEaRl_AKSJgjPA5d589w-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=b97e349a5956154d&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  2. Type values in the grid cells based on business rules and standards for your data model. 
  3. Click Update. 
  4. To remove a term, highlight the row, press DELETE, and click Update.

##### Selecting Additional Fields for a Picklist
After you create the picklist in GPT, you can add additional columns to include when querying for picklist values. Querying for additional fields results in a multi-column drop-down list when the picklist is used in Feature Explorer. The following snapshot shows an example of the drop-down list: 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/MKurpmLUQPUVm4buQ5i_oQ-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=d4aeb9797f5f8019&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
The additional fields are stored in [G3E_PICKLIST.G3E_ADDITIONALFIELDS](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/1Hghbgy9rikks~bnc1MKiw). They appear in the multi-column drop-down list in the order selected. 
  * To select additional fields for the picklist:


  1. On the Picklist properties panel, select the Additional Fields tab. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261812)
  2. Use the ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261812), ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261812), ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261812), or ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261812) to move fields from the Available fields list to the Additional fields list and back. 
  3. Click Reset to clear the Additional fields and to reset the Available fields list to all the fields in the picklist. 
  4. Click Reload to populate the Additional fields list with the current database list and to populate the Available fields list with the remaining fields. 
  5. Click Update.

#### Defining Relationships in GPT

##### Defining Relationships
After you add a new relationship in GPT, you can review and then edit it to meet the needs of your data model. You create node-edge connectivity, ownership, and many-to-many ownership relationships exactly the same way. 
  * To add a new relationship:


  1. In the tree view, select the Relationships node.
  2. From the Edit menu, select Create NodeEdgeConnectivity, Create Ownership, or Create MMOwnership. 
OR
Right-click the Relationships node, and select Create NodeEdgeConnectivity, Create Ownership, or Create MMOwnership. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259423) and select select Create NodeEdgeConnectivity, Create Ownership, or Create MMOwnership. 
If you create an ownership relationship or a many-to-many ownership relationship, the software creates and displays a child node and a parent node for each relationship. If you create a node-edge connectivity relationship, the software creates a node-edge connectivity node.   
|  Example ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259423)  |  
| --- |  
  3. Select the relationship you want to configure.
  4. On the General tab, do the following: 
    1. In the Name field, edit the name of the relationship, for example OwnershipHelp Parent. 
    2. In the Tooltip field, edit the tooltip. 
    3. If necessary, select a table name from the Table drop-down list. 
    4. If necessary, select a support component number from the Support component drop-down list. The component number appears in the field. 
    5. Click Other participant, and select one relationship from the list when a relationship requires two entries. They are reciprocal relationships that describe a hierarchy. The ownership and many-to-many ownership relationships require another participant while node-edge connectivity does not. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259423)
  5. Review the information in the content panel:

|  Number  |  [G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_RNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA)  |

##### Relating a Feature to Another Feature
You can use GPT to establish a node-edge, ownership, or many-to-many ownership relationship by dragging a feature to the Relations node of another feature. Before you can relate one feature to another feature, you must have already [established the appropriate relationship](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/D~aChHJAqw7W3E5AVKB8Rw). 
  * To relate a feature to another feature:


  1. In the tree view, expand both feature nodes so the Relations node under each feature node is visible. 
  2. Drag the feature you are relating to the Relations node of the primary feature.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259435)
  3. Select the relationship you want to establish between the features from the drop-down list. 
  4. Click OK. 
  5. When the new relationship appears in the Relations node of the primary feature, click to display the properties of the new relationship, and edit as necessary.

##### Relating a Feature to Itself
You can create a relationship by relating a feature to itself. Before you can create the relationship, you must have already [established the appropriate relationship](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/D~aChHJAqw7W3E5AVKB8Rw). 
  * To relate a feature to itself:


  1. In the tree view, under a specific facility, select the Relations node.
  2. From the Edit menu, select Relate to Itself. 
OR
Right-click the Relations node, and select Relate to Itself. 
OR
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259431) and select Relate to Itself. 
  3. On the Select Item dialog box, select a relationship type. 
  4. When the new relationship appears in the Relations node of the primary feature, click it to display the new relationship's properties, and edit as necessary.

##### Relating Features Using Child-to-Parent Ownership
You can relate a child feature to a parent feature using the ownership relationship. In this relationship, the [G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_FNOFIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA)= G3E_SOURCEFNO. Before you can relate a feature to another feature, you must have already [established the appropriate relationship](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/D~aChHJAqw7W3E5AVKB8Rw) and [related a feature to another feature](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/M0Jey4q0cZ7NNFI_L7_LYQ) or [related a feature to itself](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/eNzhZt9QYnKG2yKcuS3P0Q). 
  * To add a new child-to-parent ownership relationship:


  1. On the Relation dialog box General tab, do the following: 
    1. To review the relationship properties, click the Relationship arrow, select a path, and click OK to jump to the applicable relationship. Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259442) to go back to the original position in the tree view. 
    2. In the Triggering component drop-down list, select a feature component to trigger the relationship. The list contains feature components that are not already support components (G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_SUPPORTCNO). Dimensioning (4096) and all nongraphic feature components (1 and 2048) are omitted from the list. 
    3. To review the properties of the connecting feature, click the Owner feature arrow. Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259442) to go back to the original position in the tree view. 
    4. In the Owner field drop-down list, select a support component attribute. 
    5. In the Delete drop-down list, indicate if the child (owned) feature should be deleted, reowned, or orphaned when the parent feature is deleted. 
    6. To return P1 ownership errors, select it from the Enforcement drop-down list. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259442)
  2. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Relationship  |  [G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA)  |  
|  Number  |  [G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_ONO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |  
|  Triggering component  |  [G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw) of   
[G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_TRIGGERINGCNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |  
|  Owner feature  |  [G3E_FEATURE.G3E_USERNAME](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/VFyFq8MbVW9PQDgb03TtpQ) of  
[G3E_G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_OWNERFNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |  
|  Owner field  |  [G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_OWNERFIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |  
|  Delete  |  [G3E_G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_DELETE](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |  
|  Source component  |  [G3E_G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_SOURCECNO](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |  
|  Enforcement  |  [G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_ENFORCEMENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |  
  3. On the Relations dialog box Advanced tab, do the following: 
    1. From the Owner component field drop-down list, select a support component attribute. 
    2. From the Second owner field drop-down list, select a support component attribute for the second owner. 
    3. From the Second owner component field drop-down list, select a support component attribute for the second owner component. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259442)
  4. Review the information in the content panel:

|  Second owner field  |  [G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_SECONDOWNERFIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |  
|  Second owner component field  |  [G3E_OWNERSHIP.G3E_SECONDOWNERCNOFIELD](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qg4U6UhE0YMmyPrKGNwqeQ)  |

##### Relating Features Using Many-to-Many Ownership
You can relate a features to a child feature using the many-to-many ownership relationship. Before you can relate a feature to another feature, you must have already [established the appropriate relationship](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/D~aChHJAqw7W3E5AVKB8Rw) and [related a feature to another feature](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/M0Jey4q0cZ7NNFI_L7_LYQ) or [related a feature to itself](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/eNzhZt9QYnKG2yKcuS3P0Q). 
  * To add a new many-to-many ownership relationship:


  1. On the Relation dialog box General tab, do the following: 
    1. To review the relationship properties, click the Relationship arrow, select a path, and click OK to jump to the applicable relationship. Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259438) to go back to the original position in the tree view. 
    2. In the Owner triggering component drop-down list, select a feature component to trigger the relationship. The list contains feature components that are not already support components (G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_SUPPORTCNO). Dimensioning (4096) and all nongraphic feature components (1 and 2048) are omitted from the list. 
    3. Type the maximum offset and break tolerance values in their respective fields.
    4. To return P1 ownership errors, check Enforcement. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259438)
  2. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Relationship  |  [G3E_RELATIONSHIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA).G3E_USERNAME   |

##### Relating Features Using Node-Edge Connectivity
You can relate one feature to another feature using the node-edge connectivity relationship. Before you can relate a feature to another feature, you must have already [established the appropriate relationship](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/D~aChHJAqw7W3E5AVKB8Rw) and [related a feature to another feature](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/M0Jey4q0cZ7NNFI_L7_LYQ) or [related a feature to itself](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/eNzhZt9QYnKG2yKcuS3P0Q). 
  * To add a new node-edge connectivity relationship:


  1. On the Relation dialog box General tab, do the following: 
    1. To review the relationship properties, click the Relationship arrow, select a path, and click OK to jump to the applicable relationship. Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259433) to go back to the original position in the tree view. 
    2. In the Triggering component drop-down list, select a feature component to trigger the relationship. The list contains feature components that are not already support components (G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_SUPPORTCNO). Dimensioning (4096) and all nongraphic feature components (1 and 2048) are omitted from the list. 
    3. To review the properties of the connecting feature, click the Connecting feature arrow. Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259433) to go back to the original position in the tree view. 
    4. In the Connecting triggering component drop-down list, select a connecting component to trigger the relationship. The list contains feature components that are not already support components (G3E_RELATIONSHIP.G3E_SUPPORTCNO). Dimensioning (4096) and all nongraphic feature components (1 and 2048) are omitted from the list. 
    5. If required, type values for Max offset and Break tolerance. 
    6. Check Enforcement if the relationship is required. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259433)
  2. Review the information in the content panel:  
|  Panel Item  |  Reference   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Relationship  |  [G3E_RELATIONSHIP](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/kNLtlT57qrNKkSWlV3r3IA).G3E_USERNAME   |  
|  Number  |  [G3E_NODEEDGECONNECTIVITY](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/qtGEWVGTKGMEyq1xdmQpYg).G3E_NECNO   |  
|  Triggering component  |  [G3E_COMPONENT](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/mnr8C95rrztI1ZOL48OYBw).G3E_USERNAME of  
G3E_NODEEDGECONNECTIVITY.G3E_TRIGGERINGCNO   |  
|  Connecting feature  |  G3E_NODEEDGECONNECTIVITY.G3E_CONNECTINGFNO   |  
|  Connecting triggering component  |  G3E_COMPONENT.G3E_USERNAME of  
G3E_NODEEDGECONNECTIVITY.G3E_CONNECTINGTRIGGERINGCNO   |  
|  Max offset  |  G3E_NODEEDGECONNECTIVITY.G3E_MAXOFFSET   |  
|  Break tolerance  |  G3E_NODEEDGECONNECTIVITY.G3E_BREAKTOLERANCE   |  
|  Enforcement  |  G3E_NODEEDGECONNECTIVITY.G3E_ENFORCEMENT   |  
  3. On the Relations dialog box Advanced tab, do the following: 
    1. Type a value in the Source connecting node field representing the node number to connect to for the corresponding device. 
    2. Type a value in the Related connecting node field representing the node number to connect to for the corresponding device. 
    3. Check Break linear to allow the source feature to break linear features during connection. 
    4. Check Allow interior relation to allow connectivity to be established interior to linear elements (not just at endpoints). 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259433)
  4. Review the information in the content panel:

|  Allow interior relation  |  G3E_NODEEDGECONNECTIVITY.G3E_ALLOWINTERIORRELATION   |  
  5. Click Update.

##### Relating Features Using Parent-to-Child Ownership
You can relate a parent feature to a child feature using the ownership relationship. Before you can relate a feature to another feature, you must have already [established the appropriate relationship](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/D~aChHJAqw7W3E5AVKB8Rw) and [related a feature to another feature](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/M0Jey4q0cZ7NNFI_L7_LYQ) or [related a feature to itself](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/eNzhZt9QYnKG2yKcuS3P0Q).

#### Editing in GPT

##### Copying and Pasting Items in GPT
You can copy items in the Project Tool (GPT) tree view from place to place inside a Data Connection node, or you can copy items from one Data Connection node to another. You can copy an entire Data Connection or Facility node. 
You can also copy all the items under expandable nodes, designated by a folder icon, as well as items that cannot be expanded. To communicate allowable operations, the software enables or disables the copy and paste menu options. 
  * To copy and paste a single item in the GPT:


  1. In the tree view, highlight the item you want to copy.
  2. From the Edit menu, select Copy. 
OR
Right-click the item, and select Copy. 
  3. To paste the item you copied, highlight where you want to paste the item.
  4. From the Edit menu, select Paste. 
OR 
Right-click the destination, and select Paste. 


  * To copy and paste a list of children items:


  1. In the tree view, select a node that displays its children in the content panel.
  2. From the Edit menu, select Select All. 
  3. From the Edit menu, select Copy. 
  4. To paste the list of items you copied, highlight the location where you want to paste the list of children items. 
  5. From the Edit menu, select Paste. 
OR 
Right-click the destination, and select Paste.

##### Deleting Items in GPT
You can delete items from the GPT tree view at any node except those designated by a folder icon. 
![Warning](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261791) The deletions are not reversible. 
  * To delete an item from the GPT tree view:


  1. In the tree view, highlight the item you want to delete.
  2. From the Edit menu, select Delete. 
OR 
Right-click the item, and select Delete. 
OR 
Click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261791).

#### Filtering Database Items in GPT
You can use the GPT Filter command to filter items under a node designated by the ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259514) icon by writing an SQL statement. For example, if your data connection contains hundreds of components, you may want to see only the ones that have geometry. 
In addition, you can save and reuse a filter under an existing GPT view, [create a new view](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/LvaHo8qwmny2CY~RCUcO0w), or edit a previous view and make it active. Any time you create a filter, it is saved under the currently active view. If you have not created a new view, your filter is saved under the default view. 
You can also use the SHIFT key to quickly hide or filter a GPT tree view node or leaf item. You cannot hide an item designed by a ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259514). The filter is added to the currently active view. Use the Filter dialog box to remove the filter. 
  * To filter database items:


  1. Right-click any node designated by a ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259514) icon, and select Filter. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/v2ilFHHexjgD3gKg3N5D5Q-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=260fe46a0b1924f0&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  2. From the Field drop-down list, select a column name from the applicable table. 
  3. From the Operator drop-down list, select an SQL operator. 
  4. From the Value drop-down list, select a value that relates to the field you selected in Step 2. 
  5. Click the appropriate buttons to compose the filter statement.
  6. If you select the BETWEEN SQL operator, you can select a value from the Value 2 drop-down list. 
  7. Click OK. 
The ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259514) icon appears to designate that the node is filtered. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259514)
  8. To remove the filter and the filter icon from the node, do the following:
    1. Right-click the node from which you want to remove the filter.
    2. Select Filter. 
    3. Click Clear. 
    4. Click OK. 
OR
    5. From the Tools menu, select Preferences. 
    6. Select the Views tab. 
    7. Highlight a view, and double-click the filter. The view does not have to be the active view. 
    8. Click Clear, and click OK on the Filter dialog box. 


  * To create a quick-hide filter:


  1. In the tree view, right-click the item you want to hide and select Hide. 
OR
Press SHIFT.
  2. Select any tree view item you want to hide except ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259514). When selected, a ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259514) symbol appears on the parent node. 


  * To remove a quick-hide filter:


  1. Right-click the parent node.
  2. On the Filter dialog box, click Clear, and then click OK.

#### Finding Database Items in GPT
Use the GPT Find command to find an item in the database.
  * To find a database item:


  1. Select Edit > Find item. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/Xno~ew9M~xY_oV7B_VvgyA-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=6eff24eaf9f31277&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  2. Select an item to search for from the Item type drop-down list. Use the Item key or Item name fields to narrow your search. Item key is always a number and is the value of the primary key for the chosen metadata table. Item name is always the G3E_USERNAME value for the chosen metadata table. 
  3. Click Search. 
The results of the search are presented, listing their type, name, and key number.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/VtEsxg3U8IVjKLVQi2mRjQ-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=7956276bbd1fd3af&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  4. To let GPT locate the element in the tree view, highlight it, and click Find. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/m5AkzYe_skVcErEjUwTWOw-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=79dd86f2dc059a12&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  5. If more than one item meets the criteria, select the item you want, and click OK.

#### Importing a FRAMME Schema
You can use GPT to import data from a FRAMME schema. Before using this functionality, you must install the FRAMME nucleus compilers on your machine: FRMKTNUC (SU0N032AA-0400A) Version: 04.00.08.02. GPT uses the system or user variable RBNAME to identify the default rulebase. 
  * To import data from a FRAMME schema:


  1. From the Database menu, select Import. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/8JBRSk2XEqWgNA0Zj7K7gQ-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=817d7ab75554200f&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  2. Review the information and settings on the FRAMME Definition Reader dialog box:   
|  Item Name  |  Description   |  
| --- | --- |  
|  Rulebase  |  If the rulebase name as defined in the RBNAME system variable does not display at the bottom of the FRAMME Definition Reader dialog box, select Rulebase > Open and browse to it.   |  
|  Skip multi-reference components  |  Skips the multi-reference FRAMME components. If this option is not checked, components identified with COMPONENT_*_CREF* in the fdloutput file is included. By default, this option is checked.   |  
|  Use rulebase builder specifications  |  The rulebase builder specification file is /Rulebase/<rulebasename>/Tools/feature.qof. This file is used to insert user-friendly feature names from FRAMME into the NetWorks Core metadata. If the software finds a .qof file, Use rulebase builder filter specification is checked, and the browse field is disabled. If the GPT does not find the feature.qof file, you can type or browse to one.   |  
  3. Click Import. 
The feature definition items are inserted in XML format.
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/SBYcL_XVlLNcaj6qnubiPw-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=6e8e2f474b73fd85&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  4. Click Insert. FRAMME data are inserted into the database. By default, all components are inserted as LTT components. 
  5. During the insert operation, a form appears that lets you determine how you want the component definitions interpreted in the database. Select Share and check Only show this form when Shift is pressed. 
  6. Click OK.

#### Managing the Entity Keys of Your Data Model

##### Custom Scheme
Using GPT customized enumeration, you can change the range of numbers for your numbering scheme. Enumeration for customized methods is defined according to the conventions in the table. 
The variable i takes values in the set of natural numbers (thus: 1, 2, 3, 4, and so on). It denotes the primary index of the table. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/261835) The prefix G3E_ is omitted from the numbering.   
|  Name  |  Shared  |  Field  |  Custom  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  Feature  |   |  FNO  |  i  |  
|  Component  |  Shared  |  CNO  |  i  |  
|   |  Not shared  |  CNO  |  FNO•CNO  |  
|  Feature Component  |  Shared  |  FCNO  |  FNO•CNO  |  
|   |  Not shared  |  FCNO  |  CNO  |  
|  Attribute  |   |  ANO  |  CNO•ANO  |  
|  Dialogs  |   |  DNO  |  FNO•DNO  |  
|  Dialog Tab (Row) number  |   |  DRWNO  |  DNO•DRWNO  |  
|  Dialog Tab  |  Shared  |  DTNO  |  i  |  
|   |  Not shared  |  DTNO  |  DRWNO  |  
|  Tab Attribute  |   |  TANO  |  DTNO•ANO  |  
|  Component View Definition  |   |  VNO  |  FNO•i  |  
|  Component View Composition  |   |  CVNO  |  VNO•i  |  
|  Legend Entry  |   |  LENO  |  i  |  
|  Style  |   |  SNO  |  i  |  
|  Legend  |   |  LNO  |  i  |  
The (string) concatenation is indicated by the dot operator.
The concatenation of number 476 with number 55 is indicated as 476 • 55 and yields 47655.

#### Navigating GPT
The following explains how to move around in GPT:
  * To move up and down in the navigation tree, use the arrow keys.
  * To move forward and back to items you have viewed, click ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259328) or ![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259328). 
  * To move quickly through the tree view to find an item in a long list, click the parent node or the first item in the list and type the first letter of the item. 
  * To move the focus from the tree view to the content panel tabs, press TAB.
  * To move from one field to the next in the content panel, press TAB.
  * To move from one cell to the next in the grid, use the arrow keys.
  * When focus is on a tab, use the arrow keys to move from tab to tab.
  * Click a folder node to display the items listed in the node in the content panel. Use the View menu or the corresponding buttons to change the display. 
  * Double-click most items listed on a Links tab to jump to the item in the tree view and to display the properties for the item in the content panel.

#### Setting GPT Preferences
In GPT, you can set preferences for security, logging, model correction, and messages. Settings for creating a location for a log file, [creating a GPT script file](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/N8n8rkGaM~hOnNFSI42psQ), logging in to a data source, and setting preferences are stored in the registry under HKEY_CURRENT_USER > Software > Intergraph > GPT_Explorer > Settings. 
  * To set GPT preferences:


  1. From the Tools menu, select Preferences. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/259502)
  2. Click each tab to set preferences as required.
Security—If you check both options, the last database to which you connected appears when you reopen GPT. 
Logging—Check to create a session log file and then browse to determine its location. The log file keeps a record of all scripts being run in your database. 
Model Corrections—You can direct the software not to automatically fix model corrections, to prompt you before correcting abnormalities, and to automatically correct all database abnormalities. 
Messages—You can make selections about the appearance of messages that display in the message panel. 
Views—A [GPT view](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/LvaHo8qwmny2CY~RCUcO0w) lets you filter the contents of your database for easier manipulation and editing. Views also let you capture and produce information about only a portion of your database for use with the [Create Document](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/X3c5hKouhrk~TPFcEUgWtg) command.

## Validate Deltas and Component View Consistency
If NetWorks Core does not connect to a configuration properly, run the Validate Deltas Consistency tool to verify that the mapfiles, the database, and the MODIFICATIONLOG are consistent for all the component views in that configuration. If you have run the Validate Deltas Consistency tool and you are still experiencing connection problems, run the batch [DDCScan tool](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/TB18t6t85L_5sL~pfKouTQ). 
  * To validate deltas and component view consistency:


  1. Navigate to NetWorks Core > Administrative Tools > Validate Deltas Consistency. 
![](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/256075?tocId=EDODAmcLctOR521WtAnL0w)
  2. On the Validate Deltas Consistency dialog box, type the username and password, and select the configuration you want to validate. 
  3. To run a verification on the MODIFICATIONLOG, mapfiles, and the database, check Validate MODIFICATIONLOG consistency, and click Validate. 
OR
To verify the mapfiles and the database only, do not check Validate MODIFICATIONLOG consistency, and click Validate. If this verification does not find errors, check Validate MODIFICATIONLOG consistency, and click Validate. 
The software writes problems to ValidateDeltasConsistency.txt in the temporary folder on your machine. This file is recreated each time you execute ValidateDeltasConsistency.exe. If you validate multiple configurations without closing the dialog box, all reports are retained in the file. 
  4. Fix any problems, [republish the mapfiles](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/KMyb7We6CN6SLJS3Anpyuw), and [purge the MODIFICATIONLOG](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/36P2JjlfzXGWnwVEIkdiqQ). 
  5. To validate other configurations, repeat Steps 2 through 4.

## Centralized Password Vault

### Client Configuration for Centralized Password Vault
  * To update an existing password vault:

### Password Vault Manager
Password vault manager is used to create and manage the centralized password vault. Administrators can create a new password vault; and add, delete, or update the database credentials stored within the vault. 
  * To create a new password vault:


  1. From the Start menu in the NetWorks Core drop-down list, select Password Vault Manager. 
  2. Select Create New Password Vault and click Next.  

![PasswordVault_CreateNew](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/zww7aK0FFgEZqmp8cHfMKQ-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=b3aaf577df1b092e&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  3. Provide the necessary parameters required to create the centralized password vault. 
    1. Vault Location: This represents the location where the vault files are created. Ensure that the selected vault location is accessible to all users of NetWorks Core, HxGN NetWorks Comms, and HxGN NetWorks Web Services. Give the administrator full access to this location, and give the client read-only access. 
    2. Admin Password: This represents the administrative password required to manage the contents of the centralized password vault. 
    3. Master Password: This represents the master key used to lock or unlock the contents of the centralized password vault. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1077514) The minimum password length for both administrator and master passwords is eight characters. The same password value should not be used for both administrator and master password. 
![PasswordVault_MasterAndAdminPassword](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/qVkNHU~iUEmjMv3OP72wQQ-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=f0c77b995ff6de2b&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  4. When you have completed all the fields, click Create. 
A data grid is displayed. The administrator can add, update, or delete database connection strings. 
     * The Configuration column provides a dropdown list of NetWorks Core configurations retrieved from the CCM file. 
     * The Username column is a text box that represents the database username. 
     * The Password column is a password control that represents the database password.
![PasswordVault_Add](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1077514)
  5. Click Add to create a new row within the data grid. Select a configuration and type the username and password. Repeat the process to add more rows to the data grid. Click Save to encrypt and save the rows within the centralized password vault. 
![Note](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/r/en-US/HxGN-NetWorks-Core-Admin-Help/1077514) The combination of Configuration and Username should be unique. The database connection string is validated before saving it to the vault. If an error occurs, hover over the red flag displayed to the left of the grid to see the error message. 
![PasswordVault_InvalidConnectionString](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/DjFIB8Qt_b1l5b9lDb7ing-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=44ea46cae50c85e8&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)


Changing Passwords
Using the password vault manager, administrators can change administrator or master passwords. 
  * To change a password:


  1. Click Settings in the bottom left corner. 
![PasswordVault_Settings](https://hexagonppm.fluidtopics.net/api/khub/maps/_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/resources/8twJVPCZF5redNU6GSgoqw-_OIjXZnxNqnWnqZEcXwqLA/content?v=8d646a139dbf2552&Ft-Calling-App=ft/turnkey-portal)
  2. To change the administrator password, select Change Admin Password, enter the new administrator password, confirm it, and click Update.
